1.title: Grammar Auction: paraphrases about cities
1.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Shahar mavzusidagi paraphrase gaplarda Band 5 darajadagi tipik xatoni topish: known for, cheaper than, a large number of, rise/raise, one of the + ko'plik, ega-kesim moslashuvi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Paraphrase iboralariga (known for, cheaper than, short of) alohida qarang.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Rio de Janeiro is well known with its beaches and carnival.
items.fix: Rio de Janeiro is well known for its beaches and carnival.
items.why: well known / famous / known + FOR ('with' emas).

items.s: Office workers in big cities are often short of time.
items.why: be short OF time = have little time — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: A flat in a small town is more cheaper than a flat in the capital.
items.fix: A flat in a small town is cheaper than a flat in the capital.
items.why: costs less = is cheaper; 'more' va '-er' birga ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: Lilongwe is famous for its friendly and helpful inhabitants.
items.why: famous for + ot; inhabitants = residents (ko'plik).

items.s: The population of the village fell to about 3,000.
items.why: fell to = dropped to; raqam — 'langar', matnda odatda o'zgarmaydi.

items.s: Noise levels in the city centre raised last year.
items.fix: Noise levels in the city centre rose last year.
items.why: rise – rose (o'zi ko'tariladi); raise – biror narsani ko'taradi.

items.s: Very few tourists visits the village in winter.
items.fix: Very few tourists visit the village in winter.
items.why: tourists — ko'plik, shuning uchun visit (-s qo'shilmaydi).

items.s: Many young people leave villages because there are not many jobs.
items.why: not many = very few; gap grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.

items.s: The standard of living in Tashkent has improved in recent years.
items.why: quality of life = standard of living; Present Perfect + in recent years.

items.s: Paris has a large amount of museums and art galleries.
items.fix: Paris has a large number of museums and art galleries.
items.why: Sanaladigan ot: a large number of; 'amount' — sanalmaydigan (traffic).

items.s: Life in a village is less expensive than life in the capital.
items.why: costs less = is less expensive — so'z turkumi o'zgargan paraphrase.

items.s: Samarkand is one of the most famous city in Central Asia.
items.fix: Samarkand is one of the most famous cities in Central Asia.
items.why: one of the + ko'plik ot: cities.

1.title: Board Game: Paraphrase Race
1.stage: Keyingi dars boshida o'tgan darsni takrorlash uchun, Kirish o'rniga (20 daqiqa)
1.goal: Sinonim, antonim + inkor, so'z turkumi o'zgarishi va umumlashtirish orqali paraphrase qilish; Table completion qoidalarini og'zaki takrorlash; shahar mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni ovoz chiqarib bajaradi: sinonim aytadi, gapni boshqacha aytadi yoki savolga javob beradi.
Guruh a'zolari javoblar varag'i bilan tekshiradi. Ma'nosi saqlangan boshqa paraphrase ham qabul qilinadi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato yoki javob bo'lmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Give a synonym: famous
squares.a: well-known

squares.t: Give a synonym: began
squares.a: started

squares.t: Paraphrase: a lot of people
squares.a: many people / a large number of people

squares.t: What is a paraphrase? Explain in one sentence.
squares.a: The same meaning expressed in different words.

squares.t: Paraphrase with 'not': cheap
squares.a: not expensive

squares.t: One word for 'people who live in a city'?
squares.a: residents / inhabitants

squares.t: Which words are easy to find because they rarely change?
squares.a: Names, dates, numbers and places — the 'anchors'.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about your favourite city.
squares.a: e.g. I love Samarkand because it is full of history and great food.

squares.t: Paraphrase: the price went up
squares.a: the cost increased / rose

squares.t: Change the word form: 'It costs less.' → 'It is …'
squares.a: It is cheaper. / It is less expensive.

squares.t: The text says 'money'. You write 'cash'. Is it correct?
squares.a: No — copy the word from the text: money.

squares.t: Paraphrase: quality of life
squares.a: standard of living

squares.t: Paraphrase with 'not': shallow
squares.a: not deep

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY: is 'about a third' a good answer? Why?
squares.a: No — it is three words; write only 'third'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: don't pay attention to
squares.a: ignore

squares.t: Ask your partner a question about his/her hometown.
squares.a: e.g. What do you like most about your hometown?

squares.t: Give one general word for: Tashkent, Bukhara, Khiva
squares.a: cities (Uzbek cities)

squares.t: Paraphrase: be short of time
squares.a: have little time / not have enough time

squares.t: The text says 'residents'. You write 'resident'. Correct?
squares.a: No — keep the plural form from the text: residents.

squares.t: Paraphrase the sentence: 'The city is extremely noisy.'
squares.a: e.g. The city is very loud.

squares.t: Say 2 good and 2 bad things about life in a big city.
squares.a: e.g. more jobs, good transport; heavy traffic, noise

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Not many tourists visit in winter.'
squares.a: e.g. Very few tourists come in winter.

squares.t: Why do IELTS texts use different words from the questions?
squares.a: To test whether you understand the meaning, not whether you can match words.

squares.t: Should cities ban cars from the centre? Give 2 reasons.
squares.a: e.g. Yes: the air becomes cleaner and the streets become safer.

1.title: Dominoes: paraphrase pairs (city life)
1.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida, so'zlar jadvali o'rniga (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: Savoldagi so'z yoki iborani matndagi paraphrase bilan juftlash: sinonim (famous — well-known), antonim + inkor (shallow — not deep), so'z turkumi o'zgarishi (costs less — is cheaper).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z yoki iboraning paraphrase'i (ma'nosi bir xil ibora) qaysi toshning chap tomonida turganini toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'residents — people who live there'. Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; har juftni gapda ishlatib bergan guruhga +1 bonus.

1.title: Taboo: city life
1.stage: Dars boshida, Kirish bosqichida mavzuga isitish uchun (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
1.goal: Shahar hayoti so'zlarini ularning o'zini aytmasdan boshqa so'zlar bilan tushuntirish — og'zaki paraphrase mashqi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (ya'ni so'zni paraphrase qiladi).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who… has lived in more than one city
1.stage: 2-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin, Tahlildan oldin harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa)
1.goal: Shahar hayoti mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va javob berishda savoldagi so'zni sinonim bilan almashtirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever lived in more than one city?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where? When? Why?).
Javob beruvchi savoldagi so'zni takrorlamay, sinonim bilan javob berishga harakat qiladi (big → large, noisy → loud).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has lived in more than one city.
items.q: Have you ever lived in more than one city?

items.t: …has visited Samarkand or Bukhara this year.
items.q: Have you visited Samarkand or Bukhara this year?

items.t: …would rather live in a village than in a big city.
items.q: Would you rather live in a village than in a big city?

items.t: …walks to school or work every day.
items.q: Do you walk to school or work every day?

items.t: …has been stuck in a traffic jam this week.
items.q: Have you been stuck in a traffic jam this week?

items.t: …knows the names of all his/her neighbours.
items.q: Do you know the names of all your neighbours?

items.t: …has helped a stranger in the street recently.
items.q: Have you helped a stranger in the street recently?

items.t: …thinks Tashkent is too noisy.
items.q: Do you think Tashkent is too noisy?

items.t: …uses public transport more often than a car.
items.q: Do you use public transport more often than a car?

items.t: …would like to study in a big city abroad.
items.q: Would you like to study in a big city abroad?

items.t: …can give three synonyms for 'big'.
items.q: Can you give three synonyms for 'big'?

items.t: …has read an article in English about a city.
items.q: Have you ever read an article in English about a city?

1.title: Speaking cards: city life (Part 1 and Part 3)
1.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin, Listening bosqichi vaqtida (bu darsda listening materiali yo'q) (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga shahar hayoti mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; savoldagi kalit so'zni takrorlamay paraphrase qilish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va savoldagi kalit so'zni kamida bir marta sinonim bilan almashtiradi (famous → well-known).
Tinglovchi har bir to'g'ri paraphrase uchun +1 ball beradi; savoldagi so'zni aynan takrorlash ball bermaydi.
'Paraphrase challenge' kartalarida qavsdagi so'zni javobda aytish taqiqlanadi — aytsa, 0 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Where is your hometown? Is it a city, a town or a village?
What do you like most about the place where you live?
Is your hometown a good place for young people? Why / why not?
How do you usually travel around your city?
Is there anything you would like to change in your neighbourhood?
Do you know your neighbours well? Do you help each other?
Which city in Uzbekistan would you recommend to a foreign tourist, and why?
Do you prefer quiet places or busy places? Why?
Why do many young people leave villages and move to big cities?
Are people in big cities less friendly than people in small towns? Why?
Should governments pay people to live in small towns? Why / why not?
What can cities do to reduce traffic and noise?
How has life in your city changed in the last ten years?
Which matters more for a city: a strong economy or a high quality of life?
Paraphrase challenge (don't say 'famous'): Is your city famous for anything?
Paraphrase challenge (don't say 'expensive'): Is it expensive to live in your city?

1.title: Sentence Race: paraphrase rules and city facts
1.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uy vazifasi berilishidan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
1.goal: Paraphrase qoidalari va shahar mavzusidagi gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish; tayyor gapdagi bitta so'zga sinonim topish.
materials: Har gap uchun alohida konvert (so'zlar qirqilgan holda)
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: bosh harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi — to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: gapdagi bitta so'zga sinonim aytsa (masalan, residents → inhabitants, famous → well-known).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The answer must be a word from the passage.
Always look for synonyms of the key words.
Names and dates stay the same in the passage.
The word 'residents' has the same meaning as 'inhabitants'.
People who live in a city are called its residents.
Many young people are leaving villages for the capital.
Traffic has fallen by half since the new metro line opened.
Very few tourists visit the museum in winter.
Samarkand is famous for its old buildings and delicious food.

1.title: Quiz Board: paraphrase and city words
1.stage: Tahlil bosqichidan keyin, dars oxirida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
1.goal: Paraphrase qoidalari, sinonim va antonim + inkor juftlari, shahar mavzusidagi so'zlar va og'zaki paraphrase'ni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'lim) va 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Paraphrase it' va 'Say it!' bo'limlarida ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What do you underline in the question first?
Can you write your own synonym as the answer?
qs.a: No — copy the word from the text.

qs.q: Which words rarely change in the text: names, dates and numbers — or verbs?
Name the 4 types of paraphrase from today's lesson.
qs.a: synonym, word form, antonym + not, general word

qs.q: ONE WORD ONLY. You write 'the residents'. How many marks? Why?
famous = ?
not deep = ? (one word)
the price went up = ?
costs less than = ? (use 'is' + an adjective)
qs.a: is cheaper than / is less expensive than

qs.q: people who have just moved in = ? (one word, starts with 'new')
A person who lives in a place is a …
The head of a town or city is the …
Too many cars on the road = heavy …
Money you pay every month to live in someone else's flat is …
The path next to a road where people walk is the …
Say a sentence about your city with 'famous for'.
qs.a: e.g. Bukhara is famous for its ancient architecture.

qs.q: Say 'The city is not safe' in another way.
Paraphrase: 'Not many people live here.'
qs.a: e.g. Very few people live here.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'Life in the capital costs a lot.'
qs.a: e.g. The capital is an expensive place to live.

qs.q: Talk for 30 seconds: city or village? Use 2 paraphrases.
qs.a: e.g. Villages are quieter and less stressful.

2.title: Grammar Auction: does the answer fit the gap?
2.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
2.goal: To'ldirilgan izoh gaplarida [qavs] ichidagi javob bo'sh joy grammatikasiga mosligini tekshirish: birlik/ko'plik, so'z turkumi (ot/sifat), must be + V3, ONE WORD chegarasi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi. [Qavs] ichidagi so'z — o'quvchi yozgan javob. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: javob bo'sh joyga grammatik jihatdan mos keladimi?
Maslahat: qavsdan oldingi va keyingi so'zga qarang — son + ko'plik, 'the ___' — ot, 'must be ___' — V3, 'one of the' — ko'plik, '___ than' — qiyosiy sifat.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi. Xato javobni birinchi tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The Happy Planet Index was created in [2008].
items.why: 'in' + yil: kutilgan tur — son (yil).

items.s: The index looks at each country's impact on the [environmental].
items.fix: The index looks at each country's impact on the [environment].
items.why: 'the ___' dan keyin OT kerak: environment (sifat emas).

items.s: Costa Rica is one of the greenest [country] in the world.
items.fix: Costa Rica is one of the greenest [countries] in the world.
items.why: 'one of the' + ko'plik ot: countries.

items.s: Every member pays a yearly [fee] of 50 dollars.
items.why: 'a yearly ___ of' — birlik ot kerak: fee.

items.s: The survey takes about three [hour] per household.
items.fix: The survey takes about three [hours] per household.
items.why: 'three' dan keyin ko'plik ot: hours.

items.s: Young people often leave to find better-paid [jobs] abroad.
items.why: Sifat + ko'plik ot; 'a' yo'q, shuning uchun jobs.

items.s: Members can borrow tools such as drills and [ladders].
items.why: 'drills and ___' — bir xil tur: ko'plik ot.

items.s: New reeds must be [add] to the island regularly.
items.fix: New reeds must be [added] to the island regularly.
items.why: 'must be' + V3 (majhul nisbat): added.

items.s: Bhutan's constitution protects the country's [forests].
items.why: "the country's ___" — ot kerak; forests mos keladi.

items.s: The library's most popular item is the pressure [washers].
items.fix: The library's most popular item is the pressure [washer].
items.why: 'item is the ___' — bitta narsa: birlik (washer).

items.s: In the survey, most citizens said they were [happier] than before.
items.why: '___ than' — qiyosiy sifat: happier.

items.s: (ONE WORD ONLY) The islands are made of [the reeds].
items.fix: (ONE WORD ONLY) The islands are made of [reeds].
items.why: Artikl ortiqcha: ikki so'z — ONE WORD chegarasi buziladi.

2.title: Board Game: Predict the Answer
2.stage: Keyingi dars boshida o'tgan darsni takrorlash uchun, Kirish o'rniga (20 daqiqa)
2.goal: Bo'sh joy atrofidagi grammatikadan javob turini bashorat qilish (yil, son, ot, sifat, fe'l); note completion qoidalari, paraphrase va baxt/hayot sifati mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi. 'Predict the type' kataklarida javob TURINI aytadi (yil, son, ot, sifat, fe'l) va bitta misol keltiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javoblar varag'i bilan tekshiradi; misol boshqacha bo'lsa ham, turi to'g'ri bo'lsa — qabul qilinadi.
Xato yoki javob bo'lmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Predict the type: 'Year opened: ___'
squares.a: a year, e.g. 2013

squares.t: Predict the type: 'Number of members: about ___'
squares.a: a number, e.g. 5,000

squares.t: Predict the type: 'the ___ of the town'
squares.a: a noun, e.g. centre / population

squares.t: Predict the type: 'It is a very ___ place.'
squares.a: an adjective, e.g. quiet

squares.t: Paraphrase: effect
squares.a: impact

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: what makes you happy?
squares.a: e.g. My family, my friends and football make me happy.

squares.t: Predict the type: 'Visitors can borrow tents and ___.'
squares.a: a noun, usually plural, e.g. ladders

squares.t: Paraphrase: lends
squares.a: allows people to borrow

squares.t: Gap: '___ metres'. Is '3,812 metres' a good answer?
squares.a: No — 'metres' is already there; write only 3,812.

squares.t: Predict the type: 'The survey takes about ___ hours.'
squares.a: a number, e.g. three / 3

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY: why is 'the environment' wrong?
squares.a: It is two words; write 'environment'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: artificial
squares.a: man-made

squares.t: Ask your partner about the happiest day of his/her life.
squares.a: e.g. What was the happiest day of your life?

squares.t: Predict the type: 'Unemployment reached ___ per cent.'
squares.a: a number, e.g. 29

squares.t: Predict the type: 'Most people ___ to work by bus.'
squares.a: a verb, e.g. go / travel

squares.t: Paraphrase: yearly
squares.a: annual / every year

squares.t: Are note completion answers always in the same order as the text?
squares.a: Not always — find each one by its key word.

squares.t: Predict the type: 'The city has two ___.'
squares.a: a plural noun, e.g. universities

squares.t: What do you read first, before the text?
squares.a: The title and the notes — then predict each gap.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: borrow tools or buy them? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Borrow: it saves money, and I rarely need a drill.

squares.t: Predict the type: 'designed by a ___ from Costa Rica'
squares.a: a noun (a person or job), e.g. professor

squares.t: You expect a year, but the text says '143 countries'. Is 143 your answer?
squares.a: No — it counts countries, not a year; keep scanning for a date.

squares.t: Part 3: Can a country measure happiness? How?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — with surveys about health, free time and trust.

squares.t: Part 3: Should tourists pay extra to visit fragile places like floating islands?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — the money can protect the place and help local families.

2.title: Dominoes: note words and text words
2.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida — jadval o'rniga (10 daqiqa)
2.goal: Izohdagi (note) so'zni matndagi paraphrase bilan juftlash — parosat yetmagan joyda javobni topish uchun (effect = impact, uses = consumes).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.

Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'effect — impact'. Ustoz tekshiradi.

2.title: Taboo: happiness, sharing and islands

O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever taken part in a survey?).

Tinglovchi ball beradi: to'g'ri bashorat +1, 3 gapli to'liq javob +1, savoldagi so'zni sinonim bilan almashtirish +1.

2.title: Sentence Race: prediction tips and notes
2.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uy vazifasi berilishidan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
2.goal: Bashorat (parosat) qoidalari va mavzu gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish; gap ichidagi grammatik belgilarni (artikl, son, 'more than') ko'rish.
materials: Har gap uchun alohida konvert (so'zlar qirqilgan holda)
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: bosh harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi — to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapdagi bitta so'zning turini aytsa (ot, fe'l, sifat yoki son) — bu bashorat mashqi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Read the title before you look at the passage.
Numbers and dates are easy to find in the passage.
An article before the gap usually means a noun.
Never write more words than the instructions allow.
Your answer must be grammatically correct in the gap.
Members pay an annual fee to borrow tools.

2.title: Quiz Board: predict, paraphrase, happiness

2.goal: Javob turini bashorat qilish, note completion qoidalari, izoh ↔ matn paraphrase'lari va baxt/bo'lishish mavzusidagi so'zlarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'lim) va 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Predict the type 200').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Paraphrase it' bo'limida ma'nosi bir xil boshqa sinonim, 'Say it!' bo'limida esa grammatik to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

3.title: Grammar Auction: booking calls and form answers
3.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
3.goal: Part 1 qo'ng'iroqlaridagi gaplarda (bron, narx, sana, imlo) tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish: ko'plik (months, children), 'on + kun', make a mistake, information, accommodation imlosi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (bular Part 1 qo'ng'irog'ida aytiladigan gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: nine month → nine months, accomodation → accommodation).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Could you spell the name of your street, please?
items.why: Part 1 dagi odatiy so'rov: Could you spell…? — to'g'ri va xushmuomala.

items.s: We'd like to stay for nine month, until June.
items.fix: We'd like to stay for nine months, until June.
items.why: Sondan keyin ot ko'plikda: nine months. Formada ham shunday yoziladi.

items.s: I'd like to book a single room from the 10th of September.
items.why: book a single room + from + sana (the 10th of September) — to'g'ri.

items.s: I'm looking for accomodation close to the library.
items.fix: I'm looking for accommodation close to the library.
items.why: Imlo: accommodation — ikkita c, ikkita m. Imlo xatosi = 0 ball.

items.s: I'd like to start my membership in Monday the 1st.
items.fix: I'd like to start my membership on Monday the 1st.
items.why: Hafta kuni va sanadan oldin 'on' ishlatiladi: on Monday, on the 1st.

items.s: The taxi will pick us up at a quarter to six.
items.why: Vaqt: at + a quarter to six (5.45) — to'g'ri.

items.s: The flat is for five people: two adults and three childs.
items.fix: The flat is for five people: two adults and three children.
items.why: child so'zining ko'pligi — children; 'childs' degan shakl yo'q.

items.s: My surname is Matthews: M-A-double T-H-E-W-S.
items.why: 'double T' = TT. Ism harflab to'g'ri aytilgan.

items.s: Sorry, I did a mistake — it's the 10th, not the 3rd.
items.fix: Sorry, I made a mistake — it's the 10th, not the 3rd.
items.why: Birikma: make a mistake ('do' emas).

items.s: I'm calling to enquire about renting a flat near the station.
items.why: enquire about + -ing — rasmiy va to'g'ri.

items.s: Could you give me an information about the prices?
items.fix: Could you give me some information about the prices?
items.why: information — sanalmaydigan ot: 'an' qo'yilmaydi, 'some' ishlatiladi.

items.s: Our budget is 450 pounds a month, including bills.
items.why: 450 pounds (ko'plik) + a month; including bills — to'g'ri.

3.title: Board Game: Part 1 form completion
3.stage: Track 3 tinglanib, javoblar tekshirilgandan keyin mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
3.goal: Harflab aytish, raqam / sana / narx / vaqtni o'qish va yozish, tuzatishni eshitish, so'z chegarasi qoidasi hamda Part 1 mavzusida (bron, forma, turar joy) gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: harflab aytadi, raqamni o'qiydi, qoidani tushuntiradi yoki gapiradi.
Harflab aytish va raqam kataklarida o'ngdagi o'yinchi eshitganini qog'ozga yozadi — yozuv to'g'ri chiqsagina topshiriq bajarilgan hisoblanadi.
Guruh javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi; xato bo'lsa o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

3.title: Dominoes: spoken numbers, dates and spelling

rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida so'zlovchi AYTGAN shakl bor (oh nine eight double five) — formaga YOZILADIGAN shaklini (09855) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.

Diqqat: fifteen / fifty, thirteenth / thirtieth, half past / a quarter to — o'xshash juftlar ataylab qo'shilgan.

Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: In Part 1, how many times do you hear the recording?

4.title: Grammar Auction: describing a process
4.stage: 1-qo'shimcha reading (pencil) tahlilidan keyin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Flow chart matnlaridagi jarayon tilida tipik xatolarni topish: passiv (is cut, are dyed, is mixed), once / after dan keyin 'will' ishlatilmasligi, First va At first farqi, 'born in'.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (bular jarayon yoki sayohatchi hayoti haqidagi gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: is cutted → is cut, will be dry → is dry).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: First, the silkworm cocoons are collected and sorted.
items.why: Jarayonning birinchi bosqichi: First + passiv (are collected).

items.s: Once the paint will be dry, the name is stamped on each pencil.
items.fix: Once the paint is dry, the name is stamped on each pencil.
items.why: Vaqt bog'lovchisidan (once, when, after) keyin 'will' ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: Then the cocoons are boiled in water to soften them.
items.why: Then + passiv (are boiled) + maqsad (to soften) — to'g'ri.

items.s: After that, the paper is cutted into sheets.
items.fix: After that, the paper is cut into sheets.
items.why: cut — noto'g'ri fe'l: cut – cut – cut.

items.s: The threads are dyeing in bright colours.
items.fix: The threads are dyed in bright colours.
items.why: Passiv: be + V3 (dyed). '-ing' iplarni o'zi bo'yayapti degan ma'no beradi.

items.s: The cocoa beans are roasted at a high temperature.
items.why: Passiv: are + roasted; 'at a high temperature' — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: The pencil lead is made from a mixture of graphite and clay.
items.why: be made from + xomashyo — to'g'ri.

items.s: The used paper mixed with water to make a pulp.
items.fix: The used paper is mixed with water to make a pulp.
items.why: Passivda 'be' tushib qolmaydi: is mixed.

items.s: Finally, the bread is baked in a tandir.
items.why: Oxirgi bosqich: Finally + passiv (is baked).

items.s: At first, the raw cotton is cleaned; then it is spun into thread.
items.fix: First, the raw cotton is cleaned; then it is spun into thread.
items.why: Bosqich sanashda 'First'. 'At first' = avvaliga (keyin vaziyat o'zgargan).

items.s: Patrick Malone gave up his job to join the expedition.
items.why: give up (tashlab ketmoq) + to join (maqsad) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Freya Stark was born at Paris to a family of artists.
items.fix: Freya Stark was born in Paris to a family of artists.
items.why: Shahar va mamlakat oldidan 'in': born in Paris.

4.title: Board Game: question order, flow charts, short answers
4.stage: Sinf mashqi ('Guruhini toping') dan keyin mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Savollar tartibi guruhlari (ALWAYS / USUALLY / NEVER), flow chart bo'sh joyining turi (fe'l / ot), short answer so'z chegarasi, paraphrase va jarayonni ketma-ketlik so'zlari bilan gapirib berish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase topadi yoki gapiradi.
'Is … in order?' kataklarida javob uchta so'zdan biri bo'ladi: always, usually yoki never — va bitta sabab aytiladi.
Guruh javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi; xato bo'lsa o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Is True / False / Not Given in text order? (always / usually / never)
squares.a: Always in text order.

squares.t: Put in order: Finally / First / After that
squares.a: First → After that → Finally

squares.t: Short answer: 'Who…?' What kind of answer do you need?
squares.a: A person (a name or a job).

squares.t: Is Matching Headings in text order?
squares.a: Never — each paragraph is checked separately.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'by hand'
squares.a: manually

squares.t: Short answer: 'How many…?' What kind of answer do you need?
squares.a: A number.

squares.t: Is Flow-chart completion in text order?
squares.a: Usually — but it is not guaranteed.

squares.t: Name four words that show the next step in a process.
squares.a: e.g. then, next, after that, once, finally

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'heated in an oven'
squares.a: baked (or roasted)

squares.t: Gap: '___ the mixture'. Do you need a verb or a noun?
squares.a: A verb (e.g. stir, heat).

squares.t: Is Matching Features in text order?
squares.a: Never.

squares.t: Gap: 'put it in a ___'. Do you need a verb or a noun?
squares.a: A noun (e.g. box, mould).

squares.t: Say three steps of making tea with First, Then and Finally.
squares.a: e.g. First, boil the water. Then add the tea. Finally, pour it into cups.

squares.t: Short answer: 'When…?' What kind of answer do you need?
squares.a: A time or a date (e.g. in 1912, in winter).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'crushed into small pieces'
squares.a: ground

squares.t: Sentence Completion: you found Q2 and Q4. Where is Q3?
squares.a: In the text between the answers to Q2 and Q4.

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS. Is 'It takes six weeks' OK?
squares.a: No — write only 'six weeks'.

squares.t: Is Summary Completion in text order?
squares.a: Usually (sometimes it covers only one part of the text).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'She was awarded a prize.'
squares.a: She won / received a prize.

squares.t: Limit: ONE WORD ONLY. Is 'the factory' OK?
squares.a: No — write 'factory'; 'the' counts as a second word.

squares.t: Your answer is right but in your own words. Do you get a mark?
squares.a: No — copy the word(s) from the text.

squares.t: Why does knowing the question order save time?
squares.a: You read the text once, from start to end, answer by answer.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds about a process you know (e.g. baking non).
squares.a: e.g. First, the dough is made. Then it is left to rise. Finally, it is baked.

squares.t: Explain the three question-order groups with one example each.
squares.a: Always: TFNG; Usually: flow chart; Never: matching headings.

4.title: Dominoes: process paraphrases
4.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Matndagi so'zni savoldagi paraphrase bilan moslash (baked = heated in an oven, ground = crushed into powder) — flow chart va short answer javobini topishning asosiy ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida MATNDAGI so'z bor (baked) — uning SAVOLDAGI paraphrase'ini (heated in an oven) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Bonus: har juftni jarayon gapida ishlating (The bread is baked = heated in an oven).

4.title: Taboo: processes and explorers
4.stage: Kirish (isitish) bosqichida — o'tgan dars takroridan keyin (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Jarayon va sayohat mavzusidagi so'zlarni (expedition, factory, harvest, melt, dye, raw material…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Topilgan so'z bilan jarayon gapi aytilsa (masalan: The chocolate is melted…) — yana +1 ball.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

4.title: Find someone who… has seen how something is made
4.stage: 1- va 2-qo'shimcha reading orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Can you…? savollarini tuzish; jarayon, hunarmandchilik, qayta ishlash va sayohat tajribasi haqida qisqa suhbat.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever visited a factory?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va short answer uslubidagi bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? How long?) — javob 1–3 so'z bilan yoziladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 natijani sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has visited a factory and seen how something is made.
items.q: Have you ever visited a factory and seen how something is made?

items.t: …has seen how silk is made in Margilan.
items.q: Have you ever seen how silk is made in Margilan?

items.q: Can you explain how plov is cooked, step by step?

items.q: Have you ever baked bread or a cake without any help?

items.t: …has read a biography of a famous explorer or traveller.
items.q: Have you ever read a biography of a famous explorer or traveller?

items.t: …has travelled somewhere remote, far from any city.
items.q: Have you ever travelled somewhere remote, far from any city?

items.t: …reads the questions before reading the text.
items.q: Do you read the questions before you read the text?

items.t: …has drawn a flow chart or a mind map for a school project.
items.q: Have you ever drawn a flow chart or a mind map for a school project?

items.q: Would you like to join a scientific expedition?

items.q: Do you speak three or more languages?

items.q: Have you ever made something by hand, such as a bracelet or a card?

4.title: Speaking cards: making things and exploring
4.stage: 2-qo'shimcha reading tahlilidan keyin gapirish, Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Qo'l mehnati, zavod mahsulotlari, qayta ishlash va sayohatchilar mavzusida Part 1 va Part 3 javoblari; jarayonni ketma-ketlik so'zlari (first, then, finally) bilan aytib berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi: javob + sabab + misol. 'Part 3' kartalarida 4–5 gap.
Tinglovchi javobdagi ketma-ketlik so'zlari (first, then, after that, finally) va passiv gaplarni sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy making things by hand? What was the last thing you made?

4.title: Sentence Race: process and question-order sentences
4.stage: Xulosa va vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Jarayon gaplari (passiv + ketma-ketlik so'zi), short answer savoli va savollar tartibi qoidalarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) bering.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: bosh harf gap boshini, vergul va nuqta esa so'z o'rnini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert. Gap qoida bo'lsa, qaysi savol turiga tegishli ekanini aytgan jamoa +1 bonus oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Next, the cocoons are boiled to loosen the silk thread.
Flow chart answers usually come in the same order as the text.
In Matching Headings, the answers are never in text order.
The beans are roasted before their shells are broken off.

Write no more than three words for each answer.
Freya Stark learned Arabic while she was staying in Lebanon.

4.title: Quiz Board: question order, flow charts, short answers
4.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars kirishida (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Savollar tartibi, flow chart va short answer qoidalari, paraphrase hamda 'Say it!' savollari orqali darsni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Question order 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30–40 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Are True / False / Not Given questions in text order?
Are Matching Headings questions in text order?
Which group is Flow-chart completion in: always, usually or never?
Short answer: you found Q4. Where do you look for Q3?
qs.a: Before the answer to Q4 (and after the answer to Q2).

qs.q: Name three question types that are NEVER in text order.
qs.a: Any 3: Matching Headings / Information / Features, Classification…

qs.q: Which question word asks for a person?
Gap: '___ the mixture'. Which part of speech do you need?
Give three words that show the next step in a process.
qs.a: e.g. then, next, after that, finally, once

qs.q: Limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS. Is 'a small wooden box' OK?
Your answer is correct but it is in your own words. How many marks?
qs.a: 0 — use the exact word(s) from the text.

qs.q: 'made cold' = one word?
'a research trip' — which noun means the same?
'take off the labels' — replace 'take off' with one verb.
Paraphrase 'at the same time' with one word often used in process texts.
'She won a gold medal.' Say it with the passive.
qs.a: She was awarded a gold medal.

qs.q: Name three things that are made in factories.
Say three steps of making a sandwich with First, Then and Finally.
qs.a: e.g. First, cut the bread. Then add the cheese. Finally, close it.

qs.q: Say how a pencil is made in three passive sentences.
qs.a: e.g. The wood is cut. The lead is baked. The pencils are painted.

qs.q: Talk for 30 seconds about an explorer or traveller you admire.
qs.a: e.g. Ibn Battuta travelled for almost 30 years…

qs.q: Explain the question-order rule to a new student in 30 seconds.
qs.a: Always / usually / never groups + one example of each

5.title: Note Auction: is the answer written correctly?
5.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari keyingi darsda takror uchun.
5.goal: Part 1 qaydlariga yozilgan javobni tekshirish: ko'plik -s (two tickets), imlo (Wednesday), sanalmaydigan otlar (equipment, identification), 'a ten-minute walk' shakli va ega-kesim moslashuvi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Tushuntiring: bu gaplar — Part 1 qaydlariga yozilgan tayyor javoblar; xato bo'lsa, u bitta: ko'plik, imlo, ot shakli yoki moslashuv.
Ustoz gapni doskaga YOZADI (imlo xatosi ko'rinishi uchun faqat o'qib berish yetarli emas). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'forty minute' → 'forty minutes', 'Wensday' → 'Wednesday').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa). Ustoz eslatadi: IELTSda imlo yoki -s xatosi = 0 ball.

items.s: The photography course starts on 3 March and lasts six weeks.
items.why: Sana va davomiylik to'g'ri: six weeks — ko'plik.

items.s: The film club meets every Wensday evening.
items.fix: The film club meets every Wednesday evening.
items.why: Imlo: Wednesday — 'd' va ikkinchi 'e' eshitilmaydi, lekin yoziladi. Imlo xatosi = 0 ball.

items.s: The full price is £120, but members get a 10% discount.
items.why: Narx va chegirma to'g'ri yozilgan; 'but' dan keyingi ma'lumot — a'zolar uchun.

items.s: The boat trip lasts forty minute.
items.fix: The boat trip lasts forty minutes.
items.why: Son birdan katta — ot ko'plikda: forty minutes.

items.s: All participants must wear a life jacket on the boat.
items.why: must + V1 (wear); a life jacket — bitta narsa, birlik to'g'ri.

items.s: Please bring your own equipments.
items.fix: Please bring your own equipment.
items.why: equipment — sanalmaydigan ot, -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: Visitors should bring an identification, such as a passport.
items.fix: Visitors should bring identification, such as a passport.
items.why: identification — sanalmaydigan ot, 'an' ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: The meeting point is outside the main entrance of the library.
items.why: Joy aniq yozilgan: outside the main entrance.

items.s: The hotel is a ten-minutes walk from the beach.
items.fix: The hotel is a ten-minute walk from the beach.
items.why: Chiziqchali sifat birikmada ot birlikda: a ten-minute walk.

items.s: Children under five travel free on all city buses.
items.why: travel free = pul to'lamaydi; 'under five' — 5 yoshgacha.

items.s: Both rooms has a private bathroom.
items.fix: Both rooms have a private bathroom.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (both rooms) — kesim 'have'.

items.s: Parking is free for guests who stay two nights or more.
items.why: parking — sanalmaydigan, 'is'; two nights — ko'plik.

5.title: Board Game: spell it, say it, catch the answer
5.stage: 'Sinf mashqi'dan (chalg'ituvchilar mashqi) keyin mustahkamlash sifatida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
5.goal: Part 1 ko'nikmalari: ism va so'zlarni harflab aytish, son, sana, vaqt va narxni to'g'ri aytish, bo'sh joy turini oldindan aniqlash, paraphrase va chalg'ituvchidan to'g'ri javobni tanlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Ustoz har guruhga javoblar kalitini beradi (bitta 'hakam' o'quvchiga).
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: harflab aytadi, son/sana/vaqtni aytadi, paraphrase topadi yoki 'Which answer?' katagida to'g'ri javobni tanlaydi.
'Spell' kataklarida har harf aniq aytilishi shart: bitta harf xato bo'lsa ham javob xato (IELTSda imlo xatosi = 0 ball).
'Which answer?' kataklarida o'yinchi javobni o'zgartirgan signal so'zni ham aytadi (but, sorry, no, wait). Signal so'zsiz javob — yarim to'g'ri, o'yinchi joyida qoladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Spell your surname letter by letter.
squares.a: e.g. K-A-R-I-M-O-V

squares.t: Say the time 8.15 in two different ways.
squares.a: eight fifteen / (a) quarter past eight

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'cost'
squares.a: price / charge / fee

squares.t: Say the date 12/11 in words.
squares.a: the twelfth of November / November the twelfth

squares.t: Gap: 'Tour guide: Mr ___' What type of word is missing?
squares.a: a surname (a name) — listen for the spelling

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'free'
squares.a: there's no charge / you don't have to pay

squares.t: Spell the days: Wednesday, Thursday.
squares.a: W-E-D-N-E-S-D-A-Y, T-H-U-R-S-D-A-Y

squares.t: Student price? 'It's usually £18, but students pay £11.'
squares.a: £11 — 'but' changes the answer

squares.t: Say 15 and 50 clearly. Where is the stress in each?
squares.a: fif-TEEN (2nd syllable), FIF-ty (1st syllable)

squares.t: Correct the note: 'Bring two passport photo.'

5.title: Speaking cards: bookings, clubs and courses
5.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa va vazifa'dan oldin — IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida (12 daqiqa)
5.goal: Part 1 mavzulari (bron qilish, klublar, kurslar, sayohat ma'lumoti) bo'yicha 3–4 gapli javob berish va sherigining javobidan son, sana yoki nomni qayd (notes) shaklida yozib olish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi (imtihonchi) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: Part 1 savollariga — aniq va shaxsiy, Part 3 savollariga (Why? Should…? How has…?) — sabab va misol bilan.
Imtihonchi javob paytida qayd yozadi: kamida bitta son, sana, joy yoki nom (masalan: 'club — chess, Tuesdays'). Javobdan keyin qaydni o'qib beradi; sherigi tasdiqlasa ikkalasiga +1 ball.

Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: jamoa gap qaysi qoidaga tegishli ekanini aytsa (chalg'ituvchi, tuzatish, bo'sh joy turi, harflab aytish).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

5.title: Quiz Board: Note Completion (Part 1)

5.goal: Note completion qoidalari, paraphrase, chalg'ituvchilar hamda sana, vaqt, narx va ismlarni aytish/harflashni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Distractors 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Distractors' bo'limida gapni ustoz tabiiy tezlikda, faqat bir marta o'qiydi — xuddi audiodagidek.
'Say it!' bo'limida sana, vaqt va narx to'liq aytilishi, ism esa harfma-harf aytilishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

6.title: TFNG Auction: is the answer right?
6.stage: 'Savol turi' tushuntirilgandan keyin, 'Uch ustun mashqi' o'rniga yoki undan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
6.goal: TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN javobini tekshirish: paraphrase (fortnight = two weeks), cheklovchi so'zlar (most ≠ all, usually ≠ always), raqamlar, 'the first' va o'z bilimini qo'shmaslik.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Har qatorda qisqa matn (Text), savol gapi (Statement) va o'quvchi bergan javob bor.
Ustoz qatorni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: berilgan javob (TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN) to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar qatorni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa qatorni oladi.
Javob TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato javobni birinchi bo'lib to'g'rilab, isbotini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'postponed' = 'delayed' → TRUE).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI qator sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Text: "The bridge opened in 1889." Statement: "It opened in the 19th century." → TRUE
items.why: 1889 — XIX asr: boshqa so'zlar bilan bir xil ma'no.

items.s: Text: "The Aurora was the first ship to reach the island." Statement: "No ship had reached it before." → FALSE
items.fix: Text: "The Aurora was the first ship to reach the island." Statement: "No ship had reached it before." → TRUE
items.why: 'the first' = undan oldin hech bir kema yetib bormagan — ma'no bir xil, TRUE.

items.s: Text: "Most of the crew were fishermen." Statement: "All of the crew were fishermen." → FALSE
items.why: 'most' ≠ 'all': cheklovchi so'z ma'noni qarshi qiladi — FALSE.

items.s: Text: "The robot cost $2 million." Statement: "It was too expensive for schools." → TRUE
items.fix: Text: "The robot cost $2 million." Statement: "It was too expensive for schools." → NOT GIVEN
items.why: Matnda maktablar haqida gap yo'q; o'z xulosangizni qo'shmang — NOT GIVEN.

items.s: Text: "The expedition lasted two weeks." Statement: "It lasted a fortnight." → TRUE
items.why: a fortnight = two weeks — paraphrase, TRUE.

items.s: Text: "He never learned to swim." Statement: "He was a strong swimmer." → NOT GIVEN
items.fix: Text: "He never learned to swim." Statement: "He was a strong swimmer." → FALSE
items.why: Matn qarshi ma'noni aytadi (suzishni o'rganmagan) — FALSE.

items.s: Text: "Tickets are half price for children." Statement: "Children pay 50% of the normal price." → TRUE
items.why: half price = 50% — paraphrase, TRUE.

items.s: Text: "Her book sold 10,000 copies." Statement: "Her book won a prize." → NOT GIVEN
items.why: Sotuv haqida aytilgan, mukofot haqida emas — NOT GIVEN.

items.s: Text: "The discovery was made in 1952." Statement: "It was made before 1950." → TRUE
items.fix: Text: "The discovery was made in 1952." Statement: "It was made before 1950." → FALSE
items.why: 1952 — 1950 dan keyin; raqam qarshi — FALSE.

items.s: Text: "Lake A is 300 m deep." Statement: "Lake A is deeper than Lake B." → FALSE
items.fix: Text: "Lake A is 300 m deep." Statement: "Lake A is deeper than Lake B." → NOT GIVEN
items.why: B ko'lining chuqurligi berilmagan — solishtirib bo'lmaydi, NOT GIVEN.

items.s: Text: "He usually works alone." Statement: "He always works alone." → FALSE
items.why: 'usually' ≠ 'always' — cheklovchi so'z, FALSE.

items.s: Text: "The trip was postponed until June." Statement: "The trip was delayed." → NOT GIVEN
items.fix: Text: "The trip was postponed until June." Statement: "The trip was delayed." → TRUE
items.why: postponed = delayed (kechiktirildi) — paraphrase, TRUE.

6.title: Board Game: TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN?
6.stage: 2-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
6.goal: TFNG qoidalarini og'zaki tushuntirish, mini-matnlarda TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN ni isbot bilan aytish, paraphrase topish va kashfiyotchilar, ixtirolar, okean mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi. Javoblar kaliti guruhdagi bitta 'hakam' o'quvchida turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani tushuntiradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki to'liq gap bilan gapiradi.
'T/F/NG?' kataklarida o'yinchi javob bilan birga isbotni ham aytadi — qaysi so'z shunday deyishga majbur qildi. Isbotsiz javob qabul qilinmaydi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida vaqt tugamasdan to'xtasa — 1 katak orqaga.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: What does TRUE mean in TFNG? Explain in one sentence.
squares.a: The text gives the same information, maybe in other words.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'find their way'
squares.a: navigate

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'The museum is closed on Mondays.' Statement: 'You can visit it on Monday.'
squares.a: FALSE — 'closed' means you cannot visit

squares.t: Name 4 limiting words that often make a statement FALSE.
squares.a: e.g. all, only, never, always, every, the first

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about a famous explorer or traveller.
squares.a: e.g. Marco Polo travelled along the Silk Road to China…

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'memorise'
squares.a: learn by heart / commit to memory

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'The team found over 200 new species.' Statement: 'They found under 100.'
squares.a: FALSE — the numbers contradict each other

squares.t: What is the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite. NOT GIVEN: the text says nothing about it.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'invented'
squares.a: came up with / created / developed

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'The shop opens at 9.' Statement: 'The shop closes at 6.'
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — closing time is not mentioned

squares.t: Would you like to explore the ocean? Why or why not? (20 seconds)
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because I would love to see coral reefs…

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'died out'
squares.a: became extinct / disappeared

squares.t: Do TFNG answers come in the same order as the text?
squares.a: Yes — look for Q3 between the answers to Q2 and Q4.

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'Few people believed him.' Statement: 'Most people believed him.'
squares.a: FALSE — 'few' is the opposite of 'most'

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'without help'
squares.a: alone / on your own / single-handedly

squares.t: Name an invention you can't live without. Why? (20 seconds)
squares.a: e.g. My phone, because I use it for studying and…

squares.t: Which words are easiest to scan for in the text? Why?
squares.a: Numbers, names and dates — they are not usually paraphrased.

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'He won the award in 2004.' Statement: 'He won it this century.'
squares.a: TRUE — 2004 is in the 21st century

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'rejected'
squares.a: did not accept / turned down

squares.t: Why can't you use your own knowledge to answer TFNG?
squares.a: Only the text counts; IELTS tests reading, not general knowledge.

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'The writer likes solar power.' Statement: 'The writer says it is cheap.'
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — the price is not mentioned

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a shortage of'
squares.a: not enough / too few / a lack of

squares.t: Text: 'Only two climbers reached the top.' Make a FALSE statement.
squares.a: e.g. All the climbers reached the top. / Nobody reached the top.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is exploring the oceans more important than exploring space?
squares.a: e.g. I think the oceans are more important because we know very little about them…

6.goal: Kashfiyotlar, ixtirolar va okean mavzusida savol tuzish va berish; olingan javob asosida TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN gap aytish.

items.t: …has taken a photo he/she is really proud of.
items.q: Have you ever taken a photo you are really proud of?

items.t: …would like to dive in the ocean one day.
items.q: Would you like to dive in the ocean one day?

items.t: …always checks whether online news is true.
items.q: Do you always check whether online news is true?

items.t: …has changed his/her mind after reading an article.
items.q: Have you ever changed your mind after reading an article?

items.t: …uses a microwave almost every day.
items.q: Do you use a microwave almost every day?

6.title: Speaking cards: discoveries, inventions and the sea
6.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa va vazifa'dan oldin — IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida (12 daqiqa)
6.goal: Kashfiyotchilar, ixtirolar, okean va ma'lumotni tekshirish mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; sherigining javobi asosida TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN statement tuzish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi (imtihonchi) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: Part 1 savollariga — shaxsiy misol bilan, Part 3 savollariga (Why? Should…?) — sabab va misol bilan.
Javobdan keyin imtihonchi eshitganiga qarab bitta statement aytadi (masalan: 'You use a map app every day'). Sherigi o'z javobiga ko'ra TRUE, FALSE yoki NOT GIVEN deydi; to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy reading about famous explorers? Why or why not?
Which invention has changed your daily life the most?
How often do you take photos? What do you usually photograph?
Would you like to travel by boat across an ocean? Why or why not?
Do you prefer paper maps or map apps? Why?
Why do you think some inventors never become famous?
Which should governments spend more on: exploring the oceans or exploring space? Why?
How can ordinary people help to protect marine life?
Is it important to check whether information online is true? How do you do it?
Many inventions happen by accident. Can you think of an example?
Should traditional skills, like navigating by the stars, still be taught today?
Who is a famous scientist from Uzbekistan, and why is he or she important?
What would you like to discover or invent in the future?
Why do people enjoy looking at old photographs?
Do you think explorers today have easier lives than explorers in the past?

6.title: Sentence Race: TFNG rules and paraphrased statements
6.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan oldin qoidalarni takrorlash (8 daqiqa)
6.goal: TFNG qoidalari va paraphrase qilingan statement gaplarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish (FALSE means…, NOT GIVEN means…, Nobody had… before him).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Eslatma: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: qoida gapi bo'lsa jamoa o'zbekcha misol keltiradi; statement gapi bo'lsa unga TRUE bo'ladigan qisqa 'matn' o'ylab topadi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: FALSE means the text says the opposite.
NOT GIVEN means the information is not in the text.
Limiting words often make a statement false.
Never answer with your own knowledge of the topic.
The answers come in the same order as the text.
Circle the key words before you read the text.
The first mobile phones were far too expensive for most people.
Nobody had reached the island before him.
His idea was rejected by most scientists at first.

6.title: Quiz Board: True, False or Not Given
6.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa)
6.goal: TFNG qoidalari, mini-matnlarda javob va isbot, paraphrase hamda mavzu bo'yicha gapirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'T, F or NG? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi (T, F or NG? bo'limida matn va statementni doskaga yozadi); jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
'T, F or NG?' bo'limida javob isbot bilan aytilishi shart (qaysi so'z?); 'Say it!' bo'limida to'liq gap bilan.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What does NOT GIVEN mean?
qs.a: The text has no information about it.

qs.q: Name three limiting words to watch for.
qs.a: e.g. all, only, never, always, every

qs.q: Do TFNG answers follow the order of the text?
qs.a: Yes, they come in text order.

qs.q: Can you use your own knowledge to answer? Why or why not?
A statement compares X and Y, but the text gives a number only for X. What is the answer?
Text: 'The museum opens at 10 a.m.' Statement: 'It opens in the morning.'
Text: 'The trip took six days.' Statement: 'The trip took over a week.'
Text: 'She speaks French.' Statement: 'She speaks French fluently.'
Text: 'Few people visited the island.' Statement: 'It was popular with visitors.'
Text: 'It was the tallest building of its time.' Statement: 'No building then was taller.'
Paraphrase: 'proof'
Paraphrase: 'find the way'
Paraphrase: 'made public'
Paraphrase: 'died out'
Paraphrase: 'was not included'
qs.a: did not appear / was left out

qs.q: Name a famous explorer or inventor and give one fact about him or her.
qs.a: e.g. Marco Polo travelled to China.

qs.q: Text: 'Only three students passed.' Say a FALSE statement.
qs.a: e.g. Nobody passed. / Ten students passed.

qs.q: Text: 'The café opens at 8.' Say a NOT GIVEN statement.
qs.a: e.g. The café closes at 6. / The coffee is cheap.

qs.q: Explain the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN in two sentences.
qs.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite. NOT GIVEN: it says nothing.

qs.q: Which invention is more important: the phone or the fridge? Give two reasons.
qs.a: e.g. The fridge, because it keeps food fresh and safe…

7.title: Grammar Auction: describing parts and positions
7.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
7.goal: Chizmani tasvirlaydigan gaplarda joy predloglari (on either side, beneath, between … and …), passiv (is fixed to, is driven by) va enter / prevent … from -ing kabi fe'l shakllarini to'g'ri ishlatish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (har gap qurilma qismini — joyi, materiali yoki vazifasini — tasvirlaydi). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi va xato qayerda ekanini aytadi: predlogdami, fe'l shaklidami yoki ega–kesim moslashuvidami.
Oxirida eng ko'p to'g'ri gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa). Ustoz har gapni doskaga oddiy chizma chizib izohlaydi: qism qayerda turadi.

items.s: The heating element is located at the base of the kettle.
items.why: at the base of — tagida; passiv 'is located' to'g'ri.

items.s: Two mirrors are fitted on either sides of the handlebars.
items.fix: Two mirrors are fitted on either side of the handlebars.
items.why: either dan keyin ot birlikda: on either side (ikki yonida).

items.s: The solar panels are mounted on the roof of the building.
items.why: mount on — o'rnatmoq; passiv 'are mounted' to'g'ri.

items.s: Cold water enters to the tank through a curved pipe.
items.fix: Cold water enters the tank through a curved pipe.
items.why: enter — o'timli fe'l, undan keyin 'to' kelmaydi.

items.s: Hot air comes out of a narrow opening at the front of the dryer.
items.why: come out of — chiqmoq; at the front of — oldingi qismida.

items.s: The blades is made of light glass fibre.
items.fix: The blades are made of light glass fibre.
items.why: blades — ko'plik, shuning uchun 'are made of'.

items.s: A rubber seal prevents water to leak out of the machine.
items.fix: A rubber seal prevents water from leaking out of the machine.
items.why: prevent + ot + from + -ing; 'to + fe'l' ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: The battery is placed beneath the floor of the car.
items.why: beneath — ostida; undan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ot keladi.

items.s: The pump is situated between the tank with the house.
items.fix: The pump is situated between the tank and the house.
items.why: between A and B — 'with' emas, 'and'.

items.s: The generator is driven by a fast-turning shaft.
items.why: Passiv + by: drive → is driven by (harakatga keltiriladi).

items.s: The motor sits beneath of the seat.
items.fix: The motor sits beneath the seat.
items.why: beneath / below dan keyin 'of' kelmaydi.

items.s: The chain connects the front gear to the rear wheel.
items.why: connect A to B — A ni B ga ulamoq.

7.title: Board Game: Label the Diagram
7.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan keyin yoki keyingi darsda takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
7.goal: Diagram labelling qoidalarini (ot, so'z chegarasi, matn tartibi, langar qismlar) takrorlash, texnik so'zlarni paraphrase qilish va joy predloglari bilan qurilma qismlarini og'zaki tasvirlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: paraphrase aytadi, predlog bilan joylashuvni tasvirlaydi yoki diagram labelling qoidasini inglizcha tushuntiradi.
Guruh javob kaliti bo'yicha tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namunaviy javob, boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.
materials: Doskadagi predloglar ro'yxati (above, beneath, inside, through, between, on either side) ko'rinib tursin.

squares.t: Name three parts of a bicycle in English.
squares.a: e.g. frame, seat, chain, pedals, wheels, handlebars

squares.t: Say the opposite: above
squares.a: below / beneath

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'attached to'
squares.a: fixed to / connected to

squares.t: What part of speech are most diagram answers?
squares.a: Nouns — the names of parts.

squares.t: Say it in English: ikki yonida
squares.a: on either side (of) / on both sides (of)

squares.t: Where is the seat on a bicycle? Use a preposition.
squares.a: e.g. It is on top of the frame, above the pedals.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'hollow'
squares.a: empty inside

squares.t: Correct: Water enters into the tank.
squares.a: Water enters the tank.

squares.t: What do you look at first in a diagram task?
squares.a: The title and the parts that are already labelled.

squares.t: Instructions: ONE WORD ONLY. Is 'metal ring' OK?
squares.a: No — it is two words. Write only 'ring'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'buried'
squares.a: placed under the ground

squares.t: Describe where your phone's camera is.
squares.a: e.g. It is on the back, in the top left corner.

squares.t: Say three verbs that describe movement in a process.
squares.a: e.g. enters, flows into, passes through, is carried to

squares.t: Are diagram answers usually in the same order as the text?
squares.a: Usually, but not always: look after your last answer; if it is not there, use the labelled parts.

squares.t: Correct: The blades is fixed to the hub.
squares.a: The blades are fixed to the hub.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'increases the speed'
squares.a: makes it turn faster / raises the speed

squares.t: Label: 'the ___ stone'. The text says 'the bed stone'. Answer?
squares.a: bed (do not repeat 'stone')

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'prevents'
squares.a: stops

squares.t: Explain how a kettle works in three steps.
squares.a: e.g. You fill it with water, the element at the base heats it, then it switches off.

squares.t: Why is general knowledge dangerous in diagram tasks?
squares.a: The answer must come from the text, not from what you already know.

squares.t: Describe the position of the board in this classroom.
squares.a: e.g. It is on the front wall, opposite the door.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'extremely cold'
squares.a: at a very low temperature / freezing

squares.t: Give two advantages of electric cars.
squares.a: e.g. They produce no exhaust fumes and are quieter and cheaper to run.

squares.t: Describe a machine you use every day: three parts and their positions.
squares.a: e.g. My hair dryer has a handle at the bottom, a fan inside and a nozzle at the front.

7.title: Dominoes: diagram paraphrases
7.stage: 'Paraphrase mashqi' bosqichida — matn va savoldagi so'zlar jadvalidan keyin (12 daqiqa)
7.goal: Chizma belgisidagi so'z va matndagi paraphrase'ni tez bog'lash: attached to = fixed to, hollow = empty inside, prevents = stops va hokazo.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z yoki iboraning paraphrase'ini (ma'nosi bir xil boshqa ifodani) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'Hollow means empty inside.' Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus +1: bitta juftlikni qurilma qismi haqidagi gapda ishlatish.

7.title: Taboo: machine parts and technology
7.stage: 1-qo'shimcha reading oldidan: qism nomlari va texnik so'zlarni isitish (10 daqiqa)
7.goal: Chizmalarda uchraydigan qism nomlari va texnik so'zlarni (blade, generator, vacuum, stopper, gearbox…) inglizcha ta'riflab berish: vazifasi, joylashuvi, nimadan yasalgani.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: nima uchun kerak, qayerda joylashgan, nimadan yasalgan — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin; chizish, yozish va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

7.title: Find someone who… has taken a machine apart
7.stage: 1-reading va listening orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
7.goal: Texnika, qurilmalar va energiya mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Can you…? / Would you like to…?) va qo'shimcha savol bilan suhbatni davom ettirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever seen a wind turbine in real life?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi: Where? When? How does it work?
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 ta qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bo'yicha tekshiradi.

items.t: …has taken a machine apart to see how it works.
items.q: Have you ever taken a machine apart to see how it works?

items.t: …has ridden in an electric car.
items.q: Have you ever ridden in an electric car?

items.t: …has seen a wind turbine in real life.
items.q: Have you ever seen a wind turbine in real life?

items.t: …can explain how a bicycle chain works.
items.q: Can you explain how a bicycle chain works?

items.t: …has flown on a plane more than three times.
items.q: Have you flown on a plane more than three times?

items.t: …takes a vacuum flask of tea to school or work.
items.q: Do you take a vacuum flask of tea to school or work?

items.t: …has repaired something at home without any help.
items.q: Have you ever repaired something at home without any help?

items.t: …has built furniture by following a diagram.
items.q: Have you ever built furniture by following a diagram?

items.t: …would like to become an engineer.
items.q: Would you like to become an engineer?

items.t: …has visited a museum of science or technology.
items.q: Have you ever visited a museum of science or technology?

items.t: …charges his/her phone more than once a day.
items.q: Do you charge your phone more than once a day?

items.t: …has drawn a plan of his/her home.
items.q: Have you ever drawn a plan of your home?

7.title: Speaking cards: machines and technology
7.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida (IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
7.goal: Texnika, ixtirolar va qayta tiklanadigan energiya mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish; qurilmani tasvirlashda joy predloglarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi (examiner) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: Part 1 savoliga 20–30 soniya, Part 3 savoliga (fikr va sabab talab qiladigan savol) 40 soniya — fikr + sabab + misol.
Examiner javobdagi texnik so'zlar va joy predloglarini sanaydi (engine, battery, above, inside, at the base…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

cards: Do you enjoy finding out how machines work? Why or why not?
Which machine in your home could you not live without? Why?
Have you ever tried to repair something yourself? What happened?
Do you prefer instructions with diagrams or with words? Why?
Would you like to have an electric car in the future? Why or why not?
Describe a machine in your home. Where are its main parts?
Are wind turbines a good idea for Uzbekistan? Why or why not?
How has technology changed the way people travel in the last twenty years?
Why do many people find technical texts difficult to read?
