What are the advantages and disadvantages of renewable energy?
Do you think machines will do most jobs in the future? Why?
Which invention of the last hundred years is the most important? Why?
Is it better to repair old things or to buy new ones? Why?

7.title: Sentence Race: parts, positions and strategy
7.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
7.goal: Qurilma qismlarining joylashuvi va jarayonini tasvirlaydigan gaplarda (passiv, joy predloglari) hamda diagram labelling strategiyasi gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball oladi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; keyin konvertlar jamoalar orasida almashadi.
Bonus +1: gapdagi joy predlogini yoki diagram labelling qoidasini o'zbekcha qisqa tushuntirish.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The heating element is located at the base of the kettle.
Diagram answers usually follow the order of the text.
Do not repeat words that are already on the diagram.
If the instructions say ONE WORD ONLY, a two-word answer is wrong.
The blades turn slowly, but the gearbox increases the speed.
The stopper prevents warm air from escaping through the neck.
Labelled parts help you find the answer in the text.
Two mirrors are fitted on either side of the handlebars.
Heat cannot travel through a vacuum by conduction.

7.title: Quiz Board: Diagram Labelling (Reading)
7.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida o'tgan savol turini takrorlash yoki 'Tahlil' o'rniga (15 daqiqa)
7.goal: Diagram labelling qoidalari, chizma paraphrase'lari, qism nomlari va joy predloglarini o'yin shaklida takrorlash; 'Say it!' bo'limida qurilmani og'zaki tasvirlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida 30 soniya gapiradi). To'g'ri bo'lsa ball jamoaga.
Xato bo'lsa, boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ballning yarmi).
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What part of speech are most diagram answers?
What do you study first: the text or the diagram?
qs.a: The diagram — its title and labelled parts.

qs.q: Label: 'the pit ___'. The text says 'the pit wheel'. What do you write?
Parts already labelled help you find your place in the text. What do we call them?
You know the machine well. Why can your own knowledge be a trap?
qs.a: The answer must come from the text, not from memory.

qs.q: removed = ?
beside = ?
transported = ?
sealed = ?
'160 km in cities' = '160 km in ___ motoring conditions'
One of the three long, flat parts of a wind turbine that the wind turns.
The machine that turns movement into electricity.
A space with no air in it at all.
The powder made by grinding grain, used to make bread.
A preposition meaning 'directly under' (7 letters, starts with 'b').
Say where your nose is on your face.
qs.a: e.g. It is in the middle of my face, above my mouth.

qs.q: Describe the position of the door in this room.
qs.a: e.g. It is on the left, opposite the window.

qs.q: Name three parts of a bicycle and say where they are.
qs.a: e.g. The seat is above the pedals; the lamp is at the front.

qs.q: Explain in two sentences how a kettle heats water.
qs.a: e.g. An element at the base heats it, then it switches off.

qs.q: Describe a machine for 20 seconds without naming it. Your team guesses.
qs.a: Open answer: parts + positions + what it does.

8.title: Grammar Auction: place phrases and 'used to'
8.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin, 'Joy iboralari mashqi'dan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
8.goal: Reja (plan) tasvirida joy iboralarini (opposite, next to, at the far end of, on your right, on the first floor) va 'used to' (eski joy ↔ hozirgi joy) ni to'g'ri ishlatish, xatoni topib tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi (xuddi audio'dagi gid kabi) yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi va xato qayerda ekanini aytadi: predlogda, artiklda, 'used to' shaklida yoki ega–kesim moslashuvida.
Oxirida eng ko'p to'g'ri gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa). Ustoz 'used to' li gaplarda qaysi joy javob bo'lishini (hozirgisi) alohida so'raydi.

items.s: The café is directly opposite the main entrance.
items.why: opposite dan keyin 'of' kelmaydi; directly — aynan ro'parasida.

items.s: The first-aid room is next the staff room.
items.fix: The first-aid room is next to the staff room.
items.why: next to — 'to' tushib qolmasin.

items.s: The music room is behind the main hall, on the right.
items.why: behind — orqasida; on the right — o'ng tomonda.

items.s: The meeting room is at the far end the corridor.
items.fix: The meeting room is at the far end of the corridor.
items.why: at the (far) end OF — 'of' tushib qolmasin.

items.s: Directly below the roof garden is a small gym.
items.why: Joy iborasi gap boshida — inversiya: Below X is Y.

items.s: The science lab used to be upstairs, but now it is on ground floor.
items.fix: The science lab used to be upstairs, but now it is on the ground floor.
items.why: the ground floor — aniq artikl shart.

items.s: The boiler is in a small room to the right of the kitchen.
items.why: to the right of — o'ng tomonida.

items.s: The lockers is next to the changing rooms.
items.fix: The lockers are next to the changing rooms.
items.why: lockers — ko'plik, shuning uchun 'are'.

items.s: The gift shop is in your right as you come in.
items.fix: The gift shop is on your right as you come in.
items.why: on your right / on your left — 'in' emas, 'on'.

items.s: The museum shop used to be in the basement, but it is now by the exit.
items.why: used to — eski joy; javob — hozirgi joy (by the exit).

items.s: The cinema is on the first floor, above the shops.
items.why: Qavat bilan 'on': on the first floor.

items.s: The library use to be in the old building.
items.fix: The library used to be in the old building.
items.why: Tasdiq gapda 'used to' — oxirida -d bo'ladi.

8.title: Board Game: Follow the Speaker
8.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida yoki keyingi darsda takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
8.goal: Listening diagram labelling strategiyasi (rejani oldindan o'qish, bir marta eshitish, used to va 'I mean' tuzoqlari, imlo), joy iboralari va paraphrase'larni og'zaki mashq qilish; o'z uyi va maktabi rejasini tasvirlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: joy iborasini aytadi, rejani tasvirlaydi yoki listening qoidasini inglizcha tushuntiradi.
Guruh javob kaliti bo'yicha tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namunaviy javob). Imlo topshirig'ida bitta harf xato ham xato hisoblanadi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Say it in English: ro'parasida
squares.a: opposite

squares.t: Say the opposite: at the front
squares.a: at the back

squares.t: How many times do you hear the audio in the exam?
squares.a: Only once.

squares.t: Describe where you are sitting now.
squares.a: e.g. I'm sitting next to the window, behind Aziz.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'next to'
squares.a: beside / by

squares.t: Say it in English: eng narigi uchida
squares.a: at the far end (of)

squares.t: Say where the door is in this classroom.
squares.a: e.g. It's in the corner, opposite the board.

squares.t: What do you do before the audio starts?
squares.a: Study the plan: the title, the labelled places and 'you are here'.

squares.t: Correct: The shop is next the café.
squares.a: The shop is next to the café.

squares.t: Say it in English: yuqori o'ng burchakda
squares.a: in the top right corner

squares.t: Spell these words: entrance, restaurant
squares.a: E-N-T-R-A-N-C-E, R-E-S-T-A-U-R-A-N-T

squares.t: In what order does a speaker usually describe a plan?
squares.a: Step by step from 'you are here': top to bottom or left to right.

squares.t: Give directions from this room to the school exit.
squares.a: e.g. Turn left, go along the corridor; the exit is on your right.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lunch and dinner'
squares.a: midday and evening meals

squares.t: You hear: 'It used to be upstairs, but now it's by the exit.' Answer?
squares.a: by the exit (the present position, not the old one)

squares.t: What are 'anchors' on a plan?
squares.a: Places already labelled; they help you follow the speaker.

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY. You hear 'a small wooden bench'. Label: 'wooden ___'.
squares.a: bench

squares.t: Correct: The gym is in the first floor.
squares.a: The gym is on the first floor.

squares.t: Describe the plan of your home: three rooms and their positions.
squares.a: e.g. The kitchen is on the left; my room is at the end of the hall.

squares.t: Why do you make quick marks on the plan while listening?
squares.a: The audio is played once; you write the full answers later.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'is only for staff'
squares.a: is reserved for staff / staff only

squares.t: The speaker names a place, then says 'Sorry, I mean…'. What do you write?
squares.a: The corrected place — the one after 'I mean'.

squares.t: Describe your school's plan in 30 seconds (five places).
squares.a: e.g. The entrance is at the front; the canteen is opposite the gym…

squares.t: Give a 30-second tour of a museum in your city.
squares.a: e.g. As you come in, the ticket office is on your left…

8.title: Dominoes: place phrases and paraphrases
8.stage: Sinf mashqidan ('Joy iboralari mashqi') keyin, listening'dan oldin (12 daqiqa)
8.goal: Audio'dagi joy iboralari va xizmatlar haqidagi ifodalarni ularning paraphrase'i bilan bog'lash: opposite the entrance = facing the door you came in by, upstairs = on a higher floor, free of charge = you don't have to pay.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi iboraning paraphrase'ini (bir xil ma'noli boshqa ifodani) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; joy iboralarini doskadagi xona rejasida barmoq bilan ko'rsatadi. Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: facing the door you came in by
at the far end of the corridor
as far along the hall as you can go
in the upper corner on the right-hand side
It was here before, but not any more.

8.title: Taboo: buildings, plans and facilities
8.stage: Listening bosqichidan oldin: reja va xizmat joylari so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa)
8.goal: Reja va sxemalarda uchraydigan joy va qism nomlarini (reception, corridor, basement, gutter, pump, deck, cabin…) inglizcha ta'riflab berish — joylashuvi va vazifasi bilan.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: bu joy qayerda bo'ladi, u yerda nima qilinadi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin; chizish, yozish va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

8.title: Find someone who… has got lost in a big building
8.stage: Dars o'rtasida, ikki audio orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
8.goal: Sayohat, binolar va joy topish mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Can you…?, shu jumladan 'Do you know where … is?' ichki savol tartibi) va qo'shimcha savol berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever got lost in a big building?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi: Where was it? How did you find the way?
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 ta javobni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz 'Do you know where … is?' savolidagi so'z tartibini alohida tekshiradi.

items.t: …has travelled on an overnight train.
items.q: Have you ever travelled on an overnight train?

items.t: …has been on a ferry or a big boat.
items.q: Have you ever been on a ferry or a big boat?

items.t: …has got lost in a big building.
items.q: Have you ever got lost in a big building?

items.t: …uses a map app to find places in the city.
items.q: Do you use a map app to find places in the city?

items.t: …has visited a factory on a guided tour.
items.q: Have you ever visited a factory on a guided tour?

items.t: …can describe the plan of his/her school.
items.q: Can you describe the plan of your school?

items.t: …has studied in a library study room.
items.q: Have you ever studied in a library study room?

items.t: …knows where the nearest metro station is.
items.q: Do you know where the nearest metro station is?

items.t: …has been to a museum in Samarkand or Bukhara.
items.q: Have you ever been to a museum in Samarkand or Bukhara?

items.t: …prefers to sit at the front of a bus.
items.q: Do you prefer to sit at the front of a bus?

items.t: …has given directions to a tourist in English.
items.q: Have you ever given directions to a tourist in English?

items.t: …lives on the top floor of a block of flats.
items.q: Do you live on the top floor of a block of flats?

8.title: Speaking cards: places, plans and travel
8.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida (IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
8.goal: Binolar, jamoat joylari va sayohat mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish; javobda joy iboralarini (opposite, next to, at the far end) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi (examiner) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: Part 1 savoliga 20–30 soniya, Part 3 savoliga (fikr va sabab talab qiladigan savol) 40 soniya — fikr + sabab + misol.
Examiner javobdagi joy iboralarini sanaydi (opposite, next to, on the left, at the far end, upstairs…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

cards: Do you find it easy to follow maps and plans? Why or why not?
Describe the layout of your home. Which room do you like most?
What facilities does your school or university have?
Have you ever been on a long train journey? What was it like?
Do you prefer to ask people for directions or to use a map app? Why?
What facilities should a modern library have?
Which public building in your city is the best designed? Why?
Why do some people get lost easily in big buildings?
Should museums and factories offer free guided tours? Why or why not?
How could the bus or train stations in your city be improved?
Why is it important for public buildings to be easy for disabled people to use?
Do you like travelling by boat? Why or why not?
What makes a shopping centre easy or difficult to find your way around?
Would you like to live in a flat on a high floor? Why or why not?

8.title: Sentence Race: plans, places and listening tips
8.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
8.goal: Rejadagi joyni tasvirlaydigan gaplarda (opposite, at the far end of, on your left, used to, inversiya) va listening strategiyasi gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball oladi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; keyin konvertlar jamoalar orasida almashadi.
Bonus +1: gapdagi joy iborasini doskadagi xona rejasida ko'rsatish yoki listening maslahatini o'zbekcha tushuntirish.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The ticket office is directly opposite the entrance.
You hear the recording once, so study the plan first.
The speaker usually moves around the plan in a fixed order.
The gym used to be upstairs, but it has moved to the basement.
You will find the café at the far end of the corridor.
As you come in, the reception desk is on your left.
Make a quick mark on the plan and write the answer later.
Check your spelling, because a misspelt answer gets no marks.
Do not write two words if the task says ONE WORD ONLY.
Directly below the café is the games room.

8.title: Quiz Board: Diagram Labelling (Listening)
8.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida o'tgan savol turini takrorlash yoki 'Tahlil' o'rniga (15 daqiqa)
8.goal: Listening diagram labelling qoidalari, joy iboralari, paraphrase va og'zaki reja tasvirlashni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Place phrases 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida 30 soniya gapiradi). To'g'ri bo'lsa ball jamoaga.
Xato bo'lsa, boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ballning yarmi).
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many times is the audio played in the exam?
What do you study before the audio starts?
qs.a: The plan: title, labelled places, 'you are here'.

qs.q: You hear: 'It used to be by the door, but now it's upstairs.' Answer?
What happens if you misspell a correct answer?
qs.a: No mark — the spelling must be correct.

qs.q: Label: 'the ___ room'. A student writes 'art room'. Why is it wrong?
qs.a: 'room' is already on the plan: write only 'art'.

qs.q: The opposite of 'in front of'.
Say it in English: ro'parasida.
Say it in English: eng narigi uchida.
Say it in English: kirganda chap tomonda.
qs.a: on your left as you come in

qs.q: Fill in both gaps: 'The lift is ___ the far end ___ the hall.'
beside = ?
lunch and dinner = ?
free of charge = you don't have to ___
get onto the Internet = ?
'Visitors cannot go in here.' = It's ___ only.
Say where the board is in this classroom.
qs.a: e.g. It's on the front wall, opposite us.

qs.q: Tell a classmate how to get to the school canteen.
qs.a: e.g. Go down the stairs and turn right; it's at the end.

qs.q: Describe your bedroom: three things and where they are.
qs.a: e.g. My bed is by the window; the desk is opposite it.

qs.q: Give a 20-second tour of your school as a guide.
qs.a: e.g. As you come in, the office is on your left…

qs.q: Say where something in your town used to be and where it is now.
qs.a: e.g. The bank used to be by the park, but now it is by the station.

9.title: Grammar Auction: used to, but, whereas, in the end
9.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
9.goal: Multiple choice chalg'ituvchilarini yaratadigan tilni to'g'ri ishlatish: used to + V1 (eski ma'lumot), but / whereas / however (boshqa fikr), in the end (reja va natija), instead of + -ing, although; xatoni topib tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar sayohat, ish va o'qish haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: used to leaving → used to leave, At the end → In the end).
Bonus (tuzoqli gaplarda): ustoz so'raydi — 'Audioda bu gap qaysi tuzoqni yaratadi?' (eski ma'lumot / boshqa odamning fikri / reja va natija). To'g'ri javob +50.
Oxirida eng ko'p to'g'ri gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The swimming club used to meet on Tuesdays, but now it meets on Fridays.
items.why: used to + V1 — eski odat. MC savolida javob hozirgi holat: Fridays.

items.s: The ferry used to leaving at six, but the timetable has changed.
items.fix: The ferry used to leave at six, but the timetable has changed.
items.why: used to dan keyin fe'lning 1-shakli keladi: used to leave.

items.s: We had booked a taxi, but in the end we walked to the station.
items.why: in the end = oxir-oqibat. Reja (taxi) — tuzoq, natija (walked) — javob.

items.s: At the end, Tom chose the job in the bookshop.
items.fix: In the end, Tom chose the job in the bookshop.
items.why: 'Oxir-oqibat' — in the end; at the end of + joy/vaqt (at the end of May).

items.s: Although the café pays more, but Tom prefers the bookshop.
items.fix: Although the café pays more, Tom prefers the bookshop.
items.why: although va but bitta gapda birga ishlatilmaydi — bittasi qoladi.

items.s: The bike scheme is cheap. However, finding a free space can be difficult.
items.why: However yangi gap boshida, keyin vergul. Javob ko'pincha shu signaldan keyin.

items.s: Instead of take the bus, many workers now cycle to the office.
items.fix: Instead of taking the bus, many workers now cycle to the office.
items.why: instead of — predlog, undan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida: instead of taking.

items.s: My friend enjoyed the trip, whereas I found it rather boring.
items.why: whereas — qarama-qarshi fikr. Savol gapiruvchi haqida bo'lsa, javob: boring.

items.s: Students who book early get a 20% discount on the museum tour.
items.why: book early — oldindan band qilmoq; a discount on + narsa. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: The tutor suggested to start with the interviews.
items.fix: The tutor suggested starting with the interviews.
items.why: suggest + -ing (yoki suggest that …): suggested starting.

items.s: Despite the rain, most people still preferred cycling to driving.
items.why: despite + ot; prefer + -ing + to + -ing — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: The café job pays more, but the shifts starts too early.
items.fix: The café job pays more, but the shifts start too early.
items.why: shifts — ko'plik, fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: the shifts start.

9.title: Board Game: Multiple Choice traps
9.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan keyin yoki keyingi darsda takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
9.goal: Multiple choice strategiyasi (oldindan o'qish, variantni qisqartirish, o'chirib borish, taxmin qilish), chalg'ituvchi turlarini tanish, variant so'zlarini paraphrase qilish va sayohat / ish mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: paraphrase aytadi, tuzoq turini topadi, strategiyani inglizcha tushuntiradi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javob kaliti bo'yicha tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namunaviy javob, boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.
materials: Doskada 3 ta tuzoq turi yozilib tursin: old information / another person's opinion / partly true.

squares.t: How many options does a standard IELTS Listening MC question have?
squares.a: Usually three: A, B and C (some tasks ask you to choose TWO from five).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'cheap'
squares.a: inexpensive / low-cost / it doesn't cost much

squares.t: What do you do before the recording starts?
squares.a: Read the question and the options; underline the key words.

squares.t: Say one signal word that often comes before the answer.
squares.a: e.g. but / however / actually / in the end

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a reduced price'
squares.a: a discount / 20 per cent off / cheaper than usual

squares.t: Trap type? 'It used to open at 8, but now it opens at 9.'
squares.a: Old information: 8 is the trap; the answer is 9.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how do you usually get to school or work?
squares.a: e.g. I usually take the metro because it is quick and cheap.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'on foot'
squares.a: walking (e.g. We walked all the way.)

squares.t: True or false: the option you hear is always the answer.
squares.a: False — all three options are often mentioned.

squares.t: Trap? 'My brother loved the film, but I found it slow.' Speaker's view?
squares.a: Another person's opinion is the trap — the speaker found it slow.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'compulsory'
squares.a: required / obligatory / you must do it

squares.t: How can you shorten three long options while reading?
squares.a: Write 1–2 key words next to each: A fast / B cheap / C near.

squares.t: Say the opposite of 'crowded'.
squares.a: empty / quiet / not busy

squares.t: You missed an answer. What do you do?
squares.a: Guess the most likely option and move on to the next question.

squares.t: Describe a journey you took recently in three sentences.
squares.a: e.g. Last month I went to Bukhara by train. It took four hours. It was comfortable.

squares.t: 'It's clean, but the food is poor.' Is 'clean, with good food' right?
squares.a: No — a partly true option: only 'clean' is confirmed.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the most popular'
squares.a: the one most people choose / the favourite

squares.t: Why are the options often paraphrased?
squares.a: IELTS tests meaning: the audio uses different words from the options.

squares.t: Ask your partner an MC question about the weekend (give A, B, C).
squares.a: e.g. What did you do on Saturday? A) studied B) played football C) visited family

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'He changed his mind.'
squares.a: He decided to do something different. / He made a new decision.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'annually'
squares.a: every year / once a year / per year

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is a part-time job a good idea for students?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, it teaches responsibility, but it can take time away from studying.

squares.t: Which is harder for you: MC in Listening or in Reading? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Listening, because the audio doesn't stop and I can't read it again.

squares.t: Name the three main trap types in MC questions.
squares.a: Old information, another person's opinion, a partly true option.

9.title: Dominoes: option ↔ what the speaker says
9.stage: 'Paraphrase mashqi' bosqichida — variant va audio so'zlari jadvalidan keyin (12 daqiqa)
9.goal: Variantdagi so'z va audiodagi paraphrase'ni tez bog'lash: a reduced price = 20 per cent off, compulsory = you have to do it, disorganised = hopeless at planning va hokazo (sayohat, ish, o'qish mavzulari).
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi variant so'zining audiodagi paraphrase'ini (ma'nosi bir xil ifodani) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'Option: compulsory — audio: you have to do it.' Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus +1: bitta juftlikdan MC savoli tuzish (A, B, C bilan).

pairs: the last day to hand it in
a bigger success than we hoped

9.title: Taboo: travel, jobs and study

9.goal: Listening matnlarida uchraydigan sayohat, ish va o'qish so'zlarini (ferry, cabin, souvenir, shift, wages, deadline, commute…) inglizcha ta'riflab berish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi uchun.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi (ta'rif, sinonim, misol) — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

Imo-ishora mumkin; chizish, yozish va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Ustoz eng yaxshi 2–3 ta ta'rifni 'bu audiodagi paraphrase bo'lishi mumkin' deb doskaga yozadi.

9.title: Find someone who… has travelled overnight
9.stage: Ikki listening orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
9.goal: Sayohat, yarim kunlik ish va o'qish tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Would you rather…?) va qo'shimcha savol bilan suhbatni davom ettirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever missed a train?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi: When? Where? What happened in the end?
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi. Ustoz uning 1 ta javobidan MC savoli tuzadi (A, B, C) — sinf topadi.

items.t: …has travelled overnight on a train or a bus.
items.q: Have you ever travelled overnight on a train or a bus?

items.t: …has had a part-time job while studying.

items.q: Have you ever used a city bike or an electric scooter?

items.t: …has missed a train, a bus or a flight.
items.q: Have you ever missed a train, a bus or a flight?

items.t: …has bought a souvenir that he/she never used.

9.title: Speaking cards: travel, jobs and study
9.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida (IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
9.goal: Sayohat, transport, yarim kunlik ish va o'qish mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish; but / whereas / in the end bilan fikrni solishtirish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi (examiner) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 20–30 soniya javob beradi (Part 3 savollarida — 40 soniyagacha): fikr + sabab + misol.
Examiner javobdagi signal so'zlarni sanaydi (but, however, whereas, actually, in the end, used to): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga aytdiradi.

cards: How do you usually get to school or work? Has this changed in recent years?
Do you prefer travelling by train or by bus? Why?
Have you ever travelled overnight? How did you feel the next day?
Do you buy souvenirs when you travel? What kind?
Would you like to have a part-time job while you study? Why or why not?
What is more important in a first job: the money or the working hours? Why?

9.title: Sentence Race: MC strategy and trap sentences
9.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
9.goal: Multiple choice strategiyasi gaplari va tuzoq yaratadigan gaplarda (used to, but, whereas, in the end) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, vergul va nuqta qayerda ekanini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball oladi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; keyin konvertlar jamoalar orasida almashadi.
Bonus +1: tuzoq gapda qaysi variant javob, qaysi biri tuzoq ekanini aytish (masalan: 'six — eski ma'lumot, late — javob').
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Always read the questions before the recording begins.
You may hear all three options in the recording.
The café pays more, but the shifts start too early.
The shop used to close at six, but these days it stays open late.
My brother enjoyed the concert, whereas I found it too loud.
If you are not sure, choose the most likely option.
In the end, we decided to drive to the airport.
Mark your answer and move on to the next question.
The wrong options are there to test your understanding.
Old information is a common trap in multiple-choice questions.

9.title: Quiz Board: Multiple Choice (Listening)
9.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida o'tgan savol turini takrorlash yoki 'Tahlil' o'rniga (15 daqiqa)
9.goal: Multiple choice qoidalari, chalg'ituvchi turlari, variant ↔ audio paraphrase'lari va 'Say it!' bo'limida tuzoq gaplarni og'zaki tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Spot the trap 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida 30 soniya gapiradi). To'g'ri bo'lsa ball jamoaga.
Xato bo'lsa, boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ballning yarmi).
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many options are there in a standard IELTS Listening MC question?
When should you read the question and the options?
Do Listening MC questions follow the order of the recording?
qs.a: Yes — they come in the same order.

qs.q: You hear words from all three options. How do you choose?
qs.a: Choose the one that answers the question in meaning.

qs.q: You are not sure of an answer. What should you do, and why?
qs.a: Guess the most likely option — a blank always scores 0.

qs.q: 'It used to cost £5, but now it's £7.' How much is it now?
'My friend liked the film, but I found it boring.' What did the speaker think?
qs.a: It was boring (the friend's opinion is the trap).

qs.q: 'We'd planned to fly, but in the end we went by coach.' How did they travel?
qs.a: By coach (flying was only the plan).

qs.q: Option: 'cheap and close to the centre'. Audio: 'cheap, but far from the centre'. Right?
qs.a: No — partly true: only 'cheap' is correct.

qs.q: 'The film starts at 7.30, but the doors open half an hour earlier.' When can you go in?
qs.a: From 7.00 (7.30 is the trap — you must calculate).

qs.q: inexpensive = ?
a discount = ?
qs.a: a reduced price / … per cent off

qs.q: compulsory = ?
Option: 'free'. Audio: 'at no extra cost'. Do they match?
qs.a: Yes — 'at no extra cost' means free.

qs.q: Audio: 'nowhere to leave the bike'. Which option: A) no bikes B) no parking spaces C) no helmets?
Say one signal word that often comes just before the answer.
qs.a: e.g. but / however / actually / in the end

qs.q: Make an 'old information' trap sentence about your school.
qs.a: e.g. Lessons used to start at 8, but now they start at 9.

qs.q: Say a sentence where your opinion is different from a friend's.
qs.a: e.g. My friend loves football, whereas I prefer tennis.

qs.q: Ask the class an MC question about your city with three options.
qs.a: e.g. What is our city famous for? A) food B) parks C) the metro

qs.q: In 30 seconds, explain in English how you cross out wrong options.
qs.a: e.g. I cross out options that are heard but don't answer the question.

10.title: Grammar Auction: reasons for, effect on, a rise in
10.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
10.goal: Sarlavha va asosiy g'oya tilidagi birikmalar (reason for, effect on, solution to, a rise in, worried about + -ing, most + ko'plik ot) va moslashuv (the main idea is, teenagers need) — to'g'ri-xatoni ajratish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar transport, shahar, hayvonlar va uyqu mavzusida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: reasons of → reasons for, effect to → effect on).
Bonus: gapni sotib olgan jamoa unga 3–5 so'zli sarlavha aytadi (masalan: 'A rise in wolf numbers'). Sarlavha gapning asosiy g'oyasiga mos bo'lsa +50.
Oxirida eng ko'p to'g'ri gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Congestion charges are one solution to heavy traffic in city centres.
items.why: solution to + ot (predlog 'to'). Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: The paragraph explains the reasons of the teenage sleep problem.
items.fix: The paragraph explains the reasons for the teenage sleep problem.
items.why: Sabab — reason for; 'reasons of' deyilmaydi.

items.s: Many shopkeepers were against the idea of closing streets to cars.
items.why: the idea of + -ing; close streets to cars — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: Street noise has a strong effect to the way city birds sing.
items.fix: Street noise has a strong effect on the way city birds sing.
items.why: Ta'sir — effect on; 'effect to' xato.

items.s: There has been a sharp rise in the number of wolves in Europe.
items.why: a rise in + ot — o'sish; the number of + ko'plik ot. To'g'ri.

items.s: Wider roads often attract even more drivers.
items.why: even more — yana ham ko'proq. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Most teenagers needs more sleep than adults think.
items.fix: Most teenagers need more sleep than adults think.
items.why: teenagers — ko'plik, fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: need.

items.s: Researchers found that city birds start singing earlier than birds in the countryside.
items.why: start + -ing; earlier than — qiyoslash to'g'ri.

items.s: The main idea of both paragraphs are the same.
items.fix: The main idea of both paragraphs is the same.
items.why: Ega — 'the main idea' (birlik), shuning uchun 'is'.

items.s: Farmers are worried about lose their sheep to wolves.
items.fix: Farmers are worried about losing their sheep to wolves.
items.why: Predlogdan (about) keyin fe'l -ing shaklida: about losing.

items.s: The most people in big cities spend hours in traffic every week.
items.fix: Most people in big cities spend hours in traffic every week.
items.why: 'Ko'pchilik' ma'nosida most artiklsiz keladi: most people ('the most people' xato).

items.s: Traffic-free shopping streets became popular in Europe in the 1960s.
items.why: in the 1960s — o'n yillik oldidan 'the'. Gap to'g'ri.

10.title: Board Game: Main idea or detail?
10.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan keyin yoki keyingi darsda takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
10.goal: Matching headings strategiyasi (avval xatboshi, asosiy g'oya, tartibsizlik, ortiqcha sarlavhalar), asosiy g'oya va tafsilotni ajratish, matn so'zlarini paraphrase qilish va shahar / uyqu / tabiat mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: 'main idea' yoki 'detail' deydi, paraphrase aytadi, sarlavha o'ylab topadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javob kaliti bo'yicha tekshiradi ('e.g.' — namunaviy javob, boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Are the headings (i, ii, iii…) in the same order as the paragraphs?
squares.a: No — they are in random order, so read each paragraph separately.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'traffic jam'
squares.a: congestion / heavy traffic

squares.t: What do you read first: the paragraph or the list of headings?
squares.a: The paragraph — then say its main idea in your own words.

squares.t: Main idea or detail? 'The toll is £15 a day.'
squares.a: Detail — a specific number.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'disappeared'
squares.a: were no longer found / vanished

squares.t: Why are there more headings than paragraphs?
squares.a: Some headings are extra distractors and are not used.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: is traffic a problem in your city?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, in Tashkent the roads are very busy in the rush hour.

squares.t: Where is the main idea usually found in a paragraph?
squares.a: Often in the first or last sentence — but check the whole paragraph.

squares.t: Main idea or detail? 'Many cities are trying to reduce car use.'
squares.a: Main idea — a general statement.

squares.t: Explain the difference: 'causes of X' and 'effects of X'.
squares.a: Causes = why it happens; effects = what happens as a result.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'opposition'
squares.a: resistance / people were against it

squares.t: A heading fits only one sentence of a paragraph. Choose it?
squares.a: No — a heading must cover the whole paragraph.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'brought back'
squares.a: reintroduced / returned

squares.t: Give a heading for a paragraph about why teens go to bed late.
squares.a: e.g. Reasons for late bedtimes / A body clock that moves later

squares.t: Two headings: 'Problems with X' / 'Solutions to X'. What do you check?
squares.a: Does the paragraph describe difficulties or ways to fix them?

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'exhausting'
squares.a: very tiring

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should city centres be closed to cars?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, streets become safer and cleaner, but some shops may lose customers.

squares.t: Why is 'word spotting' dangerous in matching headings?
squares.a: The same word may appear in the wrong paragraph; match meaning, not words.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a promising start'
squares.a: early success / a positive beginning

squares.t: Give this morning a one-line heading.
squares.a: e.g. A rushed start to a busy day

squares.t: Main idea or detail? 'In 2019, one town opened 12 bike lanes.'
squares.a: Detail — one specific example with numbers.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'financial benefits'
squares.a: economic advantages / financial gains

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how much sleep do teenagers need? Why?
squares.a: e.g. About 8–10 hours, because their brains and bodies are still developing.

squares.t: Explain your matching headings strategy in three steps.
squares.a: Read the paragraph, say its main idea, then choose the heading.

10.title: Dominoes: heading ↔ paragraph summary
10.stage: 'Sinf mashqi' bosqichida yoki undan keyin: sarlavhani xatboshi mazmuni bilan ulash (12 daqiqa)
10.goal: Sarlavhani xatboshining bir gapli mazmuni (asosiy g'oyasi) bilan bog'lash: sarlavhadagi so'z matnda bo'lmasligi mumkin — ma'noga qarab ulash (paraphrase).
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi SARLAVHAGA mos xatboshi mazmunini (bir gapli xulosani) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har juftlikdagi paraphrase'ni aytadi (masalan: 'paying' = 'charged a fee', 'opposition' = 'protested'). Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus +1: bitta sarlavhaga o'xshash, lekin noto'g'ri sarlavha o'ylab topish.

pairs: Paying to drive into the centre

Online courses save students time and money.
More foreign visitors now come to Samarkand.
Shop owners protested against closing the street.

Do you prefer reading news headlines or full articles? Why?

10.title: Sentence Race: main ideas and heading rules
10.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
10.goal: Matching headings qoidalari va xatboshining asosiy g'oyasini ifodalovchi gaplarda (topic sentence) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, vergul va nuqta qayerda ekanini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball oladi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; keyin konvertlar jamoalar orasida almashadi.
Bonus +1: gap qoidami yoki xatboshi mazmunimi — agar mazmun bo'lsa, unga qisqa sarlavha aytish.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: A good heading covers the whole paragraph, not one detail.
Many cities charge drivers a fee to enter the centre.
Shopkeepers were worried that they would lose customers.
Missing sleep makes it harder for teenagers to concentrate.
City birds sing higher so that they can be heard over traffic.
The paragraph explains why wolves have returned to Europe.
You cannot use the same heading twice.
Extra headings are included to test your understanding.
Start with the paragraphs that seem easiest to you.
Closing streets to cars made shopping safer and more pleasant.

10.title: Quiz Board: Matching Headings (Reading)
10.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida o'tgan savol turini takrorlash yoki 'Tahlil' o'rniga (15 daqiqa)
10.goal: Matching headings qoidalari, asosiy g'oya va tafsilot farqi, matn ↔ sarlavha paraphrase'lari va 'Say it!' bo'limida o'z sarlavhasini tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Main idea or detail? 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida 30 soniya gapiradi). To'g'ri bo'lsa ball jamoaga.
Xato bo'lsa, boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ballning yarmi).
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Are there more headings or more paragraphs?
qs.a: More headings — some are not used.

qs.q: What should you read first: the paragraph or the headings?
Is the list of headings in the same order as the paragraphs?
qs.a: No — the headings are in random order.

qs.q: A heading matches one sentence only. Is it the right heading?
qs.a: Probably not — it must fit the whole paragraph.

qs.q: Two headings look alike: 'Problems of X' and 'Solutions to X'. What do you do?
qs.a: Find the word that differs and check what the paragraph does.

qs.q: 'Traffic is a growing problem in many cities.'
'The fine is 50 euros.'
'There are several reasons why teenagers sleep late.'
'One farmer lost twenty sheep in a single night.'
Where is the main idea often found, and why must you still read everything?
qs.a: Often first or last sentence — but it can be in the middle.

qs.q: congestion = ?
disappeared = ?
exhausting = ?
'Shopkeepers protested against the plan.' One noun for the heading?
Heading: 'Early success'. Which fits: A) Sales rose in the first month. B) Sales may rise one day.
qs.a: A — it describes success at the start.

qs.q: Say the main idea of today's lesson in one sentence.
qs.a: e.g. A heading must match the main idea of the whole paragraph.

qs.q: Give your last weekend a heading.
qs.a: e.g. A relaxing weekend with my family

qs.q: Say one main idea and one detail about your city.
qs.a: e.g. My city is growing fast. Two new schools opened this year.

qs.q: Make two similar headings about traffic and explain the difference.
qs.a: e.g. 'Causes of traffic jams' vs 'Solutions to traffic jams'

qs.q: In 30 seconds: should cities ban cars from the centre? Start with your main idea.
qs.a: e.g. I think they should, because streets become safer and cleaner.

11.title: Grammar Auction: inventions, memory and work
11.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin, paraphrase mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: Reading matnlari mavzusidagi (konditsioner, ruchka, xotira, 4 kunlik hafta) gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: artikl, because/because of, moslik, so'z turkumi, effect/affect.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaning boshlang'ich puli — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap grammatik jihatdan to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatib, xato turini aytgan jamoa (artikl, moslik, so'z turkumi…) +50 oladi.
MC odati: har gapda bitta so'z hal qiladi — xuddi variantlardagi farqli so'z kabi. Ustoz buni oxirida ta'kidlaydi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The first air conditioner was designed to solve a problem at a printing plant.
items.why: Passiv: was + V3 (designed); 'to solve' — maqsadni bildiradi.

items.s: In the 1920s, air conditioners were too expensive for the most people.
items.fix: In the 1920s, air conditioners were too expensive for most people.
items.why: Umumiy ma'noda 'most people' (ko'pchilik) — 'the' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: Cinemas earned more money because of they were cool in summer.
items.fix: Cinemas earned more money because they were cool in summer.
items.why: 'because of' + ot; ega + fe'l (they were) kelsa — 'because'.

items.s: The ballpoint pen was invented much earlier than most people think.
items.why: 'much' + comparative (much earlier than) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Biro's first pens was not popular because they had to be held upright.
items.fix: Biro's first pens were not popular because they had to be held upright.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (pens) → 'were'.

items.s: Our memories are not as reliable as we usually believe.
items.why: 'not as + sifat + as' — to'g'ri taqqoslash.

items.s: A witness who feels very confident is not always accurately.
items.fix: A witness who feels very confident is not always accurate.
items.why: 'be' dan keyin sifat keladi (accurate), ravish (accurately) emas.

items.s: In the experiment, the word 'smashed' made many people remember broken glass that was not there.
items.why: 'make + kishi + fe'l asosi' (made people remember) — to'g'ri.

items.s: The four-day week had a positive affect on employees' health.
items.fix: The four-day week had a positive effect on employees' health.
items.why: 'effect' — ot (ta'sir), 'affect' — fe'l: have an effect on.

items.s: Most of the companies decided to keep the shorter week after the trial.
items.why: 'most of the + ko'plik ot' — aniq guruh (sinovdagi kompaniyalar) haqida.

items.s: The number of staff who left their jobs were much lower than before.
items.fix: The number of staff who left their jobs was much lower than before.
items.why: 'The number of …' birlik fe'l oladi: was.

items.s: Some researchers believe that the language we speak shapes the way we think.
items.why: Ega 'the language' — birlik, shuning uchun 'shapes' (-s).

11.title: Board Game: Multiple choice strategy race
11.stage: 2-qo'shimcha reading tekshirilgach, tahlildan oldin (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: Multiple choice strategiyasini (farqli so'z, tuzoqlar, mutlaq so'zlar, vaqt) og'zaki takrorlash, matnlardagi iboralarni paraphrase qilish va mavzu bo'yicha gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 kishilik guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, iborani paraphrase qiladi yoki savolga 20–30 soniya javob beradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; paraphrase va 'Speaking' kataklarida boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki 30 soniyada javob bo'lmasa, o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: How many options does a Reading multiple-choice question usually have?
squares.a: Four (A–D); you choose one.

squares.t: Do the answers follow the order of the passage?
squares.a: Yes — work through the questions in order.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'cost too much'
squares.a: was too expensive / was not affordable

squares.t: What do you do FIRST with a multiple-choice question?
squares.a: Read the question and say in one sentence what it asks.

squares.t: Find the different word: A) Most workers agreed. B) All workers agreed.
squares.a: most / all (more than half vs every worker)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'became popular'
squares.a: took off / caught on

squares.t: Speaking: Which invention could you not live without? Why?
squares.a: e.g. My phone — I use it to study and to stay in touch with my family.

squares.t: Name three 'danger words' that often make an option wrong.
squares.a: always, never, only, all, every (any three)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'depended on'
squares.a: relied on / counted on

squares.t: What is the 'partly true' trap?
squares.a: One half of the option matches the text, but the other half does not.

squares.t: Find the different word: A) Sales doubled. B) Sales nearly doubled.
squares.a: nearly — B says the amount was a little less than double.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'can be trusted'
squares.a: reliable / dependable

squares.t: Speaking: Would you like a four-day working week? Why / why not?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — I would have more time for my family, sport and study.

squares.t: What is the 'true but not the answer' trap?
squares.a: The option is in the text, but it answers a different question.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'income rose steeply'
squares.a: e.g. earnings increased sharply / went up very fast

squares.t: How long should you spend on one multiple-choice question?
squares.a: About 1.5–2 minutes.

squares.t: Difference: 'The writer criticises X' vs 'The writer mentions X'?
squares.a: criticise = says X is bad; mention = only refers to X

squares.t: Speaking: Is your memory good? Give an example.
squares.a: e.g. I remember faces well, but I often forget people's names.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'without our permission'
squares.a: without us agreeing / without asking us

squares.t: You can't decide between B and C. What do you do?
squares.a: Choose one, mark the question and come back to it at the end.

squares.t: Why write a reason next to each option you reject?
squares.a: It makes you check the text instead of guessing.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'performance fell sharply'
squares.a: e.g. results got much worse very quickly

squares.t: Speaking: Does technology make people's memory worse? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — we save everything on our phones, so we remember less.

squares.t: Make two options that differ in only ONE word.
squares.a: e.g. A) Prices rose slightly. B) Prices rose sharply.

11.title: Dominoes: text words and their paraphrases
11.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida, jadval o'rniga (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: Matndagi ibora va savoldagi paraphrase'ni tez tanish (took off = became popular, relied on = depended on): MC da javob so'z bilan emas, ma'no bilan topiladi.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshini aralashtirib bering.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Toshning o'ng tomonida matndagi ibora bor — uning paraphrase'i (bir xil ma'no) qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping va ulang.
Har ulashda ikkala iborani ovoz chiqarib o'qing; ma'nosi bir xilligini sherigingizga bir gap bilan tushuntiring.
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulash bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: changes in how hot or cold it is
only worked in a vertical position
people who agree to take part
a very clear picture in your mind
depended on people who saw the event
proved innocent by a scientific test
rest days at different times for different staff
has no way to name exact amounts
did not accept what was concluded

11.title: Taboo: inventions, memory and work
11.stage: Dars boshida, kirish bosqichida isinish yoki keyingi dars boshida (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: Reading matnlaridagi mavzu so'zlarini (invention, humidity, luxury, witness, evidence, linguist…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball va keyingi karta. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

11.title: Find someone who… has taken part in an experiment
11.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin, harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: Present perfect / present simple / would bilan to'g'ri savol tuzish; ixtirolar, xotira, ish va tillar mavzusida B2 darajada gaplashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever taken part in a scientific experiment?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why? What happened?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; faqat inglizcha gapiriladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi; ustoz kalit bo'yicha savollarini tekshiradi va u eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has forgotten an important password this month.
items.q: Have you forgotten an important password this month?

items.t: …remembers his/her first day at school clearly.
items.q: Do you remember your first day at school clearly?

items.t: …thinks air conditioning is a necessity, not a luxury.
items.q: Do you think air conditioning is a necessity, not a luxury?

items.t: …has taken part in a scientific experiment or survey.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a scientific experiment or survey?

items.t: …would choose a four-day week even with lower pay.
items.q: Would you choose a four-day week even with lower pay?

items.t: …has bought something because of an advertisement.
items.q: Have you ever bought something because of an advertisement?

items.t: …uses a pen more often than a keyboard.
items.q: Do you use a pen more often than a keyboard?

items.t: …can speak three or more languages.
items.q: Can you speak three or more languages?

items.t: …has been sure about a memory that turned out to be wrong.
items.q: Have you ever been sure about a memory that turned out to be wrong?

items.t: …uses flashcards or an app to memorise new words.
items.q: Do you use flashcards or an app to memorise new words?

items.t: …knows who invented the telephone.
items.q: Do you know who invented the telephone?

items.t: …has read an English article of over 500 words this week.
items.q: Have you read an English article of over 500 words this week?

11.title: Speaking cards: inventions, memory and work
11.stage: Listening bosqichi o'rnida (bu darsda audio yo'q) yoki keyingi dars boshida, Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa); ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: Reading mavzulari (ixtirolar, xotira, 4 kunlik hafta, til va fikrlash) bo'yicha IELTS Part 1/3 uslubida fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol (masalan: I think… because… For example…).
Tinglovchi ball beradi: aniq sabab uchun +1, misol uchun +1, matnlardan olingan mavzu so'zi uchun +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball to'plagan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What is the most useful invention in your home? Why?

11.title: Sentence Race: MC options and strategy sentences
11.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: MC strategiyasi gaplari va matn mazmunini paraphrase qilgan variant gaplarda so'z tartibini tiklash.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi: ichida bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta — gap oxiri) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert. Jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qib, qaysi matnga yoki qaysi qoidaga tegishli ekanini aytsa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The writer's main purpose is to explain how memory works.

Half of option C matches the text, but the other half does not.

11.title: Quiz Board: multiple choice and paraphrase
11.stage: Tahlil bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
11.goal: MC qoidalari, paraphrase, matnlardagi mavzu so'zlari va variantlar farqini og'zaki tushuntirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 ustun × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollarida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many options does each Reading multiple-choice question usually have?
Do the answers follow the order of the passage?
Name two 'danger words' that often make an option wrong.
What is the 'partly true' trap?
qs.a: One part of the option is right, the other part is wrong.

qs.q: An option is true in the text but does not answer the question. Choose it?
qs.a: No — it is a trap: true, but not the answer.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'cost too much'
qs.a: was too expensive / was not affordable

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'became popular'

Paraphrase: 'kept at the same level'
A person who saw a crime and describes it in court.
The amount of water in the air.
Something pleasant and expensive that you do not really need.
A scientist who studies how languages work.
The money a company receives from selling its goods or services.
Explain the difference: 'most' vs 'all'.
qs.a: most = more than half; all = every one

qs.a: describes = explains it; recommends = says it is a good idea

12.title: Grammar Auction: does the answer fit the sentence?
12.stage: Sinf mashqidan (so'z turkumini bashorat qilish) keyin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: To'ldirilgan gap grammatik to'g'riligini tekshirish: to/will + fe'l asosi, sondan keyin ko'plik, ot yoki sifat (safe/safety, serve/service), comparative (cheaper).
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaning boshlang'ich puli — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi: bu Part 2 audiolari mavzusidagi, bo'sh joyi to'ldirilgan gap. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: to'ldirilgan so'z gapga grammatik mosmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatib, qaysi so'z turkumi kerakligini aytgan jamoa (ot, fe'l asosi, sifat, ko'plik) +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Children under twelve are not allowed to walk around without an adult.
items.why: 'be allowed to + fe'l asosi' (to walk) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Visitors are not allowed to feeding the animals.
items.fix: Visitors are not allowed to feed the animals.
items.why: 'to' dan keyin fe'lning asos shakli: to feed.

items.s: The land train takes visitors around the park every twenty minutes.
items.why: Present simple, ega birlik (the land train) → takes.

items.s: The park is home to over four hundred animal.
items.fix: The park is home to over four hundred animals.
items.why: Birdan katta sondan keyin ot ko'plikda: animals.

items.s: The new device will helping parents check school attendance.
items.fix: The new device will help parents check school attendance.
items.why: 'will' dan keyin fe'lning asos shakli: will help.

items.s: The festival has moved to the school playing fields this year.
items.why: Present perfect: has + V3 (moved) — natija hozir muhim.

items.s: A weekend pass is more cheap than buying three tickets.
items.fix: A weekend pass is cheaper than buying three tickets.
items.why: Bir bo'g'inli sifat: cheap → cheaper ('more' qo'shilmaydi).

items.s: The fitness room is next to a studio for yoga and dance classes.
items.why: 'next to' — joy predlogi; 'a studio for …' — to'g'ri.

items.s: The exhibition shows devices that keep children safety at home.
items.fix: The exhibition shows devices that keep children safe at home.
items.why: 'keep + kishi + sifat': safe; 'safety' — ot.

items.s: The otters are fed at half past eleven every morning.
items.why: Passiv: are + V3 (fed); aniq vaqt oldidan 'at'.

items.s: Joe prefers shops because of the personal serve he gets there.
items.fix: Joe prefers shops because of the personal service he gets there.
items.why: 'the personal ___' — ot kerak: service ('serve' — fe'l).

items.s: All the profits from the festival will go to a children's hospital.
items.why: 'will + fe'l asosi' (will go) — to'g'ri.

12.title: Board Game: predict, listen, complete
12.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin, audio javoblari tekshirilgach (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Bo'sh joyga qanday so'z kerakligini bashorat qilish, so'z chegarasi, paraphrase, vaqt/son/imlo va Part 2 mavzularida (muzey, park, festival, sport zali) gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 kishilik guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: so'z turkumini bashorat qiladi, paraphrase qiladi, raqam/vaqtni aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
'Predict' kataklarida faqat so'z turkumi (ot, fe'l, son, sifat) aytilsa ham yetarli; misol so'z aytsa — guruh qarsak chaladi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; xato bo'lsa o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Listening Part 2: how many speakers are there?
squares.a: Usually one — it is a monologue (a talk, a tour or an announcement).

squares.t: Predict the word type: 'Please ___ your ticket at the entrance.'
squares.a: a verb in the base form, e.g. show

squares.t: Predict: 'The boat trip takes about ___ hours.'
squares.a: a number, e.g. two

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'students can borrow books'
squares.a: students are allowed to take out books

squares.t: Speaking: Describe a museum or park you have visited.
squares.a: e.g. Last spring I visited a museum in Samarkand with my class…

squares.t: Predict: 'The new pool is much ___ than the old one.'
squares.a: a comparative adjective, e.g. deeper / bigger

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY. Is 'the museum' an acceptable answer?
squares.a: No — it is two words; write 'museum'.

squares.t: Correct the answer: 'The device will helping parents.'
squares.a: The device will help parents.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'free of charge'
squares.a: free / it costs nothing / you don't have to pay

squares.t: Say this time in two ways: 11.30
squares.a: half past eleven / eleven thirty

squares.t: Predict: 'Only people over ___ can use the gym alone.'
squares.a: a number (an age), e.g. sixteen

squares.t: Speaking: What should a good sports centre have?
squares.a: e.g. a pool, a gym, changing rooms and a café.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'is not permitted'
squares.a: is not allowed / is forbidden

squares.t: Singular or plural: 'over four hundred ___'?
squares.a: plural, e.g. animals

squares.t: Why read the sentences BEFORE the audio starts?
squares.a: To predict the word type and find the key words to listen for.

squares.t: Predict: 'The café only accepts payment by ___.'
squares.a: a noun, e.g. card

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'runs every twenty minutes'
squares.a: runs three times an hour

squares.t: Speaking: Talk for 30 seconds about a festival in your city.
squares.a: e.g. On Navruz we cook sumalak, visit relatives and go to the park.

squares.t: Gap: 'an app designed to ___ your data'. protect or protecting?
squares.a: protect — after 'to' we need the base form.

squares.t: Spell 'accommodation' letter by letter.
squares.a: A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-I-O-N

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'prevent an accident'
squares.a: avoid an accident / stop an accident from happening

squares.t: You have written your answer. What do you do next?
squares.a: Read the whole sentence again: does it make sense and fit grammatically?

squares.t: Speaking: Online or in a shop — where do you buy electronics? Why?
squares.a: e.g. In a shop — I can try the product and take it home at once.

squares.t: Make a gap sentence about your school for a partner.
squares.a: e.g. Lessons start at ___ every morning. (answer: 8.30)

12.title: Dominoes: question words vs what the speaker says
12.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida, jadval o'rniga (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Savol gapidagi ibora va audioda aytiladigan paraphrase'ni tanish (can borrow = are allowed to take out; twice as many = double the number).
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshini aralashtirib bering.

START toshini stolga qo'ying. Toshning o'ng tomonida savol varag'idagi ibora bor — so'zlovchi uni boshqacha qanday aytishi mumkin? O'sha paraphrase qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping va ulang.
Bir o'quvchi o'ng tomonni 'savol' kabi, sherigi chap tomonni 'audio' kabi ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulash bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

12.title: Taboo: exhibitions, parks, festivals and gadgets
12.stage: Dars boshida, kirish bosqichida isinish yoki keyingi dars boshida (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Part 2 mavzularidagi so'zlarni (exhibition, device, attendance, cloakroom, stall, membership…) inglizcha ta'rif va sinonim bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; javobni to'g'ri harflab (spelling) aytib bersa yana +1 — Listening'da imlo muhim.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

12.title: Find someone who… has been to an exhibition
12.stage: 1-qo'shimcha mashqdan keyin, harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Present perfect va present simple bilan to'g'ri savol tuzish; ko'rgazma, park, festival, sport zali va elektronika xaridi mavzusida gaplashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you been to an exhibition this year?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where? When? How much did it cost?) — javobdagi son yoki joy nomini ham yozib oladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; faqat inglizcha gapiriladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi; ustoz savollarini kalit bo'yicha tekshiradi.

items.t: …has been to an exhibition or museum this year.
