items.q: Do you know the opening hours of the nearest library?

12.title: Speaking cards: places to visit, events and gadgets
12.stage: 2-qo'shimcha mashqdan keyin, mavzu bo'yicha gapirish (IELTS Speaking Part 1/3, 12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Part 2 audiolari mavzularida (muzey va ko'rgazma, festival, sport markazi, hayvonot parki, elektronika xaridi) IELTS Part 1/3 uslubida fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol. Javobda kamida bitta son, vaqt yoki narx aytilsin.
Tinglovchi javobdagi son/vaqt/narxni daftarga yozadi va oxirida takrorlab beradi — to'g'ri bo'lsa ikkalasiga +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball to'plagan juftlik g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy visiting museums or exhibitions? Why / why not?
What was the last exhibition or show you went to? Describe it.
Are there good sports facilities near your home? What are they like?
Should sports centres be free for students? Why / why not?
What is the most popular festival in your city? What happens there?
Do you think festivals are good for a city's economy? How?
Is it better to buy electronics online or in a shop? Why?
What influences your shopping choices more: friends, reviews or adverts?
Have you ever visited a zoo or wildlife park? Did you enjoy it?
Should zoos and wildlife parks exist today? Give reasons.
Why are rules such as 'don't feed the animals' important?
How can technology help parents keep children safe?
What new gadget would you like to buy? Why?
Do people spend too much money on electronic devices nowadays?
Why do many people prefer guided tours to exploring a place alone?
How could your city attract more visitors to its parks and museums?

12.title: Sentence Race: sentence completion rules and notices
12.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Sentence completion qoidalari va Part 2 e'lonlariga o'xshash gaplarda so'z tartibini tiklash (modal + fe'l asosi, passiv, predloglar).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi: ichida bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf — gap boshi, nuqta — gap oxiri) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball. Jamoa gapdagi bitta so'zni bo'sh joy qilib, uning turkumini (ot, fe'l, son) aytsa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Predict whether the missing word is a noun or a verb.
After 'will', we need the base form of the verb.
A paraphrase expresses the same idea in different words.
Writing too many words makes your answer wrong.
After writing an answer, read the whole sentence again.
Visitors are not allowed to feed the animals.
Maps are available free of charge at the ticket desk.
Only cash is accepted at the ticket office.
Anyone under sixteen can enter the festival for free.
The new sports hall took a year and a half to build.

12.title: Quiz Board: sentence completion
12.stage: Tahlil bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
12.goal: Sentence completion qoidalari (so'z turkumi, chegara, grammatik moslik), paraphrase, Part 2 mavzu so'zlari va son/vaqt/imloni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 ustun × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Gap rules 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollarida javob ovoz chiqarib aytiladi, harflab aytishda har harf to'g'ri bo'lishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Listening Part 2 is a monologue. What does that mean?
qs.a: One person speaks (e.g. a talk or an announcement).

qs.q: The limit is NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS and you write three. What is your score?
qs.a: zero — the answer is marked wrong

qs.q: Which word type fits: 'Staff will ___ you to your seat.'?
qs.a: a verb in the base form (e.g. show / take)

qs.q: Fix the answer: 'The ticket includes a free guided tours.'
Gap: 'Please avoid ___ the animals.' feed or feeding?
qs.a: feeding — 'avoid' is followed by the -ing form

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'not allowed'
Paraphrase: 'a year and a half'
Paraphrase: 'at no cost'
Paraphrase: 'the most crowded time'
qs.a: the busiest time / the peak time

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'was damaged by water'
A room where you leave your coat.
A small table or shop at a market or festival.
The money you earn every month from your job.
Being present at school or work regularly.
An expert who plans healthy diets.
Say this time in two ways: 3.45
qs.a: a quarter to four / three forty-five

qs.q: Spell the word 'exhibition' aloud.
Say this price aloud: £32.50
Say this year aloud: 1974
Describe your school's facilities in 20 seconds.
qs.a: e.g. We have a library, a gym and a computer room.

13.title: Grammar Auction: talking about gadgets
13.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftari bilan birga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari keyingi darsga.
13.goal: Texnologiya mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 darajadagi tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish: predlog (keen on, thinking of), sanalmaydigan ot (space), many/much, moslashuv (everyone has), -ed/-ing sifat, although…but.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz texnologiya mavzusidagi gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (Listening Part 2–3 dagi kabi gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: xato turini ham aytishi kerak (predlog, ko'plik, moslashuv, so'z shakli yoki bog'lovchi).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I considered getting a smartwatch, but in the end I decided against it.
items.why: consider + -ing; 'decided against it' — variant rad etilgan (inkor signali).

items.s: My grandmother isn't keen of video calls.
items.fix: My grandmother isn't keen on video calls.
items.why: Turg'un birikma: keen ON (of emas).

items.s: My new laptop doesn't take up much spaces on the desk.
items.fix: My new laptop doesn't take up much space on the desk.
items.why: space (joy) — sanalmaydigan ot, ko'plik shakli yo'q; much + space.

items.s: These speakers sound crisp and clear, even at high volume.
items.why: sound + sifat (crisp, clear), ravish emas; at high volume — to'g'ri.

items.s: Everyone in my family have a smartphone now.
items.fix: Everyone in my family has a smartphone now.
items.why: everyone — birlik ega: has (have emas).

items.s: I'm very interesting in new electronic devices.
items.fix: I'm very interested in new electronic devices.
items.why: Odamning his-tuyg'usi: interested in; interesting — narsaning xususiyati.

items.s: Most people can't afford the latest gadgets when they first come out.
items.why: afford + ot; come out = sotuvga chiqmoq — to'g'ri.

items.s: The display was so dim that I could hardly read my messages.
items.why: so + sifat + that; could hardly + fe'l asosi (to siz).

items.s: There were too much people at the exhibition, so we had to queue.
items.fix: There were too many people at the exhibition, so we had to queue.
items.why: people — sanaladigan ko'plik ot: many (much emas).

items.s: Many students find it easier to take notes on a laptop than on paper.
items.why: find it + sifat + to-infinitive; easier … than — to'g'ri.

items.s: Although the phone looks good, but it is difficult to use.
items.fix: Although the phone looks good, it is difficult to use.
items.why: although va but bitta gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: My brother spends ages setting up every new gadget he buys.
items.why: spend + vaqt + -ing (spends ages setting up) — to'g'ri.

13.title: Board Game: Answer or distractor?
13.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin mustahkamlash sifatida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
13.goal: Pick from a list strategiyasini og'zaki mustahkamlash: variantlarni oldindan o'qish, tasdiq/inkor signallari, chalg'ituvchi turlari, paraphrase va texnologiya mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase qiladi, gap 'answer' yoki 'distractor' ekanini sababi bilan tushuntiradi yoki mavzu bo'yicha gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda kalit bor). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk/Speak' kataklarida o'yinchi to'liq gaplar bilan 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida bitta paraphrase ishlatadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: 'Choose TWO letters': how many letters do you write?
squares.a: Two letters, in any order (B, C = C, B).

squares.t: When do you read the five options: before or after listening?
squares.a: Before listening — underline the key words.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a gadget'
squares.a: a device / a piece of equipment

squares.t: Answer or distractor? 'I was going to buy a printer, but I realised I didn't need one.'
squares.a: Distractor — 'but … didn't need one' rejects the printer.

squares.t: Say three signal words that REJECT an option.
squares.a: e.g. but, however, I decided not to, I'm not keen on

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'expensive'
squares.a: costly / pricey / it costs a lot

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: which gadget do you use most every day?
squares.a: e.g. My phone — I use it for messages, maps and music.

squares.t: Answer or distractor? 'The screen is really bright — I love it.'
squares.a: Answer — the speaker clearly likes the screen.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'difficult to use'
squares.a: not user-friendly / hard to operate / complicated

squares.t: Are all five options mentioned in the recording?
squares.a: Usually yes — but only two of them are confirmed.

squares.t: Correct: I'm not so keen of smartwatches.
squares.a: I'm not so keen on smartwatches.

squares.t: One speaker giving a talk: Part 2 or Part 3?
squares.a: Part 2 (a monologue); Part 3 is a conversation.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'it saves space'
squares.a: it doesn't take up much room / it's compact

squares.t: Answer or distractor? 'I thought about a tablet, but my laptop does the same job.'
squares.a: Distractor — the tablet is rejected; the laptop is enough.

squares.t: Say one advantage and one disadvantage of smartphones.
squares.a: e.g. They're convenient, but they can be addictive.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the sound was very clear'
squares.a: the audio quality was crisp / it was easy to hear

squares.t: Distractor type 2: the option is true, but it is about…?
squares.a: …another person or thing, not the one in the question.

squares.t: You heard only ONE answer. What do you do?
squares.a: Write it and guess the second — each letter gets its own mark.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'we had to wait in a queue'
squares.a: we had to queue / we stood in line

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: is modern technology making life easier?
squares.a: e.g. Mostly yes: we can pay, study and shop online.

squares.t: Positive or negative: 'I'm fed up with it'?
squares.a: Negative — the speaker is tired of it / annoyed by it.

squares.t: Part 3 is a conversation with two or more speakers. What must you follow?
squares.a: Who says what — only the person in the question counts.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The phone kept losing the signal.'
squares.a: The connection was unreliable / the phone often had no signal.

squares.t: Describe a gadget you would never buy, and say why.
squares.a: e.g. A smart fridge — it's too expensive and I don't need it.

13.title: Dominoes: what you hear ↔ what the option says
13.stage: 'Paraphrase mashqi' bosqichida, so'zlar jadvali bilan birga yoki uning o'rniga (10 daqiqa)
13.goal: Listening'dagi paraphrase: audioda eshitiladigan ibora (it costs a fortune, it drives me mad…) ↔ savol variantidagi ma'nodosh ibora (it is extremely expensive, it is extremely annoying…).
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora (audioda eshitiladigan so'zlar) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrasega mos — toping va ulang.
Eslatma: Pick from a list savolida variant audioda boshqa so'zlar bilan aytiladi — ma'no bir xil bo'lishi kerak, so'zlar emas.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.

Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('It costs a fortune means it is extremely expensive'); ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: it doesn't take up much room
the sound is crisp and clear
I didn't need to buy it
the choice of stations is limited
there isn't much to choose from
to stay up to date with new devices
it wasn't new when I got it
I can hardly see the screen
the display is difficult to read
we had to queue to get in
we waited in line at the entrance

13.title: Taboo: electronics and gadgets
13.stage: Listening oldidan — texnologiya so'zlarini faollashtirish uchun (10 daqiqa)
13.goal: Elektronika va texnologiya so'zlarini (charger, aerial, tripod, revolving door, survey…) inglizcha ta'rif va paraphrase bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Bu ham paraphrase mashqi: Listening'da ham narsa ko'pincha nomi bilan emas, tavsif bilan beriladi (masalan, 'a small machine for doing sums' = calculator).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

13.title: Find someone who… has been to a tech exhibition
13.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — '2-qo'shimcha reading' (bu darsda qo'shimcha skript) bosqichidan oldin (10 daqiqa)
13.goal: Texnologiya bo'yicha hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Did you use to…? Would you rather…? Are you thinking of…?) va javobdagi tasdiq/inkorni eshitib ajratish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: 'Have you ever been to a technology exhibition?').
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What was it? Why? Was it worth it?).
Listening mashqi: javob beruvchi ba'zan ataylab 'chalg'ituvchi' qo'shadi ('I nearly bought one, but…'). So'rovchi javob aslida 'yes'mi yoki 'no'mi — to'g'ri ajratishi kerak.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

13.title: Speaking cards: technology in daily life
13.stage: Listening skriptini tekshirgandan keyin, mavzu bo'yicha gapirish (Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
13.goal: Texnologiya va turmush mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida 3–4 gapli javob berish; tinglovchi javobdan 2 ta tasdiqlangan fikrni ajratadi (pick from a list ko'nikmasi).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol (IELTS uslubi).
Javobda bitta variantni aytib, keyin RAD etish shart (masalan: 'I thought about a tablet, but in the end…') — xuddi Listening Part 3 dagi kabi.
Tinglovchi javobdagi 2 ta TASDIQLANGAN fikrni aytib beradi va rad etilgan variantni nomlaydi. To'g'ri bo'lsa — ikkalasiga +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What electronic devices do you use every day? Which one is the most important to you?
Do you prefer to buy the latest gadgets or wait until prices go down? Why?
What was the last electronic device you bought? Why did you choose it?
Do you enjoy visiting exhibitions or fairs? What kind do you like?
Do you prefer taking photos with your phone or with a camera? Why?
How often do you use a computer for study or work?
Is there a gadget you bought but hardly ever use? Why don't you use it?
Do you think people spend too much money on electronics nowadays?
How has technology changed the way families spend time together?
Why do some older people find new devices difficult to use?
Should companies make gadgets simpler instead of adding more functions? Why?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of having many functions on one device?
At what age should children be allowed to have a smartphone? Why?
How might electronic devices change our daily lives in the next 20 years?
What do you usually do when a new device doesn't work properly?

13.title: Sentence Race: strategy and signal sentences
13.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin qoidani mustahkamlash yoki 'Xulosa va vazifa' oldidan tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
13.goal: Pick from a list qoidalari va tasdiq/inkor gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish (but, not keen on, not always, before the recording starts).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Agar gap variantni tasdiqlasa yoki rad etsa, jamoa buni aytsa ('bu — inkor, chunki but…') yana +1 ball.
Keyin jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Read all five options before the recording starts.
Each letter is worth one mark, so never leave a gap.
The speaker mentions the option but rejects it.
An option you hear is not always correct.
Which TWO problems does the speaker mention?
I was thinking of buying a tablet, but I changed my mind.
I'm not keen on smartwatches because their screens are tiny.
The headphones are light, but the battery doesn't last long.
Most visitors came to learn about inventions, not to shop.
The exhibition hall is spacious, so it never feels crowded.

13.title: Quiz Board: Choose TWO letters
13.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); tanlanmagan o'yinlar — takror uchun
13.goal: Pick from a list qoidalari, tasdiq/inkor va chalg'ituvchilarni ajratish, texnologiya lug'ati va paraphrase'ni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'lim), har birida 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Answer or trap? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Answer or trap?' savollarida sababni ham aytadi (qaysi so'z tasdiqlaydi yoki rad etadi).
'Say it another way!' bo'limida jamoa iborani o'z so'zlari bilan og'zaki aytadi; ma'no saqlansa — ball beriladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: 'Choose TWO letters': how many letters do you write?
Does the order of the two letters matter?
qs.a: No — 'B, C' and 'C, B' are both correct.

qs.q: When should you read the five options?
'Questions 7–8: Choose TWO letters.' How many marks can you get?
qs.a: Two — one mark for each correct letter

qs.q: Name the two kinds of distractor in this question type.
qs.a: Mentioned then rejected; true but about another person/thing

qs.q: Q: What did he buy? — 'I got a new tablet last week.' Tablet: answer or trap?
qs.a: Answer — he confirms he bought it.

qs.q: Q: What did she buy? — 'I almost bought a smartwatch, but it was too expensive.' Smartwatch?
Q: What did the speaker buy? — 'My sister bought a drone last month.' Drone?
qs.a: Trap — it's about another person (the sister).

qs.q: Q: What does he like? — 'I'm not so keen on e-readers.' E-readers: answer or trap?
qs.a: Trap — 'not so keen on' = he doesn't like them.

qs.q: Q: What did she buy? — 'At first I didn't want a printer, but in the end I got one.' Printer?
qs.a: Answer — rejected at first, then confirmed.

qs.q: The part of a phone or laptop that you look at.
It gives power to your phone and needs charging.
A three-legged stand that keeps a camera still.
A rod or wire that picks up radio or TV signals (British English).
An adjective for sound that is sharp and clear: '___ audio quality'.
Paraphrase: 'expensive'
qs.a: e.g. costly / pricey / it costs a lot

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'I didn't buy it in the end.'
qs.a: e.g. I decided against it / I changed my mind.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'It doesn't take up much space.'
qs.a: e.g. It's compact / It doesn't need much room.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'It is hard to use.'
qs.a: e.g. It isn't user-friendly / It's complicated to operate.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'I want to keep up with the latest technology.'
qs.a: e.g. I want to stay up to date with new devices.

14.title: Grammar Auction: does the answer fit the gap?
14.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, xatolar daftari bilan birga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari keyingi darsga.
14.goal: Summary completion javobini grammatika bo'yicha tekshirish: sifat/ravish/ot shakli (weak, expensive, carefully), kasb oldida artikl (as a teacher), moslashuv (have been sold), ichki savol tartibi — ixtirolar mavzusida.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz ixtirolar haqidagi xulosa (summary) gapini o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap grammatik jihatdan to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: xato turini ham aytishi shart (masalan: 'too + sifat → weak', 'ko'plik ega → have been').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The two inventors received a patent for their idea in 1952.
items.why: receive a patent — to'g'ri birikma; o'tgan zamon, yil bilan.

items.s: At first, the new glue was too weakly to be useful.
items.fix: At first, the new glue was too weak to be useful.
items.why: 'was too ___' — sifat kerak: weak (weakly — ravish).

items.s: The pen became popular because it was cheap and reliable.
items.why: was + ikki sifat (cheap and reliable) — to'g'ri.

items.s: The first bar code scanners were huge and expense.
items.fix: The first bar code scanners were huge and expensive.
items.why: 'and' ikki sifatni bog'laydi: expensive (expense — ot).

items.s: Rubik worked as teacher before he became a famous inventor.
items.fix: Rubik worked as a teacher before he became a famous inventor.
items.why: Kasb oldidan artikl kerak: as a teacher.

items.s: Jeans were originally working clothes for miners and farmers.
items.why: originally = dastlab; were + ot birikmasi — to'g'ri.

items.s: Managers could not understand what was the new glue useful for.
items.fix: Managers could not understand what the new glue was useful for.
items.why: Ichki savolda darak tartib: what + ega + fe'l (the new glue was).

items.s: Millions of these pens has been sold since 1950.
items.fix: Millions of these pens have been sold since 1950.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (millions of pens) — have been sold.

items.s: Nobody used the idea for years because suitable scanners were not available.
items.why: were not available = did not yet exist — to'g'ri paraphrase va grammatika.

items.s: The company handed out free samples, and most office workers liked them.
items.why: hand out = tarqatmoq; most + ko'plik ot (artiklsiz) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Bich studied every ballpoint pen on the market very careful.
items.fix: Bich studied every ballpoint pen on the market very carefully.
items.why: Fe'lni (studied) ravish tasvirlaydi: carefully.

items.s: The famous yellow colour of sticky notes was an accident.
items.why: was + an + ot (unli tovush oldida an) — to'g'ri.

14.title: Board Game: Complete the summary
14.stage: 2-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin mustahkamlash sifatida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
14.goal: Summary completion strategiyasi: ikki tur, so'z chegarasi, bo'sh joy turini bashorat qilish (parosat), matn tartibi, artikl qoidasi, paraphrase va ixtirolar mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, bo'sh joyga qanday so'z turi kerakligini aytadi, paraphrase qiladi yoki mavzu bo'yicha gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda kalit bor). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'What word type fits?' kataklarida o'yinchi so'z turini (ot, fe'l, sifat, ko'plik ot) va bitta mos misol so'zni aytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Summary completion: name the two types.
squares.a: 1) words from the passage; 2) words chosen from a box.

squares.t: 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS': is 'the metal pins' OK?
squares.a: No — that's three words. Write 'metal pins'.

squares.t: What word type fits? 'The glue was too ___ to hold paper.'
squares.a: an adjective (e.g. weak)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'cheap'
squares.a: inexpensive / low-cost / affordable

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: a simple invention you use every day.
squares.a: e.g. The zip — my bag and my jacket both have one.

squares.t: What word type fits? 'He decided to ___ a new pen.'
squares.a: a verb in the base form (e.g. design)

squares.t: What do you read first: the whole passage or the summary title?
squares.a: The summary title — it shows which part of the text to read.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'by accident'
squares.a: by chance / it wasn't planned

squares.t: Summary answers usually come in the order of…?
squares.a: …the passage (answer 3 comes after answer 2).

squares.t: What word type fits? 'Many ___ were sold in Europe.'
squares.a: a plural noun (e.g. copies, cubes)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'very rich'
squares.a: extremely wealthy / well-off

squares.t: Box type: must the box word look exactly like the word in the text?
squares.a: No — it is often a synonym or another form; match the meaning.

squares.t: Correct the summary: 'All the sides are identity.'
squares.a: All the sides are identical. (an adjective is needed)

squares.t: Name three inventions that changed daily life.
squares.a: e.g. the telephone, the light bulb, the internet

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'it failed'
squares.a: it was not successful / it didn't work

squares.t: The gap has 'an' before it. What does that tell you?
squares.a: The answer begins with a vowel sound (e.g. an idea, an engineer).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'popular with the public'
squares.a: people liked it / it sold well

squares.t: The summary says 'the ___'. Do you write 'the' in your answer?
squares.a: No — the article is already there; write only the missing word(s).

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: why do some good inventions fail at first?
squares.a: e.g. People don't understand them, or they are too expensive.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'register a patent'
squares.a: officially protect an invention

squares.t: Box word 'affordable'; text: 'it costs very little'. Match?
squares.a: Yes — the same meaning in different words.

squares.t: You have written all the answers. What is your last step?
squares.a: Read the whole summary again: check grammar, meaning and spelling.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The product was renamed.'
squares.a: It was given a new name / They changed its name.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: what would you like to invent, and why?
squares.a: e.g. A pen that translates my notes into English.

14.title: Dominoes: summary ↔ passage paraphrases
14.stage: 'Paraphrase mashqi' bosqichida, matndagi va xulosadagi so'zlar jadvali bilan birga (10 daqiqa)
14.goal: Xulosadagi (summary) iborani matndagi paraphrase bilan ulash: originally named = first called, made up of = consisting of, renamed = given a new name, extremely wealthy = very rich va h.k.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi iboraning ma'nodoshini (xulosa ↔ matn paraphrasei) boshqa toshlarning chap tomonidan toping va ulang.
Eslatma: summary completion'da xulosa matnni BOSHQA so'zlar bilan aytadi; javobni topish uchun avval shu paraphraseni topasiz.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('Renamed means given a new name'); ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: shocked by how bad it was
was popular all over the world
was not available at that time
an adhesive that is not sticky enough
no other puzzle has sold more
handed out products at no cost

14.title: Taboo: inventions and products
14.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' dan keyin — ixtirolar mavzusidagi so'zlarni faollashtirish (10 daqiqa)
14.goal: Ixtirolar mavzusidagi so'zlarni (inventor, patent, prototype, manufacturer, bar code, checkout, sample…) inglizcha ta'rif va paraphrase bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Bu — paraphrase mashqi: summary ham matnni boshqa so'zlar bilan aytadi. Tushuntirishda sinonim yoki ta'rif ishlating (masalan, 'a person who makes something that never existed before' = inventor).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

14.title: Find someone who… has solved a Rubik's Cube
14.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — 2-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin, dam olish o'rnida (10 daqiqa)
14.goal: Ixtirolar va mahsulotlar bo'yicha hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you like…?) va qisqa javobni bir gapli xulosa qilib yozish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: 'Have you ever solved a Rubik's Cube?').
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? How long did it take? Did it work?).
Qo'shimcha javobni 5–6 so'zli xulosa qilib ism yoniga yozadi (masalan: 'Aziz — solved it in 3 minutes').
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has solved a Rubik's Cube.
items.q: Have you ever solved a Rubik's Cube?

items.t: …uses sticky notes to study or plan the day.
items.q: Do you use sticky notes to study or plan your day?

items.q: Have you ever had an idea for an invention?

items.t: …has bought a product after trying a free sample.
items.q: Have you ever bought a product after trying a free sample?

items.t: …has visited a science or technology museum.
items.q: Have you ever visited a science or technology museum?

items.q: Do you think the smartphone is the greatest invention ever?

items.q: Have you ever taken part in a science fair or a project competition?

14.title: Speaking cards: inventions and success
14.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin, mavzu bo'yicha gapirish (Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
14.goal: Ixtirolar va ularning muvaffaqiyati mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida 3–4 gapli javob berish; sherigining javobini bir gapli xulosa (summary) qilib, paraphrase bilan aytish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol (IELTS uslubi).
Tinglovchi javobni BIR gapli xulosa qilib aytadi va kamida bitta so'zni sinonim bilan almashtiradi (masalan: 'cheap' → 'inexpensive').
Xulosa to'g'ri va paraphrase bor bo'lsa — tinglovchiga +1 ball; javob 3 gapdan uzun bo'lsa — javob beruvchiga +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What invention do you use most in your daily life? Why is it important to you?
Do you still write with a pen, or do you type most things? Why?
Have you ever tried to solve a difficult puzzle? Did you finish it?
Which is more important for a new product: a good idea or good advertising? Why?

14.title: Sentence Race: summary rules and summary sentences
14.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin qoidalarni mustahkamlash yoki 'Xulosa va vazifa' oldidan tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
14.goal: Summary completion qoidalari va xulosa (summary) gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish; gapdagi so'z turini (ot / fe'l / sifat) aniqlash.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Keyin ustoz gapdagi bitta so'zni ko'rsatadi — jamoa uning turini aytsa (ot, fe'l, sifat, ravish) yana +1 ball.
Keyin jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Before reading the passage, look at the title of the summary.
Write no more than two words from the passage.
Answers usually follow the order of the passage.
Box words may appear in another form in the passage.
Check your spelling, because a misspelt answer is marked wrong.
The puzzle is made up of layers of cubes.
At first, the weak glue seemed to have no practical use.
Early scanners were far too expensive for most supermarkets.
The notes can be removed without leaving a mark.
Jeans became fashionable after film stars wore them on screen.

14.title: Quiz Board: Summary completion
14.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror ('Xulosa va vazifa' oldidan) yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); tanlanmagan o'yinlar — takror uchun
14.goal: Summary completion qoidalari, bo'sh joy grammatikasi, paraphrase va ixtirolar lug'atini o'yin shaklida takrorlash; 'Say it!' bo'limida og'zaki javob.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (bo'lim), har birida 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Summary rules' savollarida qisqa sababni ham aytadi.
'Say it!' savollarida to'liq gap aytiladi; kalitdagi javob — faqat namuna, ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa ball beriladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.

qs.q: 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS': what is the most you can write?

15.title: Grammar Auction: does the answer fit the gap?
15.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
15.goal: To'ldirilgan gapni qayta o'qib tekshirish odatini shakllantirish: so'z turkumi (ot/sifat), birlik/ko'plik, ortiqcha artikl va imlo xatolarini topib tuzatish (hayvonlar va tabiat mavzusida).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap grammatika va imlo jihatdan to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatib, sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'are almost ___ — sifat kerak: silent') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Snow leopards live high in the mountains of Central Asia, including Uzbekistan.
items.why: Ko'plik ega + live; 'in the mountains of' — to'g'ri.

items.s: Owls are almost silence when they fly at night.

items.s: Many bats find their food in the dark by using sound.

items.s: Many animals become agressive when their young are in danger.

items.s: Penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers.
items.why: 'cannot + fe'l', 'excellent swimmers' (sifat + ot) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Bees make the honey from the nectar of flowers.
items.fix: Bees make honey from the nectar of flowers.
items.why: Umumiy ma'nodagi sanalmaydigan ot artiklsiz: honey. Javobga 'the' qo'shmang.

items.s: The cheetah is one of the fastest animal in the world.
items.fix: The cheetah is one of the fastest animals in the world.
items.why: 'one of the' + eng … + ko'plik ot: animals.

items.s: Chameleons can move their eyes in two different directions at once.
items.why: 'can + fe'l asosi', 'in two different directions' — to'g'ri.

items.s: Dolphin sleep with only one half of their brain at a time.
items.fix: Dolphins sleep with only one half of their brain at a time.

15.title: Board Game: sentence completion and animals

15.goal: Sentence completion qoidalarini (so'z chegarasi, bo'sh joy turi, matn tartibi, so'zni o'zgartirmaslik) og'zaki takrorlash, paraphrase qilish va hayvonlar/tabiat mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani tushuntiradi, so'z turini aytadi, paraphrase qiladi yoki to'liq gap bilan javob beradi.

Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).

START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora (START toshida: 'an animal that hunts others') bilan bir xil ma'noli so'z (bu yerda: 'a predator') qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.

Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'active at night = nocturnal'. Ustoz tekshiradi.

60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora va o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas: faqat paraphrase — bu IELTS readingdagi asosiy ko'nikma.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever planted a tree?).

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2–3 ta qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

17.title: Grammar Auction: directions and location language
17.stage: Savol turi (qoida va tipik xatolar) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
17.goal: Yo'l ko'rsatish va joylashuv iboralaridagi tipik xatolarni topish: turn left ('to' siz), next to, at the end of, on your left, reach ('to' siz), beside / besides.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz yo'l ko'rsatish gapini doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: xatoni aniq aytishi kerak (masalan: 'next to — to tushib qolgan').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Go straight ahead until you reach the roundabout.
items.why: reach + joy ('to' siz); go straight ahead — to'g'ri yuring.

items.s: Turn to left at the second junction.
items.fix: Turn left at the second junction.
items.why: 'Turn left / turn right' — 'to' qo'shilmaydi (yoki: turn to the left).

items.s: The toilets are between the café and the pond.
items.why: between X and Y — ikki joy orasida.

items.s: The café is next the bookshop.
items.fix: The café is next to the bookshop.
items.why: 'next to' — 'to' tushib qolmasin (yonida).

items.s: The library is in the end of the corridor.
items.fix: The library is at the end of the corridor.
items.why: Joy: 'at the end of'. 'In the end' — 'oxir-oqibat' degani.

items.s: Walk past the fountain and you'll come to the museum.
items.why: walk past — yonidan o'tib keting; come to — yetib kelasiz.

items.s: Cross the road and the post office is in your left.
items.fix: Cross the road and the post office is on your left.
items.why: Tomon: 'on your left / on your right' — 'in' emas.

items.s: The museum is at the corner of Park Road and Mill Lane.
items.why: at / on the corner of — ikki ko'cha burchagida.

items.s: Keep walking until you reach to the crossroads.
items.fix: Keep walking until you reach the crossroads.
items.why: 'reach' dan keyin 'to' kelmaydi (reach / get to).

items.s: The pharmacy is directly opposite the bus stop.
items.why: opposite + joy ('to' shart emas) — ro'parasida, qarshisida.

items.s: The lockers are besides the sports hall.
items.fix: The lockers are beside the sports hall.
items.why: beside = yonida; besides = bundan tashqari.

items.s: Take the first turning on the right after the bridge.
items.why: take the first turning on the right — birinchi o'ng burilish.

17.title: Board Game: Follow the map
17.stage: Listening mashqlari (xarita/reja) tekshirilgandan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
17.goal: Map labelling strategiyasini (boshlanish nuqtasi, tartib, chap/o'ng almashishi, chegara joylar) og'zaki tushuntirish, yo'nalish iboralarini paraphrase qilish va yo'l ko'rsatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gap bilan javob beradi yoki yo'l ko'rsatadi.
'Paraphrase' kataklarida iborani boshqa so'zlar bilan aytadi; 'Correct' kataklarida xatoni tuzatadi; 'Part 1/3' kataklarida kamida 3 gap gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi (javoblar ustoz varag'ida); shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.a: The starting point: 'You are here' or the entrance.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'go straight ahead'.
squares.a: e.g. carry straight on / keep going straight

squares.t: Correct: The bank is in your right.
squares.a: The bank is on your right.

squares.t: Do the answers usually come in the same order as the questions?
squares.a: Yes, usually — the speaker 'walks' round the map in order.

squares.a: e.g. I sit next to Aziz, opposite the teacher's desk.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'at the end of the corridor'.
squares.a: e.g. where the corridor ends / at the far end of the corridor

squares.t: What is a T-junction?
squares.a: A place where one road ends at another road, making a T shape.

squares.t: Correct: Turn to left at the roundabout.
squares.a: Turn left at the roundabout.

squares.a: My left — the sides are reversed.

squares.a: e.g. Go out, turn right and go down the stairs; the entrance is ahead.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'just beyond the bridge'.
squares.a: e.g. just past / a little further than the bridge

squares.a: Don't write it as an answer — use it only as a landmark or a limit to keep your place.

squares.a: crossroads = two roads cross; roundabout = a circle that cars drive round

squares.t: Describe the way from your home to the nearest shop.
squares.a: e.g. I leave my house, turn left and walk past the park; it's opposite the school.

squares.t: Correct: The toilets are besides the café.
squares.a: The toilets are beside the café.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the building facing the station'.
squares.a: the building opposite / across from the station

squares.t: Part 1: Do you often get lost? Answer in 3 sentences.
squares.a: e.g. Not really. I usually use a map app, and I check the route before I go.

squares.t: Why should you follow the route on the map with your pencil?
squares.a: So you don't lose your place and miss the next location.

squares.t: Describe the ground floor of your school in 20 seconds.
squares.a: e.g. The entrance is in the middle; the canteen is on the left, next to the gym.

squares.t: Part 3: Are paper maps still useful today? Why / why not?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — they work without a battery or the internet and show the whole area.

17.goal: Yo'l topish, xaritalar va joylashuv haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Can you…?) va javobni yo'nalish iboralari bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.

Yakun: har o'quvchi 2 ta natijani sinfga aytadi (masalan: 'Dilnoza lives opposite a school.'). Ustoz savollarning grammatikasini tekshiradi.

17.goal: Yo'l ko'rsatish va joylashuv gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish (opposite, between … and …, at the end of, take the second turning) va map labelling strategiyasini gap shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: bosh harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa jamoa qayta teradi.
Bonus: jamoa gapdagi joylashuvni doskaga kichik sxema qilib chizsa (masalan, gift shop va lake qarama-qarshi) yana +1 ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The gift shop is directly opposite the lake.
Take the second turning on the left after the bridge.
The toilets are between the café and the main gate.
If you go too far, you will reach the car park.
Always find the starting point before the recording begins.
The library is at the end of the corridor, on the right.
When the speaker walks down the map, the sides are reversed.
Walk past the fountain until you come to the T-junction.
The pharmacy is across the road from the post office.

17.title: Quiz Board: map and plan labelling
17.stage: Xulosa bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (15 daqiqa); tanlanmagan o'yinlar — keyingi darslarda takror uchun
17.goal: Map labelling qoidalari, yo'nalish iboralarining paraphrase'i, joy nomlari va og'zaki yo'l ko'rsatishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What do you find first on the map before the recording starts?
qs.a: The starting point ('You are here' / the entrance).

qs.q: Do the answers usually come in the same order as the questions?
The instructions say 'Write the correct letter, A–G'. What do you write on the answer sheet?
qs.a: One letter only (e.g. C), not the name of the place.

qs.q: The speaker walks down the map towards you and says 'on your right'. Which side of the map is that for you?
qs.a: The left side, as you look at the map.

qs.q: The speaker says: 'Don't go too far, or you'll reach the pond.' The pond isn't in the questions. Why mention it?
qs.a: It marks a limit on the route; it is not an answer.

qs.q: Another way to say 'next to'?
Another way to say 'opposite'?
Paraphrase: 'go straight on'.
qs.a: carry straight on / keep going straight

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'just beyond the bridge'.
qs.a: just past / a little further than the bridge

qs.q: 'The café is at street level.' Which floor is it on?
A circular junction where several roads meet and all cars drive round in one direction.
A place where two roads cross each other.
A small cupboard where you can lock your bag at a gym or college.
A fenced area where animals are kept at a zoo.
A place where one road ends at another road, making a T shape.
Say where the door is in this room. Use 2 prepositions.
qs.a: e.g. The door is next to the board, opposite the window.

qs.q: Tell a visitor how to get from this room to the exit.
qs.a: e.g. Turn left, go down the stairs, and the exit is on your right.

qs.q: Describe where your house is. Use 'opposite' or 'between'.
qs.a: e.g. My house is between a shop and a park, opposite a school.
