qs.a: Go past the bank, take the first right; it's at the end of the road.

18.title: Grammar Auction: writing about animal research
18.stage: Savol turi (Choose TWO qoidasi va tuzoqlar) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
18.goal: Hayvonlar va tadqiqotlar mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: research + was, the number of + is, one of the most + ko'plik ot, communicate with, each other, so'z turkumi (precise).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz hayvonlar va tadqiqotlar haqidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: xatoni aniq aytishi kerak (masalan: 'research sanalmaydi — was bo'ladi').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Humpback whales migrate thousands of kilometres every year.
items.why: migrate — ko'chib yurmoq; thousands of + ko'plik ot (kilometres).

items.s: The research were carried out in the Kalahari Desert.
items.fix: The research was carried out in the Kalahari Desert.
items.why: research — sanalmaydigan ot: 'was', 'were' emas.

items.s: Scientists attached small tracking devices to the birds.
items.why: attach something to something — 'to' bilan.

items.s: Bees communicate each other by dancing.
items.fix: Bees communicate with each other by dancing.
items.why: communicate WITH somebody — 'with' tushib qolmasin.

items.s: Young geese stay close to each others during migration.
items.fix: Young geese stay close to each other during migration.
items.why: each other — o'zgarmaydi, 's' qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: Honey badgers are known for being fearless.
items.why: be known for + -ing / ot.

items.s: The honey badger is one of the most fearless animal in Africa.
items.fix: The honey badger is one of the most fearless animals in Africa.
items.why: one of the most + KO'PLIK ot: animals.

items.s: Dolphins sleep with only half of their brain at a time.
items.why: at a time — bir vaqtda; half of their brain — to'g'ri.

items.s: The number of whales are increasing again.
items.fix: The number of whales is increasing again.
items.why: The number of … — birlik: 'is' (A number of … — 'are').

items.s: Most animals that have a brain need some kind of sleep.
items.why: Most animals … need — ko'plik ega, ko'plik fe'l.

items.s: The waggle dance gives very precision information.
items.fix: The waggle dance gives very precise information.
items.why: Ot oldida sifat kerak: precise (precision — ot).

items.s: The researchers were surprised by the results of the study.
items.why: be surprised by — to'g'ri predlog.

18.title: Board Game: Choose TWO — animal life
18.stage: 1-qo'shimcha reading tekshirilgandan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
18.goal: Pick from a list strategiyasini (ikki harf, tartib muhim emas, bo'sh qoldirmaslik, 'boshqa guruh' va 'kuchliroq so'z' tuzoqlari) tushuntirish, hayvonlar mavzusidagi paraphrase va gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gap bilan javob beradi.
'Paraphrase' kataklarida iborani boshqa so'zlar bilan aytadi; 'Option / Text' kataklarida 'match' yoki 'no match' deydi va SABABini aytadi; 'Part 1/3' kataklarida kamida 3 gap gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi (javoblar ustoz varag'ida); shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: The instructions say 'Choose TWO letters'. How many letters do you write?
squares.a: Two letters, e.g. B, D.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'took a photo of'.
squares.a: photographed / snapped a picture of

squares.t: Name 3 animals that migrate.
squares.a: e.g. whales, geese, storks, salmon

squares.t: Does the order of the two letters matter: 'B, D' or 'D, B'?
squares.a: No — any order is correct.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'very small'.
squares.a: tiny / minute

squares.t: You are sure of only one answer. What do you do with the second?
squares.a: Guess — never leave it blank; each letter gets its own mark.

squares.t: What 3 questions do you ask about every option?
squares.a: Is it in the text? Does it answer the question? Does it say exactly the same?

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lost its way'.
squares.a: got lost / did not know where it was going

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about your favourite wild animal.
squares.a: e.g. I love snow leopards because they are rare and live high in the mountains.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'hard to get to'.
squares.a: difficult to reach / not easily accessible

squares.t: What is the 'wrong group' trap? Give an example.
squares.a: The words are in the text, but they are about another group, e.g. females, not males.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'their hearts beat more slowly'.
squares.a: they have lower heart rates

squares.t: Why do scientists attach tracking devices to animals?
squares.a: e.g. To follow their movements and learn where and how far they travel.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'unpredictable'.
squares.a: e.g. hard to know how it will behave

squares.t: Option: 'Whales always swim north to south.' Text: 'usually'. Is it a match?
squares.a: No — 'always' is stronger than 'usually'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'took turns at the front'.
squares.a: e.g. each bird led for a while / they shared the lead

squares.t: Part 1: Did you have a pet as a child? Tell us about it.
squares.a: e.g. Yes, we had a cat called Mosh; I fed it every morning before school.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'widely accepted'.
squares.a: believed by most people / generally agreed

squares.t: Explain in English: 'migration'.
squares.a: when animals travel a long way to another area, usually at the same time each year

squares.t: Why can an option use words from the text but still be wrong?
squares.a: It is about another person, time or group, or it says the opposite.

squares.t: Part 3: Should zoos keep large animals like elephants? Why / why not?
squares.a: e.g. Only if they have lots of space; otherwise the animals suffer.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a hostile environment'.
squares.a: an unfriendly or dangerous place to live or work

squares.t: Part 3: Why is it important to study animal behaviour?
squares.a: e.g. It helps us protect endangered species and understand nature better.

squares.t: Part 3: How can ordinary people help to protect wild animals?
squares.a: e.g. By not buying products made from wild animals and by supporting reserves.

18.title: Dominoes: animal research paraphrases
18.stage: 'Paraphrase mashqi' bosqichida — matn va savol so'zlari jadvali o'rniga yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa)
18.goal: Pick from a list variantlari matnda boshqa so'zlar bilan beriladi: hayvonlar va tadqiqotlar mavzusidagi so'z/iborani uning paraphrase'i bilan ulash (tiny = very small, took turns = regularly changed places…).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z (masalan, 'tiny') qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase'ga ('very small') mos kelishini toping va ulang.
Diqqat: o'xshash toshlar bor ('predator' / 'prey', 'suspected' / 'widely accepted') — ma'nosiga qarab tanlang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Bonus: 3 ta paraphrase bilan hayvonlar haqida gap tuzgan guruh +1 ball oladi.

pairs: did not know where it was going
hard to know how it will behave
an animal that hunts other animals
an animal that is hunted for food

18.title: Taboo: animal life and research
18.stage: Kirish bosqichida — hayvonlar mavzusidagi so'zlarni faollashtirish uchun, readingdan oldin (10 daqiqa)
18.goal: Hayvonlar hayoti va tadqiqotlar mavzusidagi so'zlarni (migration, predator, habitat, species, nocturnal…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol orqali tushuntirish — bu paraphrase ko'nikmasining o'zi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Misol keltirish mumkin (masalan, predator uchun: 'A lion or a wolf is one.'). O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Bonus: topgan o'quvchi so'z bilan hayvonlar haqida to'g'ri gap aytsa +1 ball (masalan: 'Owls are nocturnal.').
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

18.title: Find someone who… has seen a wild animal
18.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Listening yoki 2-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin (10 daqiqa)
18.goal: Hayvonlar bilan bog'liq hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Can you…? Would you like…?) va javobni tafsilot bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever seen a wild animal in its natural habitat?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? What happened?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi.
Yakun: har o'quvchi 2 ta natijani sinfga paraphrase qilib aytadi (masalan: 'Jasur has been stung by a bee' → 'A bee once stung Jasur.'). Ustoz savollar grammatikasini tekshiradi.

items.t: …has had a pet for more than three years.
items.q: Have you had a pet for more than three years?

items.t: …has seen a wild animal in its natural habitat.
items.q: Have you ever seen a wild animal in its natural habitat?

items.t: …has visited a zoo or a nature reserve this year.
items.q: Have you visited a zoo or a nature reserve this year?

items.t: …has watched a wildlife documentary recently.
items.q: Have you watched a wildlife documentary recently?

items.t: …is afraid of spiders or snakes.
items.q: Are you afraid of spiders or snakes?

items.t: …has seen birds flying in a V shape.
items.q: Have you ever seen birds flying in a V shape?

items.t: …has bought honey directly from a beekeeper.
items.q: Have you ever bought honey directly from a beekeeper?

items.t: …has been stung by a bee.
items.q: Have you ever been stung by a bee?

items.t: …would like to work with animals in the future.
items.q: Would you like to work with animals in the future?

items.t: …sleeps more than eight hours a night.
items.q: Do you sleep more than eight hours a night?

items.t: …has ridden a horse or a camel.
items.q: Have you ever ridden a horse or a camel?

items.t: …can name three endangered animals.
items.q: Can you name three endangered animals?

18.title: Speaking cards: animals and wildlife
18.stage: Dars oxirida gapirish (IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
18.goal: Hayvonlar, uy hayvonlari, hayvonot bog'lari va yovvoyi tabiatni asrash haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; mavzu so'zlarini (habitat, species, migrate, endangered…) gapda ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi (sabab va misol bilan). 'Part 3' kartalarida fikrini asoslab beradi.
Tinglovchi javobdagi mavzu so'zlarini sanaydi (habitat, species, migrate, predator, endangered…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you like animals? Which animal is your favourite and why?
Have you ever had a pet? How did you look after it?
Do you enjoy watching wildlife documentaries? Why / why not?
Which wild animals live in Uzbekistan? Have you seen any of them?
Have you ever visited a zoo? What did you think of it?
If you were a scientist, which animal would you like to study? Why?
Do you think animals have feelings? Give an example.
Part 3: Why do some animals travel thousands of kilometres every year?
Part 3: Should zoos exist in the 21st century? Why / why not?
Part 3: How can technology help scientists learn about wild animals?
Part 3: Why are so many animal species becoming endangered?
Part 3: What can humans learn from the way animals work together?
Part 3: Is it fair to keep large pets, such as dogs, in small city flats?
Part 3: Who should pay to protect wildlife — governments or individuals?

18.title: Sentence Race: Choose TWO strategy and animal facts
18.stage: Tahlil (xatolar daftari) bosqichidan keyin, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
18.goal: Pick from a list strategiyasi va hayvonlar haqidagi paraphrase qilingan hamda ehtiyotkor (might, it seems that) gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Maslahat: bosh harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa jamoa qayta teradi.
Bonus: jamoa gapning bir qismini paraphrase qilib aytsa yana +1 ball (masalan: 'use less energy' → 'save energy').
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Always check how many letters the question asks for.
Both answers can be written in any order.
An option can use words from the text but be wrong.
Birds flying in a V shape use less energy.
A longer waggle means the food is further away.
Giraffes need far less sleep than bats do.
The reason why animals need sleep remains a mystery.
The whale might have been searching for food.
It seems that the whale chose an unusual route.

18.title: Quiz Board: pick from a list
18.stage: Xulosa bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (15 daqiqa); tanlanmagan o'yinlar — keyingi darslarda takror uchun
18.goal: Pick from a list qoidalari va tuzoqlari, paraphrase, hayvonlar mavzusidagi so'zlar va og'zaki javoblarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Question rules' bo'limida javob sababi bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: 'Choose TWO letters, A–E.' How many letters do you write?
You write 'D, B' but the key says 'B, D'. Is your answer correct?
Questions 1–2 ask you to choose TWO letters. How many marks can you get?
qs.a: Two — one mark for each correct letter.

qs.q: An option uses the same words as the text, but it is about a different group. Do you choose it?
Text: 'Young males rarely play with each other.' Option: 'Young males avoid females.' Is it a match?
qs.a: No — the text is about males with males, not with females.

qs.q: Another way to say 'very small'?
Paraphrase: 'took a photo of'.
Paraphrase: 'took turns'.
Paraphrase: 'hard to get to'.
qs.a: difficult to reach / not easily accessible

qs.q: Which two-word phrase means 'following animals' movements from space'?
The home that bees build and live in.
An animal that hunts and kills other animals.
The natural place where an animal or plant lives.
Moving to another region at the same time every year.
Active at night and asleep during the day.
Name two wild animals that live in Uzbekistan.
qs.a: e.g. snow leopard, saiga, wolf, fox, desert tortoise

qs.q: Give one reason why geese fly in a V shape.
qs.a: e.g. It saves energy. / They can see each other.

qs.q: Describe a pet you have or would like. Use 3 sentences.
qs.a: e.g. I'd like a dog. Dogs are loyal. I'd walk it every day.

qs.q: Say one advantage and one disadvantage of zoos.
qs.a: e.g. Zoos protect rare species, but animals lose their freedom.

qs.q: Explain in 2 sentences how a bee shows other bees where food is.
qs.a: It dances. The angle shows direction; the waggle time shows distance.

19.title: Grammar Auction: opinions about habits and change
19.stage: Tahlil bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: Odatlar va o'zgarish mavzusidagi fikr gaplarida Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: I agree, better off + -ing, most people, habit of + -ing, qiyosiy daraja (healthier), fe'l moslashuvi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'I am agree' → 'I agree').
Bonus: gapda fikr bildiruvchi so'z bo'lsa (In my opinion, believe, better off, surprising), uni birinchi aytgan jamoa +20 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: In my opinion, most people find it difficult to break a bad habit.
items.why: 'In my opinion' — fikr belgisi; break a habit — to'g'ri kollokatsiya.

items.s: I am agree that teenagers are more open to new experiences.
items.fix: I agree that teenagers are more open to new experiences.
items.why: agree — fe'l, oldidan 'am' qo'yilmaydi (o'zbekcha 'roziman' ta'siri).

items.s: Many adults find it hard to get rid of habits they picked up as children.
items.why: get rid of + ot; pick up a habit — odat orttirmoq (V2: picked up).

items.s: If you want to change, you are better off to start today.
items.fix: If you want to change, you are better off starting today.
items.why: better off dan keyin -ing shakl keladi: better off starting.

items.s: According to the writer, boredom can lead to creative ideas.
items.why: According to the writer — muallif fikrini yetkazish uchun to'g'ri ibora.

items.s: Most of people like to stick to what they already know.
items.fix: Most people like to stick to what they already know.
items.why: Umumiy ma'noda 'most people'; 'most of' dan keyin the/my/these kerak.

items.s: Old habits often come back when we are stressed or overworked.
items.why: Ko'plikdagi ega (habits) — come back; stressed, overworked — sifatlar.

items.s: My brother has a habit to check his phone during meals.
items.fix: My brother has a habit of checking his phone during meals.
items.why: have a habit OF + -ing: a habit of checking.

items.s: The author thinks walking is more healthier than driving.
items.fix: The author thinks walking is healthier than driving.
items.why: healthier — o'zi qiyosiy daraja; 'more' ortiqcha.

items.s: The writer does not think that every pupil needs to learn programming.
items.why: does not think + that-gap; every pupil + birlik fe'l (needs).

items.s: Older people often prefers a fixed routine to new experiences.
items.fix: Older people often prefer a fixed routine to new experiences.
items.why: people — ko'plik: prefer (-s qo'shilmaydi).

items.s: It is hardly surprising that most graduates choose a safe career.
items.why: It is hardly surprising that… — muallif bahosi; tuzilma to'g'ri.

19.title: Board Game: YES, NO or NOT GIVEN?
19.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin, gapirish tanaffusi sifatida (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: YES/NO/NOT GIVEN strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: fakt va fikrni ajratish, paraphrase, miqdor va taqqoslash tuzoqlari, odatlar mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdan bitta 'hakam' javoblar varag'ini ushlab turadi va tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javob — namuna: mazmunan to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Does YES / NO / NOT GIVEN ask about facts or opinions?
squares.a: Opinions — what the writer thinks or claims.

squares.t: Fact or opinion? 'In 1990, he left home.'
squares.a: Fact — a date and an event, no judgement.

squares.t: Fact or opinion? 'His decision was very brave.'
squares.a: Opinion — 'brave' is the writer's judgement.

squares.t: Name 3 phrases that show a writer's opinion.
squares.a: e.g. I believe, in my view, unfortunately, should

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'postpone'
squares.a: put off / delay

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about a good habit you have.
squares.a: e.g. I read for 20 minutes every night because it relaxes me.

squares.t: What is the difference between NO and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: NO: the writer says the opposite. NG: the writer gives no view.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'generous'
squares.a: willing to give / unselfish (text: 'in an act of kindness')

squares.t: Statement: 'MANY people agree.' Which word must you check?
squares.a: 'many' — compare it with most / few / some in the text.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'break a habit'
squares.a: give up / kick a habit; stop doing something

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'better off + -ing'.
squares.a: e.g. You're better off revising a little every day.

squares.t: Is your own opinion important in YES / NO / NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: No — only the writer's opinion counts.

squares.t: Speaking: Why do people find it hard to change?
squares.a: e.g. Change feels risky, and routines make us feel safe.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'teenagers'
squares.a: adolescents / young people aged 13–19

squares.t: Text: 'This is unusual; most would not do it.' Statement: 'Many people do it.'
squares.a: NO — 'unusual' and 'most would not' contradict 'many'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'conventional'
squares.a: traditional / ordinary / usual

squares.t: Text praises cycling, says nothing on cost. Statement: 'Cycling saves money.'
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — the writer gives no view on cost.

squares.t: Give 2 tips for breaking a bad habit.
squares.a: e.g. Replace it with a good one; ask a friend to check on you.

squares.t: Where do you look for a NOT GIVEN answer?
squares.a: In the part of the text between the answers before and after it.

squares.t: Hedge it: 'Old habits always come back.'
squares.a: e.g. Old habits tend to / may come back.

squares.t: Text: 'I consider this a serious mistake.' Statement: 'The writer approves.'
squares.a: NO — 'a serious mistake' shows disapproval.

squares.t: Text: 'Coding has benefits.' Statement: 'Coding is the most useful subject.'
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — no comparison with other subjects.

squares.t: Speaking: Is it easier to change when you are young? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because young people have fewer responsibilities.

squares.t: Give the group one YES / NO / NOT GIVEN tip in English.
squares.a: e.g. Underline opinion words and check quantities.

19.title: Dominoes: opinion and habit paraphrases
19.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida, so'zlar jadvalidan keyin (12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: Matndagi so'z va iboralarni savoldagi paraphrase bilan ulash: odat, o'zgarish va muallif fikrini bildiruvchi iboralar (in favour of, have my doubts).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora bilan bir xil ma'noli paraphrase qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: "'postpone a decision' means 'put off making a choice'".
Ustoz tekshiradi; bitta xato ulanish bo'lsa, navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: stop doing something you always do
when stressed and short of time
a feeling of being unsure or unsafe
duties you must take care of
I am in favour of it

19.title: Taboo: habits, change and behaviour
19.stage: Kirish qismida, mavzuga isitish sifatida (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: Odatlar, o'zgarish va inson xulqi mavzusidagi so'zlarni (habit, postpone, conventional, charity…) inglizcha ta'riflab, paraphrase qilishni mashq qilish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Bu — IELTS paraphrase mashqi: so'zni boshqa so'zlar bilan ayting.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

19.title: Find someone who… has broken a bad habit
19.stage: Dars o'rtasida, 2-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: Odatlar va hayotdagi o'zgarishlar haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you…? Do you…? Would you…?) va boshqalarning fikrini aniq yetkazish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you broken a bad habit in the last year?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi: How did you do it? / Why?
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta natijani fikr fe'li bilan aytadi: 'Aziz believes that…', 'Lola thinks that…'.

items.t: …has broken a bad habit in the last year.
items.q: Have you broken a bad habit in the last year?

items.t: …has picked up a new hobby recently.
items.q: Have you picked up a new hobby recently?

items.t: …checks their phone as soon as they wake up.
items.q: Do you check your phone as soon as you wake up?

items.t: …would like to take a gap year to travel.
items.q: Would you like to take a gap year to travel?

items.t: …believes that coding should be compulsory at school.
items.q: Do you believe that coding should be compulsory at school?

items.t: …walks more than 5,000 steps a day.
items.q: Do you walk more than 5,000 steps a day?

items.t: …has donated money or clothes to charity.
items.q: Have you ever donated money or clothes to charity?

items.t: …usually puts off difficult tasks until the last minute.
items.q: Do you usually put off difficult tasks until the last minute?

items.t: …has changed their mind about their future career.
items.q: Have you ever changed your mind about your future career?

items.t: …thinks being bored can be useful.
items.q: Do you think being bored can be useful?

items.t: …goes to bed at the same time every night.
items.q: Do you go to bed at the same time every night?

items.t: …used to have a habit that they no longer have.
items.q: Did you use to have a habit that you no longer have?

19.title: Speaking Cards: habits and change
19.stage: Xulosa qismida yoki keyingi dars boshida (IELTS Speaking Part 1 va 3, 12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: Odatlar, o'zgarish va xulq haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; fikrni aniq bildirish (In my view, I strongly believe, I doubt that…) va YES/NO/NOT GIVEN mantiqini gapirishda qo'llash.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol.
Tinglovchi gapiruvchi ishlatgan fikr iboralarini sanaydi (In my opinion, I believe, I doubt that…): har biri uchun gapiruvchiga +1 ball.
Keyin tinglovchi gapiruvchining fikri haqida bitta gap aytadi (masalan: 'You think change is easy.'); gapiruvchi YES, NO yoki NOT GIVEN deb javob beradi va sababini aytadi — to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you have any habits you would like to change? Why?
What did you do every day as a child that you don't do now?
Do you prefer a fixed daily routine or doing different things every day?
How do you feel when your plans change suddenly?
Are you more open to new experiences now than five years ago? Why?
In your opinion, what is the best way to break a bad habit?
Why do you think people become less keen on change as they get older?
Do young people in Uzbekistan usually follow their parents' career path? Why?
Is it better to make a big change quickly or step by step? Why?
Have smartphones given us new bad habits? Give some examples.
Should schools teach children good habits, such as healthy eating? Why?
Some people say boredom is useful. Do you agree? Why or why not?
Would you ever give up a safe job to travel the world? Why or why not?
Should cities make it easier for people to walk? How could they do this?

19.title: Sentence Race: writers' opinions
19.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (8 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: Muallif fikrini bildiruvchi gaplarni (In my view, the writer thinks, it came as no surprise, better off) to'g'ri tartibda tuzish va fikr so'zini ajratish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi; katta harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; gapda fikr bildiruvchi so'z bo'lsa (In my view, consider, better off, tend to), uni ham aytadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: In my view, coding should be an option at school.
The writer thinks that most people are afraid of change.
It came as no surprise that old habits returned.
Few people find it easy to change their habits.
You are better off making the change today.
Teenagers are more willing to try new things than adults.
The writer does not think that coding is necessary for everyone.
Old habits tend to come back when we are stressed.
Unfortunately, most of us find it hard to change.
I consider this a serious mistake.

19.title: Quiz Board: YES, NO or NOT GIVEN
19.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror, uy vazifasidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
19.goal: YES/NO/NOT GIVEN qoidalari, paraphrase, odatlar mavzusidagi so'zlar va fikr bildirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'e.g.' javoblar — namuna: mazmunan to'g'ri javob qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Does YES / NO / NOT GIVEN test facts or the writer's opinions?
The statement matches the writer's view. Which answer?
The writer gives no view on the statement. Which answer?
Which is stronger: 'I suspect that…' or 'I am convinced that…'?
Text: 'I think very few apps are useful.' Statement: 'The writer thinks most apps are useful.'
Another way to say 'postpone'?
One word meaning 'very useful' (v…).
One word for 'people who agree with an idea' (s…).
Paraphrase: 'I am against this idea.'
qs.a: e.g. I disagree with / oppose this idea.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'Most people prefer the familiar.'
qs.a: e.g. The majority like what they already know.

qs.q: Something you do regularly, almost without thinking (h…).
An organisation that collects money to help people in need (c…).
A child aged about one to three (t…).
Traditional and ordinary; not new or different (c…).
A lack of confidence and a feeling of not being safe (i…).
Say one habit you want to break.
qs.a: e.g. I want to stop staying up late.

qs.q: Give your opinion on phones at school, starting with 'In my view'.
qs.a: e.g. In my view, phones should be switched off in class.

qs.q: Turn this fact into an opinion: 'He gave all his savings to charity.'
qs.a: e.g. It was very generous of him to give away his savings.

qs.q: Make a hedged claim about teenagers with 'tend to'.
qs.a: e.g. Teenagers tend to spend a lot of time online.

qs.q: The writer says: 'Walking is good for health.' Say a NOT GIVEN statement.
qs.a: e.g. Walking is better than swimming. (no view given)

20.title: Grammar Auction: sleep, memory and fear
20.stage: Tahlil bosqichida, xatolar daftaridan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
20.goal: Summary to'ldirishda hal qiluvchi so'z shakli va kollokatsiyalarni tekshirish: fewer/less, afraid of, exposed to, effect/affect, one-hour sessions, successful.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'less mistakes' → 'fewer mistakes').
Bonus: xato turini (predlog, so'z shakli yoki miqdor so'zi) birinchi aytgan jamoa +20 oladi — box summary mashqida ham aynan shu tekshiriladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Participants who slept well made fewer mistakes in the test.
items.why: mistakes — sanaladigan ot: fewer mistakes.

items.s: People who take a nap make less mistakes in the afternoon.
items.fix: People who take a nap make fewer mistakes in the afternoon.
items.why: Sanaladigan ot (mistakes) bilan 'fewer' ishlatiladi, 'less' emas.

items.s: Around ten per cent of adults suffer from a phobia of some kind.
items.why: suffer from — to'g'ri predlog; per cent — britancha yozilishi.

items.s: Many people are afraid from spiders and snakes.
items.fix: Many people are afraid of spiders and snakes.
items.why: afraid OF — 'from' emas (o'zbekcha '-dan qo'rqmoq' ta'siri).

items.s: The treatment took place over a three-month period.
items.why: three-month — sifat vazifasida, shuning uchun 'month' birlikda.

items.s: She attended twelve one-hours sessions with a therapist.
items.fix: She attended twelve one-hour sessions with a therapist.
items.why: Son + ot sifat bo'lib kelsa, ot birlikda: one-hour sessions.

items.s: A short nap can make you more alert in the afternoon.
items.why: make + kishi + sifat: make you more alert.

items.s: Sleep has a positive affect on memory.
items.fix: Sleep has a positive effect on memory.
items.why: effect — ot (ta'sir); affect — fe'l (ta'sir qilmoq).

items.s: The virtual reality treatment was surprisingly success.
items.fix: The virtual reality treatment was surprisingly successful.
items.why: 'surprisingly' (ravish) dan keyin sifat keladi: success (ot) → successful (sifat).

items.s: Scholars made important progress in reading hieroglyphs.
items.why: make progress — kollokatsiya; progress sanalmaydi ('a progress' emas).

items.s: The therapist slowly exposed her with the object of her fear.
items.fix: The therapist slowly exposed her to the object of her fear.
items.why: expose somebody TO something — predlog 'to'.

items.s: The results were the same in all three experiments.
items.why: the same — 'the' bilan keladi; all three + ko'plik ot.

20.title: Board Game: summary completion with a box
20.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin, gapirish tanaffusi sifatida (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
20.goal: Box bilan summary strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: so'z turkumini aniqlash, ro'yxatni guruhlash, paraphrase, inkor va son tuzoqlari; xotira, uyqu va qo'rquv haqida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

Guruhdan bitta 'hakam' javoblar varag'ini ushlab turadi va tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javob — namuna: mazmunan to'g'ri boshqa javob ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: In a summary with a box, do you write a word or a letter?
squares.a: A letter (A–J), as the instructions say.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'observed'
squares.a: watched / looked at

squares.t: Word class? 'at ___ times of the day'
squares.a: an adjective (e.g. different)

squares.t: 5 gaps and 10 words in the box: how many words are extra?
squares.a: Five.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about your earliest memory.
squares.a: e.g. I remember my first day at school because I cried.

squares.t: Group these: twelve, complex, fewer, six.
squares.a: numbers: twelve, six; adjective: complex; quantity: fewer

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'phobia'
squares.a: a very strong / extreme fear

squares.t: Word class? 'remembered ___ words than the others'
squares.a: a comparative quantity word (more / fewer)

squares.t: Speaking: How many hours do you usually sleep?
squares.a: e.g. About seven hours on weekdays and more at weekends.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'seek treatment'
squares.a: try to get help (from a doctor or therapist)

squares.t: Why not look for the exact box word in the text?
squares.a: Box words are usually paraphrases, not copies.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'gradually'
squares.a: step by step / little by little

squares.t: Text: 'She moved slowly.' Gap: 'She did not move very ___.'
squares.a: quickly — 'not very quickly' = slowly

squares.t: Name 3 common phobias in English.
squares.a: e.g. a fear of spiders, heights and flying

squares.t: Text: 'fewer wrong answers'. Gap: 'more ___ answers' (correct / wrong)
squares.a: correct — fewer wrong answers = more correct answers

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'alert'
squares.a: awake and attentive / wide awake

squares.t: The text has 12, three and six. What must you check?
squares.a: What each number refers to: hours, months or sessions?

squares.t: You have used letter G. What do you do next?
squares.a: Cross it out — each letter is usually used only once.

squares.t: Speaking: Why do we forget things when we are tired?
squares.a: e.g. A tired brain cannot focus or store new information well.

squares.t: Which fits? 'The results were ___.' (the same / fewer / six)
squares.a: the same — an adjective phrase after 'were'

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lasted for three months'
squares.a: took place over a three-month period

squares.t: Describe a time you were afraid of something.
squares.a: e.g. I was scared of the dark when I was a child, so I…

squares.t: Speaking: Can technology help people overcome fear?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — VR lets people face their fear safely, step by step.

squares.t: Give the group one box-summary tip in English.
squares.a: e.g. Group the words first, then check for negatives.

people who take part in a study

20.title: Find someone who… takes an afternoon nap
20.stage: Dars o'rtasida, 2-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
20.goal: Xotira, uyqu va qo'rquv haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Are you…? Do you…? Have you ever…?) va javoblarni son/miqdor bilan umumlashtirish.

items.t: …is afraid of spiders or snakes.
items.q: Are you afraid of spiders or snakes?

items.t: …takes a short nap in the afternoon.

items.t: …goes to bed after midnight on school nights.
items.q: Do you go to bed after midnight on school nights?

20.title: Speaking Cards: memory, sleep and fear
20.stage: Xulosa qismida yoki keyingi dars boshida (IELTS Speaking Part 1 va 3, 12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
20.goal: Xotira, uyqu va qo'rquv haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; javobni tinglovchi bir gapli 'summary' ga aylantira olishi.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: javob + sabab + misol.
Tinglovchi javobni BITTA gapda, boshqa so'zlar bilan qisqa aytadi (summary + paraphrase). Gapiruvchi 'Yes, exactly' desa — tinglovchiga +1 ball.
Gapiruvchi mavzu so'zlarini ishlatsa (memory, nap, alert, phobia, nightmare…) — har biri uchun +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

20.title: Sentence Race: summary sentences
20.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (8 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
20.goal: Summary uslubidagi gaplarni (miqdor so'zlari, taqqoslash, paraphrase) va box strategiyasi gaplarini to'g'ri tartibda tuzish hamda gapdagi 'box so'zi' bo'la oladigan so'zni topish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi; katta harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi, gapni o'qiydi va ro'yxatda (box) bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan bitta so'zni ko'rsatib, uning turkumini aytadi: son, sifat, ot yoki fe'l.
Ustoz tekshiradi: gap to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball, so'z turkumi to'g'ri aytilsa yana +1 ball; jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Students who slept made fewer mistakes than the others.
Check what each number in the text refers to.

Group the words in the box before you read.

20.title: Quiz Board: summary completion with a box
20.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror, uy vazifasidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
20.goal: Box bilan summary qoidalari, paraphrase, xotira/uyqu/qo'rquv so'zlari va og'zaki javobni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Box rules 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin. 'e.g.' javoblar — namuna: mazmunan to'g'ri javob qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: In the gap, do you write the word or its letter?
5 gaps and 10 words in the box: how many words will you NOT use?
What should you do first with the words in the box?
qs.a: Group them: numbers, adjectives, nouns, verbs…

Another way to say 'about a third'?

21.title: Grammar Auction: talking about success and happiness
21.stage: Tahlil bosqichida — listening javoblari tekshirilgandan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
21.goal: Muvaffaqiyat va baxt mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodlarning tipik xatolarini topish: kollokatsiya (make a decision), so'z shakli (successful), predlog (influence on, depend on), succeed in + -ing, most + ot.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: gaplar listeningdagi mavzuda — muvaffaqiyatli odamlar va baxt; har xato gapda faqat BITTA xato bor.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan, 'did a decision' → 'made a decision'); ustoz izohni (why) o'qib beradi.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

items.s: The young scientist made an important discovery.
items.why: make a discovery — to'g'ri kollokatsiya.

items.s: My grandfather had a big influence to me.
items.fix: My grandfather had a big influence on me.
items.why: influence bilan 'on' ishlatiladi, 'to' emas.

items.s: She became success when she was only twenty.
items.fix: She became successful when she was only twenty.
items.why: become + sifat: successful (yoki 'a success'); 'success' — ot, artiklsiz kelmaydi.

items.s: Many psychologists believe that close friends make us happier.
items.why: make + kimdir + sifat (happier) — to'g'ri.

items.s: He did a wise decision to publish his results early.
items.fix: He made a wise decision to publish his results early.
items.why: make a decision — 'do' bilan emas.

items.s: People who do voluntary work often feel happier.
items.why: do voluntary work — to'g'ri kollokatsiya.

items.s: He succeeded to win a scholarship to study abroad.
items.fix: He succeeded in winning a scholarship to study abroad.
items.why: succeed IN + -ing; 'succeed to do' deyilmaydi.

items.s: It is important to set yourself realistic goals.
items.why: set (yourself) a goal — to'g'ri kollokatsiya.

items.s: The most of successful people work extremely hard.
items.fix: Most successful people work extremely hard.
items.why: Umumiy ma'noda: 'Most + ot' (yoki 'most of the + ot'); 'the most of' — xato.

items.s: Her uncle had a strong influence on her career.
items.why: have an influence ON somebody/something — predlog to'g'ri.

items.s: Success depends from hard work, talent and luck.
items.fix: Success depends on hard work, talent and luck.
items.why: depend ON — 'from' emas (o'zbekchadagi '-dan' ta'siri).

items.s: Money cannot always bring people lasting happiness.
items.why: bring happiness — to'g'ri; happiness sanalmaydi, 'a' qo'yilmaydi.

21.title: Board Game: listening matching and success
21.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
21.goal: Listening matching strategiyasini (ism — langar, 2 ortiqcha variant, inkor qilingan chalg'ituvchi, sabab va natija) og'zaki tushuntirish, variantlarni paraphrase qilish va muvaffaqiyat/baxt mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
'Paraphrase' kataklarida kamida bitta to'g'ri sinonim yoki ibora aytilishi kerak (masalan, 'a relative' → 'his uncle'); guruh ustoz kalitidan tekshiradi.
Javob noto'g'ri bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

squares.t: Matching: 4 people and 6 options. How many options are extra?
squares.a: Two — they are not used for any person.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a relative' (give two examples).
squares.a: e.g. an uncle, an aunt, a cousin, a grandmother

squares.t: Are the people discussed in the same order as the questions?
squares.a: Yes — person 1 comes first, then 2, 3 and 4.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a wise decision'.
squares.a: e.g. a sensible choice / a clever thing to do

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about a successful person from Uzbekistan.
squares.a: e.g. Ulugbek was a great astronomer; he built an observatory in Samarkand.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'helping other people'.
squares.a: e.g. doing voluntary work / looking after elderly neighbours

squares.t: Why should you read the options before you listen?
squares.a: To predict synonyms — the audio rarely uses the same words.

squares.t: Audio: 'Her family was very poor.' Can the answer be 'a lot of money'?
squares.a: No — 'very poor' is the opposite of 'a lot of money'; it is a distractor.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'an invention'.
squares.a: e.g. he came up with something new / a new product was created

squares.t: In listening matching, what is the 'anchor'?
squares.a: The person's name — when you hear it, the answer is coming.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'having a social life'.
squares.a: e.g. going out with close friends regularly

squares.t: Say what makes YOU happy: 'The thing that makes me happy is …'
squares.a: e.g. The thing that makes me happy is spending time with my family.

squares.t: Question: 'What helped them succeed?' Is 'won an award' a cause or a result?
squares.a: A result — the question asks for the cause.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a personal style'.
squares.a: e.g. she did things her own way / she was very individual

squares.t: You missed the answer for person 2. What should you do?
squares.a: Move on to the next name and guess at the end — never leave a blank.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'an achievable ambition'.
squares.a: e.g. a realistic goal / something to aim for that you can reach

squares.t: Can you use the same letter twice?
squares.a: Only if the instructions say so; usually cross out each letter you use.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is money the key to happiness?
squares.a: e.g. Not really — money helps, but friends and goals matter more.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a change of job'.
squares.a: e.g. she switched careers / he left teaching to become a chef

squares.t: 'I prefer getting ready for a holiday to the holiday itself.' Holiday or planning?
squares.a: Planning a trip — 'being on holiday' is rejected.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'determination'.
squares.a: e.g. never giving up / really wanting to succeed

squares.t: Two speakers talk about one person. Does it matter WHO gives the answer?
squares.a: No — follow the person being described; the answer is a fact about him/her.

squares.t: Describe someone you admire: what helped him or her succeed?
squares.a: e.g. My aunt became a doctor because she worked hard and had a great teacher.

squares.t: Give 3 tips for listening matching tasks in 30 seconds.
squares.a: e.g. Predict synonyms, follow the names, watch for negatives, cross out used letters.

21.title: Dominoes: options and their paraphrases
21.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida (10 daqiqa) — sinonim jadvali bilan birga yoki uning o'rniga
21.goal: Qutidagi variantni (a relative's influence, a wise decision, an invention…) audioda aytilishi mumkin bo'lgan paraphrase bilan moslash — listening matching savolining asosiy ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi variant ('a relative's influence') qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrasega mos kelsa — o'sha toshni ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Har ulashda o'quvchi variant va paraphraseni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: 'a lot of money = a huge amount of cash'.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
Bonus: guruh istalgan 2 ta variant uchun o'z paraphrasesini qo'shimcha aytsa, +1 ball oladi.

pairs: his older cousin got him interested in film
she never copied anyone and did things her own way
a sensible choice that he never regretted
he came up with a completely new product
going out with close friends regularly
doing voluntary work in a care home
a realistic goal to aim for
packing and deciding what to see
she left banking to work as a chef
putting in long hours every day
an ability she was born with
being in the right place at the right time
a tutor who always believed in her
being fit and hardly ever ill

21.title: Taboo: success, happiness and people
21.stage: Kirish bosqichida isinish (5 daqiqa, 6–8 karta) yoki keyingi darsda lug'at takrori (10 daqiqa, hamma karta)
21.goal: Muvaffaqiyat va baxt mavzusidagi so'zlarni (scholarship, ambition, influence, voluntary work, psychologist…) inglizcha ta'rif va sinonim bilan tushuntirish — bu aynan audiodagi paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas; imo-ishora mumkin. Ustoz eng yaxshi paraphraselarni doskaga yozib boradi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

21.title: Find someone who… has done voluntary work
21.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa)
21.goal: Muvaffaqiyat, maqsadlar va baxt haqida savollarni to'g'ri tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you like…?) va javobni tinglab, asosiy faktni qisqa yozib olish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi (masalan: Have you ever done any voluntary work?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What did you do? Why?). Javobdagi asosiy faktni 2–3 so'z bilan yozib oladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi. Keyin ustoz 2–3 o'quvchidan so'raydi: 'Who has done voluntary work? What did he/she do?'

items.t: …has won a prize or a certificate in a competition.

21.title: Speaking cards: what makes people successful and happy?
21.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin, mavzu bo'yicha gapirish (Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
21.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 savollariga muvaffaqiyat va baxt mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; fikrni sabab (because…) va misol (for example…) bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab (because…) + misol (for example…).
Tinglovchi javobdagi asosiy SABABni o'z so'zlari bilan bir gapda qaytaradi — matchingdagi kabi paraphrase ('So, the main reason is…'). To'g'ri bo'lsa ikkalasi +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball to'plagan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Who is the most successful person in your family? What helped him or her to succeed?

21.title: Sentence Race: matching strategy and paraphrases
21.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
21.goal: Matching strategiyasi haqidagi gaplarni va muvaffaqiyatli odamlar haqidagi paraphrase gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Eslating: katta harfli so'z — gap boshi, vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxiri, nuqta yoki so'roq belgili so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gap nima ekanini aytsa — strategiya qoidasi, qaysi variantning paraphrasesi (masalan, 'a personal style') yoki chalg'ituvchi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The question asks for a cause, not a result.
Think of synonyms for every option before the recording starts.

21.title: Quiz Board: listening matching and success
21.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
21.goal: Matching qoidalari (ortiqcha variant, langar, chalg'ituvchi, sabab/natija), paraphrase, muvaffaqiyat va baxt lug'ati hamda og'zaki javoblarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
'Say it!' va 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar ochiq: ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa, ustoz qabul qiladi.
Hamma katak tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: 4 people and 6 options: how many options are NOT used?
What tells you that the answer for the next person is coming?
Do the people come in the same order as in the recording?
qs.a: Yes — the questions follow the order of the recording.

qs.q: Audio: 'She wasn't rich at all.' Is 'a lot of money' the answer for her? Why?
qs.a: No — money is mentioned but denied (a distractor).

qs.q: Question: 'What helped them succeed?' Audio: 'After years of practice, she won a prize.' Is the prize the answer?
qs.a: No — the prize is a result; the cause is years of practice.

qs.q: 'rich' = w______ (7 letters)
Give two words for 'a relative'.
qs.a: e.g. an uncle, an aunt, a cousin, a grandparent

qs.q: 'Voluntary work' is work that you do …
qs.a: without pay, to help other people

qs.q: 'an achievable ambition' = a r________ g___
Paraphrase 'a wise decision' in three or more words.
qs.a: e.g. a sensible choice / a clever thing to do

qs.q: Money given to a student to pay for his or her studies.
A person who studies how the mind works and how people behave.
A scientific test done to find out something new.
The series of jobs you do during your working life.
The quality of never giving up (a noun that starts with 'd').
Name two things that make you happy.
