qs.q: In one sentence, say what helped a famous person succeed.
qs.a: e.g. Messi succeeded because he trained hard from a young age.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'She had her own unique style.'
qs.a: e.g. She did things differently from everyone else.

qs.q: Give two tips for listening matching tasks.
qs.a: e.g. Predict synonyms before listening; cross out used letters.

qs.q: Is money the key to happiness? Answer in three sentences.
qs.a: e.g. Not really. Money helps a little. Friends and goals matter more.

22.title: Grammar Auction: suggesting, agreeing and disagreeing
22.stage: Sinf mashqi ('Taklif, rad yoki kelishuv?') dan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
22.goal: Part 3 suhbatidagi taklif, kelishuv va rad iboralarini to'g'ri ishlatish: I agree ('am'siz), agree WITH somebody, What about + -ing, Let's + V1, You're right, Me neither.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: gaplar — suhbatda taklif berish, rozi bo'lish yoki rad etish iboralari; har xato gapda bitta xato bor.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan, 'I am agree' → 'I agree'). Qo'shimcha +20: gap taklif, rad yoki kelishuv ekanini aytsa.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

items.s: I am agree with you about the criteria.
items.fix: I agree with you about the criteria.
items.why: agree — fe'l; oldidan 'am' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: Yeah, you're right. Let's choose someone with global influence.
items.why: Kelishuv + taklif: Let's + V1 (choose) — to'g'ri.

items.s: What about choose a scientist for our talk?
items.fix: What about choosing a scientist for our talk?
items.why: What about / How about + -ing shakl.

items.s: Why don't we look for some photos in the library?
items.why: Why don't we + V1 ('to'siz) — taklif.

items.s: Let's to meet again on Thursday after class.
items.fix: Let's meet again on Thursday after class.
items.why: Let's + V1; 'to' qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: I'm not sure that's a good idea.
items.why: Shubha / rad signali — grammatik to'g'ri.

items.s: I don't agree to you — fame doesn't always last.
items.fix: I don't agree with you — fame doesn't always last.
items.why: Odam bilan: agree WITH somebody; 'agree to' — taklif yoki shartga rozi bo'lish.

items.s: That's a good idea, but it might be too expensive.
items.why: 'but' — rad signali; gap to'g'ri.

items.s: A: I don't trust online tests. B: Me too.
items.fix: A: I don't trust online tests. B: Me neither.
items.why: Inkor gapga qo'shilish: Me neither; 'Me too' — faqat tasdiq gapga.

items.s: How about asking our tutor for some advice?
items.why: How about + -ing — to'g'ri taklif; advice sanalmaydi.

items.s: You have right — effort matters more than luck.
items.fix: You are right — effort matters more than luck.
items.why: 'be right' iborasi: You are right; 'have right' deyilmaydi.

items.s: I see your point, but I still think talent matters more.
items.why: Qisman rozilik + rad: 'I see your point, but…' — to'g'ri.

22.title: Board Game: suggestion, objection or agreement?
22.stage: Listening tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
22.goal: Part 3 pick from a list strategiyasini (Choose TWO, AGREE so'zi, taklif → rad → kelishuv zanjiri) og'zaki tushuntirish, signal iboralarni tanish, variantlarni paraphrase qilish va o'qish/muvaffaqiyat mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gap turini aytadi (suggestion / objection / agreement), paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
'Suggestion, objection or agreement?' kataklarida sababini ham aytish kerak (qaysi so'z signal berdi: but, I agree, What about…).
Javob noto'g'ri bo'lsa yoki o'yinchi 10 soniyada boshlamasa — oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Guruh ustoz kalitidan tekshiradi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

squares.t: 'Choose TWO letters, A–E': how many letters do you write?
squares.a: Two, in any order — each one gets one mark.

squares.t: Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'What about asking our tutor?'
squares.a: Suggestion — nothing has been decided yet.

squares.t: Give 3 ways to agree with someone.
squares.a: e.g. I agree. / You're right. / That's a good idea.

squares.t: Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'Yeah, but it might be too expensive.'
squares.a: Objection — 'but' rejects the idea.

squares.t: Give 3 ways to make a suggestion.
squares.a: e.g. What about …ing? / Why don't we …? / Let's …

squares.t: Key word? 'Which TWO ideas do the speakers agree on?'
squares.a: AGREE — both students must accept the idea.

squares.t: Give 3 ways to disagree politely.
squares.a: e.g. I'm not sure. / I see your point, but … / I don't think so.

squares.t: Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'OK, let's go with that.'
squares.a: Agreement — this is the answer.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: what do you need to do well at school?
squares.a: e.g. You need to work hard, plan your time and ask for help.

squares.t: One student suggests an idea; the other ignores it. Is it an answer?
squares.a: No — one person's idea is not enough; both must agree.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'conduct more research'.
squares.a: e.g. look for more information / gather more facts

squares.t: Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'I'm not sure that's fair.'
squares.a: Objection — it shows doubt.

squares.t: Is the first idea in a discussion usually the answer?
squares.a: Often not — it may be rejected later; wait for the final decision.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'effort'.
squares.a: e.g. working hard / being determined / not giving up

squares.t: The question says 'do next'. What are you listening for?
squares.a: Future actions they plan, e.g. 'Next, I'll …' / 'Tomorrow, let's …'

squares.t: Your partner wants to study late at night. Disagree and suggest something else.
squares.a: e.g. I'm not sure — why don't we study in the morning instead?

squares.t: 'Grades aren't everything, are they?' — 'No.' Do they think grades matter most?
squares.a: No — both agree that grades are not the most important thing.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is success more about talent or hard work?
squares.a: e.g. Both matter, but hard work is more important — talent alone is not enough.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'find photographs'.
squares.a: e.g. get some pictures / look for images online

squares.t: Is 'Yeah, maybe' strong agreement?
squares.a: No — it is uncertain; listen to what comes next.

squares.t: Describe a group project: how did your group make decisions?
squares.a: e.g. We shared ideas, discussed them and finally agreed to divide the work.

squares.t: Why is 'Yeah, but …' a trap for listeners?
squares.a: It sounds like agreement, but 'but' introduces a rejection.

squares.t: Speaking Part 3: Why do some students learn better in groups?
squares.a: e.g. They can test each other, and explaining ideas helps them remember.

squares.t: Explain the chain: suggestion → ? → ? Give an example.
squares.a: Suggestion → objection → agreement, e.g. 'Bus?' 'Too slow.' 'Taxi, then?' 'OK, agreed.'

22.title: Dominoes: options and what the speakers say
22.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida (10 daqiqa) — jadval bilan birga yoki uning o'rniga
22.goal: Pick from a list variantlarini (conduct more research, global importance, effort, experience…) suhbatda aytilishi mumkin bo'lgan paraphrase bilan moslash — variant deyarli hech qachon aynan aytilmaydi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi variant ('conduct more research') qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrasega mos kelsa — o'sha toshni ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Har ulashda o'quvchi ovoz chiqarib aytadi: 'wealth = having plenty of money'.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
Bonus: guruh 2 ta variantni suhbat shaklida aytsa (taklif + kelishuv, masalan: 'Why don't we email a classmate?' — 'Good idea!'), +1 ball.

pairs: gather more facts before we decide
working hard and not giving up
an achievement that changed the whole world
having done the job for many years
whether the person is a man or a woman
being a celebrity that everyone recognises
how old they were at the time
the place where someone lives or works
prepare what we will say to the class
go to the gym three times a week
sit by a lake and listen to the birds
an unexpected chance at the right moment

22.title: Taboo: study, success and discussion
22.stage: Kirish bosqichida isinish (5 daqiqa, 6–8 karta) yoki keyingi darsda lug'at takrori (10 daqiqa, hamma karta)
22.goal: O'qish, muvaffaqiyat va muhokama so'zlarini (criteria, research, seminar, assignment, deadline, suggestion…) inglizcha ta'rif va sinonim bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Jamoa taxmin aytganda tushuntiruvchi faqat 'Yes, you're right!' yoki 'No, not quite…' bilan javob beradi — kelishuv/rad iboralarini mashq qilish uchun.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

22.title: Find someone who… has given a presentation in English
22.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa)
22.goal: O'qish, guruh ishi va muvaffaqiyat haqida savollarni to'g'ri tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you prefer…? Do you think…?) va natijaga rozi yoki qarshi ekanini bildirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zi tuzadi (masalan: Have you ever given a presentation in English?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? How did it go?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi.
Oxirida ustoz 2–3 qatorni so'raydi (masalan: 'Who thinks hard work is more important than talent?'); qolganlar 'I agree' yoki 'I'm not sure, because…' bilan munosabat bildiradi.

items.t: …has worked on a group project this year.
items.q: Have you worked on a group project this year?

items.t: …has given a presentation in English.
items.q: Have you ever given a presentation in English?

items.t: …prefers studying alone to studying in a group.
items.q: Do you prefer studying alone to studying in a group?

items.t: …has changed his/her mind after a discussion with a friend.
items.q: Have you ever changed your mind after a discussion with a friend?

items.t: …thinks hard work is more important than talent.
items.q: Do you think hard work is more important than talent?

items.t: …has joined a club or a society this year.
items.q: Have you joined a club or a society this year?

items.t: …has done a personality test online.
items.q: Have you ever done a personality test online?

items.t: …uses the library more than the Internet for research.
items.q: Do you use the library more than the Internet for research?

items.t: …has missed a deadline for an assignment.
items.q: Have you ever missed a deadline for an assignment?

items.t: …usually agrees with his/her friends' suggestions.
items.q: Do you usually agree with your friends' suggestions?

items.t: …has asked a teacher for advice about his/her studies.
items.q: Have you ever asked a teacher for advice about your studies?

items.t: …feels happiest when he/she spends time outdoors.
items.q: Do you feel happiest when you spend time outdoors?

22.title: Speaking cards: discuss, disagree, agree
22.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin juftlikda muhokama (Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
22.goal: O'qish, guruh ishi va muvaffaqiyat haqida Part 1/3 savollariga javob berish va Part 3 listeningdagi taklif → rad → kelishuv zanjirini o'zi ishlatish (I agree / I see your point, but… / So we both agree that…).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi, savolni o'qiydi va 2–3 gap bilan javob beradi.
Sherigi munosabat bildiradi: rozi bo'ladi (You're right / I agree) yoki e'tiroz bildiradi (I see your point, but… / I'm not sure) va o'z sababini aytadi.
Juftlik 1 daqiqada bitta umumiy fikrga kelishi va uni 'So we both agree that…' bilan aytishi kerak.
Har to'g'ri ishlatilgan kelishuv yoki rad iborasi uchun +1 ball. Rollar almashadi; 12 daqiqadan keyin ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you prefer studying alone or with other people? Why?
How do you usually make decisions with your friends, for example about weekend plans?
Is it easy for you to agree with other people's ideas? Why or why not?
What do you do when you disagree with a friend?
Do you enjoy giving presentations? Why or why not?
Where do you usually do research for school: in a library or online?
Do you think personality tests tell us anything useful about people?
What are the advantages of working on a group project?
Why do some groups find it hard to reach an agreement?
Is talent or hard work more important for success at university?
Should success at school be measured only by exam results?
How can students stay motivated when a subject is difficult?
Do you think experience is more important than qualifications for getting a job?
What makes a good team leader in a student project?
Should universities teach students how to work in teams? Why?
Does being successful always make people happy? Why or why not?

22.title: Sentence Race: suggestions, objections and agreement
22.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
22.goal: Taklif (Why don't we…? What about + -ing, How about + -ing), rad (I'm not sure…, …but…) va kelishuv (I agree that…) iboralari bor gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Eslating: katta harfli so'z — gap boshi ('I' va ismlardan tashqari), vergulli so'z — birinchi qism oxiri, nuqta/so'roq belgili so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gap turini to'g'ri aytsa — suggestion, objection, agreement yoki strategiya qoidasi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Why don't we look for some photos online?
What about choosing someone who changed the world?
How about asking Mr Karimov for advice?
I'm not sure that's a good idea.
That's a good idea, but it might be too expensive.
I see your point, but money matters too.
Yeah, I agree that talent is important.
Before our next meeting, let's find more information.
Talent isn't enough for success, is it?
Only one speaker liked it, so it cannot be an answer.

22.title: Quiz Board: pick from a list — who agrees?
22.stage: Dars oxirida yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
22.goal: Pick from a list (Part 3) qoidalari, taklif/rad/kelishuv signallari, o'qish va muvaffaqiyat lug'ati hamda og'zaki javoblarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Agree or not? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
'Agree or not?' bo'limida signal so'zni ham aytish kerak (but, I agree, let's…); 'Say it!' javoblari ochiq — ma'no va grammatika to'g'ri bo'lsa qabul qilinadi.
Hamma katak tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: In 'Choose TWO letters, A–E', how many letters do you write?
'Which TWO things do the students AGREE on?' Which word is the most important?
qs.a: AGREE — both speakers must accept the idea.

qs.q: What is the usual chain of ideas in a Part 3 discussion?
Is the first idea mentioned usually the answer? Why?
qs.a: Often not — it may be rejected later; wait for the final decision.

qs.q: One student suggests an idea; the other says 'Hmm, maybe.' Can you choose it yet?
qs.a: No — 'maybe' is not clear agreement; keep listening.

qs.q: Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'You're absolutely right.'
Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'Why don't we ask the librarian?'
Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'Yeah, but that could take too long.'
Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'I'm not so sure about that.'
Suggestion, objection or agreement? 'Fine — let's go with that one, then.'
A piece of work that a student must do and hand in to a teacher.
The latest time or date by which you must finish something.
A class in which a small group discusses a topic with a tutor.
The standards you use to judge or choose something (plural).
What is the singular of 'criteria'?
Suggest to your partner that you do the homework together.
qs.a: e.g. Why don't we do the homework together?

qs.q: Agree with this: 'Hard work matters more than luck.'
qs.a: e.g. I agree — you can't rely on luck.

qs.q: Disagree politely: 'Online tests are useless.'
qs.a: e.g. I see your point, but some of them are quite useful.

qs.q: Paraphrase 'global importance'.
qs.a: e.g. something that changed the world / international impact

qs.q: Is talent or effort more important for success? Answer in three sentences.
qs.a: e.g. Both matter. But effort matters more. Talent alone isn't enough.

23.title: Grammar Auction: booking and registration English
23.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin (qoida va tipik xatolar), sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
23.goal: Ro'yxatdan o'tish va chipta band qilish haqidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish va tuzatish: bilvosita savol tartibi, predloglar (on Monday, by Friday), information, 23rd, advertised.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering — boshlang'ich pul 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato (predlog, zamon, fe'l shakli, so'z tartibi)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'starts in Monday' → 'starts on Monday').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: I'd like to enrol on the evening IELTS course, please.
items.why: enrol on (yoki in) a course — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: Could you tell me what is your postcode?
items.fix: Could you tell me what your postcode is?
items.why: Bilvosita savolda so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek: what your postcode is.

items.s: How much does a ticket for Saturday cost?
items.why: How much does … cost? — does + fe'lning 1-shakli.

items.s: The course starts in Monday, the 9th of May.
items.fix: The course starts on Monday, the 9th of May.
items.why: Hafta kuni va sana oldidan 'on' ishlatiladi.

items.s: Please fill in this registration form before the first class.
items.why: fill in a form — to'g'ri birikma ('fill the form' emas).

items.s: I'm calling about the IELTS course advertise on Instagram.
items.fix: I'm calling about the IELTS course advertised on Instagram.
items.why: Qisqargan passiv: course (which is) advertised — V3 kerak.

items.s: Can you spell your surname for me, please?
items.why: Harflab aytishni so'rash: spell + ot; to'g'ri va xushmuomala.

items.s: I have to pay the registration fee until Friday.
items.fix: I have to pay the registration fee by Friday.
items.why: Muddat (deadline) — 'by'; 'until' davomiylik uchun.

items.s: You can contact me at work between 9 a.m. and 5.30 p.m.
items.why: between … and … — vaqt oralig'i; 5.30 — britancha yozilish.

items.s: I need some informations about the weekend course.
items.fix: I need some information about the weekend course.
items.why: information — sanalmaydigan ot: ko'plik -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: My date of birth is the 23th of March.
items.fix: My date of birth is the 23rd of March.
items.why: 23 — twenty-third: 23rd (th emas); 21st, 22nd, 23rd.

items.s: I'd like to book two seats for the concert on Saturday.
items.why: book seats/tickets for + tadbir; on + hafta kuni — to'g'ri.

23.title: Board Game: Form completion — spell it, say it
23.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
23.goal: Form completion strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: harflab aytish (double L), raqam va postcode'ni guruhlab o'qish, tuzatishni ushlash, home/work raqamini ajratish, paraphrase va mavzu bo'yicha gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: harflab aytadi, raqamni guruhlab o'qiydi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Harflash, raqam va postcode kataklarida chapdagi o'yinchi eshitganini daftarga yozadi; xato yozilsa, aytuvchi qaytadan aniqroq aytadi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, yana zar tashlash).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Spell your first name aloud, letter by letter.
squares.a: e.g. D-I-L-N-O-Z-A

squares.t: How do you say 'LL' when you spell a name?
squares.a: double L

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'surname'
squares.a: family name / last name

squares.t: Form completion: do the answers come in the same order as the recording?
squares.a: Yes — always in the order you hear them.

squares.t: Say this phone number the British way: 0712 559081
squares.a: oh-seven-one-two, double five-nine, oh-eight-one

squares.t: Ask someone politely to spell his or her surname.
squares.a: e.g. Could you spell your surname for me, please?

squares.t: Say this date the British way: 22/10
squares.a: the twenty-second of October

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: a course you would like to take.
squares.a: e.g. I'd like to take a coding course because…

squares.t: You hear: '4-6-2… no, sorry, 4-2-6.' What do you write?
squares.a: 426 — always write the corrected version.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'I'd like to sign up for the course.'
squares.a: e.g. I'd like to enrol on / register for the course.

squares.t: Say this postcode clearly: TN12 5QX
squares.a: T-N-one-two, five-Q-X

squares.t: Form: '12 ______ Road'. You hear '12 Navoi Road'. What do you write?
squares.a: Navoi — never repeat words already printed on the form.

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Is '27 Silver Street' OK?
squares.a: Yes — a number and two words.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'mobile number'
squares.a: e.g. mobile phone number / contact number

squares.t: You hear a home number and a work number. How do you choose?
squares.a: Look at the label on the form: Home / Work / Mobile.

squares.t: Name 3 things a gym membership form might ask for.
squares.a: e.g. name, address, membership type, start date, health problems

squares.t: Do capital letters matter in IELTS Listening answers?
squares.a: No — capitals don't matter, but spelling must be exact.

squares.t: You hear: 'Monday… actually, Tuesday suits me better.' Answer?

24.title: Grammar Auction: prices, choices and changes
24.stage: 'Savol turi' bosqichidan keyin (tuzoqlar tushuntirilgach), sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
24.goal: Kurs, tadbir va narx haqidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni topish: used to, 'ago' bilan Past Simple, up by 10%, recommend + -ing, would rather + V1, prefer A to B, ikki inkor.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering — boshlang'ich pul 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato (predlog, zamon, fe'l shakli, so'z tartibi)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'recommended to download' → 'recommended downloading').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: The class used to cost £30, but now it costs £35.
items.why: used to + V1 — o'tmishdagi holat; now — hozirgi narx.

items.s: Registration has opened two days ago.
items.fix: Registration opened two days ago.
items.why: 'ago' bilan Past Simple: opened ('has opened' emas).

items.s: I'll go for the weekend class because I work during the week.
items.why: go for = tanlamoq; MCQ da aynan tanlovni bildiradi.

items.s: The price of the tickets went up on ten per cent.
items.fix: The price of the tickets went up by ten per cent.
items.why: O'zgarish miqdori 'by' bilan: went up by 10%.

items.s: The assistant recommended to download the app.
items.fix: The assistant recommended downloading the app.
items.why: recommend + -ing (yoki that …), 'to' + fe'l emas.

items.s: It's worth booking a place in advance.
items.why: It's worth + -ing — foydali ekanini bildiradi.

items.s: I'd rather to travel by metro than drive in this traffic.
items.fix: I'd rather travel by metro than drive in this traffic.
items.why: would rather + V1 ('to' qo'shilmaydi).

items.s: The morning class is the most popular, so it's already full.
items.why: the most + ko'p bo'g'inli sifat; so — natija.

items.s: Most visitors prefer using the app than paying by card.
items.fix: Most visitors prefer using the app to paying by card.
items.why: prefer A to B — 'than' emas.

items.s: Unless you book early, you won't get a seat.
items.why: unless = if … not; unless'dan keyin inkor ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: The talks are free, so you don't need to pay nothing.
items.fix: The talks are free, so you don't need to pay anything.
items.why: Ingliz tilida ikki inkor bo'lmaydi: don't … anything.

items.s: The cafés are so expensive that most visitors eat elsewhere.
items.why: so + sifat + that — natija.

24.title: Board Game: Multiple choice — find the real answer
24.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
24.goal: Listening MCQ strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: uchala variant eshitiladi, o'zgargan ma'lumot (was … but now), rad etilgan va tanlangan variant, fikr so'zlari; paraphrase va mavzu bo'yicha gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: tuzoqni topadi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
'You hear: …' kataklarida chapdagi o'yinchi gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; zar tashlagan o'yinchi taxtaga qaramasdan, faqat tinglab javob beradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, yana zar tashlash).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: MCQ: how many of the options A, B and C are usually mentioned?
squares.a: Usually all three — but only one answers the question.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'It's a bargain.'
squares.a: e.g. It's very cheap / It's good value for money.

squares.t: You hear: 'It was £20, but now it's £25.' What is the price now?
squares.a: £25 — £20 is the old price.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'on foot'
squares.a: walking / you walk there

squares.t: What does 'I think I'll go for that one' tell you?
squares.a: The speaker has made a choice — this is the answer.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: an event you went to recently.
squares.a: e.g. Last month I went to a book fair in Tashkent…

squares.t: Why should you read the options before the recording starts?
squares.a: To see how they differ and know what to listen for.

squares.t: An option says 'by public transport'. What might you hear instead?
squares.a: e.g. I'll take the bus / hop on the metro / catch a train.

squares.t: You hear: 'It's not bad, but it's nothing special.' Is it 'excellent'?
squares.a: No — the speaker thinks it is just average.

squares.t: Ask politely when a course starts.
squares.a: e.g. Could you tell me when the course starts?

squares.t: You hear: 'I thought about the bus, but I'll take a taxi.' How will he travel?
squares.a: By taxi — the bus was rejected.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'fully booked'
squares.a: full / no places left / sold out

squares.t: Say 3 words or phrases that signal a change of information.
squares.a: e.g. but now, actually, used to, not any more

squares.t: Name 3 ways a ticket office can send tickets.
squares.a: e.g. by email, by post, by courier (or you collect them at the venue)

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: the best way to travel around your city.
squares.a: e.g. The metro is the best because it's fast and cheap…

squares.t: Offer or choice? 'We can also deliver them by courier.'
squares.a: An offer — the customer hasn't chosen yet.

squares.t: You hear: 'The food's fine, but you pay through the nose for it.' Opinion?
squares.a: The food is OK, but it is very expensive.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'It used to last two hours.'
squares.a: e.g. It was two hours long before; the length has changed.

squares.t: Ask a question to find out the cheapest option.
squares.a: e.g. Which is the cheapest option?

squares.t: You hear: 'Booking isn't required, but it's a good idea.' Must you book?
squares.a: No — it's advised, not compulsory.

squares.t: Role-play: ask about a cooking class — days, price, what to bring.
squares.a: e.g. Which days is it on? How much is it? Do I need to bring anything?

squares.t: Why is choosing the first option you hear a common mistake?
squares.a: All three are mentioned; the first one is often a distractor.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: do you prefer free events or paid ones? Why?
squares.a: e.g. I prefer paid ones because they are usually better organised.

squares.t: Make a trap: mention three ways to travel, but choose only one.
squares.a: e.g. The bus is slow and taxis cost a lot, so I'll walk. (answer: on foot)

24.title: Sentence Race: MCQ strategy and choices
24.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
24.goal: MCQ strategiyasi va tanlov/o'zgarish/baho gaplarida (used to, go for, unless, cost a fortune) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach, qo'l ko'taradi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert. Strategiya gaplarida jamoa qoidani o'zbekcha izohlasa +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The class used to last two hours, but it is longer now.
You will hear all three options in the recording.
Underline the keywords in each question before listening.
In the end, he went for the cheaper option.
Don't choose an option until the speaker has decided.
Tickets for the author talks are free of charge.
Eating at the fair will cost you a fortune.
Unless you book in advance, you might not get a seat.
How much does a one-day cooking course cost?
Only one option answers the question exactly.

24.title: Quiz Board: Multiple choice review
24.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
24.goal: MCQ qoidalari, paraphrase, tuzoq turlari (eski narx, rad etilgan variant, fikr, hisoblash) va ma'lumot so'rash iboralarini takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Spot the trap 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob og'zaki, to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Do the questions follow the order of the recording?
How many of the options are usually mentioned in the recording?
What should you do before the recording starts?
qs.a: Read the questions, underline keywords, compare the options.

qs.q: A question asks for the speaker's opinion. What should you listen for?
qs.a: Opinion words: great, not bad, overpriced, a fortune…

qs.q: Why should you go back to the question before you choose?
qs.a: To check which option answers exactly what is asked.

qs.q: 'free of charge' = ?
'It's not compulsory.' = ?
qs.a: It's optional / you don't have to.

qs.q: 'costs a fortune' = ?
'It's first come, first served.' = ?
qs.a: No booking — the earliest people get the places.

qs.q: You hear 'Just drop in any time.' Which option? A) book ahead B) no booking needed C) phone first
'It was £50, but now it's £60.' What is the price now?
'We can email them or post them.' — 'Post, please.' How will the tickets arrive?
'I wanted the Saturday class, but it's full, so Sunday, please.' Which day?
'Most people take the bus, but I always cycle.' How does the speaker travel?
qs.a: By bike — the bus is what other people do.

qs.q: 'The first hour is free, then it's £2 per hour.' Cost of a three-hour ride?
Ask how long a course lasts.
qs.a: How long does the course last? / How long is the course?

qs.q: Say that a price has changed, using 'used to'.
qs.a: e.g. It used to cost £10, but now it costs £12.

qs.q: Choose one of two options using 'I'll go for…'.
qs.a: e.g. I'll go for the evening class.

qs.q: Politely reject an option and give a reason.
qs.a: e.g. I'd rather not take the bus — it's too slow.

qs.q: Give your opinion of a café, using 'but'.
qs.a: e.g. It's cosy, but the prices are too high.

25.title: Grammar Auction: reading and learning errors
25.stage: Paraphrase mashqidan keyin, 1-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
25.goal: O'qish va o'rganish mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodlarning tipik xatolarini (moslashuv, predlog, 'information', 'make a mistake', 'an hour', 'despite') topish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering. Boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi (predlog, artikl, moslashuv, collocation)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'interested for' → 'interested in').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: Speed reading is not only about reading fast but also about remembering what you read.
items.why: not only … but also — to'g'ri juftlik; gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Reading for pleasure improve your vocabulary faster than learning word lists.
items.fix: Reading for pleasure improves your vocabulary faster than learning word lists.
items.why: Gerund ega (Reading …) birlik hisoblanadi: improves.

items.s: Most students read the questions before they skim the text.
items.why: Most + ko'plik ot (the'siz) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Many teenagers are interested for graphic novels because of the pictures.
items.fix: Many teenagers are interested in graphic novels because of the pictures.
items.why: interested + in ('for' emas).

items.s: The same paragraph may contain the answers to two different questions.
items.why: may + V1 — to'g'ri; bu NB qoidasi: bitta harf ikki marta.

items.s: A lot of informations in the article is irrelevant to the task.
items.fix: A lot of information in the article is irrelevant to the task.
items.why: information — sanalmaydigan ot: -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: Graphic novels can help reluctant readers learn new words more quickly.
items.why: help + (to) V1 — ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri.

items.s: Readers often do mistakes when they go back to the start of every sentence.
items.fix: Readers often make mistakes when they go back to the start of every sentence.
items.why: Collocation: make a mistake ('do' emas).

items.s: If you enjoy a book, you will finish it much more quickly.
items.why: 1-shart gap: If + Present Simple, will + V1.

items.s: Most people forget half of a new word list within a hour.
items.fix: Most people forget half of a new word list within an hour.
items.why: hour — unli tovush bilan boshlanadi (h o'qilmaydi): an hour.

items.s: Our local library now runs a free reading club for teenagers.
items.why: run a club — to'g'ri collocation; library birlik: runs.

items.s: Despite of its short length, the article contains a lot of useful facts.
items.fix: Despite its short length, the article contains a lot of useful facts.
items.why: Despite'dan keyin 'of' kelmaydi (in spite of — mumkin).

25.title: Board Game: Which paragraph contains…?
25.stage: Tahlil bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
25.goal: Matching information strategiyasi (ma'lumot turi, NB qoidasi, heading va information farqi), table completion qoidalari, paraphrase va o'qish mavzusida gapirishni takrorlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: ma'lumot turini aytadi (definition, number, reason…), paraphrase beradi yoki savolga javob beradi.
Guruh javob kalitiga qarab tekshiradi (kalit guruh sardorida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Speaking' kataklarida kamida 2 gap va bitta sabab (because …) aytilishi shart; paraphrase kataklarida kalitdagidan boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi. FINISH ga birinchi yetgan yoki vaqt tugaganda eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Say the instruction for this question type.
squares.a: Which paragraph contains the following information?

squares.t: Info type? 'a definition of speed reading'
squares.a: A definition — look for 'is', 'means' or 'refers to'.

squares.t: Info type? 'the number of books sold last year'
squares.a: A number / statistic — scan for figures.

squares.t: Info type? 'why some students read slowly'
squares.a: A reason — look for 'because', 'due to', 'so'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'read quickly'
squares.a: e.g. read rapidly / read at speed / skim through

squares.t: Speaking: Do you prefer paper books or e-books? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Paper books, because they are easier on my eyes.

squares.t: Do matching information answers come in text order?
squares.a: No — they can be anywhere in the text (NOT in order).

squares.t: Can you use one paragraph letter twice?
squares.a: Yes, if the task says 'NB You may use any letter more than once.'

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'hardly ever'
squares.a: rarely / almost never / only occasionally

squares.t: Info type? 'the groups that benefit from speed reading'
squares.a: A list of examples — look for jobs or groups (e.g. workers, students).

squares.t: Heading vs information: what is the difference?
squares.a: Heading = main idea of a paragraph; information = one small detail.

squares.t: Speaking: What was the last book you read? Did you like it?
squares.a: e.g. I read … last month and liked it because …

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'remember'
squares.a: recall / retain / keep in mind

squares.t: Info type? 'how chunking differs from word-by-word reading'
squares.a: A comparison — look for 'whereas', 'unlike', 'on the other hand'.

squares.t: Table completion: 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS' — can you write three?
squares.a: No — one or two words only, or the answer is marked wrong.

squares.t: Why is it better to do matching information last?
squares.a: Answers are not in order; after the other tasks you already know the text.

squares.t: Speaking: Why do some teenagers stop reading books?
squares.a: e.g. Because social media takes up most of their free time.

squares.t: Info type? 'the origin of a word'
squares.a: Origin / history — look for 'comes from' or 'is derived from'.

squares.t: The word 'speed' is in every paragraph. What do you do?
squares.a: Don't match words — check the TYPE of information asked.

squares.t: Table completion: what do you check after writing a word?
squares.a: Spelling, the word limit, and grammar fit (e.g. singular or plural).

squares.t: Speaking: How can schools encourage children to read more?
squares.a: e.g. By starting reading clubs and letting children choose books.

squares.t: Info type? 'a prediction about the future of books'
squares.a: A prediction — look for 'will', 'is likely to', 'is expected to'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Few adults read for pleasure.'
squares.a: e.g. Not many grown-ups read just for enjoyment.

squares.t: Speaking: Will printed books disappear one day? Give 2 reasons.
squares.a: e.g. No — people love holding books, and libraries are still popular.

25.title: Dominoes: paraphrase pairs (reading and learning)
25.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida — jadval bilan ishlashdan keyin (12 daqiqa)
25.goal: Savoldagi va matndagi so'zlar o'rtasidagi paraphraseni tanish (skim a text = read it quickly for the general idea) — matching informationning asosiy ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora (savol tili) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi ibora (matn tili) bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring; har ulashda ikki ifoda nega bir ma'no berishini ovoz chiqarib ayting.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulanish bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Qo'shimcha +1: 2 ta iborani o'z so'zlari bilan yana bir marta paraphrase qilish.

pairs: read it quickly for the general idea
people who do not want to read

25.title: Taboo: books, reading and learning
25.stage: Kirish qismida, o'tgan dars takroridan keyin mavzuga kirish uchun (10 daqiqa)
25.goal: O'qish, kitob va o'rganish mavzusidagi so'zlarni (library, skim, literacy, assignment…) ta'rif orqali tushuntirish — bu 'a definition of …' turidagi savollarga tayyorlaydi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.

60 soniya ichida so'zni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: ta'rif, misol yoki qarama-qarshi ma'no bilan. So'zning o'zi yoki uning qismi (masalan, e-book dagi 'book') va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va so'zni harflab aytish mumkin emas; imo-ishora mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Oxirida 3 ta so'zga to'liq ta'rif gapi aytiladi (A library is a place where …).

25.title: Find someone who… has read a book in English
25.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli tanaffus — 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin (10 daqiqa)
25.goal: O'qish va o'rganish tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Present Perfect, Present Simple, Present Continuous, used to, would rather) va qo'shimcha savol bilan suhbatni davom ettirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever read a whole book in English?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What was it? When? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; faqat inglizcha gapiriladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi (Aziz has read … because …).

items.t: …has read a whole book in English.
items.q: Have you ever read a whole book in English?

items.t: …reads the news on their phone every morning.
items.q: Do you read the news on your phone every morning?

items.t: …has borrowed a book from a library this year.
items.q: Have you borrowed a book from a library this year?

items.t: …prefers e-books to paper books.
items.q: Do you prefer e-books to paper books?

items.t: …has tried a speed-reading technique.
items.q: Have you ever tried a speed-reading technique?

items.t: …used to read comics as a child.
items.q: Did you use to read comics as a child?

items.t: …is reading a book at the moment.
items.q: Are you reading a book at the moment?

items.t: …has finished an online course.
items.q: Have you ever finished an online course?

items.t: …learns new words with a flashcard app.
items.q: Do you learn new words with a flashcard app?

items.t: …would rather watch the film than read the book.
items.q: Would you rather watch the film than read the book?

items.t: …has been to a book fair or a book club.
items.q: Have you ever been to a book fair or a book club?

items.t: …can read for an hour without checking their phone.
items.q: Can you read for an hour without checking your phone?

25.title: Speaking cards: reading and learning (Part 1 & 3)
25.stage: Listening bosqichi o'rniga (bu darsda audio yo'q) yoki dars oxirida (12 daqiqa)
25.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida o'qish, kitoblar va o'rganish haqida kengaytirilgan javob berish (fikr + sabab + misol).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying; juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Part 1 savoliga 2–3 gap, Part 3 savoliga 4–5 gap bilan javob beriladi: fikr + sabab + misol.
Tinglovchi javobdan bitta detalni (raqam, misol yoki sabab) eslab qoladi va qaytarib aytadi — xuddi matching informationdagi kabi.
To'liq javob +1 ball, detalni to'g'ri qaytargan tinglovchi +1 ball. Rollar almashadi; 12 daqiqadan keyin ko'p ball olgan g'olib.

cards: Part 1: Do you enjoy reading? What kind of things do you usually read?
Part 1: What was the last book you read? Would you recommend it?
Part 1: Do you prefer reading paper books or reading on a screen? Why?
Part 1: Did your parents read to you when you were a child?
Part 1: How often do you visit a library or a bookshop?
Part 1: Do you read differently when you study and when you relax? How?
Part 1: What is the best way for you to remember new English words?
Part 3: Why do many young people read less than their parents did?
Part 3: Should schools let children choose the books they study? Why or why not?
Part 3: Are graphic novels and comics 'real' reading? Explain your view.
Part 3: How has the internet changed the way people read?
Part 3: Is reading fast always a good thing? When is slow reading better?
Part 3: What can the government do to encourage adults to read more?
Part 3: Will libraries still exist in thirty years? Why or why not?

25.title: Sentence Race: matching information rules
25.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (8 daqiqa)
25.goal: Matching information qoidalari va ma'lumot turlarini ifodalovchi gaplarni (The first paragraph contains a definition of …, You may use any letter more than once) to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi bor so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri — +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: gap qaysi qoida yoki ma'lumot turi haqida ekanini o'zbekcha aytish (masalan: 'ta'rif', 'NB qoidasi').
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The first paragraph contains a definition of speed reading.
Answers to matching information questions can be anywhere in the text.
You may use any letter more than once.
Some paragraphs may not be used at all.
Check what type of information each question asks for.
Some adults think that graphic novels are a bad influence.
Graphic novels tell a story through a series of pictures.
Why do some students find it hard to read quickly?
This paragraph explains where the word 'library' comes from.
Spaced repetition is more effective than studying all night.

25.title: Quiz Board: Which paragraph?
25.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
25.goal: Matching information qoidalari, paraphrase, o'qish mavzusidagi so'zlar va og'zaki javoblarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
Paraphrase va 'Say it!' javoblarida kalitdagi misoldan farqli, lekin to'g'ri variantlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What is the task instruction for this question type?
qs.a: Which paragraph contains the following information?

qs.q: Are the answers in the same order as the text?
qs.a: No — they can be anywhere in the text.

qs.q: What does 'NB You may use any letter more than once' mean?
qs.a: One paragraph can answer two or more questions.

qs.q: Headings or matching information: which one asks about ONE small detail?
Why is it smart to do this task after the other tasks on the same text?
qs.a: You already know the text, so you find details faster.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'hardly ever'
Paraphrase: 'a huge amount of information'
qs.a: a large volume / a great deal of information

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'get mixed up'
Say it in two words: 'people who do not want to read'
Paraphrase: 'The design has hardly changed for a century.'
qs.a: e.g. It has stayed almost the same for 100 years.

qs.q: A place where you can borrow books for free.
A person who writes books.
To read a text quickly to get the general idea.
The ability to read and write.
A book-length story told in comic-style pictures.
Name 3 things people read every day.
qs.a: e.g. messages, the news, road signs

qs.q: Give one reason why reading helps you in IELTS.
qs.a: e.g. It builds vocabulary and reading speed.

qs.q: Define 'speed reading' in one sentence.
qs.a: e.g. Reading fast while still understanding and remembering.

qs.q: Compare paper books and e-books in one sentence.
qs.a: e.g. E-books are lighter, but paper books are easier on the eyes.

qs.q: Explain the difference between skimming and scanning.
qs.a: Skim = general idea; scan = find one detail (name, number).

26.title: Grammar Auction: reporting opinions on tourism
26.stage: Paraphrase mashqidan keyin, 1-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
26.goal: Sayohat va turizm mavzusida odamlar fikrini yetkazuvchi gaplardagi tipik xatolarni (suggest + V-ing, explain to, according to, the number of … has, trip/travel) topish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering. Boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi? Fikr bildiruvchi fe'llar (suggest, explain, admit) va moslashuvga alohida e'tibor bering.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'suggested to book' → 'suggested booking').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: Dr Karimova argues that cheap flights have changed the way people travel.
items.why: argue that + to'liq gap; flights — ko'plik: have changed.

items.s: The travel agent suggested to book the tour three months in advance.
items.fix: The travel agent suggested booking the tour three months in advance.
items.why: suggest + V-ing yoki suggest that …; 'suggest to + V1' xato.

items.s: Local people claim that tourism has made housing more expensive.
items.why: claim that + gap; tourism — birlik: has made.

items.s: The number of tourists visiting Samarkand have risen steadily in recent years.
items.fix: The number of tourists visiting Samarkand has risen steadily in recent years.
items.why: 'The number of …' — birlik: has risen ('A number of …' — ko'plik).

items.s: Some experts warn that too many visitors can damage fragile places.
items.why: warn that + gap; can + V1 — to'g'ri.

items.s: The guide explained us why the old city is on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
items.fix: The guide explained to us why the old city is on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
items.why: explain + to + kishi ('explain us' emas).

items.s: The hotel manager admitted that prices had risen sharply.
items.why: admit that + gap; o'tgan zamonda 'had risen' — to'g'ri.

items.s: My last travel to Bukhara was the best holiday of my life.
items.fix: My last trip to Bukhara was the best holiday of my life.
items.why: travel — sanalmaydigan ot; bitta safar: a trip / a journey.

items.s: Many travellers now prefer staying with local families to staying in hotels.
items.why: prefer + V-ing + to + V-ing — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: According to his opinion, eco-tourism is the future of the industry.
items.fix: In his opinion, eco-tourism is the future of the industry.
items.why: 'According to' + opinion xato: 'In his opinion' yoki 'According to him' deyiladi.

items.s: She recommended that we visit the mountains in spring.
items.why: recommend that + we + V1 (visit) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Tourists should respect local traditions and don't take photos of people without asking.
items.fix: Tourists should respect local traditions and not take photos of people without asking.
items.why: should … and not + V1 ('don't' emas).

26.title: Board Game: Who said what?
26.stage: Tahlil bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
26.goal: Matching people strategiyasi (ismlar xaritasi, fikr kimniki, NB qoidasi), fikr bildiruvchi fe'llar, summary completion, paraphrase va sayohat mavzusida gapirishni takrorlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki fikr kimniki ekanini aytadi.
Guruh javob kalitiga qarab tekshiradi (kalit guruh sardorida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Speaking' kataklarida kamida 2 gap va bitta sabab aytilishi shart; paraphrase kataklarida kalitdagidan boshqa to'g'ri variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi. FINISH ga birinchi yetgan yoki vaqt tugaganda eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Step 1: what do you do with the names in the text?
squares.a: Scan the text and circle every name (about 1 minute).

squares.t: Say 3 verbs that introduce someone's opinion.
squares.a: e.g. says, argues, believes, claims, warns

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'tourists'
squares.a: visitors / travellers / holidaymakers

squares.t: Speaking: Where did you go on your last holiday?
squares.a: e.g. I went to Chimgan with my family last summer.

squares.t: Are the statements in the same order as the text?
squares.a: No — matching people is NOT in text order.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'dangers'
squares.a: risks / threats / hazards

squares.t: Can one person be the answer to two statements?
squares.a: Yes, if the task says 'NB You may use any letter more than once.'

squares.t: Whose idea? Nodir: 'A famous blogger went to Khiva, so now everyone wants to go.'
squares.a: Nodir's — the blogger is only mentioned; he gives no view.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'visit a place for a second time'
squares.a: return / go back / make a repeat visit

squares.t: Speaking: What do tourists usually buy in your city?
squares.a: e.g. They buy ceramics, silk scarves and dried fruit.

squares.t: What do you write next to each name you circle?
squares.a: 2–3 words about their opinion, e.g. 'too expensive', 'good for jobs'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the effects of climate change'
squares.a: the impact of global warming

squares.t: A fact in the text has no name and no 'says'. Whose is it?
squares.a: The author's — don't match it to any person in the list.

squares.t: Speaking: Give one advantage of tourism for local people.
squares.a: e.g. It creates jobs and brings money to small towns.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'there is no evidence'
squares.a: no studies confirm it / nothing proves it

squares.t: Which verb means 'say something is true, maybe without proof'?
squares.a: claim

squares.t: Summary completion: what do you check around the gap?
squares.a: Grammar — e.g. after 'a' you need a singular noun.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'you should not delay'
squares.a: e.g. do it now / go as soon as possible / don't wait

squares.t: Which verb means 'agree that something is true, often unwillingly'?
squares.a: admit / acknowledge

squares.t: Speaking: Give one disadvantage of mass tourism.
squares.a: e.g. Crowds damage old buildings and prices rise for locals.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Holidays abroad are too expensive for most families.'
squares.a: e.g. Most families cannot afford to travel to other countries.

squares.t: Why is it risky to choose a person just because you see a key word?
squares.a: The idea near the name may be different, or belong to someone else.

squares.t: Speaking: Would you like to visit the Arctic? Why or why not?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — I'd love to see the ice before it melts.

squares.t: Speaking: How will tourism in Uzbekistan change in 10 years?
squares.a: e.g. It will probably grow because more airlines fly here now.

26.title: Dominoes: statement = speaker's words
26.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida — 'Kim nima dedi?' mashqidan keyin (12 daqiqa)
26.goal: Matching people ko'nikmasi: savoldagi fikr (statement) va odamning o'z so'zlari o'rtasidagi paraphraseni tanish; sayohat va turizm haqidagi fikrlar.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
Toshning bir tomonida — test gapi (statement), ikkinchi tomonida — odamning o'z so'zlari (qo'shtirnoq ichida).
START toshidagi gap qaysi toshdagi odam so'zlari bilan bir xil fikrni bildiradi — toping va ulang. Aynan bir xil so'z kutmang: FIKR bir xil bo'lishi kerak.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi; xato bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Bonus +1: har juftlikda paraphrase bo'lgan so'zlarni ko'rsatish (cheaper = cost half).

pairs: Travel is now cheaper than ever.
"Flights cost half what they did ten years ago."
Visitors should learn about local customs first.
"Read about the culture before you arrive."
Tourism can harm the natural environment.
"Coral near the beach is dying because of the boats."
"My son now works as a guide every summer."
"Our rent has doubled since the hotels opened."
Some trips are only for rich people.
"Few ordinary families can afford a cruise."
Many travellers return to the same place.
"A quarter of our guests come back a second time."
Solo travel is becoming more popular.
"More and more people now go on holiday alone."
"The old square is too full to enjoy these days."
Travelling teaches young people about the world.
"My trip abroad taught me more than school did."
Online reviews influence where people stay.
"I never book a hotel without reading the ratings."
Winter holidays are growing in popularity.
"Our ski resort is fully booked every January now."
"Visitors push into queues and shout at waiters."
Food is the main reason some people travel.
"I choose my holidays by the dishes I want to try."

26.title: Taboo: travel and tourism
26.stage: Kirish qismida, o'tgan dars takroridan keyin sayohat mavzusiga kirish uchun (10 daqiqa)
26.goal: Sayohat, turizm va jamiyat mavzusidagi so'zlarni (accommodation, destination, souvenir, remote…) inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi yoki uning qismi (masalan, 'tour guide' dagi 'tour') va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va so'zni harflab aytish mumkin emas; imo-ishora mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Qo'shimcha: har jamoa 2 so'z bilan o'z safari haqida bitta gap aytadi.

26.title: Find someone who… has been to Khiva
26.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli tanaffus — 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin (10 daqiqa)
26.goal: Sayohat tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever …?, Do you …?, Would you like …?) va javobni keyin 'X says that …' bilan boshqalarga yetkazish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering; hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever been to Khiva?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Who with? Did you enjoy it?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; faqat inglizcha gapiriladi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani fikr fe'li bilan aytadi (Laylo says that she has been to Khiva twice).

items.t: …has been to Khiva.
items.q: Have you ever been to Khiva?

items.t: …has travelled abroad more than twice.
items.q: Have you travelled abroad more than twice?

items.t: …has flown on a plane alone.
items.q: Have you ever flown on a plane alone?

items.t: …would like to visit the Arctic or Antarctica.
items.q: Would you like to visit the Arctic or Antarctica?

items.t: …reads online reviews before booking a hotel.
items.q: Do you read online reviews before booking a hotel?

items.t: …has stayed with a local family on holiday.
items.q: Have you ever stayed with a local family on holiday?

items.t: …collects souvenirs from every trip.
items.q: Do you collect souvenirs from every trip?

items.t: …has shown a foreign tourist around their town.
items.q: Have you ever shown a foreign tourist around your town?

items.t: …thinks tourism is good for their city.
items.q: Do you think tourism is good for your city?

items.t: …has been on a train for more than ten hours.
items.q: Have you ever been on a train for more than ten hours?

items.t: …is planning a trip for next summer.
items.q: Are you planning a trip for next summer?

items.t: …prefers the mountains to the seaside.
items.q: Do you prefer the mountains to the seaside?

26.title: Speaking cards: travel, tourism and society
26.stage: Listening bosqichi o'rniga (bu darsda audio yo'q) yoki dars oxirida (12 daqiqa)
26.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida sayohat va turizm haqida javob berish hamda sherigining fikrini fikr fe'llari bilan qayta aytish (argues / believes / warns that …).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying; guruhdagi birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Ikkinchi o'quvchi javob beradi: Part 1 — 2–3 gap, Part 3 — 4–5 gap (fikr + sabab + misol).
Uchinchi o'quvchi javobni fikr fe'li bilan qayta aytadi: 'Malika argues that … / believes that …' — xuddi matching people matnidagi kabi.
To'liq javob +1 ball, to'g'ri qayta aytish +1 ball. Rollar aylanadi; 12 daqiqadan keyin ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Part 1: Do you like travelling? Why or why not?
Part 1: Where did you go on your last holiday, and who did you go with?
Part 1: Do you prefer travelling alone or with other people?
Part 1: What do tourists usually do when they visit your city?
Part 1: Is there a place in Uzbekistan you would love to visit? Why?
Part 1: Do you plan your trips carefully or decide at the last minute?
Part 3: What are the main benefits of tourism for a country like Uzbekistan?
Part 3: How can tourism damage the environment or local traditions?
Part 3: Should the number of visitors to famous historic sites be limited? Why?
Part 3: Why do some people want to visit remote and dangerous places?
Part 3: Do online reviews make it easier or harder to choose a holiday?
Part 3: How has cheap air travel changed the way people spend their holidays?
Part 3: Some people say travel is the best education. Do you agree?
Part 3: Is it fair for foreign tourists to pay more than locals for museum tickets?

26.title: Sentence Race: reporting people's opinions
26.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (8 daqiqa)
26.goal: Odam fikrini yetkazuvchi gaplarni (X argues that …, According to …, In his view …) va matching people qoidalarini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralash so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri; vergulli so'zdan keyin gap davom etadi.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. To'g'ri — +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: gapdagi fikr kimniki ekanini va qaysi so'z buni ko'rsatishini aytish (argues, admitted, according to…).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Dr Karimova argues that tourism creates thousands of new jobs.
According to the guide, most visitors come back a second time.
The same person may be the answer to two questions.
She warned that the ice was melting faster than expected.
The manager admitted that ticket prices had doubled since May.
In her opinion, solo travel builds confidence.
In his view, cheap flights are good for young travellers.
Always check who is speaking before you choose a letter.
Most speakers are quoted in one part of the text.

26.title: Quiz Board: Who says it?
26.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); qolgan o'yinlar — takror uchun
26.goal: Matching people qoidalari, fikr bildiruvchi fe'llar, sayohat mavzusidagi paraphrase va og'zaki javoblarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 100–500 ball. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Reporting verbs 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida — 30 soniya).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
Paraphrase va 'Say it!' javoblarida kalitdagi misoldan farqli, lekin to'g'ri variantlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: In this task, do you write a number or a letter for each statement?
qs.a: A letter — the person (A, B, C…).

qs.q: What is the FIRST step with this question type?
qs.a: Scan the text and circle all the names.

qs.q: Can one person be used twice? Can a person be used zero times?
qs.a: Yes, if there is an NB; and yes — some people may not be used.

qs.q: A speaker mentions a famous person in his quote. Whose opinion is it?
qs.a: The speaker's — the famous person is only mentioned.

qs.q: Why is it a trap to choose a person just because a key word appears near the name?
qs.a: The idea may differ — match the whole meaning, not one word.

qs.q: Which verb: tell someone about a possible danger?
Which verb: say something is true, maybe without proof?
Which verb: agree that something is true, often unwillingly?
Which verb: give reasons to support your opinion?
Which verb: put forward an idea or plan for others to consider?
Paraphrase: 'tourists'
Paraphrase: 'not safe'
Paraphrase: 'visit again'
Paraphrase: 'Visitor numbers fell by a fifth.'
qs.a: e.g. There was a 20% drop in visitors.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'There's no proof that this is true.'
qs.a: e.g. No evidence supports it. / Nothing confirms it.

qs.q: Name 3 things you pack for a holiday.
qs.a: e.g. a passport, a charger, sunglasses

qs.q: Use 'argues that' to report a friend's view on cheap flights.
qs.a: e.g. Ali argues that cheap flights help students travel.

qs.q: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of tourism.
qs.a: e.g. It creates jobs, but it can push prices up.

qs.q: Recommend a place in Uzbekistan to a tourist and give a reason.
qs.a: e.g. I'd recommend Khiva — the old town is like a museum.

qs.q: Explain the difference between 'claim' and 'admit'.
qs.a: claim = say it's true (maybe no proof); admit = agree unwillingly

27.title: Language Auction: tutor feedback & process language
27.stage: Barcha tinglashlar tekshirilgach, 'Tahlil' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Part 3 mavzusidagi gaplarda (taqdimot, o'qituvchi izohi, jarayon tasviri) Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: jarayon passivi (is pumped), suggest + V-ing, discuss (predlogsiz), a/an, is/are, difficult to + V1.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart: passiv (is + V3), suggest + V-ing, discuss (predlogsiz), a/an, is/are yoki difficult to + V1.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: First, sea water is collected and sent to the plant.
items.why: Jarayon tasviri — passiv: is collected and sent.

items.s: After that, the water is pump through a special membrane.
items.fix: After that, the water is pumped through a special membrane.
items.why: Passivda fe'lning 3-shakli: is pumped (is pump emas).

items.s: The tutor thinks the description of the process needs to be shorter.
items.why: needs to be + sifat (shorter) — to'g'ri; the process — aniq artikl.

items.s: In my presentation I will discuss about the pros and cons of desalination.
items.fix: In my presentation I will discuss the pros and cons of desalination.
items.why: discuss — predlogsiz fe'l: discuss something (discuss about emas).

items.s: The ideas in this section are difficult to following.
items.fix: The ideas in this section are difficult to follow.
items.why: difficult to + V1 (infinitive): difficult to follow.

items.s: The tutor advised him to reorganise the historical background.
items.why: advise + kishi + to + V1: advised him to reorganise.

items.s: Brine is very salty substance that usually goes back into the sea.
items.fix: Brine is a very salty substance that usually goes back into the sea.
items.why: Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot oldidan 'a' kerak: a very salty substance.

items.s: Once the ice particles become heavy enough, they fall from the sky.
items.why: Once — '…gach, …bilanoq'; enough sifatdan keyin keladi: heavy enough.

items.s: The whole process are very expensive because of the high pressure.
items.fix: The whole process is very expensive because of the high pressure.
items.why: Ega birlikda (the whole process) — fe'l ham birlikda: is.

items.s: In the final stage, the clean pulp is dried with heat.
items.why: Passiv (is dried) + bosqich iborasi: In the final stage.

items.s: The tutor suggested to add a short list of reasons to the conclusion.
items.fix: The tutor suggested adding a short list of reasons to the conclusion.
items.why: suggest + V-ing: suggested adding (suggest to do emas).

items.s: Finally, the fresh water is stored in large tanks.
items.why: Passiv: is stored (is + V3); Finally — oxirgi bosqichni bildiradi.

27.title: Board Game: Part 3 — matching & flow charts
27.stage: Listening (Track 21–22) tekshirilgandan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Part 3 strategiyasi (NB — harf takrorlanadi, o'qituvchi fikri, flow chart tartibi, so'z chegarasi), paraphrase va jarayonni first / then / finally hamda passiv bilan og'zaki tasvirlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase beradi, gapni tuzatadi yoki 20 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Listening Part 3: how many speakers are there, and what do they talk about?
squares.a: Usually 2–3 (up to 4); an academic topic: a project, presentation or research.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'It needs to be shorter.'
squares.a: e.g. You should cut it down. / It goes on too long.

squares.t: Put in order (desalination): use / collection / salt removal / treatment
squares.a: collection → treatment → salt removal → use

squares.t: 'NB You may use any letter more than once.' What does it mean?
squares.a: One letter can answer several questions, so don't cross it out after using it.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'difficult to follow'
squares.a: e.g. confusing / unclear / hard to understand

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: have you ever given a presentation? How did it go?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, last year I gave a talk about… I was nervous at first, but…

squares.t: Correct: The water is pump into the plant.
squares.a: The water is pumped into the plant.

squares.t: Student: 'Too long?' Tutor: 'No, the order is the problem.' Tutor's comment?
squares.a: The ideas are difficult to follow (not 'too long').

squares.t: Give 3 sequencing words for describing a process.
squares.a: e.g. first, next, after that, then, finally, once

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Some information should be added.'
squares.a: e.g. You need to include more details. / Say more about…

squares.t: Flow chart gap: 'a very ___ process'. What kind of word do you need?
squares.a: An adjective, e.g. expensive / slow / complicated.

squares.t: Describe making tea in 3 steps with first / then / finally.
squares.a: e.g. First, boil some water. Then pour it over the tea. Finally, wait 3 minutes.

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Is 'the salty brine' OK?
squares.a: No — it is three words. Write 'brine' or 'salty brine'.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: which is harder for you, giving a talk or writing an essay?
squares.a: e.g. Giving a talk, because I get nervous in front of people.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'This is the really expensive part.'
squares.a: e.g. This stage costs a lot of money. / This step is very costly.

squares.t: Why is the student's own idea often a trap in Part 3 matching?
squares.a: The question asks for the TUTOR's view; the tutor often disagrees or corrects it.

squares.t: Make it passive: 'The plant removes the salt from the water.'
squares.a: The salt is removed from the water (by the plant).

squares.t: Flow chart: does the audio follow the order of the chart?
squares.a: Yes — the stages come in the same order as in the audio.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'removes the salt from sea water'
squares.a: e.g. takes the salt out of sea water / separates salt from sea water

squares.t: Say one advantage and one disadvantage of desalination.
squares.a: e.g. It gives dry countries fresh water, but it is costly and brine harms sea life.

squares.t: Correct: The tutor suggested to cut the conclusion.
squares.a: The tutor suggested cutting the conclusion.

squares.t: A stage name (e.g. 'Collection') is printed in the chart. Can it be an answer?
squares.a: No — words in the chart are anchors; the answer is the missing detail.

squares.t: Speaking Part 3: Should students give presentations alone or in groups? Why?
squares.a: e.g. In groups, because they can share the work and learn from each other.

squares.t: Explain how plov is cooked in 4 stages, using the passive.
squares.a: e.g. First, the meat is fried. Then carrots are added. Next, rice is put in…

27.title: Dominoes: question words and audio paraphrases
27.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida, barcha tinglashlar tekshirilgach — paraphrase takrori (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
27.goal: Savol varag'idagi ibora (A It needs to be shorter; a very expensive process; can harm marine life) va audiodagi paraphrase'ni tez tanish — Part 3 matching va flow chartning asosiy ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.

START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi SAVOL iborasi (masalan, 'It needs to be shorter.') chap tomonida uning AUDIODAGI paraphrase'i yozilgan toshga ulanadi ('You should cut it down a bit.').
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har juftda qaysi so'z nimaga almashganini aytadi (shorter = cut it down); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: You should cut it down a bit.
The ideas are difficult to follow.
I got lost — the order is confusing.
You could include a few more details.
That part has nothing to do with your topic.
The information may not be correct.
I'm not sure that fact is accurate.
a stage that costs a huge amount of money
It's bad for fish and other sea creatures.
It is used to irrigate farmland.
Farmers use it to water their fields.
The water is pumped under high pressure.
Powerful machines push the water through.
When water turns to ice, it gives off warmth.
The clouds don't disappear so quickly.
The paper is sorted by type.
Different kinds of paper are separated.

27.title: Taboo: presentations and processes

27.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida taqdimotlar, o'qituvchi izohi, jarayonlar va suv tanqisligi haqida kengaytirilgan javob berish.

Tinglovchi javobdagi mavzu so'zlari (presentation, feedback, stage, process, desalination…) va bog'lovchilarni (first, then, however) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many speakers usually talk in Listening Part 3?

qs.q: What does 'NB You may use any letter more than once' mean?
