28.title: Language Auction: water, weather and technology
28.stage: 'Paraphrase mashqi'dan keyin, 1-qo'shimcha readingdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Suv, ob-havo va texnologiya mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: predlog (access to), so'z shakli (controversial), the number of + is, sanalmaydigan ot (water), do damage, children.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart: predlog, so'z shakli, moslashuv (is/are), sanalmaydigan ot, birikma (do/make) yoki ko'plik shakli.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Clean water close to home can transform the lives of whole communities.
items.why: transform the lives of — to'g'ri birikma; whole communities — ko'plik.

items.s: Millions of people in dry regions have no access for clean water.
items.fix: Millions of people in dry regions have no access to clean water.
items.why: access bilan 'to' predlogi ishlatiladi: access to something.

items.s: Polluted water causes many diseases, especially among childrens.
items.fix: Polluted water causes many diseases, especially among children.
items.why: children — o'zi ko'plik shakli (child → children), unga -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: It is hard to tell how effective cloud seeding really is.
items.why: Egri so'roq: how effective + ega + fe'l (… cloud seeding really is).

items.s: Cloud seeding is a controversy method of making rain.
items.fix: Cloud seeding is a controversial method of making rain.
items.why: Ot oldida sifat kerak: controversial (controversy — ot).

items.s: The drought has lasted for three years, so the river carries less water.
items.why: has lasted for + davr (Present Perfect); less + sanalmaydigan ot.

items.s: The number of weather projects are growing every year.
items.fix: The number of weather projects is growing every year.
items.why: The number of … — birlik: is growing (a number of … — ko'plik).

items.s: Vertical farms can produce vegetables all year round, regardless of the weather.
items.why: all year round — butun yil davomida; regardless of + ot.

items.s: Vertical farms use much less waters than traditional fields.
items.fix: Vertical farms use much less water than traditional fields.
items.why: water — sanalmaydigan ot: -s olmaydi (much less water).

items.s: About half of the new wells break down within a few years.
items.why: About half of the + ko'plik ot → ko'plik fe'l: break down.

items.s: Drought makes serious damage to crops every year.
items.fix: Drought does serious damage to crops every year.
items.why: damage bilan 'do' ishlatiladi: do damage (make damage emas).

items.s: Collecting rainwater is a cheap way to water crops.
items.why: Gerund ega (Collecting…) — birlik fe'l: is; a cheap way to + V1.

28.title: Board Game: Passage 2 — three question types
28.stage: 1-qo'shimcha reading tekshirilgandan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
28.goal: Passage 2 dagi 3 savol turi strategiyasi (headings — asosiy g'oya, sentence completion — tartib va so'z chegarasi, pick from a list — kim qilgani), paraphrase va suv / ob-havo mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase beradi, sarlavha o'ylab topadi yoki 20 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Which question type should you do first in a mixed Passage 2, and why?
squares.a: Matching headings — it gives you a map of the whole text.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'die each year'
squares.a: e.g. are killed annually / lose their lives every year

squares.t: Headings: do you look for the main idea or a small detail?
squares.a: The main idea of the whole paragraph.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how do people in your town get their water?
squares.a: e.g. Most people have taps at home, but in some villages people use wells.

squares.t: Sentence completion: are the answers in the same order as the text?
squares.a: Yes — always in text order.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'falling water levels'
squares.a: e.g. there is less water in the river / the level is dropping

squares.t: Instruction: ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER. Is '3.3 million' OK?
squares.a: Yes — it is a number, so it is allowed.

squares.t: Where in a paragraph is the main idea usually found?
squares.a: Often in the first sentence (sometimes in the last).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'capture rainwater'
squares.a: e.g. collect rain / catch and store rainwater

squares.t: Pick from a list (choose TWO letters): how many marks can you get?
squares.a: Two — one mark for each correct letter.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: should rich countries help dry regions build wells?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because clean water saves lives and lets children stay at school.

squares.t: The list has 8 headings for 6 paragraphs. What does that tell you?
squares.a: Two headings are extra — they will not be used.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'specialist knowledge'
squares.a: e.g. expertise / expert skills

squares.t: Pick from a list: the text says OTHER people did it. Can you choose it?
squares.a: No — check WHO did it; actions by other people are a trap.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a possible success'
squares.a: e.g. if all goes well / it might work

squares.t: Say one advantage and one problem of bottled water.
squares.a: e.g. It is safe and easy to carry, but the plastic bottles create a lot of waste.

squares.t: You have 20 minutes for Passage 2. How do you split the time?
squares.a: e.g. headings 7, sentence completion 8, pick from a list 3, checking 2 (minutes)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'unsure if it is effective'
squares.a: e.g. hard to tell whether it works

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: would cloud seeding be useful in Uzbekistan? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Maybe — farmers need rain in hot summers, but scientists must check it works.

squares.t: You can't find a sentence completion answer. What should you do?
squares.a: Move on, come back later and guess — never leave it blank.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'winners and losers'
squares.a: e.g. some areas get more rain, while others get less

squares.t: Why must you read the word limit again in every section?
squares.a: Each section can have a different limit: ONE WORD is not TWO WORDS.

squares.t: Speaking Part 3: Is technology the answer to water shortages? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — it helps, but people must also stop wasting water.

squares.t: Give a heading (max 6 words) for a paragraph about weather apps on phones.
squares.a: e.g. Weather forecasts in your pocket

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Topic words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.

Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

29.title: Grammar Auction: writing about buildings and cities
29.stage: Tahlil bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (15 daqiqa; vaqt kam bo'lsa 8 gap). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
29.goal: Arxitektura va shahar mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodlarning tipik xatolarini topish: consist of, despite ('of'siz), sanalmaydigan architecture, controversial (sifat), maqsad: to + fe'l, thousands of + ko'plik, complain about.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: gaplar bugungi matnlar mavzusida — binolar, arxitektorlar va shahar; har xato gapda faqat BITTA xato bor.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan, 'is consist of' → 'consists of'); ustoz izohni (why) o'qib beradi.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

items.s: Hardly anyone realised how important the new building would become.
items.why: hardly anyone — inkor ma'nosi; 'would become' — o'tmishdan qaraganda kelajak.

items.s: The museum is consist of three separate glass buildings.
items.fix: The museum consists of three separate glass buildings.
items.why: consist of — fe'l: 'consists of'; oldiga 'is' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: The new bridge was finally completed two years behind schedule.
items.why: behind schedule — rejadan kechikib; to'g'ri ibora.

items.s: Tashkent has a lot of interesting modern architectures.
items.fix: Tashkent has a lot of interesting modern architecture.
items.why: architecture (uslub, binolar umuman) — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: Some residents still regard the tower as an eyesore.
items.why: regard + narsa + AS + ot — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: The council approved the plan despite of strong public protests.
items.fix: The council approved the plan despite strong public protests.
items.why: despite + ot ('of'siz); 'in spite of' deyish mumkin.

items.s: At first the design was very controversy.
items.fix: At first the design was very controversial.
items.why: be + very + SIFAT: controversial; 'controversy' — ot.

items.s: Concrete was popular because it was cheap, strong and easy to shape.
items.why: easy to + fe'l; sifatlar ro'yxati to'g'ri.

items.s: The old market was knocked down for build a shopping centre.
items.fix: The old market was knocked down to build a shopping centre.
items.why: Maqsad: to + fe'l; 'for + fe'l' ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: Architects spent years trying to find a solution to the roof problem.
items.why: spend time + -ing; a solution TO a problem.

items.s: Every year thousands of tourist come to see the Registan.
items.fix: Every year thousands of tourists come to see the Registan.
items.why: thousands of + KO'PLIK ot: tourists.

items.s: Many residents complained the noise from the building site.
items.fix: Many residents complained about the noise from the building site.
items.why: complain ABOUT something — predlog tushib qolgan.

29.title: Board Game: Passage 3 strategies and unknown words
29.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin — savol turlari va skillni mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida takror
29.goal: Passage 3 savol turlari (MCQ, sentence endings, Y/N/NG) qoidalari, notanish so'zning turini va ma'nosini kontekstdan topish, paraphrase va arxitektura mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
Notanish so'z kataklarida (glimp, zork kabi to'qima so'zlar) o'yinchi so'z turini VA qaysi iz yordam berganini aytadi (qo'shimcha, oldidagi so'z, gapdagi o'rni).
Guruh javobni ustozning kalit varag'i bilan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

squares.t: Name the three question types in today's Passage 3.
squares.a: Multiple choice, matching sentence endings, Yes/No/Not Given.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'knocked down'
squares.a: demolished / pulled down

squares.t: Word class? 'The new bridge is very glimp.'
squares.a: Adjective — it comes after 'is very'.

squares.t: Speak 20 seconds: your favourite building in your city.
squares.a: e.g. I love the Tashkent TV Tower because it is so tall and modern.

squares.t: An MCQ says 'in the third paragraph'. Where do you look?
squares.a: Only in the third paragraph.

squares.t: Word class? 'They plan to glimp the old tower.'
squares.a: Verb — it comes after 'to' and has an object.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'behind schedule'
squares.a: late / delayed

squares.t: Word class? 'The zorks of the old city were narrow.'
squares.a: Noun — after 'the', plural -s, subject of 'were'.

squares.t: You meet an unknown word. What do you ask first?
squares.a: Do I need it to answer the question? Often not — skip it.

squares.t: Endings: 'The new towers …' A) was ugly  B) were ugly. Which?
squares.a: B — 'towers' is plural.

squares.t: Guess: 'The plan was scrapped, so the tower was never built.' scrapped = ?
squares.a: cancelled / abandoned

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'an ugly building that spoils the view'
squares.a: an eyesore

squares.t: Speak 20 seconds: should old buildings be protected or replaced?
squares.a: e.g. I think historic buildings should be protected because they show our history.

squares.t: Which type tests the writer's views: Y/N/NG or T/F/NG?
squares.a: Yes / No / Not Given.

squares.t: Guess: 'Unlike the ornate palace, the new hall is plain.' ornate = ?
squares.a: richly decorated — 'unlike' shows it is the opposite of plain.

squares.t: Opinion clue? 'Sadly, the old theatre was demolished.'
squares.a: 'Sadly' — it shows the writer's feeling (regret).

squares.t: Correct: 'The critics was wrong about the tower.'
squares.a: The critics were wrong about the tower.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'extremely popular with visitors'
squares.a: a huge hit with visitors / it attracted huge numbers of visitors

squares.t: A paragraph lists three problems with a building. Its main purpose?
squares.a: To criticise the building / to show its weaknesses.

squares.t: Why should you do the MCQs before the Y/N/NG questions?
squares.a: MCQs name the paragraphs and usually cover the first part, so they guide your reading.

squares.t: Text: 'In my view, the tower is ugly.' Claim: the writer finds it beautiful. Y/N/NG?
squares.a: NO — the writer says the opposite.

squares.t: Guess: 'The flat was spacious, but the furniture made it feel small.' spacious = ?
squares.a: large, roomy — 'but' shows a contrast with 'small'.

squares.t: Speak 30 seconds: modern or traditional houses — which do you prefer? Why?
squares.a: e.g. I prefer traditional houses with a courtyard because they feel calm.

squares.t: Explain the difference between NO and NOT GIVEN.
squares.a: NO = the writer says the opposite; NOT GIVEN = the writer says nothing about it.

29.title: Dominoes: matching sentence endings (buildings and cities)
29.stage: Savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin — sentence endings uchun grammatika + ma'no filtri (12 daqiqa)
29.goal: Matching sentence endings strategiyasi: gap boshi va oxirini avval GRAMMATIKA (so … that, regard … as, insist on + -ing, promise to, consist of, turn into), keyin MA'NO bo'yicha ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshiga qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi oxir mos kelishini toping.
Avval grammatik filtr: gap boshining oxirgi so'ziga qarang (so … → that; regard … → as; insisted on → -ing; promised → to + fe'l). Keyin ma'noni tekshiring.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va 2–3 ulanishda qaysi grammatik iz yordam berganini aytadi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.

that it opened five years late.

as an eyesore that spoils the skyline.
The old cinema is going to be turned
of three madrasahs around a square.
Traditional houses often have thick walls,
which keep the rooms cool in summer.
The new stadium holds far more fans
When you meet an unknown word, first decide
whether you need it to answer.
by opening museums and cafés there.
it quickly paid for itself through tourism.
Before you choose a sentence ending,
check that its grammar fits the beginning.

29.title: Taboo: architecture and the city
29.stage: Kirish bosqichida isinish (5 daqiqada 6–8 karta) yoki keyingi dars boshida lug'at takrori — to'liq o'yin 10 daqiqa
29.goal: Arxitektura va shahar so'zlarini (skyscraper, façade, landmark, eyesore, demolish, heritage…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — kontekstdan ma'no topish ko'nikmasining teskarisi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Maslahat: so'z turini aytish mumkin ('It's a verb…', 'It's a place…') va misol gap ('The Registan is a famous …').
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

29.title: Find someone who… has visited the Registan
29.stage: 1-qo'shimcha readingdan keyin harakatli tanaffus sifatida (10 daqiqa)
29.goal: Binolar va shahar mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Would you…? / Can you…?) va javobni qo'shimcha savol bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever visited the Registan in Samarkand?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? What was it like? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin; savol xato tuzilsa — ismni yozish mumkin emas.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has visited the Registan in Samarkand.
items.q: Have you ever visited the Registan in Samarkand?

items.q: Have you posted a photo of a building online this month?

items.q: Would you prefer a traditional house with a courtyard to a flat?

29.title: Speaking cards: buildings, cities and taste
29.stage: Listening bosqichidan keyin — mavzu bo'yicha gapirish (Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi, 12 daqiqa)
29.goal: Binolar, arxitektura va shahar haqida Part 1 (qisqa, shaxsiy) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol) javoblari; bugungi so'zlarni (landmark, eyesore, heritage, demolish) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: shaxsiy savolga 2–3 gap, umumiy (Part 3) savolga fikr + sabab + misol, kamida 4 gap.
Tinglovchi bugungi mavzu so'zlarini sanaydi (landmark, eyesore, demolish, heritage, façade…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you live in a house or a flat? What do you like most about it?
What is the most famous building in your city? Have you ever been inside it?
Do you prefer old buildings or modern ones? Why?
Is there a building in your town that you think is an eyesore? Why?
Would you like to be an architect? Why or why not?
What makes a building beautiful, in your opinion?

29.title: Sentence Race: Passage 3 strategies and opinions
29.stage: Xulosa va vazifa bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
29.goal: Passage 3 strategiyalari (MCQ tartibi, sentence endings, notanish so'z) va muallif fikrini bildiruvchi gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; gapdagi maslahatni o'zbekcha qisqa izohlasa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Multiple-choice questions follow the order of the passage.
If a question names a paragraph, look for the answer there.
Use the words around an unknown word to guess its meaning.
The list contains more endings than you need.
The writer believes that the library was a great success.
Many residents regard the tower as an eyesore.
Its popularity forced the critics to change their minds.
NOT GIVEN means the writer does not mention the idea.
In my view, the bold design has stood the test of time.

29.title: Quiz Board: Passage 3, unknown words and architecture
29.stage: Skill (unknown words) bosqichidan keyin yoki dars oxirida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa)
29.goal: Savol turi qoidalari, paraphrase, notanish so'z turini va ma'nosini topish hamda arxitektura mavzusida gapirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Unknown words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it!' bo'limida bir o'quvchi 30 soniya gapiradi).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which question type asks for the writer's opinion: Y/N/NG or T/F/NG?
An MCQ says 'in the second paragraph'. Where should you look?
Sentence endings: what do you check first — grammar or meaning?
'Main purpose' question: do you choose one detail or the job of the paragraph?
qs.a: The job (function) of the whole paragraph

qs.q: Text: 'Luckily, the plan was rejected.' Statement: The writer regrets the decision. Y/N/NG?
qs.a: NO — 'Luckily' shows the writer is glad

qs.q: 'a famous building that everyone recognises' = one word?
'repair an old building and make it modern' = one verb?
'the front wall of a building' = one word?
Paraphrase: 'had a huge influence on'
qs.a: had a great impact on / strongly affected

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'the building still looks the same as when it opened'
qs.a: it has hardly changed / it has not changed

qs.q: 'She answered glimply.' Word class of 'glimply'?
'We saw three blords near the square.' Word class of 'blords'?
Which ending usually shows a noun: -ful, -tion or -ive?
'The tower was not demolished; it was restored to its former glory.' restored = ?
qs.a: repaired / returned to its original condition

qs.q: 'The courtyard was so secluded that no street noise could reach it.' secluded = ?
qs.a: quiet, private and hidden ('no street noise could reach it')

qs.q: Name a famous building in Uzbekistan and say one fact about it.
qs.a: e.g. The Kalon Minaret in Bukhara is almost 900 years old.

qs.q: Describe a building you like in two sentences.
qs.a: e.g. I like … because it is …

qs.q: Give one reason why people dislike some modern buildings.
qs.a: e.g. They look cold, grey or out of place.

qs.q: Old house or new flat — which would you choose to live in? Why?
qs.a: e.g. A new flat, because it is warmer and more comfortable.

qs.q: Speak 30 seconds: should a city keep its old buildings or replace them?
qs.a: e.g. Keep them — they are part of our heritage and attract tourists.

30.title: Grammar Auction: describing buildings in a lecture
30.stage: Tahlil bosqichida — xatolar daftari bilan birga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari takror uchun.
30.goal: An'anaviy va zamonaviy binolar haqidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni topish: look at, let + fe'l ('to'siz), help + fe'l, inspired by, ko'plik (leaves, were), each of + birlik fe'l, sanalmaydigan information.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: gaplar ma'ruza mavzusida — an'anaviy va zamonaviy binolar; har xato gapda faqat BITTA xato bor.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi (listening kabi). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan, 'a closer look to' → 'a closer look at'); ustoz izohni (why) o'qib beradi.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

items.s: Let's now have a closer look to the main entrance.
items.fix: Let's now have a closer look at the main entrance.
items.why: have a look AT something — 'to' emas.

items.s: Each of the posts supports part of the roof.
items.why: Each of + ko'plik ot + BIRLIK fe'l: supports.

items.s: Traditional houses was built without nails or screws.
items.fix: Traditional houses were built without nails or screws.
items.why: Ko'plik ega (houses) → were built.

items.s: The open design allows air to circulate freely.
items.why: allow + narsa + TO + fe'l — to'g'ri.

items.s: The steep roof lets the rain to run straight off.
items.fix: The steep roof lets the rain run straight off.
items.why: let + ob'ekt + fe'l ('to'siz).

items.s: The roof was covered with several layers of dried leafs.
items.fix: The roof was covered with several layers of dried leaves.
items.why: leaf → leaves (f → ves); 'leafs' — noto'g'ri ko'plik.

items.s: The seating capacity was later reduced to save money.
items.why: Passiv (was reduced) va maqsad: to + fe'l.

items.s: Stone floors help keeping the house cool on hot days.
items.fix: Stone floors help keep the house cool on hot days.
items.why: help + fe'l (yoki help to + fe'l); -ing emas.

items.s: In the lecture, the speaker compares traditional and modern houses.
items.why: compare A and B; ega birlik → compares.

items.s: The architects were inspired from traditional Chinese pottery.
items.fix: The architects were inspired by traditional Chinese pottery.
items.why: be inspired BY something — 'from' emas.

items.s: Most of the building's energy comes from solar panels on the roof.
items.why: Most of + the building's + ot; energy — sanalmaydigan → comes.

items.s: The lecturer gave us some useful informations about roofs.
items.fix: The lecturer gave us some useful information about roofs.
items.why: information — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

30.title: Board Game: Listening Part 4 — lecture notes
30.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin — Part 4 strategiyasini mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida takror
30.goal: Listening Part 4 note completion strategiyasi: qaydlarni oldindan o'qish, bo'lim signallari, javob turini bashorat qilish, so'z chegarasi, tuzatilgan raqam, paraphrase va binolar mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi, so'zni harflab aytadi yoki belgilangan vaqt gapiradi.
'Spell aloud' katagida so'z harfma-harf aytiladi — bitta harf xato bo'lsa javob xato (imtihonda ham shunday).
Guruh javobni ustozning kalit varag'i bilan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

squares.t: How many speakers are there in Listening Part 4?
squares.a: One — it is a lecture (a monologue).

squares.t: Is there a pause in the middle of Part 4?

31.title: Grammar Auction: discoveries and the grammar filter
31.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin — grammatika filtrini mustahkamlash (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
31.goal: Kashfiyotlar va tarix mavzusidagi 'bosh + oxir' ulangan gaplarda grammatika filtri ushlaydigan xatolarni (was/were moslashuvi, hope + to, succeed + in + -ing, passiv V3, predlog) topish va tuzatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering. Boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Har gap — bosh va oxir ulangan to'liq gap. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bosh va oxir grammatik jihatdan mosmi (was/were, to/that, in + -ing, V3, predlog)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'inventors was' → 'inventors were').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: The ancient city of Pompeii was buried under volcanic ash in AD 79.
items.why: Pompeii — birlik: was buried (passiv, V3). Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Many early inventors was laughed at by other scientists.
items.fix: Many early inventors were laughed at by other scientists.
items.why: Ega ko'plik (inventors) → were. Grammatika filtri aynan shuni tekshiradi.

items.s: Ulugh Beg built an observatory in Samarkand in the 15th century.
items.why: Past Simple: built. 1420-yillar — 15-asr. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: The scientists hoped finding a cure before the end of the year.
items.fix: The scientists hoped to find a cure before the end of the year.
items.why: hope + to + fe'l (to find), -ing emas.

items.s: Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize.
items.why: the first + ot + to + fe'l — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: X-rays were discover by accident in 1895.
items.fix: X-rays were discovered by accident in 1895.
items.why: Passiv: were + V3 (discovered).

items.s: The farmers soon realised that they had found something extraordinary.
items.why: realise + that + to'liq gap; had found — undan oldingi harakat.

items.s: The Wright brothers succeeded to fly a powered plane in 1903.
items.fix: The Wright brothers succeeded in flying a powered plane in 1903.
items.why: succeed + in + -ing (in flying), 'to' emas.

items.s: Galileo used a telescope to study the moons of Jupiter.
items.why: use + ot + to + fe'l (maqsad) — to'g'ri.

items.s: The explorers were interested on finding a new sea route to India.
items.fix: The explorers were interested in finding a new sea route to India.
items.why: interested + in (+ -ing), 'on' emas.

items.s: The invention of antibiotics has changed modern medicine.
items.why: Ega — invention (birlik) → has; 'antibiotics' ko'plik bo'lsa ham fe'lga ta'sir qilmaydi.

items.s: The number of discoveries in the 20th century were enormous.
items.fix: The number of discoveries in the 20th century was enormous.
items.why: 'The number of …' — birlik: was. ('A number of …' — ko'plik.)

31.title: Board Game: beginnings, endings and discoveries
31.stage: 'Tahlil' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
31.goal: Matching sentence endings strategiyasi (3 filtr, ortiqcha oxirlar, 'boshqa odam' tuzog'i), grammatika filtri, paraphrase va kashfiyotlar mavzusida gapirishni takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, grammatika filtri bo'yicha oxirni tanlaydi, paraphrase beradi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan va grammatik to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: What do you match in this question type?
squares.a: Sentence beginnings (1, 2, 3…) with endings (A–G) to make sentences that agree with the text.

squares.t: Are there more beginnings or more endings?
squares.a: More endings — some of them are extra and are never used.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'famous'
squares.a: well known / celebrated / known all over the world

squares.t: Grammar filter: 'The first computers …' — was or were?
squares.a: were (the subject is plural)

squares.t: Say the nouns of 'discover' and 'invent'.
squares.a: discovery / invention (people: discoverer / inventor)

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: an invention you use every day.
squares.a: e.g. My phone — I use it to study, to chat and to find information.

squares.t: Grammar filter: 'The engineers managed …' A) to fix it B) fixing it
squares.a: A — manage + to + verb (managed to fix it)

squares.t: Do the answers usually follow the order of the text?
squares.a: Yes, usually — answer 3 is later in the text than answer 2.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'found by chance'
squares.a: discovered by accident / found accidentally / came across

squares.t: Grammar filter: 'Scientists soon realised …' — what comes next?
squares.a: that + a full clause (e.g. that the results were wrong)

squares.t: What should you do with an ending once you have used it?
squares.a: Cross it out — each ending can be used only once.

squares.t: Correct: The first photograph was take in the 1820s.
squares.a: The first photograph was taken in the 1820s. (passive: was + V3)

squares.t: Finish logically: 'Although the idea seemed strange at first, …'
squares.a: e.g. …it soon became popular / people soon accepted it.

squares.t: Name a great scholar from Uzbekistan's history and give one fact.
squares.a: e.g. Ibn Sina wrote The Canon of Medicine; Al-Biruni calculated the Earth's size.

squares.t: What is the biggest trap in this question type?
squares.a: An ending that is true in the text but about a different person, thing or time.

squares.t: Paraphrase 'caused': 'The new invention ___ many changes.'
squares.a: led to / resulted in / brought about

squares.t: Grammar filter: 'The invention of printed books …' — was or were?
squares.a: was — the subject is 'invention', not 'books'.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Which discovery changed the world the most?
squares.a: e.g. Electricity, because almost everything we use today depends on it.

squares.t: Why is an exact word match often a trap?
squares.a: Right answers are usually paraphrased; copied words often hide a wrong meaning.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'At first, people were doubtful.'
squares.a: e.g. In the beginning, people were not sure it was true / were sceptical.

squares.t: Why should you read the whole sentence at the end?
squares.a: To check that it is grammatical and logical — it must sound smooth.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Should history be compulsory at school? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — it helps us understand our country and avoid past mistakes.

squares.t: Grammar filter: 'The scientist hoped …' — which two patterns can follow?
squares.a: to + verb (hoped to prove it) or that + clause (hoped that it would work)

squares.t: Make an item: say a beginning and TWO endings — one right, one wrong.
squares.a: e.g. 'Ulugh Beg …' A built an observatory. B wrote the Canon of Medicine (Ibn Sina). → A

items.q: Do you have an older relative who remembers life without mobile phones?

31.title: Speaking cards: discoveries and history (Part 1 & 3)
31.stage: 'Listening' o'rniga (bu darsda audio yo'q) yoki dars oxirida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
31.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida tarix, ixtirolar va kashfiyotlar haqida kengaytirilgan javob berish (fikr + sabab + misol).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol (Part 3 savollarida — umumiy fikr, faqat shaxsiy tajriba emas).
Tinglovchi javobdagi mavzu so'zlarini (discovery, invention, century, ancient, scientist, by accident…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Did you enjoy history lessons at school? Why or why not?
Which historical place in Uzbekistan would you recommend to a foreign visitor? Why?
Do you like visiting museums? When did you last go to one?
Which invention do you use most in your daily life?
Have you ever read or watched a story about a great discovery? What was it?
Would you like to be a scientist? Why or why not?
Why do you think some important discoveries happen by accident?
Why were some great inventors laughed at in their own time?
Should governments spend more money on scientific research? Why?
Which is more important for a country: new inventions or protecting its history?
Some people say we learn from history; others say we repeat the same mistakes. What do you think?
What can young people learn from visiting ancient cities like Samarkand and Bukhara?
Is it better to learn history from books, films or visits to historical sites?
Which person from history would you most like to talk to? Why?
What discovery do you think scientists will make in the next fifty years?

31.title: Sentence Race: complete sentences about discoveries
31.stage: 'Savol turi' tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin tezkor mashq (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
31.goal: Matching sentence endings qoidalarini va kashfiyotlar haqidagi to'liq gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish — bosh va oxir qanday grammatik bog'lanishini ko'rish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Gapni 'bosh' va 'oxir'ga to'g'ri ajratsa (masalan: 'The scientists hoped | to prove…') — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: You will not need every ending in the box.
The answers usually follow the order of the text.
Each ending must fit the grammar of its beginning.
A true ending may still describe a different person.
Ulugh Beg's observatory was built to study the stars.
The scientists hoped to prove that their theory was correct.
Few people believed that the new vaccine would work.
The discovery of X-rays changed the way doctors worked.
Al-Khwarizmi is known as one of the fathers of algebra.
Some of the most useful inventions were made by accident.

31.title: Quiz Board: sentence endings and discoveries
31.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
31.goal: Matching sentence endings qoidalari, grammatika filtri, paraphrase va kashfiyotlar mavzusida og'zaki javoblarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Grammar filter 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Grammar filter' bo'limida javob sababi bilan aytiladi (masalan: 'B — plural subject').
'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: 5 beginnings and 7 endings: how many endings are extra?
Which filter can you use before you read the text?
Name the three filters in the right order.
qs.a: Grammar → place in the text → meaning

qs.q: Two endings both fit the grammar. What do you do next?
qs.a: Find the place in the text and choose by meaning.

qs.q: Name two kinds of wrong (extra) endings.
qs.a: e.g. the opposite of the text; true but about another person/time

qs.q: 'The explorers …' A) was lost. B) were lost.
'The team refused …' A) to give up. B) giving up.
'The discovery of new planets …' A) have changed science. B) has changed science.
'The inventor succeeded …' A) to build it. B) in building it.
'Not until 1900 …' A) scientists understood the disease. B) did scientists understand the disease.
qs.a: B — 'Not until' at the start needs inversion: did + subject

qs.q: hardly ever = ? (one word)
ancient = ?
qs.a: very old / from a long time ago

qs.q: a mild illness = ?
qs.a: an illness that is not serious

qs.q: wipe out completely = ? (one verb)
Paraphrase: 'The idea spread quickly.'
qs.a: e.g. The idea became popular in a short time.

qs.q: Finish this beginning in two different ways: 'The first cars …'
qs.a: e.g. were very slow. / were expensive to buy.

qs.q: Say one fact about Al-Khwarizmi.
qs.a: e.g. The words 'algebra' and 'algorithm' come from his book and name.

qs.q: Say a sentence beginning that continues with 'to + verb', not '-ing'.
qs.a: e.g. The engineers were able … / The team managed … / They hoped …

qs.q: Why do some new inventions fail at first? Give one reason.
qs.a: e.g. They are too expensive, or people do not trust new ideas.

qs.q: In 30 seconds, describe an accidental discovery.
qs.a: e.g. The microwave oven: a chocolate bar melted near a machine.

32.title: Answer Auction: spelling, plurals and prepositions
32.stage: 'Tekshirish'dan keyin — ko'chirishdagi imlo va ko'plik xatolari (15 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: Listening javoblarida ball yo'qotadigan xatolarni topish va tuzatish: imlo (Wednesday, accommodation), ko'plik -s, sanalmaydigan ot (equipment), joy predloglari (next to, on your right).
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering. Boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi (imlo ko'rinishi uchun yozish shart). Bu gaplar Listening skriptlari va formalaridagi kabi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi; imlo xatosida so'z harflab aytiladi (W-E-D-N-E-S-D-A-Y).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: The hotel offers free parking for all its guests.
items.why: offers — birlik ega (hotel); parking sanalmaydi. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Please arrive at the reception desk before 9 a.m. on Wendesday.
items.fix: Please arrive at the reception desk before 9 a.m. on Wednesday.
items.why: Imlo: Wednesday (W-e-d-n-e-s). Imlo xato bo'lsa javob 0 ball.

items.s: The tour includes a visit to the old library and two museum.
items.fix: The tour includes a visit to the old library and two museums.
items.why: two + ko'plik: museums. -s tushib qolsa javob noto'g'ri.

items.s: Students must hand in their assignments by the end of February.
items.why: Imlo to'g'ri (February); must + V1; by = 'kechi bilan'.

items.s: The course fee includes all the necessary equipments.
items.fix: The course fee includes all the necessary equipment.
items.why: equipment — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: The gym is open from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day.
items.why: from … to … — vaqt oralig'i to'g'ri berilgan.

items.s: The café is next the gift shop, near the main gate.
items.fix: The café is next to the gift shop, near the main gate.
items.why: Joylashuv: next to ('to' tushib qolmaydi) — xarita savollarida muhim.

items.s: Visitors can hire audio guides at the information centre.
items.why: Britancha imlo: centre; can + V1 — to'g'ri.

items.s: The accomodation costs £85 per night, including breakfast.
items.fix: The accommodation costs £85 per night, including breakfast.
items.why: Imlo: accommodation — ikki c, ikki m.

items.s: The lecture will focus on the history of public transport.
items.why: focus on — to'g'ri predlog; will + V1.

items.s: Turn left at the crossroads and the museum is in your right.
items.fix: Turn left at the crossroads and the museum is on your right.
items.why: Yo'nalish: on your right / on your left ('in' emas).

items.s: The next meeting will take place on 14th March.
items.why: Sanadan oldin 'on'; 14th March yoki March 14th — ikkalasi to'g'ri.

32.title: Board Game: the whole Listening test
32.stage: 34-dars boshida yoki takror darsida — butun Listening kursi (20 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: 3–31-darslardagi Listening savol turlari (form, notes, map, MCQ, pick from a list, chart), test qoidalari, ko'chirish qoidalari, raqam/harflab aytish va paraphraseni takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, so'zni harflab aytadi, raqamni 'IELTS usulida' o'qiydi, paraphrase beradi yoki 30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many times do you hear each recording?
squares.a: Only once.

squares.t: How many sections and questions are there?
squares.a: 4 sections, 40 questions (10 in each section).

squares.t: Spell aloud: restaurant
squares.a: R-E-S-T-A-U-R-A-N-T

squares.t: Is '14' or 'fourteen' correct on the answer sheet?
squares.a: Both are correct.

squares.t: Do capital letters matter on the answer sheet?
squares.a: No — LIBRARY and library are both correct.

squares.t: What do you do in the pause before each section?
squares.a: Read the next questions and predict the type of answer.

squares.t: Predict the answer type: 'Price per night: £______'
squares.a: a number (an amount of money, e.g. 85)

squares.t: Say this number the IELTS way: 0998 5511
squares.a: oh, double nine, eight — double five, double one

squares.t: Which section is a monologue on an everyday topic?
squares.a: Section 2 (e.g. a guide talking about a museum or a city tour).

squares.t: Which section is a lecture with no pause in the middle?
squares.a: Section 4

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the cheapest option'
squares.a: e.g. the one that costs the least / the least expensive choice

squares.t: Map labelling: say three phrases for giving directions.
squares.a: e.g. opposite, next to, turn left at the crossroads

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER: is '15 May' OK?
squares.a: Yes — one word and one number.

squares.t: The speaker says 'guided tours'; you write 'guided tour'. Correct?
squares.a: No — the plural -s is missing, so it scores 0.

squares.t: What is a distractor? Give an example with a day.
squares.a: e.g. 'Monday? No, let's make it Tuesday.' The answer is Tuesday.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Which section of the full test was hardest for you?
squares.a: e.g. Section 4 — there is no pause and the words are academic.

squares.t: Chart question: what does 'the vast majority' mean?
squares.a: almost all (e.g. 80–90%)

squares.t: 'Choose TWO letters': can you write them in any order?
squares.a: Yes — any order, but write only two letters.

squares.t: Form completion: a name is spelt out. What must you check?
squares.a: Every letter — one wrong letter means 0 marks.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the main reason'
squares.a: e.g. the most important reason / the key reason

squares.t: How long do you get to transfer answers in the paper test?
squares.a: 10 minutes (computer test: 2 minutes to check).

squares.t: How many correct answers do you need for Band 5.0? And for 6.0?
squares.a: About 16–17 for Band 5.0; about 23–25 for Band 6.0.

squares.t: Note completion: do you use the speaker's words or your own?
squares.a: The speaker's exact words, within the word limit.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: your plan to improve your weakest question type.
squares.a: e.g. Map labelling — I will practise directions and plans every day.

32.title: Dominoes: question paper ↔ what the speaker says
32.stage: 'Xato tahlili'da — paraphrase tuzoqlarini ko'rgandan keyin (12 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: Savol varag'idagi ibora bilan audiodagi paraphraseni tanish (free of charge = you don't have to pay anything; just over half = slightly more than fifty per cent) — butun Listening testining asosiy ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora (savol varag'i tili) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi ibora (so'zlovchi tili) bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Har ulashda juftlikni ovoz chiqarib o'qing va u qaysi savol turida uchrashi mumkinligini ayting (form, map, chart, MCQ).
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulanish bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: you don't have to pay anything
a lower price if you are studying
you can choose whether to do it
only a few out of every hundred
slightly more than fifty per cent
perfect if you bring your children
the last day to hand in your work
a visit where someone shows you around

32.title: Taboo: bookings, tours, study and travel
32.stage: 33-dars boshida isinish yoki 'Xato tahlili'da qisqa tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: Listening section'larida tez-tez uchraydigan mavzu so'zlarini (reservation, deposit, receipt, deadline, questionnaire, luggage, enclosure…) inglizcha ta'rif orqali tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'deposit' uchun pay, money, first).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; javob beruvchi so'zni harflab ham aytsa (R-E-C-E-I-P-T) — yana +1. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

32.title: Find someone who… has booked a hotel room by phone
32.stage: 'Xato tahlili' o'rtasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: Listening mavzulari (bron qilish, sayohat, hayvonot parki, o'qish, test tajribasi) bo'yicha to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…?, Did you…?, Do you…?, Can you…?) va qo'shimcha savol berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever booked a hotel room by phone?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? How was it?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has booked a hotel room by phone.
items.q: Have you ever booked a hotel room by phone?

items.t: …has filled in a form in English.
items.q: Have you ever filled in a form in English?

items.t: …has been to a zoo or wildlife park in the last two years.
items.q: Have you been to a zoo or wildlife park in the last two years?

items.t: …listens to English podcasts every week.
items.q: Do you listen to English podcasts every week?

items.t: …has taken a flight from Tashkent airport.
items.q: Have you ever taken a flight from Tashkent airport?

items.t: …got more than 25 correct answers today.
items.q: Did you get more than 25 correct answers today?

items.t: …found Section 4 easier than Section 1.
items.q: Did you find Section 4 easier than Section 1?

items.t: …has asked for directions in English.
items.q: Have you ever asked for directions in English?

items.t: …has taken part in a survey.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a survey?
