items.q: Can you spell your full name quickly in English?

items.t: …watches films in English with English subtitles.
items.q: Do you watch films in English with English subtitles?

items.t: …has attended a lecture at a university.
items.q: Have you ever attended a lecture at a university?

32.title: Speaking cards: travel, study and tests (Part 1 & 3)
32.stage: 34-dars boshida yoki mock oldidan gapirish mashqi (12 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida sayohat, mehmonxona, hayvonot parki, o'qish ko'nikmalari, aeroport va test tajribasi haqida kengaytirilgan javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol (Part 3 savollarida — umumiy fikr, faqat shaxsiy tajriba emas).
Tinglovchi javobdagi mavzu so'zlarini (reservation, lecture, luggage, questionnaire, deadline…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you prefer staying in hotels or with friends when you travel? Why?
How do you usually book a trip — online or by phone? Why?
Have you ever visited a zoo or wildlife park? What did you see?
Do you think zoos are good for animals? Why or why not?
What study skills help you most when you prepare for exams?
Do you prefer taking notes on paper or on a laptop? Why?
How often do you travel by plane? What do you like or dislike about airports?
What should a modern airport have to make travellers feel comfortable?
Why do you think many people feel stressed when they travel by plane?
How can listening to English every day improve your test score?
Should universities make study-skills courses compulsory? Why or why not?
Which is harder for you: a conversation or a lecture? Why?
How has tourism changed cities like Samarkand and Bukhara in recent years?
What would you do differently if you took the full listening test again?

32.title: Sentence Race: Listening test rules
32.stage: 'Test qoidalari' bosqichida, test boshlanishidan oldin (8 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: Listening testining asosiy qoidalari va strategiyalarini (bir marta tinglash, pauzada o'qish, so'z chegarasi, imlo, ko'plik -s) ifodalovchi gaplarni to'g'ri tartibda tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Jamoa bu qoida testning qaysi bosqichida kerakligini aytsa (tinglash, pauza, ko'chirish) — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Each section of the test is played once.
Use each pause to read the questions that come next.
Always check the word limit before you write an answer.
Check your spelling when you transfer your answers.
Section 4 is an academic lecture with no pause.
A distractor is an option that the speaker mentions but rejects.
A missing plural -s makes the whole answer wrong.
Numbers can be written in words or in figures.
Try to predict the type of answer before you listen.
About sixteen correct answers are needed for Band 5.

32.title: Quiz Board: the full Listening test
32.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida yoki 34-dars boshida takror (15 daqiqa). Test kuni 1–2 o'yin tanlanadi, qolgani — takrorga.
32.goal: Test tuzilishi, javob varag'i qoidalari, Listening savol turlarining tuzoqlari va og'zaki ko'nikmalarni (raqam, harflab aytish, yo'l ko'rsatish, paraphrase) takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Answer sheet 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Answer sheet' bo'limida javob doskaga yoziladi (imlo tekshiriladi).
'Say it!' bo'limida javob ovoz chiqarib aytiladi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many sections are there in IELTS Listening?
How many questions are there in total?
Which section is a conversation between two people in an everyday situation?
Which section is a discussion about studies with two to four speakers?
Roughly how many correct answers give Band 7.0?
You are not sure of an answer. Should you leave the space blank?
qs.a: No — guess; a blank space always scores 0.

qs.q: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'a new bridge' OK?
The speaker says 'oh-double seven-two'. What do you write?
Is a hyphenated word like 'part-time' one word or two?
Correct the spelling: 'goverment' and 'enviroment'
Form completion: what is often spelt out letter by letter?
qs.a: Names (e.g. a surname or a street name)

qs.q: Multiple choice: all three options are mentioned. How do you choose?
qs.a: The one the speaker confirms; the others are rejected or changed.

qs.q: Map labelling: what should you find first on the map?
qs.a: The starting point (e.g. 'You are here' / the entrance)

qs.q: Sentence completion: the gap comes after 'an'. What does that tell you?
qs.a: The answer is singular and starts with a vowel sound.

qs.q: Chart questions: what should you listen for?
Say this number the IELTS way: 01553
Spell your surname aloud.
Give directions from the classroom door to your desk.
qs.a: e.g. Go straight on, turn left; it's opposite the window.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'The museum is closed on Mondays.'
qs.a: e.g. You can't visit the museum on Mondays.

qs.q: In 30 seconds, give a new student three tips for the Listening test.
qs.a: e.g. Read ahead in pauses, keep to the word limit, check spelling.

33.title: Grammar Auction: windmills, green tourism and screens
33.stage: Tahlil bosqichida — test tekshirilib, xatolar daftari to'ldirilgach (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: Testdagi uch mavzu (shamol tegirmoni, yashil turizm, ekranda o'qish) bo'yicha gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: afford to, despite, do damage, the number of + has, respond, ortiqcha 'more'.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: gaplar bugungi uch passage mavzusida; har xato gapda faqat BITTA xato bor.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan, 'afford paying' → 'afford to pay'); ustoz izohni (why) o'qiydi.
Ustoz eslatadi: sentence completion javoblarida ham so'z turkumi va ko'plik -s xatosi ballni yo'qotadi.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

items.s: Wind turbines can generate electricity even in remote villages.
items.why: generate electricity — to'g'ri kollokatsiya; can + fe'l (generate).

items.s: His family could not afford paying the school fees.
items.fix: His family could not afford to pay the school fees.
items.why: afford + to + fe'l: afford to pay; '-ing' shakli ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: Despite of the setback, he continued to study at the library.
items.fix: Despite the setback, he continued to study at the library.
items.why: despite + ot, 'of' qo'shilmaydi (yoki: in spite of the setback).

items.s: Many tourists visit the Alps in summer to go hiking.
items.why: go + -ing (go hiking); maqsad — to + fe'l.

items.s: The town has taken several measures to reduce its carbon emissions.
items.why: take measures — to'g'ri kollokatsiya; its — shaharga (birlik) ishora.

items.s: Hotels are trying to make less damage to the environment.
items.fix: Hotels are trying to do less damage to the environment.
items.why: do damage to — kollokatsiya; 'make damage' deyilmaydi (cause damage ham to'g'ri).

items.s: The number of visitors have doubled since the 1990s.
items.fix: The number of visitors has doubled since the 1990s.
items.why: The number of + ot → fe'l birlikda: has (a number of … → have).

items.s: Melting glaciers are clear evidence of climate change.
items.why: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot: 'an evidence' ham, 'evidences' ham deyilmaydi.

items.s: Today people read far more on screens than on paper.
items.why: far more … than — qiyosni kuchaytirish to'g'ri.

items.s: Screen reading encourages people to response quickly.
items.fix: Screen reading encourages people to respond quickly.
items.why: to + fe'l: respond; 'response' — ot. Gap-fill javobida ham so'z turkumi muhim.

items.s: The printing press made books much more cheaper.
items.fix: The printing press made books much cheaper.
items.why: cheaper — allaqachon qiyosiy shakl, 'more' ortiqcha.

items.s: Only a few people in the Middle Ages were able to write.
items.why: a few + ko'plik ot (people); were able to — o'tgan zamonda qobiliyat.

33.title: Board Game: Full Reading Test review
33.stage: Test tekshirilgach dam olish va takror sifatida (20 daqiqa) yoki 34-darsda. Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: To'liq Reading testi qoidalari (60 daqiqa, ko'chirish vaqti yo'q, so'z chegarasi), testdagi savol turlari strategiyasi, paraphrase, xom ball → band va passage mavzularida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdagi bitta o'quvchi 'hakam' bo'lib, javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Say the band' kataklarida darsdagi Reading jadvali ishlatiladi (masalan, 30 ta to'g'ri — Band 7.0).
Gapirish (Speaking) kataklarida kamida 2 gap va bitta sabab (because…) bo'lishi shart.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi. FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How long is the Reading test? Is there extra time to transfer answers?
squares.a: 60 minutes; no extra time — write answers on the answer sheet at once.

squares.t: How can you split the 60 minutes between the three passages?
squares.a: P1 about 17–18 min, P2 20 min, P3 22 min (P3 is the hardest).

squares.t: What do you do in the first minute of each passage?
squares.a: Look at the title, the question types and the word limits.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'could no longer pay for'
squares.a: e.g. could not afford any more / did not have enough money for

squares.t: TFNG: what is the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite. NOT GIVEN: the text says nothing about it.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'renewable energy'
squares.a: e.g. green energy / energy from the wind, the sun or water

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'a wind turbine' a correct answer?
squares.a: No — it is three words (articles count). Write 'wind turbine'.

squares.t: Speaking: Would you like to visit a mountain town? Why / why not?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because I love snow and hiking — Chimgan is my favourite place.

squares.t: Y/N/NG: do you compare the statement with facts or with the writer's views?
squares.a: With the writer's views and claims (opinions).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'visitors are told not to drop litter'
squares.a: e.g. tourists are warned not to leave rubbish

squares.t: Matching information: can you use one paragraph letter twice?
squares.a: Yes, if the instructions say 'You may use any letter more than once'.

squares.t: You have spent 3 minutes on one question. What do you do?
squares.a: Write a guess, mark the question, move on and come back at the end.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'screens are everywhere'
squares.a: e.g. screens are ubiquitous / screens are all around us

squares.t: Speaking: Do you prefer reading on paper or on a screen? Why?
squares.a: e.g. On paper, because it is easier on my eyes and I remember more.

squares.t: Flow chart completion: in what order do the answers usually come?
squares.a: In the same order as the text — the steps of the process.

squares.t: Say the band: 30 correct answers in Academic Reading.
Choose TWO letters: does the order of your two letters matter?
squares.a: No — A, C or C, A are both fine; each correct letter gets one mark.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'reduce carbon emissions'
squares.a: e.g. cut CO2 output / produce less greenhouse gas

squares.t: Sentence endings: why are there more endings than beginnings?
squares.a: The extra endings are distractors — some of them are not used.

squares.t: Say the band: 18 correct answers in Academic Reading.
squares.a: Band 5.0 (15–18); one more (19) gives 5.5.

squares.t: Speaking: How can tourists reduce their impact on nature?
squares.a: e.g. They can use public transport, recycle and stay on marked paths.

squares.t: MCQ: why is an option with the exact words of the text often wrong?
squares.a: It is a word-match trap; the correct option usually paraphrases the text.

squares.t: Speaking: Can one young person really change a village? Give an example.
squares.a: e.g. Yes — a teenager built a windmill and brought power to his village.

squares.t: The test ends in 1 minute and 3 boxes are empty. What do you do?
squares.a: Fill all three with a guess — an empty box always scores zero.

33.title: Dominoes: question words → text paraphrases
33.stage: Paraphrase mashqi bosqichida — test javoblari tekshirilgandan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: Testdagi uch matn mavzusidagi so'z va iboralarni ularning paraphrase'i bilan ulash (learned without a teacher → taught himself, found everywhere → ubiquitous).
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
Tushuntiring: chap tomondagi ibora — savolda keladigan so'z, unga mos tosh — matnda keladigan paraphrase (ma'nosi bir xil, so'zi boshqa).
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi, ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.
Qo'shimcha ball: har guruh 2 juftni o'z gapi ichida ishlatib beradi (+1 ball har gapga).

pairs: the town's main source of income
a sudden arrival of many visitors

33.title: Taboo: windmills, mountains and screens
33.stage: Test tekshirilgach, tahlil bosqichida (8 daqiqa). Testdan OLDIN o'ynalmaydi: so'zlar javoblarni ochib qo'yadi. Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
33.goal: Uch passage mavzusidagi so'zlarni (energiya, yashil turizm, o'qish va texnologiya) inglizcha ta'riflash va paraphrase qilish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va so'zni harflab aytish mumkin emas. Ustoz eslatadi: bu — paraphrase mashqi, testda ham xuddi shunday kerak.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

33.title: Find someone who… has read a book on a phone
33.stage: Testdan keyin harakatli tanaffus sifatida, tahlildan oldin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: Bugungi test va matn mavzulari (o'qish, energiya, turizm, ekologiya) bo'yicha to'g'ri savol tuzish: Have you ever…? / Did you… today? / Do you…? / Would you like…?
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi har qator uchun savolni O'ZI tuzadi (masalan: 'Did you finish Passage 1 in less than 20 minutes today?') va sinfdoshidan so'raydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (How? Why? When?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Savol xato tuzilsa, javob berayotgan o'quvchi uni tuzattiradi.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has read a whole book on a phone or tablet.
items.q: Have you ever read a whole book on a phone or tablet?

items.t: …has built something useful from old materials.
items.q: Have you ever built something useful from old materials?

items.t: …has taught himself or herself a skill online.
items.q: Have you ever taught yourself a skill online?

items.t: …has been skiing in Chimgan or Beldersay.
items.q: Have you ever been skiing in Chimgan or Beldersay?

items.t: …finished Passage 1 in less than 20 minutes today.
items.q: Did you finish Passage 1 in less than 20 minutes today?

items.t: …filled in every answer box in today's test.
items.q: Did you fill in every answer box in today's test?

items.t: …found Passage 3 easier than Passage 2.
items.q: Did you find Passage 3 easier than Passage 2?

items.t: …sorts rubbish for recycling at home.
items.q: Do you sort your rubbish for recycling at home?

items.t: …has seen solar panels on a house in his or her area.
items.q: Have you seen solar panels on a house in your area?

items.t: …reads the news on paper more often than on a screen.
items.q: Do you read the news on paper more often than on a screen?

items.t: …would like to give a talk at a big conference one day.
items.q: Would you like to give a talk at a big conference one day?

items.t: …visits a library at least once a month.
items.q: Do you visit a library at least once a month?

33.title: Speaking cards: reading, energy and tourism
33.stage: Xulosa bosqichida — matn mavzularini gapirish orqali mustahkamlash (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: Testdagi mavzular (o'qish va ekranlar, qayta tiklanadigan energiya, ta'lim, turizm va iqlim) bo'yicha IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga to'liq javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: Part 1 uslubidagi savolga 2–3 gap, Part 3 uslubidagi (why/how/should) savolga 4–5 gap.
Tinglovchi ball beradi: sabab (because…) +1, misol (for example…) +1, matndan olingan yangi so'z (masalan, ubiquitous, emissions) +1.
Rollar almashadi. Vaqt tugaganda eng ko'p ball to'plagan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy reading? What kinds of things do you usually read?
Do you prefer reading on paper or on a screen? Why?
How has technology changed the way young people read?
Do you think printed books will disappear in the future? Why or why not?
Is it possible to learn a subject well without a teacher? How?
What can young people do if their family cannot afford their education?
Should the government pay for all students' education? Why or why not?
Which kinds of renewable energy could work well in Uzbekistan? Why?
Do you like visiting the mountains? Which places in Uzbekistan would you recommend?
How does mass tourism affect small towns and the natural environment?
What can hotels do to become more environmentally friendly?
Is climate change visible where you live? Give an example.
How do you feel before an important exam? What helps you stay calm?
Do you think time limits in exams are fair? Why or why not?
Which is more useful: reading fast or reading carefully? Why?

33.title: Sentence Race: test strategy and paraphrased ideas
33.stage: Xulosa va uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: Reading testi strategiyasi va uch matn g'oyalarini boshqa so'zlar bilan (paraphrase) ifodalovchi gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'l ko'taradi. Maslahat: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi (Listening, Reading, Passage kabi nomlardan tashqari), nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball oladi va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa qayta teradi.
Strategiya gaplarida jamoa gapni o'zbekchaga ham izohlasa +1 qo'shimcha ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Do not spend more than two minutes on any question.
Always check the word limit before writing an answer.
If you are not sure, write your best guess.
Unlike Listening, Reading gives you no time to transfer answers.
The boy left school because his parents could not afford it.
Tourism is the main source of income for the town.
Hotels account for half of the valley's carbon emissions.
Visitors are asked to put their rubbish in recycling bins.
Cheap printed books changed the way people read.
Screen reading encourages readers to react quickly.

33.title: Quiz Board: Full Reading Test
33.stage: Test tekshirilgach, dars oxirida yoki 34-dars boshida takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — keyingi darsga.
33.goal: Reading testi qoidalari, xom ball → band, testdagi uch matn mavzusidagi paraphrase va so'zlarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash; strategiyani og'zaki tushuntirish.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Test rules, Paraphrase it, Topic words, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi (Say it! uchun 40 soniya). To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Paraphrase javoblarida kalitdagi variantlardan biri yoki ma'nosi bir xil boshqa ibora qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How long is the IELTS Reading test?
How many questions are there in the Reading test?
Is there extra time to transfer your Reading answers?
qs.a: No — write straight onto the answer sheet

qs.q: TFNG: the text does not mention the idea at all. What is the answer?
You scored 23 in Academic Reading. What band is that?
Paraphrase: 'rubbish'
Paraphrase: 'the top of a mountain'
Paraphrase: 'energy from the sun'
Paraphrase: 'use less water'
Paraphrase: 'people who love dangerous sports'
A machine that uses the wind to make electricity.
A huge mass of ice that moves slowly down a mountain.
Gases such as CO2 that cars and factories release into the air.
Supplying water to crops through pipes or channels.
An adjective meaning 'found everywhere'.
Say what you do if one question takes more than 2 minutes.
qs.a: Guess, mark it, move on and come back at the end.

qs.q: Explain FALSE vs NOT GIVEN in one sentence.
qs.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite; NOT GIVEN: it says nothing.

qs.q: Give two ways a town can make tourism greener.
qs.a: e.g. free buses, recycling bins, solar panels

qs.q: Say how screens have changed reading (two sentences).
qs.a: e.g. We read more than before. Words now mix with pictures and video.

qs.q: Tell the class your weakest question type and your plan to improve it.
qs.a: e.g. Y/N/NG — I will redo the Lesson 19 homework.

34.title: Grammar Auction: mock-day advice
34.stage: 'Bilmasam nima qilaman' bosqichidan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — mock oldi takrorga.
34.goal: Mock kuni maslahatlari haqidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: should + fe'l, if-gapda will yo'q, careful/carefully, birlik ega + -s, I agree, convert into.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering. Eslating: har gap mock kuni qoidasi yoki maslahati; xato gapda faqat BITTA xato bor.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ikki marta o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap grammatik jihatdan to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan, 'should to read' → 'should read'); ustoz izohni (why) o'qiydi.
Har gapdan keyin ustoz so'raydi: bu maslahat mock qoidasiga to'g'ri keladimi? To'g'ri izohlagan jamoa +20.
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa.

items.s: You must write your answers while you are listening.
items.why: must + fe'l (write); while + Continuous — jarayon davomida.

items.s: The examiner reads the script once, so listen careful.
items.fix: The examiner reads the script once, so listen carefully.
items.why: Fe'lni (listen) ravish tasvirlaydi: carefully; careful — sifat.

items.s: Candidates are not allowed to use their phones during the test.
items.why: be allowed + to + fe'l; during + ot (the test).

items.s: I spent too much time on Passage 1, so I didn't finish Passage 3.
items.why: spend time on something; time sanalmaydi → too much.

items.s: An empty answer box never get any marks.
items.fix: An empty answer box never gets any marks.
items.why: Birlik ega (box) → Present Simple -s: gets.

items.s: Each passage should take about twenty minutes.
items.why: each + birlik ot (passage); should + fe'l (take).

items.s: You should to read the instructions before each part.
items.fix: You should read the instructions before each part.
items.why: should + fe'l, 'to'siz: should read.

items.s: If you will miss an answer, move on to the next question.
items.fix: If you miss an answer, move on to the next question.
items.why: if-gapda 'will' ishlatilmaydi: If you miss …

items.s: The Listening test has four parts and forty questions.
items.why: has — birlik ega (the test); four parts — ko'plik.

items.s: Make sure you get enough sleep the night before the mock.
items.why: make sure + gap; get enough sleep — to'g'ri kollokatsiya.

items.s: I am agree that time management is the key to a high score.
items.fix: I agree that time management is the key to a high score.
items.why: agree — fe'l, 'am' qo'shilmaydi: I agree.

items.s: Reading and Listening scores are converted in bands using different tables.
items.fix: Reading and Listening scores are converted into bands using different tables.
items.why: convert something INTO (yoki TO) something: converted into bands.

34.title: Board Game: mock-day plan and band scores
34.stage: 'Ballni o'zing chiqar' bosqichidan keyin umumiy takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — mock oldi takrorga.
34.goal: Mock kuni tartibi, Listening Part 1–4 rejasi, Reading 20 + 20 + 20 rejasi, bo'sh katak qoidasi, xom ball → band (Listening va Reading alohida) va imtihon haqida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar, fishkalar va 1-mashqdagi xom ball → band jadvalini bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, bandni topadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdagi 'hakam' javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi. Band savollarida Listening va Reading ustunlari aralashtirilmasligi shart.
Xato javob bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Speaking kataklarida kamida 2 gap va bitta sabab (because…) kerak.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi. FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the four parts of the mock in the correct order.
squares.a: Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking.

squares.t: How many times is the Listening script read?
squares.a: Only once — so write each answer while you listen.

squares.t: How many questions are there in Listening? And in Reading?
squares.a: 40 in Listening and 40 in Reading.

squares.t: Reading plan: how many minutes for each passage?
squares.a: 20 + 20 + 20 minutes.

squares.t: What do you do in the 30–40 seconds before each Listening part?
squares.a: Read the questions and note the key words and the word limit.

squares.t: Speaking: How do you usually feel before an exam? Why?
squares.a: e.g. A bit nervous, because I want a good score, but I try to stay calm.

squares.t: Listening Part 1: what kind of information do you expect?
squares.a: Names, numbers, dates, addresses — names are often spelled out.

squares.t: Say the band: 30 correct answers in Listening.
Say the band: 30 correct answers in Academic Reading.
squares.a: Band 7.0 (30–32) — the same band, but a different range.

squares.t: You missed one Listening answer. What do you do?
squares.a: Leave it, follow the next question and guess at the end of the part.

squares.t: Part 3: a speaker says 'Actually, …'. Why is this important?
squares.a: The idea after 'actually' is often the answer; the first idea is a trap.

squares.t: Speaking: What do you do the evening before an important test?
squares.a: e.g. I revise a little, prepare my things and go to bed early.

squares.t: Where must your phone be during the mock?
squares.a: In your bag — not on the desk.

squares.t: The limit is NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS, but you have three. What do you do?
squares.a: Remove the least necessary word, e.g. an article.

squares.t: Say the band: 32 correct in Listening and 32 in Reading.
squares.a: Listening 7.5, Reading 7.0 — the two tables are different.

squares.t: Which Reading question types do you start with? Why?
squares.a: Types in text order (TFNG, sentence completion) — answers are quick to find.

squares.t: Listening Part 4 is a lecture. Is there a break in the middle?
squares.a: No — it is non-stop, so follow the questions in order.

squares.t: The Reading test starts at 14:00. At 14:25 you are still on Passage 1. What now?
squares.a: Go to Passage 2 at once; guess any blanks in the last 2 minutes.

squares.t: Speaking: Which question type is the hardest for you? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Matching headings, because the paragraphs look very similar to me.

squares.t: Writing: how many words do you need for Task 1 and Task 2?
squares.a: At least 150 words and at least 250 words.

squares.t: Why is it useless to memorise one mock variant?
squares.a: There are 5 variants (A–E) and the parts are mixed randomly.

squares.t: Say the band: 17 correct in Listening. How many more for 5.5?
squares.a: Band 5.0; one more (18) gives 5.5.

squares.t: Speaking: Give a friend three tips for the mock day.
squares.a: e.g. Sleep well, write answers at once and never leave a box empty.

squares.t: Why must your spelling be perfect in Listening and Reading?
squares.a: Answers are checked automatically — a misspelt word is marked wrong.

34.title: Speaking cards: exams, stress and time
34.stage: Xulosa bosqichida yoki mock kuni Speaking oldidan (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — mock oldi takrorga.
34.goal: Imtihonlar, stress va vaqtni boshqarish mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga to'liq javob berish — mock kunidagi Speaking uchun mashq.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: Part 1 uslubidagi savolga 2–3 gap, Part 3 uslubidagi (why/should/how important) savolga 4–5 gap.
Tinglovchi ball beradi: sabab (because…) +1, misol (for example…) +1, o'z tajribasidan misol +1.
Javob 10 soniyadan oldin to'xtab qolsa, tinglovchi 'Why?' yoki 'Can you give an example?' deb yordam beradi.
Rollar almashadi. Vaqt tugaganda eng ko'p ball to'plagan o'quvchi g'olib.

34.goal: Mock kuni qoidalari va vaqt rejasini ifodalovchi gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish va qoidani eslab qolish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'l ko'taradi. Maslahat: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi (Listening, Reading, Passage kabi nomlardan tashqari), nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; xato bo'lsa qayta teradi.
Jamoa qoidaning SABABini bir gapda aytsa (masalan, 'because the script is read once') +1 qo'shimcha ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib. Gaplar reja varaqasiga ko'chirib qo'yiladi.

34.title: Quiz Board: ready for the mock?
34.stage: Xulosa va uyga vazifadan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — mock oldi takrorga.
34.goal: Mock kuni tartibi, xom ball → band (Listening va Reading alohida), kurs davomida o'rganilgan savol turlari va shaxsiy rejani o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Mock day, Score to band, Question types, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Score to band 400'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi (Say it! uchun 40 soniya). 'Score to band' savollarida 1-mashqdagi jadvaldan foydalanish mumkin.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

35.title: Grammar Auction: talking about my mock results
35.stage: 'Olti sabab' tanishtirilgandan keyin, javoblar varaqasidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
35.goal: Mock natijasi va xatolar haqida inglizcha to'g'ri gapirish: make a mistake, run out of time, leave an answer blank, satisfied with, a two-week plan; tipik xatoni topib tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (tuzatilgan gap to'liq ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

35.title: Board Game: IELTS 5.0 course review
35.stage: Tahlildan keyingi darslarda yoki keyingi mockdan oldin butun kurs takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa)
35.goal: Butun kursni takrorlash: savol turlari qoidalari, paraphrase, xom ball va band, olti sabab, imlo va raqamlar; o'z natijasi haqida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq inglizcha gap bilan javob beradi.
Guruhdan bir kishi 'hakam' bo'ladi va javoblar kalitidan tekshiradi. Xato yoki javob yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Which cause?' kataklarida o'quvchi sabab raqamini (1–6) aytadi va bitta davo taklif qiladi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many questions and parts are there in the Listening test?
squares.a: 40 questions in 4 parts.

squares.t: How long is the Reading test? Is there extra time to transfer answers?
squares.a: 60 minutes for 3 passages; no extra transfer time.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a big increase'.
squares.a: e.g. a sharp rise / a significant increase

squares.t: Spell aloud: accommodation.
squares.a: A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-I-O-N (double c, double m)

squares.t: TFNG: what is the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite. NOT GIVEN: the text says nothing about it.

squares.t: Listening 29/40 is band 6.5. What band is 30/40?
squares.a: 7.0 — one more answer can add half a band.

squares.t: Which cause? The answer was 'two weeks'; you wrote 'two week'.
squares.a: Cause 2: heard it but wrote it wrongly (plural). Check every plural.

squares.t: Say 13 and 30, then 15 and 50, with the correct stress.
squares.a: thirTEEN / THIRty, fifTEEN / FIFty

squares.t: Why should you never leave an answer blank?
squares.a: There is no penalty for a wrong answer, but a blank is a sure zero.

squares.t: Matching Headings: what do you look for in each paragraph?
squares.a: The main idea of the whole paragraph, not one detail.

squares.t: Map labelling: say three direction phrases.
squares.a: e.g. opposite, next to, at the end of the path

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'People are worried about pollution.'
squares.a: e.g. People are concerned about pollution. / Pollution is a public concern.

squares.t: Which cause? Passage 3, questions 34–40 are all blank.
squares.a: Cause 3: ran out of time. Cure: 20 minutes per passage with a timer.

squares.t: Yes / No / Not Given: does it check facts or the writer's views?
squares.a: The writer's views and claims (TFNG checks facts).

squares.t: Say the date 20/9 aloud in two ways.
squares.a: the twentieth of September / September the twentieth

squares.t: Tell your group your weakest section and why (20 seconds).
squares.a: e.g. My weakest section is Reading because I run out of time.

squares.t: Multiple choice: why is an option with the exact words from the text risky?
squares.a: It is often a distractor; the correct option is usually paraphrased.

squares.t: Which cause? 'library' was right, but you changed it to 'laboratory'.
squares.a: Cause 6: knew it but changed it. Change an answer only with clear evidence.

squares.t: Pick from a List (choose TWO): does the order of the letters matter?
squares.a: No — the two letters can be written in any order.

squares.t: Why is 26/40 band 6.5 in Listening but 6.0 in Reading?
squares.a: The two band tables are different; the Reading table is stricter.

squares.t: Summary with a box: what do you predict before reading the options?
squares.a: The word type for each gap (noun, verb, adjective) and its meaning.

squares.t: Make this a real plan: 'I will practise more.'
squares.a: e.g. Every day at 8 pm: 20 numbers by dictation; my partner checks on Tuesdays.

squares.t: Which cause? 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS' — you wrote four words.
squares.a: Cause 4: misunderstood the instructions. Read the word limit first.

squares.t: Give a friend one tip for the next mock (30 seconds).
squares.a: e.g. Keep the last 2 minutes to fill in every blank answer.

rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.

Tinglovchi darsdagi iboralarni sanaydi (run out of time, make a mistake, raw score, band, a two-week plan): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

qs.q: Which question type checks the writer's opinions, not facts?

36.title: Grammar Auction: Task 2 sentences about crime
36.stage: Band descriptors va 3–5-mashqlardan keyin, namuna essay tahlilidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
36.goal: Task 2 essayidagi tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish (commit a crime, I agree, although…but, spend on, artikl, moslik); xato Lexical Resource yoki Grammar mezoniga tegishli ekanini aytish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi va doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 essayga yaraydimi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi; xato qaysi mezonga tegishli ekanini (LR yoki GRA) ham aytsa, yana +50.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: In my view, judges should be free to consider the motive behind a crime.
items.why: 'In my view' — fikr bildirish; be free to + fe'l, motive behind — to'g'ri.

items.s: Young people who do a crime for the first time deserve a second chance.
items.fix: Young people who commit a crime for the first time deserve a second chance.
items.why: Collocation: commit a crime ('do a crime' emas) — Lexical Resource.

items.s: Some people argue that every crime should have a fixed penalty.
items.why: 'Some people argue that…' — kirishda qarashni berishning to'g'ri usuli.

items.s: I am agree that prison is not always the best solution.
items.fix: I agree that prison is not always the best solution.
items.why: agree — fe'l, 'am agree' deyilmaydi (GRA).

items.s: Strict punishments may act as a deterrent to potential offenders.
items.why: act as a deterrent — to'g'ri collocation; 'may' da'voni yumshatadi.

items.s: Longer prison sentences does not always reduce crime.
items.fix: Longer prison sentences do not always reduce crime.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (sentences) — 'do not' bo'ladi (GRA).

items.s: A fair sentence should reflect both the crime and the offender's situation.
items.why: both … and — parallel tuzilma; reflect + ot — to'g'ri.

items.s: Many young offenders break the law because of the poverty.
items.fix: Many young offenders break the law because of poverty.
items.why: Umumiy ma'nodagi mavhum ot artiklsiz: poverty (GRA).

items.s: Prisons should focus on the rehabilitation of offenders.
items.why: focus on + rehabilitation of — predloglar to'g'ri.

items.s: Although fixed penalties are consistent, but they can be unfair.
items.fix: Although fixed penalties are consistent, they can be unfair.
items.why: Although bilan 'but' bitta gapda birga ishlatilmaydi — bittasi qoladi (GRA).

items.s: Judges must take into account the circumstances of each case.
items.why: take into account + uzun to'ldiruvchi — to'g'ri tartib.

items.s: Governments should spend more money for crime prevention.
items.fix: Governments should spend more money on crime prevention.
items.why: spend money ON something — 'for' emas (LR).

36.title: Board Game: Task 2 question types and criteria
36.stage: Keyingi dars (37) boshida takror sifatida: savol turlari va mezonlar (20 daqiqa)
36.goal: Task 2 shartlari, 4 savol turi, 4 baholash mezoni va 7.0 talabini og'zaki takrorlash; jinoyat va jazo mavzusida fikr aytish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: 'Type?' kataklarida savol turini, 'Which criterion?' kataklarida mezonni aytadi.
Gapirish kataklarida (Say / Talk) kamida 2 gap aytiladi: fikr + sabab.
Guruhdan bir kishi javoblar kalitidan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many words must a Task 2 essay have?
squares.a: At least 250 words.

squares.t: How long should you spend on Task 2?
squares.a: About 40 minutes.

squares.t: Which task gives more marks: Task 1 or Task 2?
squares.a: Task 2 — it is worth twice as much as Task 1.

squares.t: Type? '… To what extent do you agree or disagree?'
squares.a: OPINION

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'crime'.
squares.a: offence

squares.t: Type? '… Discuss both these views.'
squares.a: DISCUSSION (both views; your opinion is not required)

squares.t: How many paragraphs does a typical Task 2 essay have?
squares.a: Four: introduction, two body paragraphs, conclusion.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'punishment'.
squares.a: penalty / sentence

squares.t: Type? '… Discuss both views and give your own opinion.'
squares.a: OPINION + DISCUSSION

squares.t: Name the four marking criteria.
squares.a: Task Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy

squares.t: Type? '… What are the causes and what solutions can you suggest?'
squares.a: SITUATION (causes + solutions)

squares.t: Say one argument FOR fixed punishments.
squares.a: e.g. The same crime always gets the same sentence.

squares.t: Which criterion? 'He go to school every day.'
squares.a: Grammatical Range & Accuracy

squares.t: Which criterion? 'do a mistake' instead of 'make a mistake'.
squares.a: Lexical Resource (collocation)

squares.t: Explain 'deterrent' in simple English.
squares.a: Something that stops people from doing something wrong, e.g. a heavy fine.

squares.t: Say one argument AGAINST fixed punishments.
squares.a: e.g. Judges cannot consider why the person committed the crime.

squares.t: Which criterion? Every sentence starts with 'Moreover'.
squares.a: Coherence & Cohesion (mechanical linking)

squares.t: Does a Band 7 essay have to be error-free?
squares.a: No — a few errors are fine if the meaning stays clear.

squares.t: Type? '… Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?'
squares.a: OPINION + DISCUSSION: show both sides and say which is stronger.

squares.t: What is 'rehabilitation'?
squares.a: Helping offenders to change and return to normal life.

squares.t: What happens if your essay is on the topic but doesn't answer the question?
squares.a: Task Response can fall to band 5, even if the ideas are good.

squares.t: Which criterion? An opinion is given with no reason or example.
squares.a: Task Response (the idea is not developed)

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should young offenders go to prison?
squares.a: e.g. I think community service is often better because it teaches responsibility.

squares.t: Say your weakest criterion and one way to improve it.
squares.a: e.g. Lexical Resource: I will learn five topic collocations a day.

36.title: Dominoes: plain words and Band 7 words (crime)
36.stage: Namuna essay tahlilining 1-yurishi (lug'at) dan keyin (10 daqiqa)
36.goal: Lexical Resource: oddiy so'z yoki iborani aniqroq Band 7 muqobili bilan ulash (offence, penalty, deterrent, rehabilitation, remorse, discretion…).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: o'ng tomondagi ODDIY iboraga ma'nosi bir xil bo'lgan Band 7 iborasi yozilgan toshni toping va chap tomoni bilan ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Har ulashda juftlik ikkala iborani ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz javoblar kalitidan tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
Bonus +1: guruh 3 ta Band 7 iborasi bilan jinoyat mavzusida bitta gap tuzsa.

pairs: a fixed punishment for every crime
a set penalty for each offence
it stops people breaking the law
the reason why someone did it
people who agree with this idea

36.title: Taboo: essay and crime words
36.stage: Slayddagi essaydan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida isinish (10 daqiqa)
36.goal: Essay tuzilmasi so'zlari (introduction, conclusion, collocation) va jinoyat mavzusi so'zlarini (penalty, motive, deterrent, remorse) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

36.title: Find someone who… has written a 250-word essay
36.stage: Dars boshida, Task 2 bilan tanishuvdan oldin isinish (10 daqiqa)
36.goal: Yozish tajribasi, qoidalar va jinoyat mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you like…?) va fikr yig'ish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever taken part in a debate competition?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why? What was it about?).
Fikr so'raladigan qatorlarda (thinks, believes) 'No' deganlardan ham sababini so'rang — bu Task 2 uchun fikr yig'ish.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has written an essay of 250 words or more in English.
items.q: Have you ever written an essay of 250 words or more in English?

items.t: …has changed his/her opinion after a discussion.

items.t: …would like to become a lawyer or a judge.
items.q: Would you like to become a lawyer or a judge?

items.t: …has watched a film or a TV series about a court case.
items.q: Have you ever watched a film or a TV series about a court case?

items.t: …thinks school rules in Uzbekistan are too strict.
items.q: Do you think school rules in Uzbekistan are too strict?

items.t: …has taken part in a debate competition.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a debate competition?

items.t: …always makes a plan before writing an essay.
items.q: Do you always make a plan before writing an essay?

items.t: …keeps a notebook of useful collocations.
items.q: Do you keep a notebook of useful collocations?

items.t: …believes that most offenders can change.
items.q: Do you believe that most offenders can change?

items.t: …has received feedback on his/her writing from a teacher.
items.q: Have you ever received feedback on your writing from a teacher?

items.t: …knows the four Task 2 marking criteria by heart.
items.q: Do you know the four Task 2 marking criteria by heart?

36.title: Speaking cards: writing, rules and punishment
36.stage: Namuna essay tahlilidan oldin: jinoyat va jazo mavzusida fikr yig'ish (12 daqiqa)
36.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 (yozish, qoidalar) va Part 3 (jinoyat va jazo) savollariga 'fikr + sabab + misol' zanjiri bilan javob berish — Task 2 uchun g'oya yig'ish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: aniq fikr + sabab + misol (Task 2 dagi 'fikr, sababi, misoli' zanjiri).

Darsdagi so'zlar ishlatilsa (In my view, offence, deterrent, rehabilitation) — +1 bonus.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

36.title: Sentence Race: Task 2 rules and thesis sentences
36.stage: '4 ta savol turi' va 1–2-mashqlardan keyin tezkor mustahkamlash (8 daqiqa)
36.goal: Task 2 qoidalari va pozitsiya (thesis) gaplarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish: twice as many marks as, one main idea, In my view.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.

36.title: Quiz Board: Writing Task 2 basics
36.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror, uyga vazifadan oldin (15 daqiqa)
36.goal: 4 savol turi, 4 mezon va 7.0 talabi, tipik xatolar va mavzu bo'yicha fikr aytishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Criteria 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Fix the error' da gap to'liq to'g'rilab o'qiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: 'To what extent do you agree or disagree?' — which question type?
'Discuss both these views.' Do you have to give your own opinion?
qs.a: No — present both views (a conclusion is still needed).

qs.q: 'Why is this happening, and what can be done about it?' — which type?
In an OPINION + DISCUSSION essay, where must your opinion appear?
qs.a: In the introduction and in the conclusion.

qs.q: Why is choosing the wrong question type so costly?
qs.a: The question is not answered: Task Response can fall to 5.0.

qs.q: How much of the Task 2 score is each criterion worth?
Which criterion checks paragraphing and linking?
'do a decision' instead of 'make a decision' — which criterion?
Band 7 grammar: are error-free sentences rare or frequent?
Explain 'a tendency to over-generalise' in simple words.
qs.a: Some ideas are too general, without enough detail.

qs.q: Crime have increased in recent years.
qs.a: Crime has increased in recent years.

qs.q: The judge gave him a hard punishment.
qs.a: The judge gave him a harsh / severe punishment.

qs.q: This essay will discuss about both views.
qs.a: This essay will discuss both views.

qs.q: Criminals should be punished strict.
Nowadays, crime rate is rising in many cities.
qs.a: Nowadays, the crime rate is rising in many cities.

qs.q: Say the three key facts about Task 2.
qs.a: 250+ words, about 40 minutes, twice the marks of Task 1.

qs.q: Say one sentence about crime with 'act as a deterrent'.
qs.a: e.g. Heavy fines act as a deterrent to careless drivers.

qs.q: Explain the difference between 'retribution' and 'rehabilitation'.
qs.a: Retribution = payback; rehabilitation = helping offenders change.

qs.q: Give your opinion on fixed punishments in one sentence starting 'I would argue that…'.

37.title: Grammar Auction: Band 6 or Band 7? (university subjects)
37.stage: A essaydagi kamchiliklar tahlilidan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: Band 6 essaylarga xos xatolarni (3-shaxs -s, artikl, sifat darajasi, ko'plik, birikma, noto'g'ri bog'lovchi) topish, tuzatish va qaysi mezonni tushirishini aytish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Barcha gaplar bugungi mavzuda: talaba fanni o'zi tanlashi kerakmi.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap xatosizmi (Band 7 essayga yaraydi) yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA xato qaysi mezonni (CC, LR yoki GRA) tushirishini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: A graduate who studies engineering usually finds work quickly.
items.why: 'who studies' — birlik ega, -s bor; 'find work' artiklsiz to'g'ri (work sanalmaydi).

items.s: A student who choose history can still build a successful career.
items.fix: A student who chooses history can still build a successful career.
items.why: 'who' birlik 'student'ga ishora qiladi — fe'lga -s kerak (GRA).

items.s: Many science graduates find job soon after university.
items.fix: Many science graduates find jobs soon after university.
items.why: 'job' sanaladigan ot: a job / jobs yoki 'find work' (GRA — artikl xatosi).

items.s: Students who study what they enjoy tend to give up less easily.
items.why: Fikr aniq va to'g'ri: 'tend to' + fe'l, 'give up less easily'.

items.s: Young people are more happy when they choose their own course.
items.fix: Young people are happier when they choose their own course.
items.why: happy → happier; 'more happy' — Band 6 dagi oddiy gap xatosi (GRA).

items.s: Without enough doctors, a country's healthcare system quickly deteriorates.
items.why: 'Without' bilan qisqa shart — Band 7 qurilishi; 'deteriorate' aniq so'z.

items.s: Countries without engineers will face many problem in the future.
items.fix: Countries without engineers will face many problems in the future.
items.why: 'many' dan keyin ko'plik: problems (GRA).

items.s: For many parents, job security matters more than personal interest.
items.why: 'job security' — to'g'ri birikma; 'matters more than' — birlik ega bilan -s, qiyoslash to'g'ri.

items.s: Some students do a mistake when they choose a course only for the money.
items.fix: Some students make a mistake when they choose a course only for the money.
items.why: Birikma: make a mistake, 'do' emas (LR).

items.s: In my view, the final decision should be left to the student.
items.why: Aniq pozitsiya (TR) va to'g'ri passiv: should be left to.

items.s: Many teenagers love art; moreover, their parents want them to study medicine.
items.fix: Many teenagers love art; however, their parents want them to study medicine.
items.why: Bu yerda qarama-qarshilik bor — 'however'; 'moreover' qo'shimcha fikr uchun (CC).

items.s: Scholarships can make shortage subjects more attractive to school leavers.
items.why: make + ot + sifat; 'attractive to' — to'g'ri predlog.

37.title: Board Game: Score it like an examiner
37.stage: Keyingi darsning boshida 36–37-darslar takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: 4 mezon (TR, CC, LR, GRA) bo'yicha kamchilikni aniqlash, umumiy ballni hisoblash, tekshiruv savollarini eslash va Band 6 gapni Band 7 ga ko'tarish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: mezonni aytadi, ballni hisoblaydi, gapni tuzatadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Ball hisoblash qoidasi: to'rt mezon qo'shilib 4 ga bo'linadi; .25 va .75 pastga yaxlitlanadi (6.75 → 6.5, 7.25 → 7.0).
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the four Writing Task 2 criteria.
squares.a: Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy

squares.t: What does Lexical Resource check?
squares.a: The range and accuracy of vocabulary: word choice, collocations, spelling.

squares.t: Overall band? TR 6, CC 6, LR 6, GRA 6
Which criterion? 'A student who study art…'
squares.a: GRA — no third-person -s (who studies).

squares.t: Overall band? TR 7, CC 7, LR 6, GRA 6
Give one check question for Task Response.
squares.a: e.g. Did I answer every part of the question?

squares.t: Which criterion? Every paragraph starts with 'Moreover'.
squares.a: CC — mechanical, repetitive linking.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: should students choose any subject they like?
squares.a: e.g. I believe they should, because real interest keeps students motivated.

squares.t: Correct: 'Engineers find job easily.'
squares.a: Engineers find jobs easily. / Engineers find work easily.

squares.t: Which criterion? The word 'important' appears five times.
squares.a: LR — repetition shows a narrow range of vocabulary.

squares.t: Overall band? TR 7, CC 7, LR 7, GRA 6
squares.a: 6.5 (27 ÷ 4 = 6.75, rounded down)

squares.t: Give one check question for Coherence and Cohesion.
squares.a: e.g. Does each paragraph have one clear main idea?

squares.t: Which criterion? The essay has only 190 words.
squares.a: TR — an essay under 250 words is penalised.

squares.t: Give one check question for Lexical Resource.
squares.a: e.g. Did I avoid repeating the same word? Are my collocations correct?

squares.t: Which criterion? The conclusion says 'It depends on the situation.'
squares.a: TR — the writer's position is unclear.

squares.t: Explain: why can one weak criterion lower the whole band?
squares.a: The band is the average of all four criteria.

squares.t: Correct: 'Doctors get good salary.'
squares.a: Doctors get a good salary. / Doctors earn good salaries.

squares.t: Which criterion? An idea is given, but with no reason or example.
squares.a: TR — the idea is not developed.

squares.t: Upgrade: 'Students are more happy when they choose.'
squares.a: e.g. Students are happier and more motivated when they choose freely.

squares.t: Overall band? TR 5, CC 7, LR 7, GRA 7
squares.a: 6.5 (26 ÷ 4) — one weak criterion pulls the band down.

squares.t: Give one check question for Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
squares.a: e.g. Do I use a variety of complex sentences, and are most of them error-free?

squares.t: Upgrade with 'Without…': 'If there are no doctors, people suffer.'
squares.a: e.g. Without enough doctors, public health quickly suffers.

squares.t: Name two differences between a Band 6 and a Band 7 essay.
squares.a: e.g. Band 7: ideas fully developed, natural linking, mostly error-free complex sentences.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: idea + reason + example about studying history.
squares.a: e.g. History is valuable because it trains research skills; for example, …

37.title: Dominoes: from Band 6 to Band 7 phrases
37.stage: B essay bilan solishtirishdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: Band 6 dagi zaif yoki xato iborani (find job, get good salary, I think that maybe…) uning Band 7 variantiga ulash — LR va GRA qanday ko'tarilishini ko'rish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida Band 6 ibora bor — shu iboraning Band 7 varianti qaysi toshning chap tomonida ekanini toping va ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har juftda nima yaxshilanganini aytadi (artikl, aniq so'z, aniq pozitsiya…).
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

37.title: Taboo: marking criteria and university words
37.stage: Dars boshida, '4 mezon' takrorlanayotganda (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: Baholash mezonlari atamalari (coherence, collocation, topic sentence…) va essay mavzusidagi so'zlarni (scholarship, internship, tuition fees) inglizcha tushuntira olish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Aniq ta'rif + misol bergan tushuntiruvchiga ustoz +1 bonus berishi mumkin (TR dagi 'fikr + misol' kabi).
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

37.title: Find someone who… has received a band score
37.stage: Tekshiruv savollari yozilgandan keyin, harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: O'qish, fan tanlash va yozish tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va javobni sabab bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever received a band score for a practice essay?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' yoki 'What happened?' deb qo'shimcha savol beradi; javob kamida bitta sabab yoki misol bilan bo'lishi kerak.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

37.title: Speaking cards: choosing a degree and being assessed
37.stage: A essay baholangandan keyin: TR talabi — fikr, sabab, misol — og'zaki (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: Fan tanlash, kasb va baholash mavzusida aniq fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish — Task Response talabini og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–5 gap bilan javob beradi: aniq fikr, sabab va misol bo'lishi shart.
Savol bergan o'quvchi 'examiner' bo'ladi: fikr aniqmi? +1; sabab bormi? +1; misol bormi? +1.
'It depends' deb javob tugatilsa, ball berilmaydi — pozitsiyani aniq aytish kerak.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

37.title: Sentence Race: Band 7 sentences
37.stage: '6 dan 7 ga' xatboshini qayta yozishdan oldin (8 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: Band 7 darajadagi gaplarni (aniq pozitsiya, sifatlovchi ergash gap, passiv, 'Without…') so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzib yig'ish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf va nuqta-vergul tartibga yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap qaysi mezonga yordam berishini (TR, CC, LR, GRA) aytsa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The examiner gives a score for each of the four criteria.
One weak criterion can lower the overall band.
In my view, students should be free to choose their course.
A clear position must be stated in both the introduction and the conclusion.
Every idea should be supported by a reason and an example.
Students who follow their own interests achieve better results.
Without enough engineers, a country cannot maintain its infrastructure.
Starting every paragraph with 'Moreover' lowers the score for Coherence and Cohesion.
Paid internships would encourage more students to choose engineering.
Essays shorter than 250 words lose marks for Task Response.

37.title: Quiz Board: criteria, band maths and upgrades
37.stage: Dars oxirida, uyga vazifadan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
37.goal: Kamchilikni mezonga bog'lash, umumiy ballni hisoblash, Band 6 xatolarini tuzatish va aniq pozitsiya bilan gapirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Band maths 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Band maths' da .25 va .75 pastga yaxlitlanadi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' savollarida javob to'liq gap bilan va aniq pozitsiya bilan bo'lishi kerak; ustoz baholaydi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

38.title: Grammar Auction: good or bad paraphrase? (tourism)
38.stage: 'Yomon paraphrase belgilari' bosqichida, 4-mashqdan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
38.goal: Paraphrase qilingan gaplardagi xavfli sinonim (amount, alien), noto'g'ri birikma (popular for, rise of) va passiv/so'z turkumi xatosini topib tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Hamma gaplar turizm va kichik shaharlar mavzusidagi paraphrase lar.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: paraphrase xatosizmi yoki unda bitta xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va xato turini (xavfli sinonim, birikma yoki grammatika) aytgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Heritage sites across the country now attract a growing number of visitors.
items.why: Ega almashgan (sites attract …); 'a growing number of' + sanaladigan ot — to'g'ri.

items.s: The amount of foreign tourists visiting small towns has grown.
items.fix: The number of foreign tourists visiting small towns has grown.
items.why: 'amount' sanalmaydigan ot bilan; tourists sanaladi — 'the number of'.

items.s: It is often argued that public museums should not charge for entry.
items.why: Shaxssiz passiv: 'Some people say' → 'It is often argued that'.

items.s: Many alien visitors now come to provincial towns.
items.fix: Many foreign visitors now come to provincial towns.
items.why: Xavfli sinonim: 'alien' — begona jonzot ma'nosi; odam uchun 'foreign'.

items.s: Smaller communities are now attracting many more visitors than before.
items.why: Ega almashgan (towns → communities), qiyoslash to'g'ri: many more … than before.

items.s: Historic town centres have become very popular for tourists.
items.fix: Historic town centres have become very popular with tourists.
items.why: Birikma: popular WITH somebody ('for' emas).

items.s: Two new guest houses were build near the old fortress last year.
items.fix: Two new guest houses were built near the old fortress last year.
items.why: Passiv = be + V3: were build → were built.

items.s: The restoration of old caravanserais should be a priority for the authorities.
items.why: Fe'l otga aylangan: restore → the restoration of; 'a priority for' — to'g'ri.

items.s: There has been a significant rise of visitor numbers.
items.fix: There has been a significant rise in visitor numbers.
items.why: rise / increase / growth + IN (nimada o'sish), 'of' emas.

items.s: Although tourism brings income, it puts pressure on historic towns.
items.why: 'but' → 'Although': ergash gap oldinga chiqqan, vergul to'g'ri.

items.s: The noise causing by tourist coaches disturbs local residents.
items.fix: The noise caused by tourist coaches disturbs local residents.
items.why: Passiv ma'no (avtobuslar keltirgan shovqin) — V3: caused by, '-ing' emas.

items.s: Visitor spending at local markets has increased considerably.
items.why: 'Tourists spend' → 'Visitor spending': fe'l otga, sinonim ham ishlatilgan.

38.title: Board Game: Paraphrase your way to FINISH
38.stage: 'Uchalasini birlashtirish' bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
38.goal: Uch yo'l bilan paraphrase qilish: sinonim, so'z turkumi, gap qurilishi; xavfli sinonimni tanish va turizm mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: sinonim aytadi, gapni qayta quradi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Paraphrase da ma'no o'zgarmasligi va savoldagi kalit so'z takrorlanmasligi kerak. Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato javob yoki xavfli sinonim ('alien', 'amount of tourists') — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the three ways to paraphrase.
squares.a: Synonym, word form, sentence structure.

squares.t: Give a safe synonym for 'tourists'.
squares.a: visitors / travellers / holidaymakers

squares.t: Give a safe synonym for 'governments'.
squares.a: the authorities / policymakers / local councils

squares.t: Safe or risky? 'alien tourists'
squares.a: Risky — 'alien' suggests a creature from space; say 'foreign visitors'.

squares.t: Why are words copied from the question a problem?
squares.a: They are not counted and earn no marks.

squares.t: Verb → noun: 'The number of visitors has increased.'
squares.a: There has been an increase in the number of visitors.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: is tourism good for small towns?
squares.a: e.g. On the whole it is, because visitors spend money in local businesses.

squares.t: Correct: 'the amount of tourists'
squares.a: the number of tourists (tourists are countable)

squares.t: Which words should you NOT change? Give two examples.
squares.a: Names, numbers and key terms, e.g. environment, technology.

squares.t: Active → passive: 'Local families run these cafes.'
squares.a: These cafes are run by local families.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Some people say that…'
squares.a: It is often argued that… / It is sometimes claimed that…

squares.t: Safe or risky? 'little cities' for 'small towns'
squares.a: Risky — not a natural collocation; say 'smaller towns' or 'provincial towns'.

squares.t: Use 'Although': 'Tourism creates jobs, but it raises prices.'
squares.a: Although tourism creates jobs, it raises prices.

squares.t: Give three ways to refer to 'tourists' later in an essay.
squares.a: e.g. visitors, travellers, they / this group

squares.t: Verb → noun: 'We must preserve local traditions.'
squares.a: e.g. The preservation of local traditions is essential.

squares.t: Correct: 'Old towns are popular for tourists.'
squares.a: Old towns are popular with tourists.

squares.t: How long should you spend on the paraphrase in the exam?
squares.a: About 3 minutes.

squares.t: Clause → noun phrase: 'Because tourism grew fast, …'
squares.a: Due to the rapid growth of tourism, …

squares.t: What must you check after you paraphrase?
squares.a: That the meaning has not changed: cover the question and reread your sentence.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Many families now go on holiday abroad.'
squares.a: e.g. Foreign holidays are now common for a large number of families.

squares.t: Why is a wrong synonym worse than repeating a word?
squares.a: It adds a new error and can change the meaning (LR and TR fall).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Visitors buy a lot of local crafts.'
squares.a: e.g. There is strong demand for local handicrafts among visitors.

squares.t: Paraphrase with all 3 ways: 'More people visit museums today.'
squares.a: e.g. There has been a rise in museum attendance.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should historic centres limit tourist coaches?
squares.a: e.g. I believe they should, because narrow streets quickly become congested.

38.title: Find someone who… has stayed in a guest house
38.stage: Dars boshida, kirish bosqichida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
38.goal: Sayohat, turizm va so'z o'rganish tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va javobni kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
