'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where? When? What was it like?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi; natijalarni sinfga aytganda bitta gapni paraphrase qilib aytadi (masalan: visited → has been to).

items.t: …has visited a small town as a tourist this year.
items.q: Have you visited a small town as a tourist this year?

items.t: …has stayed in a guest house.
items.q: Have you ever stayed in a guest house?

items.t: …lives in a town that gets a lot of visitors.
items.q: Do you live in a town that gets a lot of visitors?

items.t: …has bought a handmade souvenir.
items.q: Have you ever bought a handmade souvenir?

items.t: …has shown foreign visitors around his/her city.
items.q: Have you ever shown foreign visitors around your city?

items.t: …uses a dictionary of synonyms.
items.q: Do you use a dictionary of synonyms?

items.t: …has used the wrong synonym in an essay.
items.q: Have you ever used the wrong synonym in an essay?

items.t: …would like to work in tourism.
items.q: Would you like to work in tourism?

items.t: …thinks tourists should pay an extra tax.
items.q: Do you think tourists should pay an extra tax?

items.t: …has been stuck in traffic because of tourist coaches.
items.q: Have you ever been stuck in traffic because of tourist coaches?

items.t: …can do a traditional craft, e.g. embroidery.
items.q: Can you do a traditional craft, such as embroidery?

items.t: …has visited Khiva, Bukhara or Shahrisabz.
items.q: Have you ever visited Khiva, Bukhara or Shahrisabz?

38.title: Speaking cards: paraphrase the question, then answer
38.stage: Zaif kirish tuzatilgandan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
38.goal: Turizm va kichik shaharlar mavzusida gapirish; javobni savolni o'z so'zi bilan qayta aytishdan boshlash (paraphrase ni og'zaki mashq qilish).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi avval savolni o'z so'zi bilan qayta aytadi (masalan: 'So, you're asking whether…'), keyin 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi.
Savol bergan o'quvchi ball qo'yadi: paraphrase da savolning kalit so'zi takrorlanmasa +1, javobda sabab yoki misol bo'lsa +1.
Xavfli sinonim ishlatilsa ('alien', 'amount of people') — paraphrase uchun ball berilmaydi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do many tourists visit your hometown? Where do they usually go?
What would you show a foreign visitor in your town?
Do you prefer visiting big cities or small towns? Why?
How does tourism help small towns in Uzbekistan?
What problems can large numbers of tourists cause for local people?
Should local people decide how tourism is managed in their town? Why?
Is it better to spend public money on old buildings or on new housing?
Why do tourists like buying handmade souvenirs?
How can traditional crafts survive in the modern world?
Should tourists pay more than local people to enter historic sites?
How might tourism in Uzbekistan change in the next ten years?
When you learn a new English word, do you also learn its synonyms? How?
Why is it difficult to explain something in your own words in English?
Do you often repeat the same words when you speak English? How can you avoid it?

38.title: Sentence Race: paraphrased statements
38.stage: 3-yo'l (gap qurilishi) bosqichidan keyin, 4-mashqdan oldin (8 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
38.goal: Paraphrase qilingan gaplarni (shaxssiz passiv, 'There has been a rise in…', passiv, 'Although…', 'Due to…') so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzib yig'ish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf va tinish belgilari tartibga yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball. Gapda qaysi yo'l ishlatilganini (sinonim, so'z turkumi, gap qurilishi) aytsa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: It is widely believed that entry to museums should be free.
There has been a sharp rise in the number of foreign visitors.
Provincial towns are welcoming a growing number of international visitors.
These guest houses are run by the families who own them.
Although tourism creates jobs, residents suffer from congestion.
Due to the rapid growth of tourism, house prices have risen.
Public spending on the restoration of historic buildings has increased.
Visitors from abroad often stay in family-run guest houses.
The benefits of tourism clearly outweigh its costs.
Local councils should limit the number of coaches in historic centres.

38.title: Quiz Board: three ways to paraphrase
38.stage: Dars oxirida, uyga vazifadan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
38.goal: Paraphrase ning uch yo'lini, xavfsiz va xavfli sinonimni, so'z turkumi va gap qurilishini o'zgartirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Change it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' savollarida boshqa to'g'ri paraphrase ham qabul qilinadi — asosiysi ma'no saqlansin va savol so'zlari ko'chirilmasin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Name the three ways to paraphrase.
How long should the paraphrase take in the exam?
'has increased' → 'there has been an increase': which way?
'Some people say' → 'It is often argued': which way?
Why do words copied from the question not help your score?
qs.a: They are not counted, so they earn no marks.

qs.q: 'visitors' instead of 'tourists' — safe or risky?
What is wrong with 'alien tourists'?
qs.a: 'alien' suggests a creature from space; say 'foreign tourists'

qs.q: Correct it: 'the amount of tourists'
Correct it: 'little cities' (for 'small towns')
Why is 'politicians' a risky synonym for 'governments'?
qs.a: Politicians are people; a government is an institution.

qs.q: Make it passive: Local weavers make these carpets.
qs.a: These carpets are made by local weavers.

qs.q: Verb → noun: The number of visitors has risen.
qs.a: There has been a rise in the number of visitors.

qs.q: Use 'Although': Tourism brings money, but it causes traffic.
qs.a: Although tourism brings money, it causes traffic.

qs.q: Adjective → noun: It is important to support small museums.
qs.a: e.g. Support for small museums is of great importance.

qs.q: Clause → noun phrase: Because prices rose quickly, …
qs.a: Due to the rapid rise in prices, …

qs.q: Give two synonyms for 'tourists'.
Give two ways to say 'governments'.
Paraphrase: Many tourists visit Samarkand every year.
qs.a: e.g. Samarkand attracts large numbers of visitors annually.

qs.q: Paraphrase: Some people think tourism harms local culture.
qs.a: e.g. It is often claimed that tourism damages local traditions.

qs.q: Paraphrase with all 3 ways: Fewer young people learn traditional crafts today.
qs.a: e.g. Traditional crafts now attract fewer young learners.

39.title: Language Auction: positions and reasons
39.stage: 'Pozitsiya va ikkita chuqur sabab'dan keyin, 'jonli namuna'dan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Pozitsiya va sabab gaplarida (shahar va transport mavzusi) Band 5–6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: I am agree, in my point of view, because / because of, invest in, has + V3, more + -er.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Bu gaplar — reja qatorlaridan chiqqan pozitsiya va sabab gaplari. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart: I am agree, in my point of view, because of + gap, invest on, has became yoki more safer.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I largely agree that city centres should be closed to private cars.
items.why: agree that + gap; 'largely' pozitsiya darajasini aniq ko'rsatadi.

items.s: I am agree that public transport should be free for everyone.
items.fix: I agree that public transport should be free for everyone.
items.why: agree — fe'l, oldiga 'am' qo'yilmaydi: I agree.

items.s: In my point of view, cycle lanes are a better investment than new roads.
items.fix: From my point of view, cycle lanes are a better investment than new roads.
items.why: To'g'ri ibora: from my point of view (yoki in my view).

items.s: The main cause of congestion is that most commuters drive alone.
items.why: The main cause is that + gap — sabab aniq, ega va kesim moslashgan.

items.s: Many families move to the suburbs because of housing there is cheaper.
items.fix: Many families move to the suburbs because housing there is cheaper.
items.why: because + gap (ega + fe'l); because of dan keyin faqat ot keladi.

items.s: Governments should invest more money on cycle lanes.
items.fix: Governments should invest more money in cycle lanes.
items.why: invest (money) IN something — 'on' emas.

items.s: A bus that comes every forty minutes cannot serve commuters with fixed working hours.
items.why: Chuqur sabab: aniq mexanizm (40 daqiqa) va natija; grammatika to'g'ri.

items.s: In my view, the advantages of this development outweigh its disadvantages.
items.why: outweigh — predlogsiz o'timli fe'l; its — development ga qaytadi.

items.s: Working from home has became more common in many countries.
items.fix: Working from home has become more common in many countries.
items.why: Present Perfect: has + V3 — become (became — V2).

items.s: Parks are free, so they are used by people of all ages and incomes.
items.why: so — natija bog'lovchisi; passiv 'are used' to'g'ri.

items.s: Closing streets to cars makes the city centre more safer for pedestrians.
items.fix: Closing streets to cars makes the city centre safer for pedestrians.
items.why: Qisqa sifat: safer; 'more' va '-er' birga ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: One advantage of shopping centres is that they create jobs for local people.
items.why: One advantage of + ko'plik ot + is that + gap — to'g'ri tuzilma.

39.title: Board Game: Plan before you write
39.stage: 'Rejadan essayga: namuna essay'dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Reja qoidalari (5 daqiqa, uch belgi, KEYWORD), INSTRUCTION → skelet, pozitsiyani oldindan tanlash, 'nega?' usuli bilan fikrni chuqurlashtirish va transport mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: reja qoidasini aytadi, INSTRUCTION ga skelet topadi, fikrni 'Why?' bilan chuqurlashtiradi yoki 20 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many minutes should you spend planning a Task 2 essay?
squares.a: About five (5 plan + 30 write + 5 check).

squares.t: Name the three marks you put on a Task 2 question.
squares.a: TOPIC, KEYWORD and INSTRUCTION.

squares.t: Does the examiner give marks for your plan?
squares.a: No — the examiner may see it, but only the essay is marked.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how do you usually get to school or work?
squares.a: e.g. I usually take the metro because it is fast and cheap.

squares.t: Which of the three marks do students lose most often?
squares.a: The KEYWORD — the words that limit the topic.

squares.t: Find the KEYWORD: 'Should city centres be closed to private cars?'
squares.a: city centres (not the whole city) + closed (not just reduced).

squares.t: 'To what extent do you agree or disagree?' — what does the essay need?
squares.a: One clear position, two reasons and the same position in the conclusion.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'traffic congestion'
squares.a: e.g. heavy traffic / crowded roads / traffic jams

squares.t: Should you write your plan in Uzbek or in English? Why?
squares.a: In English keywords — so you don't translate while writing.

squares.t: 'Discuss both views and give your opinion' — what goes where?
squares.a: Body 1: view 1; Body 2: view 2; your opinion in the intro and conclusion.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: is your city good for cyclists?
squares.a: e.g. Not really — there are few cycle lanes and the traffic is fast.

squares.t: Is 'It depends' a position? Why or why not?
squares.a: No — it answers nothing. Say which part you agree with and on what condition.

squares.t: Ask 'Why?' twice to deepen this idea: 'Buses are slow.'
squares.a: e.g. Buses come every 40 minutes, so people with fixed hours drive.

squares.t: Give two reasons why many people drive instead of taking the bus.
squares.a: e.g. Buses are infrequent, and the stops are far from home.

squares.t: 'Causes and problems' question — what do Body 1 and Body 2 cover?
squares.a: Body 1: the causes; Body 2: the problems. Both parts are required.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'make all public transport free'
squares.a: e.g. remove fares from buses and trains completely

squares.t: Five weak ideas or two deep reasons — which scores higher? Why?
squares.a: Two deep reasons: each has a reason, an example and a result.

squares.t: Is 'Body 1: pollution' an idea or just a topic? Improve it.
squares.a: A topic. e.g. Short car trips in town pollute most per kilometre.

squares.t: When should you choose your position — before or while writing?
squares.a: Before — otherwise the intro and the conclusion may contradict each other.

squares.t: 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' — what is essential?
squares.a: Both sides AND a clear answer on which side is heavier.

squares.t: Why are many families leaving city centres for the suburbs?
squares.a: e.g. Homes there are cheaper and bigger, and remote work makes it possible.

squares.t: Name the four lines of a Task 2 plan.
squares.a: Position / Body 1 idea / Body 2 idea / Conclusion.

squares.t: Test the plan line 'Body 1: cost'. Say three sentences from it.
squares.a: e.g. Fares are costly. Drivers compare them with petrol. Free travel changes that.

squares.t: Make a 4-line plan aloud: 'Should city parks become shopping centres?'
squares.a: e.g. No / only free space for families in flats / trees clean the air / build shops elsewhere

39.title: Dominoes: instruction words, plan rules, deep reasons
39.stage: 'INSTRUCTION so'zi va essay skeleti' bosqichida, 2-mashqdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: INSTRUCTION so'zini essay skeletiga, reja qoidasini uning sababiga, yuzaki fikrni 'nega?' javobiga (chuqur sababga) ulash — gap boshi va oxiri mantiqan va grammatik mos bo'lishi kerak.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi (masalan, An 'agree or disagree' question needs) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi davomga mos kelsa, o'sha toshni ulang.
Zanjirda uch xil juftlik bor: INSTRUCTION → skelet, reja qoidasi → sababi, transport haqidagi fikr → uning chuqur sababi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: one position and two reasons that support it.
A 'discuss both views + opinion' question needs
each view in its own paragraph, plus yours.
a paragraph on why it happens and one on results.
every problem paired with a matching solution.
both sides and a verdict on which is heavier.
Out of the forty minutes, planning takes
about five, and checking takes another five.
Write your plan in English keywords
so that you don't translate while writing.
A plan line is still only a topic
if you can't get three sentences out of it.
Choose your position before you write,
or your intro and conclusion may contradict each other.
Free buses would take cars off the road
because price keeps many drivers behind the wheel.
A cheap ticket won't attract a commuter
if the bus comes only every forty minutes.
Many families are leaving city centres
because suburban homes are bigger and cheaper.
Pedestrian streets often help local shops
because people on foot stop and buy more.
Cycling to work becomes a lasting habit
because it takes no extra time in the day.

39.title: Taboo: city, transport and planning words
39.stage: 'Takrorlash va kirish' bosqichida — mavzu so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Shahar va transport so'zlarini (congestion, commuter, suburbs, fare, subsidy, capacity…) va reja atamalarini (position, keyword, essay plan) inglizcha tushuntirish — essay rejasi uchun tayyor lug'at.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'commuter' uchun work, travel, every day).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Topilgan so'z bilan bitta reja qatorini aytgan jamoa yana +1 oladi (masalan: 'Body 1: fares — too costly for families').
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

39.title: Find someone who… has used a bike-sharing scheme
39.stage: 'Nega reja kerak' bosqichidan keyin, harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Shahar hayoti, transport va yozishdan oldin reja tuzish tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va 'Why?' bilan javobni chuqurlashtirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever used a bike-sharing scheme?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' deb ikki marta so'raydi — bu darsdagi 'nega?' usulining og'zaki mashqi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng chuqur javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has used a bike-sharing scheme.
items.q: Have you ever used a bike-sharing scheme?

items.t: …spends more than an hour a day travelling to school or work.
items.q: Do you spend more than an hour a day travelling to school or work?

items.t: …has been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour.
items.q: Have you ever been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour?

items.t: …would use the bus more often if it were free.
items.q: Would you use the bus more often if it were free?

items.t: …usually makes a plan before writing an essay.
items.q: Do you usually make a plan before writing an essay?

items.t: …has lived on the outskirts of a big city.
items.q: Have you ever lived on the outskirts of a big city?

items.t: …has taken the metro this week.
items.q: Have you taken the metro this week?

items.t: …thinks their city needs more cycle lanes.
items.q: Do you think your city needs more cycle lanes?

items.t: …has studied or worked from home for a whole month.
items.q: Have you ever studied or worked from home for a whole month?

items.t: …has changed their opinion halfway through writing an essay.
items.q: Have you ever changed your opinion halfway through writing an essay?

items.t: …walks to school or work most days.
items.q: Do you walk to school or work most days?

items.t: …has finished a Task 2 essay in under 40 minutes.
items.q: Have you ever finished a Task 2 essay in under 40 minutes?

39.title: Speaking cards: position + two deep reasons
39.stage: '4 qatorli reja: jonli namuna'dan keyin — og'zaki reja mashqi (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Shahar va transport savollariga og'zaki 'reja' bilan javob berish: aniq pozitsiya + ikkita sabab, har biri 'Why?' bilan chuqurlashtirilgan (IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 10 soniya o'ylaydi (ichida reja: pozitsiya + 2 sabab), keyin 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi.
Tinglovchi bitta sababga 'Why?' deb yana so'raydi. Aniq pozitsiya uchun +1, chuqurlashgan sabab uchun +1, misol uchun +1 ball.
'It depends' bilan tugagan javobga pozitsiya bali berilmaydi — qaysi qismiga rozi ekanini aytishi kerak.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How do you usually travel to school or work, and why?
Do you usually plan before you write something important? Why?
Is public transport in your city good? What would you change first?
Should public transport be free? Give your position and two reasons.
Why do many people prefer driving to taking the bus?
Should city centres be closed to private cars? Why or why not?
Why are many families moving from city centres to the suburbs?
What problems does heavy traffic cause in large cities?
Is cycling a realistic way to get around your city? Why or why not?
Should governments spend more on new roads or on cycle lanes and pavements?
Are city parks more important than new shopping centres? Why?
Is working from home a positive or a negative development?
How might transport in Uzbek cities change in the next twenty years?
What makes a city a good place to live, in your opinion?

39.title: Sentence Race: positions and plan rules
39.stage: 'Xulosa va uyga vazifa'dan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Pozitsiya gapi, reja qoidalari va chuqur sabab gaplarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish (I agree that…, before you…, unless…, because…, if…).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf, vergul va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap nima ekanini aytsa (pozitsiya, reja qoidasi yoki chuqur sabab) — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: I agree that private cars should be banned from city centres.
Your plan should take no more than five of the forty minutes.
Never ignore the keyword, or you will answer the wrong question.
Decide on your position before you start writing.
Each body paragraph should develop one reason with an example.
Free travel will fail unless buses run far more frequently.
Many families are moving to the suburbs because homes there are cheaper.
A cheap ticket is useless if the bus comes every forty minutes.
Can I write three or four sentences from this line?

39.title: Quiz Board: planning a Task 2 essay
39.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki 40-dars boshidagi 'Takrorlash' o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
39.goal: Savolni belgilash (TOPIC / KEYWORD / INSTRUCTION), INSTRUCTION → skelet, shahar va transport so'zlari va og'zaki reja tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'City words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob inglizcha, to'liq aytiladi; 'e.g.' javoblarda mazmunan to'g'ri variant qabul qilinadi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What three marks do you put on a Task 2 question?
Which mark tells you what the examiner wants you to do?
Name a KEYWORD: 'Working from home is rising quickly in some countries.'
Name a KEYWORD: 'City parks are being replaced by shopping centres.'
qs.a: city parks / are being replaced (happening now)

qs.q: Why does missing the KEYWORD cost so much?
qs.a: The essay answers the topic, not the question, so TR drops

qs.q: 'To what extent do you agree or disagree?' — how many positions?
'Discuss both views and give your opinion' — where does your opinion go?
qs.a: In the conclusion — ideally stated in the introduction too

qs.q: 'What are the causes, and what problems does it create?' — what do the two body paragraphs cover?
'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' — why is a list of both sides not enough?
qs.a: You must say which side is heavier

qs.q: 'Why is this happening, and is it positive or negative?' — how many parts must you answer?
qs.a: Two: the reasons + one clear judgement

qs.q: The money you pay for one bus or metro ride.
A person who travels to work every day.
Residential areas on the edge of a city.
Money a government pays to keep prices low.
The number of passengers a transport system can carry.
Give a one-line position: should buses be free?
qs.a: e.g. Mostly agree — but only if buses also run more often.

qs.q: Ask 'Why?' twice about 'Cycling is healthy' and say the deep reason.
qs.a: e.g. It builds exercise into the commute, so it takes no extra time.

qs.q: Turn the plan line 'Body 1: traffic' into a real idea.
qs.a: e.g. Solo drivers fill narrow central streets at rush hour.

qs.q: Roads or cycle lanes? Give one reason AND a short example.
qs.a: e.g. Lanes move more people per metre: one car lane rebuilt for bikes

qs.q: Say a full 4-line plan: should city centres be closed to private cars?
qs.a: e.g. Agree if buses first / space to walk / shops earn more / agree

40.title: Language Auction: paraphrase and thesis sentences
40.stage: Thesis bosqichidan keyin, 'Kirishga KIRMAYDIGAN to'rt narsa'dan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Kirish gaplarida (paraphrase va thesis, transport mavzusi) Band 5–6 xatolarini topish va tuzatish: ega-kesim moslashuvi, I am agree, a number of / the number of, although … but, is justified.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Har gap — kirishning 1-gapi (paraphrase) yoki 2-gapi (thesis). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart: has/have, I am agree, a number of + ko'plik, although … but, the number of + is, is + V3.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: A number of cities have recently banned private cars from their centres.
items.why: a number of + ko'plik ot + have; ban something from — to'g'ri.

items.s: Many city governments has closed their central streets to private cars.
items.fix: Many city governments have closed their central streets to private cars.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (governments) — have closed.

items.s: I largely agree with this view, because free fares would persuade many drivers to take the bus.
items.why: Thesis: aniq pozitsiya (largely agree) + sabab; grammatika to'g'ri.

items.s: I am strongly agree that cycle lanes are a better investment than wider roads.
items.fix: I strongly agree that cycle lanes are a better investment than wider roads.
items.why: agree — fe'l: I strongly agree ('am' ortiqcha).

items.s: Although new roads may ease traffic for a while, I believe better bus services are the long-term answer.
items.why: Although + gap, keyin bosh gap 'but'siz; ikki qarash va o'z fikri bitta gapda.

items.s: Commuting by bicycle is increasingly common in European cities.
items.why: Paraphrase: cycling to work → commuting by bicycle (so'z turkumi o'zgardi).

items.s: Private vehicles are now banned from a number of city centre.
items.fix: Private vehicles are now banned from a number of city centres.
items.why: a number of dan keyin ko'plik ot: city centres.

items.s: Although free travel would attract passengers, but higher fuel taxes would work better.
items.fix: Although free travel would attract passengers, higher fuel taxes would work better.
items.why: although va but bitta gapda birga ishlatilmaydi — 'but' olib tashlanadi.

items.s: Heavy traffic wastes countless working hours in major cities.
items.why: Paraphrase: 'congestion is a problem' aniq oqibat bilan qayta qurilgan.

items.s: City authorities ought to invest more heavily in trams and metro lines.
items.why: ought to + V1; invest in — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: The number of people who drive to work alone are rising every year.
items.fix: The number of people who drive to work alone is rising every year.
items.why: The number of … — birlik: is rising (a number of esa ko'plik).

items.s: In my view, closing central streets to cars is justify, because the air becomes cleaner.
items.fix: In my view, closing central streets to cars is justified, because the air becomes cleaner.
items.why: is + V3 (sifat/passiv): is justified.

40.title: Board Game: two sentences, four minutes
40.stage: 'Namuna essay kirishi'dan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Kirish qoidalari (2 gap, 4 daqiqa, 35–50 so'z), paraphrase (sinonim, so'z turkumi, gap qurilishi), savol turiga mos thesis va kirishga kirmaydigan to'rt narsani og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, iborani paraphrase qiladi, zaif gapning kamchiligini topadi yoki thesis aytadi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many sentences does a fast Task 2 introduction have?
squares.a: Two: a paraphrase and a thesis.

squares.t: How many minutes should the introduction take?
squares.a: About four.

squares.t: How long should an introduction be?
squares.a: About 35–50 words.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: what is traffic like in your city?
squares.a: e.g. It is heavy in the morning, especially near the centre.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'private cars'
squares.a: e.g. privately owned vehicles / personal cars

squares.t: What does sentence 1 do? And sentence 2?
squares.a: 1: paraphrases the question; 2: gives the thesis (the answer).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'cycling to work'
squares.a: e.g. commuting by bicycle / riding a bike to work

squares.t: What is wrong with: 'Nowadays, the world is changing very fast.'?
squares.a: An empty opener — it says nothing; start with the paraphrase.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'is becoming more popular'
squares.a: e.g. is increasingly common / is growing in popularity

squares.t: Why is 'In this essay I will discuss…' a weak sentence?
squares.a: It announces a plan but gives no answer — wasted words.

squares.t: Which topic words may you keep unchanged in a paraphrase?
squares.a: e.g. traffic, government, university — forced synonyms can change the meaning.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: should your city have more pedestrian streets?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — the centre is crowded, and walking streets help shops.

squares.t: What is wrong with: 'Congestion refers to too many cars on a road.'?
squares.a: A dictionary definition — the examiner knows the word; delete it.

squares.t: Opinion question: 'Buses should be free.' Give a thesis.
squares.a: e.g. I strongly agree, as free fares would take many cars off the road.

squares.t: What is wrong with: 'According to statistics, 78% of drivers…'?
squares.a: An invented figure with no source — write 'many drivers' instead.

squares.t: Change the structure: 'Many cities have closed their centres to cars.'
squares.a: e.g. Private cars have been banned from many city centres.

squares.t: Discussion question: what must the thesis show?
squares.a: Both views — you may also show which one is stronger.

squares.t: Is 'It depends on the country' a thesis? Why or why not?
squares.a: No — it takes no position, so Task Response stays low.

squares.t: Change the word form: 'Pollution is increasing in cities.'
squares.a: e.g. There has been an increase in urban pollution.

squares.t: Opinion + discussion question: what three things go in the thesis?
squares.a: View 1, view 2 and your own opinion.

squares.t: Problem–solution question: what does the thesis list?
squares.a: The main problems and the matching solutions — the body plan.

squares.t: Why must the position in the intro match the conclusion?
squares.a: A contradiction shows no clear position, so Task Response falls.

squares.t: Your intro has 70 words and took 8 minutes. What is the risk?
squares.a: Less time for the body — an unfinished essay lowers the score.

squares.t: Say a full 2-sentence intro: 'Should fuel be taxed more heavily?'
squares.a: e.g. Some argue that fuel taxes should rise. I agree, as this would cut car use.

40.title: Dominoes: question words and introduction paraphrases
40.stage: '1-gap: paraphrase' bosqichida, 1-mashqdan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Savoldagi iborani (private cars, cycling to work, the best way…) kirishdagi paraphrase'i bilan tez bog'lash — kirishning 1-gapini ko'chirmasdan yozish ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi SAVOL iborasi (masalan, 'private cars') chap tomonida uning paraphrase'i yozilgan toshga ulanadi ('privately owned vehicles').
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va 3 ta juftlikda qaysi yo'l ishlatilganini aytadi: sinonim, so'z turkumi yoki gap qurilishi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: the state ought to invest more heavily in
the benefits are greater than the drawbacks

40.title: Taboo: introductions and city transport
40.stage: 'Takrorlash va bugungi maqsad' bosqichida — isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Essay atamalari (thesis, paraphrase, synonym, definition, statistics) va transport so'zlarini (exhaust fumes, district, tram, congestion charge…) inglizcha tushuntirish — o'zi ham paraphrase mashqi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'thesis' uchun opinion, answer, position).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Ustoz eslatadi: taqiqlangan so'zni aylanib o'tish — aynan kirishdagi paraphrase ko'nikmasi. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

40.title: Find someone who… has written under a time limit
40.stage: '40 daqiqa qanday taqsimlanadi' bosqichidan keyin, harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Vaqt bilan yozish, kirish yozish odatlari va shahar transporti tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…? Can you…?).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever written an essay under a strict time limit?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (How long did it take? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani IKKI gapda aytadi: bitta fakt + o'z fikri (xuddi kirishdagidek).

items.t: …has written an essay under a strict time limit.
items.q: Have you ever written an essay under a strict time limit?

items.t: …often starts essays with 'Nowadays'.
items.q: Do you often start your essays with 'Nowadays'?

items.t: …can explain what a thesis statement is.
items.q: Can you explain what a thesis statement is?

items.t: …has visited a city with a car-free centre.
items.q: Have you ever visited a city with a car-free centre?

items.t: …has ridden a tram.
items.q: Have you ever ridden a tram?

items.t: …thinks petrol should be more expensive.
items.q: Do you think petrol should be more expensive?

items.t: …would pay a charge to drive into the city centre.
items.q: Would you pay a charge to drive into the city centre?

items.t: …knows three synonyms for 'problem'.
items.q: Do you know three synonyms for 'problem'?

items.t: …has written an introduction in under five minutes.
items.q: Have you ever written an introduction in under five minutes?

items.t: …gets to school or work in under 20 minutes.
items.q: Do you get to school or work in under 20 minutes?

items.t: …would prefer a pedestrian street to a car park near their home.
items.q: Would you prefer a pedestrian street to a car park near your home?

items.t: …has read a model IELTS essay this month.
items.q: Have you read a model IELTS essay this month?

40.title: Speaking cards: paraphrase first, then answer
40.stage: 5-mashq (taymer bilan uch raund) oldidan og'zaki isitish (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Og'zaki 'kirish': savolni o'z so'zi bilan qayta aytish (paraphrase), keyin aniq javob (thesis) va bitta sabab — transport va shahar hayoti mavzusida (IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javobni IKKI gap bilan boshlaydi: 1) savolni o'z so'zi bilan qayta aytadi, 2) aniq javob beradi; keyin bitta sabab qo'shadi.
Tinglovchi tekshiradi: savol so'zma-so'z ko'chirilmadi +1, aniq pozitsiya bor +1, 'Nowadays…' yoki 'It depends' yo'q +1.
Har javobga 40 soniya beriladi — vaqt tugasa gap yarim qolsa ham to'xtatiladi (5-mashqdagidek).
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: What is the best way to reduce traffic in your city?
Should public transport be free for students? Why or why not?
Would you like to live in a city centre without cars? Why?
Is cycling to work realistic in Uzbekistan? Why or why not?
Why do so many people drive to work alone?
Should drivers pay a charge to enter busy city centres?
Does building more roads solve traffic problems or create new ones?
How has transport in your town changed in the last ten years?
Is air pollution a serious problem where you live? What causes it?
Should cheap flights be taxed more heavily? Why or why not?
What makes public transport reliable, in your opinion?
Should cities spend more on metro lines or on buses? Why?
What do you find hardest about starting an essay?
Is walking in your city pleasant? What would make it better?

40.title: Sentence Race: fast introductions
40.stage: 'Xulosa va uyga vazifa'dan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Kirishning paraphrase gapi, thesis gapi va kirish qoidalarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish (passiv, Some argue that…, In my view…, but).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf, vergul va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap paraphrase'mi, thesismi yoki qoidami — aytsa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Cars are no longer allowed into the centres of many cities.
Commuting by bicycle has become increasingly common.
Some argue that city governments should make public transport free.
Heavy traffic wastes working hours, but better bus networks could reverse this trend.
In my view, closing central streets to private cars makes cities safer.
The first sentence of your introduction paraphrases the question.
Never begin an introduction with an invented statistic.
The thesis gives a direct answer to the question.
Forced synonyms can change the meaning of the question.

40.title: Quiz Board: incredibly fast introductions
40.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki 41-dars boshida 'Takrorlash' o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
40.goal: Kirish tuzilishi, paraphrase yo'llari, kirishga kirmaydigan to'rt narsa va savol turiga mos thesisni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the intro 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi ('Say it! 500' uchun — 60 soniya). 'e.g.' javoblarda mazmunan to'g'ri variant qabul qilinadi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many sentences are there in a fast Task 2 introduction?
How many minutes should you spend on the introduction?
What is the ideal length of an introduction in words?
Sentence 1 paraphrases the question. What does sentence 2 do?
qs.a: It gives the thesis — a direct answer to the question

qs.q: In which question types can a third sentence be justified?
Paraphrase: 'private cars'
Paraphrase: 'is becoming more popular'
qs.a: is increasingly common / is growing in popularity

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'the best way to reduce pollution'
qs.a: e.g. the most effective means of cutting pollution

qs.q: Change the structure: 'Many cities have banned cars from their centres.'
qs.a: e.g. Cars have been banned from the centres of many cities.

qs.q: Why should you NOT replace every word of the question?
qs.a: Forced synonyms can change the meaning and lower Lexical Resource

qs.q: 'Nowadays, the world is changing fast.' What is the problem?
'In this essay I will discuss both views.' Replace it with…
qs.a: A thesis that actually answers the question

qs.q: 'Congestion refers to too many cars on a road.' What is the problem?
qs.a: A dictionary definition — the examiner knows the word

qs.q: 'According to statistics, 80% of people agree.' Problem and fix?
qs.a: An invented figure — write 'many people' instead

qs.q: Intro: 'I agree.' Conclusion: 'It depends.' What goes wrong?
qs.a: The positions contradict, so Task Response falls

qs.q: Paraphrase aloud: 'Traffic is a big problem in cities.'
qs.a: e.g. Crowded roads are a major issue in many urban areas.

qs.q: Opinion thesis: 'Buses should be free. Agree or disagree?'
qs.a: e.g. I strongly agree, as free buses would take cars off the road.

qs.q: Discussion thesis: new roads or cycle lanes?
qs.a: e.g. Roads serve freight, while cycle lanes move more people cheaply.

qs.q: Problem–solution thesis: traffic is getting worse every year.
qs.a: e.g. It wastes time and harms health, but road charges could help.

qs.q: Say a full two-sentence intro in 60 seconds: 'Should all public transport be free?'
qs.a: e.g. Some want all fares scrapped. I agree: free travel cuts car use.

41.title: Paragraph Auction: topic sentence, explanation, example, link
41.stage: '2-mashq: topic sentence tekshiruvi'dan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: Body xatboshining to'rt harakatiga (Fikr, Tushuntirish, Misol, Bog'lash) oid gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: savol shaklidagi topic sentence, because / because of, although … but, which is why, fewer / less, fe'l moslashuvi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi — gap oldida uning harakati yozilgan (Topic sentence, Explanation, Example, Link). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap o'z vazifasini bajaradimi va grammatik to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart (masalan: 'savol — da'vo emas', 'because + gap', 'fewer + sanaladigan ot').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Topic sentence: Cheap parking is the main reason why so many people still drive into the centre.
items.why: Da'vo: rozi bo'lish yoki bo'lmaslik mumkin; bitta g'oya (arzon parkovka).

items.s: Topic sentence: Should cities make buses and trains free for everyone?
items.fix: Topic sentence: Cities should make buses and trains free for everyone.
items.why: Savol da'vo emas: topic sentence pozitsiyani aytadi.

items.s: Explanation: Many families keep driving because of the bus is slower than the car.
items.fix: Explanation: Many families keep driving because the bus is slower than the car.
items.why: because + ega + fe'l; because of + ot (because of traffic).

items.s: Explanation: Buses use the same crowded roads as cars, so a free ticket does not make the journey shorter.
items.why: Ikki qadamli zanjir: sabab (bir xil tirbandlik) → natija (so …).

items.s: Example: A nurse who finish her shift at one in the morning has no way home except a taxi.
items.fix: Example: A nurse who finishes her shift at one in the morning has no way home except a taxi.
items.why: Ega 3-shaxs birlikda (a nurse who …) — finishes.

items.s: Example: A clear case is a student in Chilanzar who spends an hour on the metro every morning.
items.why: Aniq odam, aniq joy, aniq harakat — to'g'ri misol.

items.s: Link: Buses are slower than cars, that is why free tickets alone change nothing.
items.fix: Link: Buses are slower than cars, which is why free tickets alone change nothing.
items.why: Vergul ikki gapni ulamaydi: ', which is why' yoki nuqta + 'That is why'.

items.s: Link: In this way, protected cycle lanes take short car trips off the roads.
items.why: 'In this way' fikrga qaytaradi; yangi g'oya qo'shilmagan.

items.s: Topic sentence: Although free travel is popular, but it cannot reduce congestion on its own.
items.fix: Topic sentence: Although free travel is popular, it cannot reduce congestion on its own.
items.why: although va but bir gapda birga kelmaydi — bittasi yetadi.

items.s: Link: As a result, there will be less cars in the city centre during rush hour.
items.fix: Link: As a result, there will be fewer cars in the city centre during rush hour.
items.why: Sanaladigan ot (cars) bilan fewer; less — sanalmaydigan ot bilan.

items.s: Explanation: This means that drivers must pay every time they bring a car into the centre.
items.why: 'This means that' fikr nega ishlashini ochadi (mexanizm).

items.s: Topic sentence: Night buses would stop many families from buying a second car.
items.why: Aniq da'vo; stop somebody from + V-ing to'g'ri.

41.title: Board Game: the four moves of a body paragraph
41.stage: '4-mashq: bog'lash gapi'dan keyin, 5-mashq oldidan og'zaki mashq (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: To'rt harakat (Fikr, Tushuntirish, Misol, Bog'lash) qoidalari, topic sentence testi, transport mavzusidagi paraphrase va og'zaki mini-xatboshi qurish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, gap qaysi harakat ekanini topadi, paraphrase beradi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
'Talk for…' kataklarida javobda to'rttala harakat bo'lsa (fikr, because, aniq misol, so/therefore) — yana 1 katak oldinga.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the four moves of a body paragraph.
squares.a: Topic sentence, explanation, example, link.

squares.t: How many main ideas go in one body paragraph?
squares.a: One. A second idea goes to a new paragraph or is dropped.

squares.t: Where does the topic sentence go?
squares.a: At the start — it is the first sentence of the paragraph.

squares.t: Say two words or phrases that start an explanation.
squares.a: e.g. This is because … / This means that … (also: because, so)

squares.t: Say two ways to introduce an example.
squares.a: e.g. For example, … / For instance, … / A clear case is …

squares.t: Say two ways to start a link sentence.
squares.a: e.g. Therefore, … / In this way, … / This is why …

squares.t: Paraphrase: traffic congestion
squares.a: e.g. heavy traffic / traffic jams / long queues of cars

squares.t: Paraphrase: private cars
squares.a: e.g. people's own vehicles / personal cars

squares.t: Topic sentence or not? 'Transport is a very important topic nowadays.'
squares.a: Not — it only announces the topic; nobody can agree or disagree with it.

squares.t: Topic sentence or not? 'Should cities charge drivers?'
squares.a: Not — it is a question, not a claim.

squares.t: Which move? 'This is because a bus in traffic saves nobody time.'
squares.a: Explanation (because + a reason).

squares.t: Which move? 'A nurse leaving work at 1 a.m. is a clear case.'
squares.a: Example (a specific person, time and situation).

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how do you get to school, university or work?
squares.a: e.g. I usually take the metro because it is faster than the bus at rush hour.

squares.t: Paraphrase: make public transport free
squares.a: e.g. remove bus and train fares / let passengers travel free of charge

squares.t: Turn it into a claim: 'I will talk about parking prices.'
squares.a: e.g. Higher parking prices would keep many cars out of the centre.

squares.t: Why is 'Many people do this' a weak example?
squares.a: It is too general: an example needs a specific person, place or action.

squares.t: Give a specific example for: 'People need night buses.'
squares.a: e.g. A nurse who finishes her shift at 1 a.m. has no bus home.

squares.t: Explain in two steps: why does cheap parking increase traffic?
squares.a: e.g. Parking is cheap, so more people drive; more cars mean longer queues.

squares.t: Say a link sentence for: 'Free buses get families out of cars.'
squares.a: e.g. Free fares therefore change the choice families make every morning.

squares.t: What happens if a paragraph ends with the example?
squares.a: The 'So what?' question stays open, and Task Response goes down.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: what is the worst traffic problem in your city?
squares.a: e.g. Rush-hour queues near the bazaar, because … For example, … So …

squares.t: Should you invent statistics for an example? Why?
squares.a: No. Fake numbers are risky; a specific person and situation are enough.

squares.t: Turn the question into a topic sentence: 'Should cities build more cycle lanes?'
squares.a: e.g. More cycle lanes would move many short trips from cars to bikes.

squares.t: Say a 4-move paragraph about night buses (claim, why, example, link).
squares.a: e.g. Night buses stop families buying cars. Late workers… A nurse at 1 a.m.… Therefore…

41.title: Dominoes: claim and specific example
41.stage: 'To'rt harakat tushuntiriladi' bosqichidan keyin, 1-mashq oldidan (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: Da'vo (topic sentence) va uni isbotlaydigan ANIQ misolni ulash: aniq odam, joy yoki harakat misolni fikrga qanday bog'lashini ko'rish (transport mavzusi).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi DA'VO (topic sentence) chap tomonida o'sha da'voning ANIQ MISOLI yozilgan toshga ulanadi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har juftda misolni da'voga nima bog'layotganini aytadi (masalan: '1 a.m.' = night buses); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Free fares pull families out of their cars.
A family of four now rides to the bazaar for free.
Night buses make a second car unnecessary.
A nurse finishing at 1 a.m. now gets home by bus.
Bus lanes make public transport faster.

Protected cycle lanes make parents feel safe.
A mother now lets her son cycle to school.

A student checks the app and leaves home just in time.
A café on a pedestrian street now fills every table.
New metro stations help outer districts.
A student in Sergeli now takes the metro to university.
Ride-sharing cuts the number of cars at rush hour.
Three colleagues now drive to the office in one car.

41.title: Taboo: city transport and traffic
41.stage: 'Kirish va takrorlash' bosqichida — transport so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: Shahar transporti so'zlarini (fare, commuter, congestion, frequency, reliability, bus lane…) boshqa so'zlar bilan tushuntirish; tushuntirishda aniq misol keltirish odatini shakllantirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'fare' uchun ticket, pay, price).
Aniq misol keltirish tavsiya etiladi, xuddi body xatboshidagidek (masalan: 'My father drives to his office every morning — he is a …' → commuter).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

41.title: Find someone who… has been stuck in a traffic jam
41.stage: Namuna essay muhokamasidan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: Transport va yo'l tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Do you…? Have you ever…? Would you…?) va javobni sabab hamda aniq misol bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' yoki 'What happened?' deb bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi — javob tushuntirish va misolga aylanadi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va bitta topilmani 3 gap bilan aytib beradi: da'vo, sabab, aniq misol.

items.t: …takes the metro at least three times a week.
items.q: Do you take the metro at least three times a week?

items.t: …has been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour.
items.q: Have you ever been stuck in a traffic jam for over an hour?

items.t: …walks or cycles to school, university or work.
items.q: Do you walk or cycle to school, university or work?

items.t: …has used a taxi app this month.
items.q: Have you used a taxi app this month?

items.t: …would stop using taxis if buses were free.
items.q: Would you stop using taxis if buses were free?

items.t: …has missed a lesson because of a late bus.
items.q: Have you ever missed a lesson because of a late bus?

items.t: …has travelled on the Afrosiyob high-speed train.
items.q: Have you ever travelled on the Afrosiyob high-speed train?

items.t: …spends more than an hour a day travelling.
items.q: Do you spend more than an hour a day travelling?

items.t: …thinks parking in the city centre should cost more.
items.q: Do you think parking in the city centre should cost more?

items.t: …is planning to get a driving licence this year.
items.q: Are you planning to get a driving licence this year?

items.t: …has written a body paragraph in English this week.
items.q: Have you written a body paragraph in English this week?

items.t: …can name a street in their city that is always congested.
items.q: Can you name a street in your city that is always congested?

41.title: Speaking cards: transport in four moves
41.stage: 'Doskada tekshirish' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida transport haqidagi javobni to'rt harakat bilan qurish: fikr, tushuntirish, aniq misol, bog'lash.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi to'rt harakat bilan javob beradi: 1) aniq fikr, 2) because / so bilan tushuntirish, 3) aniq misol (odam, joy, vaqt), 4) 'So…' yoki 'That's why…' bilan fikrga qaytish.
Tinglovchi harakatlarni sanaydi: har bajarilgan harakat +1 ball (ko'pi bilan 4). 'Many people do this' kabi umumiy gap misol hisoblanmaydi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How do you usually travel to school, university or work? Why?
Do you prefer the bus or the metro? Why?
How long is your daily journey, and what do you do on the way?
Have you ever been late because of traffic? What happened?
Would you like to cycle more in your city? Why or why not?
Is public transport in your city cheap enough? Give an example.
Should public transport be free for everyone? Why or why not?
Why do many people still prefer cars to buses?
Would charging drivers to enter city centres reduce traffic?
Is building wider roads a good way to solve traffic problems?
How could cities make buses more reliable?
Who should pay for new metro lines: passengers or the government?
Will people drive less in twenty years' time? Why?
What would cycle lanes change in a city like Tashkent?
Should companies help their staff pay for public transport?

41.title: Sentence Race: body paragraph sentences
41.stage: '3-mashq: aralash gaplarni tartiblash' oldidan isitish (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: Body xatboshi gaplarini (topic sentence, explanation, example, link) to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish va har gapning harakatini aniqlash.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf, vergul va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap qaysi harakat ekanini (Fikr, Tushuntirish, Misol, Bog'lash yoki qoida) aytsa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Each body paragraph develops one main idea.
Free fares will not solve congestion without faster buses.
This is because a bus stuck in traffic saves nobody time.
For example, a family of four pays for four tickets every Saturday.
This is why free fares alone rarely change a driver's habits.
Night buses would stop many families from buying a car.
A clear case is a nurse whose shift ends at 1 a.m.
In this way, cycle lanes keep thousands of cars off the road.
Parking is cheap, so drivers see no reason to change their habits.
A wider road fills with more cars within two years.

41.title: Quiz Board: building body paragraphs
41.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki 42-dars 'Takrorlash' bosqichi o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
41.goal: To'rt harakat qoidalari, 'da'vomi yoki yo'q' testi, transport so'zlari va og'zaki mini-xatboshini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Claim or not? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan og'zaki aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Name the four moves of a body paragraph in order.
Which move answers the question 'So what?'
Which move do students skip most often?
qs.a: The explanation (why the claim is true)

qs.q: At least how many steps should an explanation chain have?
qs.a: Two: a reason and the result of that reason

qs.q: How long is a full body paragraph (sentences and words)?
'Is the metro better than the bus?'
qs.a: Not a claim — it is a question

qs.q: 'Traffic is a topic that many people discuss.'
qs.a: Not a claim — it only announces the topic

qs.q: 'Cheap parking keeps the city centre full of cars.'
qs.a: A claim — you can agree or disagree with it

qs.q: What quick test tells you that a sentence is a claim?
qs.a: Can a reader agree or disagree with it? If yes, it is a claim

qs.q: What is wrong: 'In this paragraph, I will discuss fares, bus lanes and noise.'
qs.a: An announcement with three ideas — no single claim

qs.q: The money you pay for a bus or train journey.
A person who travels to work every day.
So many vehicles on the roads that traffic moves slowly.
How often a bus or train service runs.
A fee that drivers pay to enter a city centre by car.
Give a specific example of someone who needs a night bus.
qs.a: e.g. A nurse who finishes her shift at 1 a.m.

qs.q: Say a topic sentence about cycle lanes.
qs.a: e.g. Safe cycle lanes would take many short car trips off the roads.

qs.q: Explain in two steps: why do free fares attract families?
qs.a: e.g. The bus becomes cheaper than petrol, so families leave the car.

qs.q: Add a link sentence to: 'Bus lanes make buses faster than cars.'
qs.a: e.g. Therefore, the bus becomes the quicker choice at rush hour.

qs.q: Say a 4-move mini-paragraph about parking prices.
qs.a: e.g. Claim → because… → a driver who… → therefore…

42.title: Conclusion Auction: position, signposts, closing sentences
42.stage: 'Zaif xulosalarga tashxis' (2-mashq)dan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Xulosa gaplarida (pozitsiya, jamlanma, yopuvchi gap) Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: ikki signpost ketma-ket, 'in my point of view', 'on the balance', outweigh moslashuvi, 2-shart (would), 'a tax relief'.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi — har gap ish va bandlik haqidagi essay xulosasidan. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart (masalan: 'ikki signpost', 'would', 'artikl kerak emas').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: On balance, the benefits of paid internships clearly outweigh their costs for employers.
items.why: Bitta signpost, aniq pozitsiya; ko'plik ega (the benefits) + outweigh.

items.s: To sum up, in conclusion, a shorter working week is worth trying.
items.fix: To sum up, a shorter working week is worth trying.
items.why: Bitta signpost yetadi; ikkitasi ketma-ket — mexanik bog'lanish (CC).

items.s: To conclude, raising the retirement age is fair, provided that it happens gradually.
items.why: Pozitsiya + body'dan chiqqan shart (provided that + Present Simple).

items.s: In my point of view, governments should limit weekly working hours by law.
items.fix: In my view, governments should limit weekly working hours by law.
items.why: To'g'risi: 'In my view' yoki 'From my point of view'.

items.s: Overall, the benefits of working from home outweighs the drawbacks.
items.fix: Overall, the benefits of working from home outweigh the drawbacks.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (the benefits) — outweigh, -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: Overall, working hours should be capped by law, since long weeks harm health and safety.
items.why: Pozitsiya yangi so'z bilan (capped by law) + asosiy sabab (since …).

items.s: On the balance, a four-day week would help most office workers.
items.fix: On balance, a four-day week would help most office workers.
items.why: Turg'un ibora artiklsiz: on balance.

items.s: With proper retraining, automation can raise output and still protect people's careers.
items.why: Yopuvchi gap: natija aytilgan, yangi fikr yo'q.

items.s: If firms moved to a four-day week, staff will resign less often.
items.fix: If firms moved to a four-day week, staff would resign less often.
items.why: 2-shart: If + Past Simple, would + V1.

items.s: In my view, firms that automate should cover the cost of retraining their staff.
items.why: Aniq pozitsiya, bitta signpost; kirishdagi fikr yangi so'zlar bilan berilgan.

items.s: To conclude, factories would need a tax relief to pay for extra staff.
items.fix: To conclude, factories would need tax relief to pay for extra staff.
items.why: 'tax relief' sanalmaydigan ot — 'a' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: Unless small firms receive tax relief, a shorter week may cost them too much.
items.why: Yopuvchi gap-shart: unless + Present Simple; yangi fikr emas.

42.title: Board Game: two sentences, three minutes
42.stage: Keyingi dars boshida 40–42-darslar takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Ikki gapli xulosa qoidalari (2 gap, 3 daqiqa, 35–50 so'z, uch taqiq), paraphrase, bir gapli favqulodda xulosa va ish-bandlik mavzusida og'zaki javob.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase beradi, xulosa gapini aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
'Talk for…' kataklarida javob BIR gapli xulosa bilan yopilsa (Overall, … / On balance, …) — yana 1 katak oldinga.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many sentences does a quick conclusion have?
squares.a: Two.

squares.t: How many minutes should the conclusion take in the exam?
squares.a: About three minutes.

squares.t: How many words should a two-sentence conclusion have?
squares.a: About 35–50 words.

squares.t: Say three signposts that can start a conclusion (use only one!).
squares.a: In my view / Overall / On balance / To conclude

squares.t: What does sentence 1 of the conclusion do?
squares.a: Restates the position in new words and sums up both body ideas.

squares.t: What does sentence 2 of the conclusion do?
squares.a: Closes the essay: a result, a condition or a recommendation.

squares.t: Paraphrase: a four-day working week
squares.a: e.g. a shorter week / a week with an extra day off

squares.t: Paraphrase: without reducing pay
squares.a: e.g. with salaries left untouched / on the same salary

squares.t: Can you add a new idea in the conclusion? Why?
squares.a: No — an undeveloped idea lowers Task Response.

squares.t: Is 'It depends on the situation' a good final sentence? Why?
squares.a: No — it shows no clear position (a Band 6 limit).

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: would you like a four-day working week? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because I could use the extra day to study, for example…

squares.t: Correct: 'In conclusion, to sum up, finally, it is good.'
squares.a: e.g. Overall, a shorter week is worth trying. (one signpost + a clear position)

squares.t: What is the difference between a summary and a repetition?
squares.a: Repetition copies the intro; a summary squeezes what the body proved.

squares.t: The intro says 'I believe…'. What can the conclusion say instead?
squares.a: e.g. In my view, … / On balance, … / Overall, …

squares.t: One minute left! Say a one-sentence conclusion about remote work.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, remote work suits most staff, but not brand-new employees.

squares.t: Paraphrase: cost jobs
squares.a: e.g. put people out of work / lead to fewer permanent contracts

squares.t: Split the 40 minutes: plan, intro, body, conclusion, check.
squares.a: 5 + 4 + 22 + 3 + 6 minutes

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: why is it hard to find a first job?
squares.a: e.g. Most posts ask for experience, which young people cannot have yet…

squares.t: Body 2 is half-finished and 2 minutes are left. What do you do?
squares.a: Stop the body and write the conclusion — an unfinished essay costs more.

squares.t: Should a conclusion include an example? Why?
squares.a: No — examples belong in the body; in a conclusion they look like new ideas.

squares.t: Say a closing sentence with 'provided that' about a four-day week.
squares.a: e.g. A shorter week would help most staff, provided that it starts in offices.

squares.t: Your conclusion is 80 words long. What is the problem?
squares.a: It is retelling the body; cut it to 35–50 words.

squares.t: Restate in new words: 'Governments should limit working hours by law.'
squares.a: e.g. The law should cap the number of hours people work.

squares.t: Say a 2-sentence conclusion: should the retirement age be raised?
squares.a: e.g. On balance, a later retirement is fair if older staff get lighter roles. This…

42.title: Dominoes: intro words and new words for the conclusion
42.stage: 'Jamlanma va takror farqi' (3-mashq) bosqichidan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Savol yoki kirishdagi iborani xulosa uchun YANGI so'z bilan aytish (paraphrase) — jamlanma va takror farqining asosiy ko'nikmasi (ish va bandlik mavzusi).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.

START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi KIRISH iborasi (masalan, 'without reducing pay') chap tomonida uning XULOSADAGI yangi so'zli varianti yozilgan toshga ulanadi ('with salaries left untouched').
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Keyin guruh 2 ta juftlikni bitta xulosa gapiga qo'yib aytadi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: a week with one extra day off
make people wait longer before they can retire
limit weekly working hours by law
put a legal ceiling on the working week
staff who lose their posts to automation
firms with only a handful of staff
the gains are greater than the drawbacks
work placements that come with a salary

42.title: Taboo: work and employment
42.stage: 'Takrorlash va bugungi shart' bosqichida — ish mavzusi so'zlari (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Ish va bandlik so'zlarini (salary, productivity, retirement, internship, automation, shift…) boshqa so'zlar bilan tushuntirish — xulosada so'zni takrorlamay, paraphrase qilish uchun zaxira.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'salary' uchun money, pay, month).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Juda qiyin so'zda 'Pass' deyish mumkin — karta dastaning oxiriga qo'yiladi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

42.title: Find someone who… has had a part-time job
42.stage: 'Namuna essay xulosasi'dan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Ish, amaliyot va imtihon vaqti haqidagi tajriba bo'yicha to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Would you…? Do you…?) va natijani bir gapli xulosa bilan aytish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Would you choose a four-day week over a higher salary?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? / What was it like?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani BIR gapli xulosa bilan aytadi (masalan: 'Overall, most of us would choose a shorter week over more money.').

items.t: …has had a part-time job.
items.q: Have you ever had a part-time job?

items.t: …would like to work from home in the future.
