items.q: Do you believe people should be able to retire before 60?

42.title: Speaking cards: work and jobs — end with a conclusion
42.stage: 4-mashqdan keyin, taymerli raundlardan oldin og'zaki isitish (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida ish va bandlik haqida javob berish va har javobni aniq pozitsiyali bir gapli xulosa bilan yopish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi (fikr, sabab, misol) va javobni albatta BIR gapli xulosa bilan yopadi: 'Overall, …' yoki 'On balance, …'.
Tinglovchi xulosani baholaydi: pozitsiya aniq va yangi fikr yo'q — +2 ball; 'It depends' yoki yangi fikr — 0 ball; xulosa umuman yo'q — −1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you work or study? What do you enjoy most about it?
Would you like a four-day working week? What would you do on the extra day?
What was your first job, or what would you like it to be?
Would you rather work from home or in an office? Why?
Which jobs are popular among young people in Uzbekistan? Why?
Is it better to have a well-paid job or an interesting one?
Why do many young people find it hard to get their first job?
Should governments limit how many hours people work each week?
Will robots and computers replace many jobs in the future?
Who should pay to retrain workers who lose their jobs to machines?
Should the retirement age be raised? Why or why not?
What are the advantages of paid internships for students?
How has the internet changed the way people work?
Would a shorter working week be good for a country's economy?

42.title: Sentence Race: conclusion sentences
42.stage: 'Ikki gapli shakl' (1-mashq)dan keyin tezkor mustahkamlash (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Xulosa gaplarini (pozitsiya + shart, yopuvchi gap, favqulodda xulosa qoidasi) to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish va har gapning vazifasini aytish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf, vergul va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap xulosaning qaysi qismi ekanini (1-gap — pozitsiya, 2-gap — yopuvchi gap yoki qoida) aytsa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: In my view, a shorter week is worth trying in office jobs.
Overall, working from home suits most staff once they are trained.
On balance, flexible hours are worth the extra planning they require.
To conclude, employers should pay to retrain the workers they replace.
Overall, the working week should have a legal maximum.
In this way, automation creates new jobs instead of removing old ones.
Unless small firms receive tax relief, the change will cost jobs.
Never add a new idea in the conclusion.
If two minutes are left, write a one-sentence conclusion.
Paid internships would help young graduates find their first job.

42.title: Quiz Board: quick conclusions
42.stage: 'Favqulodda xulosa va uyga vazifa' oldidan umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
42.goal: Xulosa tuzilishi, xulosadagi tipik xatolar, ish-bandlik so'zlari va og'zaki xulosa aytishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fix the error 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan og'zaki aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many sentences does a quick conclusion have?
About how many minutes should the conclusion take?
What does sentence 2 of the conclusion do?
qs.a: Closes: a result, a condition or a recommendation

qs.q: Name the three things a conclusion must NOT do.
qs.a: Add a new idea / copy the intro / end with 'It depends'

qs.q: How do you split 40 minutes: plan, intro, body, conclusion, check?
'In conclusion, to sum up, a shorter week is good.'
qs.a: One signpost only: 'To sum up, a shorter week is good.'

qs.q: 'In my point of view, remote work is better.'
qs.a: In my view, … / From my point of view, …

qs.q: 'On the balance, flexible hours help staff.'
qs.a: On balance, flexible hours help staff.

qs.q: 'Overall, it depends on the job and the person.'
qs.a: No position — state a clear view, e.g. 'On balance, …'

qs.q: 'Overall, a shorter week helps. Also, the state should build more nurseries.'
qs.a: New idea in the conclusion — delete the second sentence

qs.q: The money you earn every month for your job.
A short period of work, often for students, to gain experience.
The time when people stop working for good, usually in old age.
Replacing human workers with machines or computer systems.
The total amount a company pays its workers (two words).
One minute left! Say a one-sentence conclusion: a four-day week.
qs.a: e.g. Overall, a four-day week would benefit most office workers.

qs.q: Replace 'I believe that…' with a conclusion signpost.
qs.a: e.g. In my view, … / On balance, … / Overall, …

qs.q: Restate in new words: 'the retirement age should be raised'.
qs.a: e.g. people should work longer before they retire

qs.q: Say a closing sentence with 'unless' about working from home.
qs.a: e.g. Unless new staff get office days, they will learn more slowly.

qs.q: Say a 2-sentence conclusion: should working hours be limited by law?
qs.a: e.g. In my view, a legal ceiling is needed… Without it, …

43.title: Language Auction: linkers and reference words
43.stage: 'Referencing' bosqichidan keyin, 4-mashqdan oldin yoki uning o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Essay gaplarida bog'lovchi va ishora xatolarini topish: noto'g'ri munosabat (Moreover o'rniga As a result), however vergullari, although + but, yalang'och this, the latter, one/ones, On the contrary.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bog'lovchi va ishora to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart: noto'g'ri munosabat, vergul, yalang'och this, the latter, although + but yoki one.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Heritage can earn money: some councils, for instance, rent old buildings out as cafes.
items.why: for instance gap ichida, ikki tomondan vergul bilan — to'g'ri va tabiiy.

items.s: The old bazaar was given a new roof. Moreover, traders can now work there in winter.
items.fix: The old bazaar was given a new roof. As a result, traders can now work there in winter.
items.why: Ikkinchi gap — NATIJA, qo'shimcha fikr emas: Moreover o'rniga As a result.

items.s: The restoration also gave work to local craftspeople.
items.why: also fe'ldan oldin turadi — eng tabiiy qo'shish so'zi.

items.s: The new gallery, however is rarely busy.
items.fix: The new gallery, however, is rarely busy.
items.why: Gap ichidagi however ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.

items.s: Tourists spend money in the old town's cafes. This is growing every year.
items.fix: Tourists spend money in the old town's cafes. This spending is growing every year.
items.why: Yalang'och this — nima o'sayotgani noaniq; this + OT qo'yiladi.

items.s: Samarkand and Termez both have ancient sites, but the former receives far more tourists.
items.why: Aniq IKKITA narsa sanalgan: the former = Samarkand.

items.s: Although the museum is small, but it attracts many visitors.
items.fix: Although the museum is small, it attracts many visitors.
items.why: Although va but bitta gapda birga kelmaydi — bittasi yetadi.

items.s: Several towns have banned cars from their old centres, and such bans are popular with tourists.
items.why: such + OT oldingi gapdagi turni umumlashtirib qaytaradi.

items.s: The council repaired a bridge, a school and a bathhouse, and the latter reopened first.
items.fix: The council repaired a bridge, a school and a bathhouse, and the bathhouse reopened first.
items.why: the latter faqat IKKITA narsadan keyin; uchta narsada otning o'zi takrorlanadi.

items.s: The old buses were noisy, so the city bought new one.
items.fix: The old buses were noisy, so the city bought new ones.
items.why: Ko'plik otning o'rnini ones bosadi: new ones (new one bo'lmaydi).

items.s: Restored markets attract visitors, which means that nearby shops earn more.
items.why: which means that — natijani gapni uzmay davom ettiradi.

items.s: Rural museums are often empty. On the contrary, city museums are usually crowded.
items.fix: Rural museums are often empty. By contrast, city museums are usually crowded.
items.why: On the contrary oldingi fikrni rad etadi; ikki narsani solishtirishda — By contrast.

43.title: Board Game: linkers, 'this + noun' and substitution
43.stage: Namuna essay tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Besh guruh bog'lovchilari, bog'lovchini gap ichiga ko'chirish, this + OT, the former / the latter, one va do so bilan substitution hamda tarixiy binolar va shahar byudjeti haqida og'zaki gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bog'lovchi aytadi, gapni tuzatadi, ishorani aniqlashtiradi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name 3 linkers for ADDING an idea.
squares.a: also, in addition, furthermore

squares.t: Name 3 linkers for CONTRAST.
squares.a: however, by contrast, whereas / while / although

squares.t: Name 2 linkers for CAUSE and 2 for RESULT.
squares.a: because, since / as a result, consequently

squares.t: Name 2 ways to introduce an EXAMPLE.
squares.a: for example, for instance, such as

squares.t: Which fits a conclusion: 'Moreover' or 'On balance'?
squares.a: On balance (also: overall, in my view).

squares.t: Move the linker inside: 'However, the old bazaar needs repairs.'
squares.a: The old bazaar, however, needs repairs.

squares.t: Speak 20 sec: Is there an old building in your town? What is it used for?
squares.a: e.g. There is an old madrasa near my home; it is now a craft centre.

squares.t: Move the linker inside: 'Therefore, the museum raised its prices.'
squares.a: The museum therefore raised its prices.

squares.t: Fix the linker: 'It rained heavily. Moreover, the fair was cancelled.'
squares.a: It rained heavily. As a result, the fair was cancelled.

squares.t: Add a noun after 'This': 'The mayor raised bus fares. This was unpopular.'
squares.a: e.g. This increase / This decision was unpopular.

squares.t: Correct: 'Although the project was costly, but it was popular.'
squares.a: Although the project was costly, it was popular.

squares.t: Tea and coffee: '___ is more popular in Uzbekistan.' Former or latter?
squares.a: The former (tea).

squares.t: Avoid repetition: 'The bridge is old, so we need a new bridge.'
squares.a: The bridge is old, so we need a new one.

squares.t: Use 'do so': 'Some cafes accept cards; others refuse to accept cards.'
squares.a: Some cafes accept cards; others refuse to do so.

squares.t: Speak 20 sec: Which public service in your city needs more money? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Buses, because many are old; as a result, people are often late.

squares.t: Contrast old and new buildings in ONE sentence with 'whereas'.
squares.a: e.g. Old buildings are unique, whereas new ones can be copied.

squares.t: Why is 'Firstly… Moreover… Moreover…' a Band 6 sign?
squares.a: It is mechanical: the same linkers start every sentence.

squares.t: What does 'such' refer to: 'Old mills became hotels. Such projects are costly.'
squares.a: Turning old mills into hotels (the type of project just mentioned).

squares.t: Fix 'they': 'Families rent rooms to students. They complain about noise.'
squares.a: Name the group: 'The students (or: The families) complain about noise.'

squares.t: Join with 'which means that': 'The park has new lights.' + 'Families stay longer.'
squares.a: The park has new lights, which means that families stay longer.

squares.t: Can you use 'the latter' after three items? What instead?
squares.a: No — only after two; use 'the last of these' or the noun.

squares.t: Link WITHOUT a linker: 'The cinema was repaired. Ticket sales rose.'
squares.a: e.g. The repair of the cinema boosted ticket sales.

squares.t: Part 3: Museums or clinics — which deserves more money? Use 'although'.
squares.a: e.g. Although museums matter, clinics should come first because…

squares.t: Part 3 (30 sec): Why protect historic buildings? Use 2 linkers + 'this + noun'.
squares.a: e.g. They cannot be rebuilt, so their loss is permanent. This heritage also draws tourists.

43.title: Dominoes: follow the reference word
43.stage: 5-mashq (substitution kartochkalari) o'rniga yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Gapning ikkinchi qismini birinchisiga ishora (these closures, such taxes, one, did the same, do so, the latter, the conversion) va bog'lovchi (whereas, although, by contrast, which means that, as a result) orqali to'g'ri ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.

START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi (masalan, 'Some cities now charge visitors a tourist tax.') chap tomonida uning davomi yozilgan toshga ulanadi ('Such taxes help to pay for restoration.').

Ulashda ikki narsaga qarang: ishora so'zi (these, such, one, do so, the latter, the conversion, it) nimaga qaytmoqda va bog'lovchi qaysi munosabatni ko'rsatmoqda. Vergul, nuqta va bosh harf ham yordam beradi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har juftda ishora so'zi nimaga qaytayotganini aytadi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: The mayor closed three old cinemas last year.
These closures upset many older residents.
The new metro line now reaches the suburbs,
which means that students can rent cheaper flats.
Some cities now charge visitors a tourist tax.
Such taxes help to pay for restoration.
The old bus station is far too small,
so a bigger one is being built nearby.
Tashkent and Khiva both once had city walls,
but only the latter has kept them.
The museum doubled its ticket prices.
This increase kept many families away.
Our town restored its old caravanserai,
and the next town did the same a year later.
whereas new suburbs rarely attract any.
many projects later recover part of their cost.
Village libraries are often empty in summer.
City libraries, by contrast, are full all year.
Many heritage cities, such as Khiva,
Some towns keep their old bazaars;
others fail to do so and regret it later.
An old silk factory was turned into a library.
The conversion cost half the price of a new one.
The old bridge was declared unsafe.
As a result, it was closed to traffic.

43.title: Taboo: heritage, city budgets and essay words
43.stage: 'Takrorlash va bugungi maqsad' bosqichida — essay mavzusi so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Namuna essay mavzusi (tarixiy binolar, shahar byudjeti, xizmatlar) va essay tuzilishi so'zlarini (heritage, restore, budget, conversion, however, conclusion…) boshqa so'zlar bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'heritage' uchun history, past, old).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Tushuntirishda bog'lovchi (because, whereas, for example) tabiiy ishlatilsa, ustoz jamoaga yana +1 beradi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

43.title: Find someone who… has visited a museum recently
43.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli tanaffus — 3-mashqdan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Tarixiy binolar, muzeylar va shahar xizmatlari bo'yicha hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va javobni bog'lovchi bilan kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you visited a museum in the last six months?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' yoki 'What was it like?' deb so'raydi. Javobchi kamida bitta bog'lovchi ishlatadi (because, however, as a result).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta natijani bog'lovchi bilan aytadi (masalan: 'Aziz loves museums, whereas Lola prefers parks.').

items.t: …has visited a museum in the last six months.
items.q: Have you visited a museum in the last six months?

items.t: …has been inside a restored madrasa or caravanserai.
items.q: Have you ever been inside a restored madrasa or caravanserai?

items.t: …uses public transport every day.
items.q: Do you use public transport every day?

items.t: …thinks their city needs more parks than museums.
items.q: Do you think your city needs more parks than museums?

items.t: …has shown foreign guests around an old town.
items.q: Have you ever shown foreign guests around an old town?

items.t: …has written an essay without using 'Moreover'.
items.q: Have you ever written an essay without using 'Moreover'?

items.t: …can name two famous buildings in Khiva.
items.q: Can you name two famous buildings in Khiva?

items.t: …would pay more tax to protect historic buildings.
items.q: Would you pay more tax to protect historic buildings?

items.t: …has seen an old building being restored near their home.
items.q: Have you seen an old building being restored near your home?

items.t: …knows the difference between 'the former' and 'the latter'.
items.q: Do you know the difference between 'the former' and 'the latter'?

items.t: …has complained about a local service, such as the buses.
items.q: Have you ever complained about a local service, such as the buses?

items.t: …would prefer a new library to a restored palace.
items.q: Would you prefer a new library to a restored palace?

43.title: Speaking cards: old buildings and city services
43.stage: 1-mashqdan keyin: bog'lovchilarni og'zaki nutqda ishlatish (Speaking Part 1/3, 12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 uslubida tarixiy binolar, muzeylar va shahar xizmatlari haqida gapirib, bog'lovchi va ishorani tabiiy (mexanik emas) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 xil bog'lovchi ishlatadi; bittasi gap ICHIDA bo'lsin (masalan: 'Museums, however, are…').
Tinglovchi ball beradi: har xil bog'lovchi +1, gap ichidagi bog'lovchi +1, 'this + OT' (this decision, these buildings) +1. Bir bog'lovchi ikki marta ishlatilsa — ball yo'q.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Are there any old buildings in your hometown? What are they used for now?
Have you ever visited a museum in Uzbekistan? What did you see there?
Do you prefer modern buildings or old ones? Why?
How often do you use public transport? How could it be improved?
Should governments spend more money on museums or on hospitals? Why?
Why do tourists want to see historic cities such as Bukhara and Khiva?
Is it better to restore an old building or to build a new one? Why?
Who should pay for protecting old buildings: the state or private companies?
What can old buildings teach young people about the past?
Can an old factory become a useful public space? Give an example.
Do people in your city care about its history? How can you tell?
Some people say museums are boring for teenagers. Do you agree?
Should old buildings be turned into libraries or clinics? Why?
How has tourism changed cities like Samarkand in recent years?

43.title: Sentence Race: linkers inside the sentence
43.stage: 4-mashqdan keyin: gap ichidagi bog'lovchi va ishoralarni takrorlash (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Bog'lovchi gap ichida (however, therefore), whereas, although va ishora (this decision, such conversions, one, did the same, the latter) bor gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf, vergul va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball. Gapdagi bog'lovchi yoki ishora so'zini topib, vazifasini aytsa (qarama-qarshilik, natija, this + OT, one) — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Restoration, however, takes longer than new construction.
The council therefore cancelled its summer craft fair.
Historic stations cannot be replaced, whereas a new gym can.
This decision upset most shop owners near the bazaar.
Such conversions save the city a great deal of money.
Most old trams were replaced, but the city kept one for tourists.
One district repaired its old water tower, and two others did the same.
Between a museum and a clinic, the council chose the latter.
Although restoration is costly, the jobs it creates stay local.

43.title: Quiz Board: cohesion and referencing
43.stage: 'Xulosa va uyga vazifa'dan oldin umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
43.goal: Bog'lovchi guruhlari, gap ichidagi bog'lovchi tinish belgilari, this + OT, the former / the latter, one / do so va bog'lovchisiz bog'lashni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Reference words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which one-word linker adds an idea and goes before the verb?
Give a linker that shows a RESULT.
Which linker gives an example and is followed by a NOUN?
Which linker contrasts two things inside ONE sentence?
Which linker admits an objection before you answer it?
The plan, however was rejected.
Although the hall is old, but it is still used.
qs.a: Although the hall is old, it is still used.

qs.q: Prices rose. Moreover, fewer people came.
qs.a: Prices rose. As a result, fewer people came.

qs.q: Despite of the cost, the plan was approved.
qs.a: Despite the cost, the plan was approved.

qs.q: We need a clinic, a school and a park; the latter is urgent.
qs.a: …; the last of these (the park) is urgent.

qs.q: 'The former' means the ___ of two things.
Add a noun: 'The mayor cut the budget. This was a mistake.'
qs.a: This cut / This decision was a mistake.

qs.q: Avoid repetition: 'We need a new bus because the old bus is broken.'
Avoid repetition: 'Some cities light their old walls at night; others do not light them.'
Why is 'they' unclear: 'Hotels employ many guides. They earn well.'?
qs.a: It could mean the hotels or the guides — name the noun.

qs.q: Join with 'because': The museum is popular. It is free.
qs.a: The museum is popular because it is free.

qs.q: Say a sentence with 'however' in the MIDDLE.
qs.a: e.g. The metro, however, is always crowded.

qs.q: Contrast village and city life with 'whereas'.
qs.a: e.g. Villages are quiet, whereas cities are busy.

qs.q: Compare buses and the metro using 'the latter'.
qs.a: e.g. Buses and the metro are cheap, but the latter is faster.

qs.q: Museums or clinics? Give your view with 'On balance'.
qs.a: e.g. On balance, clinics should come first.

44.title: Language Auction: developed ideas and strong examples
44.stage: 4-mashq (to'qilgan raqam va shaxsiy gap) o'rniga yoki undan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Fikrni ochishdagi Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: to'qilgan foiz, shaxsiy gap, bo'sh aylana, mashhur nom misol sifatida, which mean, such as + gap, because of + gap.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 essayga yaraydimi yoki unda xato bormi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin xato turini aytishi shart: to'qilgan raqam, shaxsiy gap, bo'sh aylana, mashhur nom, which means, such as yoki because.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Free entry helps museums because families on low incomes can visit more often.
items.why: Fikr + sabab (because) — zanjirning birinchi bo'g'ini to'g'ri.

items.s: Statistics show that exactly 67.3% of visitors prefer old towns.
items.fix: A large proportion of visitors prefer old towns.
items.why: To'qilgan aniq foiz ishonarsiz — ehtiyotkor miqdor ifodasi kerak.

items.s: Tourism creates jobs, which mean that young people can stay in their villages.
items.fix: Tourism creates jobs, which means that young people can stay in their villages.
items.why: which butun oldingi fikrga qaytadi — birlik: which means that.

items.s: A family bakery in the old quarter, for instance, may take on two apprentices.
items.why: Aniq va ishonarli misol; for instance gap ichida turibdi.

items.s: My uncle is a potter, and he says young people no longer want to learn the craft.
items.fix: In many craft towns, fewer young people are now training as potters.
items.why: Shaxsiy gap misol emas — uni umumiy holatga aylantiring.

items.s: As a result, the money spent on restoration slowly returns to the city through taxes.
items.why: Misoldan keyin natija bilan fikrga qaytildi — zanjir yopildi.

items.s: Old buildings are important because they are very important for a country.
items.fix: Old buildings are important because they show how people lived in the past.
items.why: Bo'sh aylana: sabab fikrning o'zini takrorlayapti.

items.s: Registan Square, for example, is known all over the world.
items.fix: Registan Square, for example, draws visitors who also fill nearby hotels.
items.why: Mashhur nom hech narsani isbotlamaydi — natijasi ko'rinadigan holat kerak.

items.s: Crafts survive only if young people learn them, which means that schools have a role to play.
items.why: which means that — sababning amaliy oqibati (ma'nosi bo'g'ini).

items.s: Heritage projects bring benefits, such as they create jobs for builders.
items.fix: Heritage projects bring benefits, such as jobs for builders.
items.why: such as dan keyin gap emas, OT keladi.

items.s: In many small towns, restoring a single street has helped closed workshops reopen.
items.why: Ehtiyotkor 'in many small towns' + aniq natija — kuchli misol.

items.s: Because of housing is needed urgently, slow restoration projects are hard to justify.
items.fix: Because housing is needed urgently, slow restoration projects are hard to justify.
items.why: because of + OT; ega + fe'ldan oldin faqat because.

44.title: Board Game: build the chain
44.stage: Namuna essay tahlilidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Fikrni ochish zanjiri (because / which means / for example / as a result), kuchli va zaif misol, to'qilgan raqam va shaxsiy gapni tuzatish hamda Speaking Part 3 da fikrni to'liq ochish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: zanjir bo'g'inini aytadi, misolni baholaydi, gapni tuzatadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz kaliti bilan tekshiradi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunan to'g'ri har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the 4 links that follow the topic sentence.
squares.a: reason, meaning, example, result

squares.t: Give 2 phrases that introduce a REASON.
squares.a: because, since, the reason is that

squares.t: Give 2 phrases for the MEANING link.
squares.a: which means that, this means that, in practice

squares.t: Give 2 phrases that introduce an EXAMPLE.
squares.a: for example, for instance, in many cities

squares.t: Give 2 phrases for the final RESULT.
squares.a: as a result, therefore, this suggests that

squares.t: Stated or developed? 'Parks are good for cities.'
squares.a: Only stated: no reason, example or result.

squares.t: Speak 20 sec: What traditional craft is your region known for?
squares.a: e.g. Rishton is famous for its blue ceramics, made by hand.

squares.t: Add a reason: 'Libraries are still useful…'
squares.a: e.g. …because not every family can afford books.

squares.t: Continue with 'which means that': 'The metro is cheap,…'
squares.a: e.g. …which means that students can travel every day.

squares.t: Name the 3 signs of a strong example.
squares.a: specific, believable, relevant to the idea

squares.t: Strong or weak? 'For example, everyone knows tourists love Samarkand.'
squares.a: Weak — 'everyone knows' proves nothing.

squares.t: Make it safe: 'Exactly 91% of people love museums.'
squares.a: e.g. Many people enjoy visiting museums.

squares.t: Make it academic: 'My friend Aziz says old houses are cold.'
squares.a: e.g. Many old houses are difficult to heat in winter.

squares.t: In a 4–5 sentence paragraph, how many sentences is the example?
squares.a: One (at most two short ones).

squares.t: What must come right AFTER the example?
squares.a: A return to the idea: as a result / this suggests that.

squares.t: Strong or weak? 'For example, the Great Wall of China is very old.'
squares.a: Weak — a famous name proves nothing.

squares.t: Give a specific example for: 'Tourism creates jobs.'
squares.a: e.g. A restored caravanserai may employ local cooks and guides.

squares.t: Why is 'Heritage matters because it matters' weak?
squares.a: It is circular: the reason repeats the idea.

squares.t: Replace a third 'For example' with another phrase.
squares.a: for instance / one such case is / in many cities

squares.t: Develop with reason + result: 'Cities need more cycle lanes.'
squares.a: e.g. …because more people would cycle; as a result, traffic would fall.

squares.t: Explain 'insufficiently developed' in simple words.
squares.a: Ideas are stated but not explained or supported.

squares.t: Part 3 (30 sec): Should young people learn traditional crafts? Reason + example.
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because… For instance, in Rishton…

squares.t: Part 3 (30 sec): Is tourism always good for historic cities? Use the chain.
squares.a: e.g. Not always, because… which means… For example… As a result…

squares.t: Develop in 4 sentences: 'Museums should offer free entry to students.'
squares.a: Idea → because… which means… → For example… → As a result…

44.title: Dominoes: claim and supporting example
44.stage: 3-mashqdan oldin: fikrni uni isbotlaydigan misol bilan juftlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Da'vo (fikr) ni aynan uni isbotlaydigan aniq misol bilan juftlash — misol aniq, ishonarli va mavzuga bog'liq bo'lishi kerak.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi FIKR (masalan, 'Mass tourism can push up local prices.') chap tomonida aynan shu fikrni isbotlaydigan MISOL yozilgan toshga ulanadi.
Har ulashda o'zingizga savol bering: bu misol aynan shu fikrni isbotlaydimi yoki boshqasini?
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi: har juftni fikr + 'For example, …' qilib aytadi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Mobile apps can make museums more attractive.
A QR code next to each exhibit plays a short video.
Potters in Rishton train teenagers every summer.
Cycle lanes can reduce traffic in city centres.
Car use fell in many cities once lanes were built.
Visitors to Khiva often buy from local woodcarvers.
Many use them as a quiet place to revise.
Better street lighting makes people feel safer.
Parents let children walk home once lamps were fitted.
Old buildings can house modern services.
A restored caravanserai now holds a small clinic.
Mass tourism can push up local prices.
Near famous sites, even bread and taxis cost more.
Distance learning widens access to education.
Village students can now join online courses.
Neighbours cook sumalak together for Navruz.
Free outdoor gyms in parks are busy every morning.
A pupil who handles an ancient coin rarely forgets it.
A monthly metro card costs less than fuel for a car.

44.title: Taboo: crafts, housing and essay terms
44.stage: 'Takrorlash va bugungi muammo' bosqichida — mavzu so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Fikrni ochish atamalari (reason, result, evidence, statistics) va essay mavzusi so'zlarini (craft, apprenticeship, housing, overcrowded, understaffed…) boshqa so'zlar bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (masalan, 'potter' uchun clay, pot, bowl).
Tushuntirishda aniq misol keltirish mumkin va foydali ('In Rishton, for example, …') — bu darsning asosiy ko'nikmasi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

44.title: Find someone who… has tried a traditional craft
44.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli tanaffus — 2-mashqdan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Hunarmandchilik, turizm, uy-joy va kutubxonalar bo'yicha hayotiy tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish va javobni sabab + misol bilan ochish (Why? Can you give an example?).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever tried a traditional craft?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va ikkita qo'shimcha savol beradi: 'Why?' va 'Can you give an example?' — javobchi sabab va aniq misol aytadi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eshitgan eng aniq misolni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has tried a traditional craft, such as pottery or embroidery.
items.q: Have you ever tried a traditional craft, such as pottery or embroidery?

items.t: …knows someone who works as an apprentice.
items.q: Do you know anyone who works as an apprentice?

items.t: …has stayed in a guesthouse rather than a hotel.
items.q: Have you ever stayed in a guesthouse rather than a hotel?

items.t: …has bought a handmade souvenir in an old bazaar.
items.q: Have you ever bought a handmade souvenir in an old bazaar?

items.t: …thinks their town needs more housing than museums.
items.q: Do you think your town needs more housing than museums?

items.t: …visits a library at least once a month.
items.q: Do you visit a library at least once a month?

items.t: …used a real example in their last essay.
items.q: Did you use a real example in your last essay?

items.t: …would like to learn a craft from a master.
items.q: Would you like to learn a craft from a master?

items.t: …has seen an old building turned into a cafe or shop.
items.q: Have you ever seen an old building turned into a cafe or shop?

items.t: …believes tourism has changed their hometown.
items.q: Do you believe tourism has changed your hometown?

items.t: …has visited Rishton, Margilan or another craft town.
items.q: Have you ever visited Rishton, Margilan or another craft town?

items.t: …has written a paragraph of over 100 words this week.
items.q: Have you written a paragraph of over 100 words this week?

44.title: Speaking cards: say it, then develop it
44.stage: 1-mashqdan keyin: zanjirni og'zaki qo'llash (IELTS Speaking Part 3, 12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: IELTS Speaking Part 3 uslubida hunarmandchilik, turizm, uy-joy va shahar xizmatlari haqida fikrni zanjir bilan ochish: fikr + sabab + ma'nosi + misol + natija.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javobni zanjir bo'yicha quradi: fikr → because → which means → for example → as a result (4–5 gap).
Tinglovchi zanjir bo'g'inlarini sanaydi: har bo'g'in +1 ball (ko'pi bilan 4). Misol aniq va ishonarli bo'lsa yana +1; to'qilgan raqam yoki 'my friend said' bo'lsa −1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Why do some young people lose interest in traditional crafts?
Should schools teach local crafts such as pottery or embroidery? Why?

Can tourism also harm historic places? In what ways?

44.title: Sentence Race: links of the chain
44.stage: 5-mashq (xatboshi anatomiyasi) dan keyin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Zanjir bo'g'inlari (fikr, sabab, ma'nosi, misol, natija) va ehtiyotkor ifoda (a large proportion, tend to) bor gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harf, vergul va nuqta yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball. Gap zanjirning qaysi bo'g'ini ekanini aytsa (fikr, sabab, ma'nosi, misol, natija yoki ehtiyotkor ifoda) — yana +1.
Oxirida 1–5-gaplarni ('Traditional crafts…' zanjiri) doskada birga tartiblang: fikr → sabab → ma'nosi → misol → natija.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Traditional crafts can keep young people in small towns.
The reason is that every workshop needs several trained assistants.
This means that school-leavers can earn money without leaving home.

Heritage spending is justified when it benefits local residents.
A large proportion of visitors are attracted by historic sites.
Towns with a restored old quarter tend to attract more visitors.
This suggests that heritage spending can pay for itself.

44.title: Quiz Board: developing ideas
44.stage: 'Xulosa va uyga vazifa'dan oldin umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
44.goal: Zanjir bo'g'inlari, kuchli va zaif misol belgilari, to'qilgan raqam, shaxsiy gap va bo'sh aylana xatolarini hamda fikrni og'zaki ochishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 savol (100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Strong or weak? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What comes first in a body paragraph?
Which link answers the question 'Why?'
Which link answers 'What does this mean in practice?'
Which link takes the reader from the example back to the idea?
qs.a: The result (as a result / this suggests that).

qs.q: Which link is missing? 'Crafts create jobs because workshops need many hands. For example, … As a result, …'
'For example, everyone agrees that crafts are nice.'
'For example, 83.6% of students dislike museums.'
'For example, the Taj Mahal is beautiful.'
qs.a: Weak — a famous name proves nothing.

qs.q: 'In many villages, a reopened workshop now trains local teenagers.'
'In my own city, the old bathhouse is now a reading room used every day.'
qs.a: Strong — personal, but specific and academic in tone.

qs.q: Tourism grows, which mean that prices rise.
Crafts bring benefits, such as they create jobs.
Because of tourism is growing, rents rise.
qs.a: Because tourism is growing, rents rise.

qs.q: Make it academic: 'My sister says museums are boring.'
qs.a: e.g. Some museums fail to engage young visitors.

qs.q: Crafts are valuable because they have great value.
qs.a: Circular reason — e.g. …because they create local jobs.

qs.q: Add a reason: 'Night markets are good for cities…'
qs.a: e.g. …because they bring life to empty streets.

qs.q: Continue: 'Guesthouses hire local people,' + which means that…
qs.a: e.g. …which means that income stays in the village.

qs.q: Give a specific example for 'Crafts attract tourists.'
qs.a: e.g. Visitors to Rishton often buy handmade bowls.

qs.q: Finish with a result: 'Crafts are taught in schools…'
qs.a: e.g. As a result, fewer old skills are lost.

qs.q: Develop fully: 'Every town needs a library.'

45.title: Language Auction: absolute claims vs hedged claims
45.stage: 1-mashq (hedging to'plami)dan keyin, 2-mashqdan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Mutlaq da'volarni (all, never, everyone knows, the only reason) topish va yumshatish vositalarining to'g'ri shaklini ajratish: tend to + V1, be likely to + V1, appear to, a number of + ko'plik.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato (mutlaq da'vo yoki yumshatish vositasi noto'g'ri shaklda)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi. Faqat bitta narsa o'zgaradi: mutlaq so'z fikrni TASHLAMASDAN almashtiriladi (all -> most, never -> rarely) yoki shakl tuzatiladi (tends -> tend, likely -> likely to).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Teenagers tend to spend more time online than their parents do.
items.why: tend to + V1 — da'vo yumshatilgan, bitta istisno uni yiqitmaydi.

items.s: Young people tends to prefer online shopping.
items.fix: Young people tend to prefer online shopping.
items.why: 'people' — ko'plik: tend to (-s qo'shilmaydi).

items.s: Everyone knows that homework improves exam results.
items.fix: It is widely believed that homework improves exam results.
items.why: 'Everyone knows' dalil emas; o'rniga 'It is widely believed that'.

items.s: A sugar tax is likely to reduce consumption, at least in the short term.
items.why: be likely to + V1 va vaqt doirasi (in the short term) — himoyalangan da'vo.

items.s: Higher fuel prices are likely reduce car use in big cities.
items.fix: Higher fuel prices are likely to reduce car use in big cities.
items.why: be likely TO + V1 — 'to' tushib qolmasin.

items.s: Advertising is one of the main reasons why children ask for sweets.
items.why: 'one of the main reasons' — 'the only reason' ning xavfsiz varianti.

items.s: Social media is the only reason teenagers sleep badly.
items.fix: Social media is one of the main reasons teenagers sleep badly.
items.why: 'the only reason' — eng oson yiqiladigan da'vo: boshqa sabablar ham bor.

items.s: A number of cities have introduced a tax on sugary drinks.
items.why: a number of + ko'plik ot + ko'plik fe'l (have); miqdor xavfsiz.

items.s: Online lessons never work for young children.
items.fix: Online lessons rarely work for young children.
items.why: 'never' ni bitta istisno yiqitadi; 'rarely' — xavfsiz chastota.

items.s: Long working hours appear to increase stress levels among employees.
items.why: appear to + V1 — dalilga asoslangan ehtiyotkorlik.

items.s: All teenagers prefer texting to phone calls.
items.fix: Most teenagers prefer texting to phone calls.
items.why: 'All' ni bitta istisno yiqitadi; 'Most' — himoyalangan miqdor.

items.s: In large cities, cycling to work is often faster than driving.
items.why: often + doira (In large cities) — da'vo aniq va himoyalangan.

45.title: Board Game: make your claims safe
45.stage: 5-mashq (da'vo doirasini ko'rsatish)dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Mutlaq so'zlarni almashtirish (all, always, never, nobody), da'voni yumshatish (tend to, are likely to, may) va doirasini ko'rsatish (kim, qayerda, qachon); mavzu bo'yicha og'zaki fikr bildirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq inglizcha gap aytadi.
Guruh tekshiradi: gapda mutlaq so'z (all, always, never, everyone) qolmaganmi, fikr saqlanganmi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato javob yoki mutlaq so'z qolgan gap — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida 2 ta yumshatish vositasi ishlatadi.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Give a softer word for 'all'.
squares.a: most / many

squares.t: Give a softer word for 'always'.
squares.a: usually / often / tend to

squares.t: Give a softer word for 'never'.
squares.a: rarely / seldom

squares.t: Replace 'nobody'.
squares.a: few people / relatively few people

squares.t: Replace 'Everyone knows that…'.
squares.a: It is widely believed / often argued that…

squares.t: Replace 'the only reason'.
squares.a: one of the main reasons

squares.t: Risky or safe? 'All children love sweets.'
squares.a: Risky — one exception breaks it. Safe: Most children like sweets.

squares.t: Risky or safe? 'Many students find maths hard.'
squares.a: Safe — 'many' is a defensible amount.

squares.t: Soften with 'tend to': Older people prefer cash to cards.
squares.a: Older people tend to prefer cash to cards.

squares.t: Soften with 'are likely to': Taxes on sweets will cut consumption.
squares.a: Taxes on sweets are likely to cut consumption.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: Do young people eat too much fast food? Use 'tend to'.
squares.a: e.g. Young people tend to eat fast food more often than their parents do…

squares.t: Add WHERE: Cycling is popular.
squares.a: e.g. Cycling is popular in cities with separate cycle lanes.

squares.t: Add WHO: Online learning is difficult.
squares.a: e.g. Online learning is difficult for young children.

squares.t: Add WHEN: The roads are very busy.
squares.a: e.g. The roads are very busy during the morning rush hour.

squares.t: What is the difference between hedging and qualifying?
squares.a: Hedging softens a claim (tend to, may); qualifying limits it (who, where, when).

squares.t: Correct: Children seems to learn languages faster than adults.
squares.a: Children seem to learn languages faster than adults.

squares.t: Correct: Sugar taxes are likely reduce obesity.
squares.a: Sugar taxes are likely to reduce obesity.

squares.t: Rewrite without losing the idea: 'Homework is useless.'
squares.a: e.g. Long homework tasks rarely improve results on their own.

squares.t: Why does 'Everyone knows that…' lose marks?
squares.a: It is not evidence; it shows the writer has no support for the claim.

squares.t: Should your opinion in the introduction be hedged? Why?
squares.a: No — keep your position clear (I believe…); hedge claims about the world.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: Should fast food be taxed? Use 2 hedges.
squares.a: e.g. A tax is likely to reduce sales, particularly among young buyers…

squares.t: Rewrite: 'Smartphones destroy children's sleep.'
squares.a: e.g. Heavy smartphone use at night appears to disturb children's sleep.

squares.t: Spot the problem: 'Perhaps some people might possibly think it may help.'
squares.a: Over-hedging — one hedge is enough: 'This may help.'

squares.t: Make a hedged AND qualified claim about homework.
squares.a: e.g. Homework tends to help older students, particularly before exams.

45.title: Dominoes: from absolute claim to safe claim
45.stage: 2-mashq (mutlaq da'voni qayta yozish)dan keyin — mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Mutlaq da'voni (all, never, always, the only) uning himoyalangan, yumshatilgan varianti bilan ulash — fikr saqlanadi, faqat da'vo xavfsiz bo'ladi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi MUTLAQ gapning xavfsiz varianti qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.
Ulashda tekshiring: mavzu bir xilmi (masalan, homework — homework) va fikr saqlanganmi?
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh har juftlikni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va qaysi mutlaq so'z almashtirilganini aytadi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: All teenagers are addicted to their phones.
Many teenagers spend hours on their phones every day.
Everyone knows that sport keeps you healthy.
Regular exercise is widely believed to improve health.
Homework is always a waste of time.
Long homework tasks are often of limited value.
Nobody uses buses in small towns.
Relatively few people take the bus in small towns.
Fast food is the only cause of obesity.
Fast food is one of the main causes of obesity.
Online courses never help adults find jobs.
Online courses alone rarely lead to a new job.
Sugar taxes immediately change how people eat.
Sugar taxes may change eating habits over time.
Young people tend to read fewer books than before.
Mass tourism can put pressure on local traditions.
Working from home is completely stress-free.
Working from home appears to reduce stress for many.
Electric cars will solve all pollution problems.
Electric cars are likely to reduce city air pollution.
Many children pick up English quite quickly.
Exams show exactly how clever a student is.
Exams seem to measure only part of a student's ability.
Children always copy what they see on TV.
Children may copy some behaviour they see on screen.

45.title: Taboo: claims, evidence and public health
45.stage: 'Takrorlash va kirish' bosqichida yoki namuna essaydan oldin — essay so'zlari (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Essay va argument so'zlarini (exception, evidence, claim, defensible) hamda namuna essay mavzusi — soliq va sog'liq so'zlarini (levy, consumption, obesity) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Qo'shimcha qoida: tushuntiruvchi 'always', 'never', 'everyone' so'zlarini ham ishlatmaydi — ishlatsa, karta raqibga o'tadi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

45.title: Find someone who… often skips breakfast
45.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli tanaffus — 3-mashq (xavfli/xavfsiz gaplar)dan keyin (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Odatlar va sog'liq haqida savol berish hamda yumshatib javob berish: tend to, usually, often, hardly ever — 'always' va 'never' siz.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you tend to drink sugary drinks more than twice a week?).
Javob beruvchi mutlaq so'z ishlatmaydi: 'Yes, I tend to…', 'Not usually…', 'Quite often…'. 'Always' yoki 'never' desa — javob hisoblanmaydi, savol qaytadan beriladi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (How often? Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani yumshatib aytadi: 'Most of my classmates tend to…'.

items.t: …tends to drink sugary drinks more than twice a week.
items.q: Do you tend to drink sugary drinks more than twice a week?

items.t: …often skips breakfast before school or work.
items.q: Do you often skip breakfast before school or work?

items.t: …usually reads the nutrition label before buying food.
items.q: Do you usually read the nutrition label before buying food?

items.t: …has changed his/her opinion after reading new evidence.
items.q: Have you ever changed your opinion after reading new evidence?

items.t: …hardly ever uses a phone after midnight.
items.q: How often do you use your phone after midnight?

items.t: …thinks a tax on fast food is likely to work.
items.q: Do you think a tax on fast food is likely to work?

items.t: …has cooked a healthy meal for the family this week.
items.q: Have you cooked a healthy meal for your family this week?

items.t: …tends to study better in the evening than in the morning.
items.q: Do you tend to study better in the evening than in the morning?

items.t: …believes most advertising is aimed at young people.
items.q: Do you believe most advertising is aimed at young people?

items.t: …has used the word 'always' in an essay this month.
items.q: Have you used the word 'always' in an essay this month?

items.t: …usually walks or cycles to school or work.
items.q: Do you usually walk or cycle to school or work?

items.t: …has tried to cut down on sugar this year.
items.q: Have you tried to cut down on sugar this year?

45.title: Speaking cards: careful claims, clear opinions
45.stage: Namuna essay tahlilidan keyin, mavzu bo'yicha gapirish (Speaking Part 1/3, 12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Ovqatlanish, sog'liq va odatlar mavzusida Part 1/3 savollariga javob berish: fikr aniq (In my view…), tashqi dunyo haqidagi da'volar yumshatilgan (tend to, many, may, particularly in…).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–5 gap bilan javob beradi: bitta aniq fikr (I believe / In my view) va kamida 2 ta yumshatish vositasi.
Tinglovchi hisoblaydi: har bir yumshatish vositasi +1 ball, har bir mutlaq so'z (all, always, never, everyone, nobody) -1 ball.
Javobda umuman aniq fikr bo'lmasa (faqat 'It depends') — -1 ball: pozitsiya yo'qolmasin.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you usually eat breakfast? Why or why not?
How often do you eat fast food? Is it popular among your friends?
Do young people in Uzbekistan tend to cook at home or eat out? Why?
Do you read nutrition labels when you buy food? Why or why not?
Why do people often believe things without checking the evidence?
Is it fair to say that all teenagers spend too much time online? Why?
Should governments tax sugary drinks? Who might suffer from such a tax?
Why is fresh food more expensive than processed food in some places?
Do adults and children tend to have different eating habits? In what ways?
Is advertising one of the main reasons why children want sweets? Explain.
Why do people sometimes make general statements about a whole generation?
Which is more effective for public health: taxes or education campaigns?
How have the eating habits in your family changed in the last ten years?
When is it better to give a clear opinion rather than a careful one?

45.title: Sentence Race: hedged and qualified claims
45.stage: 'Zaxira' bosqichida yoki 'Xulosa va uyga vazifa'dan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Yumshatilgan va doirasi ko'rsatilgan da'vo gaplarida so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: tend to, are likely to, appear to, one of the main, particularly in, In my view.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi. Katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gapdagi yumshatish vositasini yoki doirani aytib bersa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Teenagers tend to buy snacks that are high in sugar.
Higher prices are likely to reduce consumption among teenagers.
Several studies suggest that green spaces reduce stress in cities.
Social media is one of the main reasons for poor sleep.
Relatively few young people read printed newspapers.
Online lessons appear to suit older students better.
Fresh food can be expensive, particularly in winter.
In most large cities, traffic congestion tends to increase every year.
Advertising alone rarely explains children's food choices.
In my view, sugar taxes should be part of the solution.

45.title: Quiz Board: stop overgeneralising
45.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi darsning kirish bosqichi o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
45.goal: Darsni o'yin shaklida takrorlash: mutlaq so'zlarni almashtirish, xavfli/xavfsiz gapni ajratish, yumshatish vositalari shaklidagi xatoni tuzatish va og'zaki yumshatilgan da'vo tuzish.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Risky or safe? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Risky or safe?' bo'limida sabab ham aytilishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida namuna javob — misol; fikr saqlangan va mutlaq so'zsiz har qanday to'g'ri gap qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Softer word for 'all'?
Softer word for 'never'?
Which shows evidence-based caution: 'appear to' or 'must'?
Replace: 'Everyone knows that…'
qs.a: It is widely believed / often argued that…

qs.q: Soften both absolutes: 'All children always eat too much sugar.'
qs.a: e.g. Many children often eat too much sugar.

qs.q: 'Most students find exams stressful.'
'Everybody agrees that school uniforms are useless.'
'In many countries, rents have risen sharply.'
qs.a: Safe — the scope is shown: 'in many countries'.

qs.q: 'Any fine will immediately stop littering.'
'I believe sugar taxes are useful.' Should this position be hedged?
qs.a: No — it is your opinion; keep it clear.

qs.q: Young people tends to sleep late.
qs.a: Young people tend to sleep late.

qs.q: Prices are likely rise next year.
qs.a: Prices are likely to rise next year.

qs.q: A number of city has banned plastic bags.
qs.a: A number of cities have banned plastic bags.

qs.q: Screen time appear to affect teenagers' sleep.
qs.a: Screen time appears to affect teenagers' sleep.

qs.q: Maybe perhaps it could possibly work.
qs.a: It may work. (one hedge is enough)

qs.q: Make a claim about teenagers with 'tend to'.
qs.a: e.g. Teenagers tend to stay up late.

qs.q: Soften: 'Smartphones ruin children's eyes.'
qs.a: e.g. Heavy smartphone use may harm children's eyesight.

qs.q: Add WHO and WHERE: 'Cycling is dangerous.'
qs.a: e.g. Cycling can be dangerous for children in busy cities.

qs.q: Give your clear opinion on sugar taxes in one sentence.
qs.a: e.g. In my view, sugar taxes are a useful first step.

qs.q: Rewrite without losing the idea: 'Exams never show real ability.'
qs.a: e.g. Exams alone rarely show a student's full ability.

46.title: Language Auction: topic collocations for Task 2
46.stage: 3-mashq (katta so'z tuzog'i)dan keyin — birikma xatolarini mustahkamlash (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
46.goal: Task 2 mavzu lug'atidagi birikma (chunk) xatolarini topish: pay attention, do harm, invest in, teach (learn emas), long waiting lists, congestion (sanalmaydi) — to'g'ri chunklarni ajratish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: birikma to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi. Faqat bitta so'z almashtiriladi: fe'l (make -> pay/do, learn -> teach), predlog (to -> in), sifat (tall -> long) yoki so'z shakli (congestions -> congestion).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Governments should make more attention to road safety.
items.fix: Governments should pay more attention to road safety.
items.why: 'pay attention to' — tayyor birikma; 'make attention' deyilmaydi.

items.s: Recycling schemes can reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill.
items.why: 'reduce the amount of waste' — aniq va tabiiy birikma.

items.s: Many cities suffer from severe traffic congestions.
items.fix: Many cities suffer from severe traffic congestion.
items.why: 'congestion' sanalmaydigan ot — -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: The campaign aims to raise public awareness of healthy eating.
items.why: 'raise public awareness of' — sog'liq mavzusining asosiy chunki.

items.s: Overstretched hospitals often have tall waiting lists.
items.fix: Overstretched hospitals often have long waiting lists.
items.why: Navbat ro'yxati 'long' bo'ladi: long waiting lists.

items.s: Screen addiction is becoming a serious concern among teenagers.
items.why: 'a serious concern among' — texnologiya mavzusidagi tayyor ifoda.

items.s: The government should invest more money to public transport.
items.fix: The government should invest more money in public transport.
items.why: 'invest (money) in' — predlog 'in', 'to' emas.

items.s: Longer life expectancy puts extra pressure on health services.
items.why: 'put pressure on' — to'g'ri fe'l + predlog birikmasi.

items.s: Schools should learn children how to use technology safely.
items.fix: Schools should teach children how to use technology safely.
items.why: Boshqaga o'rgatish — 'teach'; 'learn' — o'zi o'rganmoq.

items.s: Heavy traffic is a major source of air pollution in cities.
items.why: 'a major source of air pollution' — muhit mavzusidagi aniq chunk.

items.s: Smoking makes a lot of harm to people's health.
items.fix: Smoking does a lot of harm to people's health.
items.why: 'do harm' — 'make harm' deyilmaydi.

items.s: Tax incentives can encourage companies to hire young workers.
items.why: 'tax incentives' + 'encourage sb to do' — ish va hukumat chunki.

46.title: Board Game: vague to precise
46.stage: 4-mashq (mavzu lug'at banki) tugagach, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
46.goal: Beshta mavzu oilasi (ta'lim, muhit, texnologiya, sog'liq, ish va hukumat) chunklarini og'zaki ishlatish; noaniq gapni aniq qilish; sinonim bilan takrordan qochish; katta so'z tuzog'ini ko'rish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq ibora yoki gap aytadi.
Guruh tekshiradi: ibora chunk holida aytildimi (yakka so'z emas) va gap aniq bo'ldimi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
'Make it precise' kataklarida 'very', 'bad', 'good', 'a lot of' so'zlari ishlatilmaydi — ishlatilsa, o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi 20–30 soniya gapiradi va kamida 2 ta mavzu chunki ishlatadi.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Give two synonyms for 'problem'.
squares.a: issue, drawback, challenge

squares.t: Give two synonyms for 'important'.
squares.a: significant, crucial, decisive

squares.t: Name 3 words for the topic 'Environment'.
squares.a: e.g. deforestation, emissions, renewable energy

squares.t: Make it precise: 'Cars are bad for cities.'
squares.a: e.g. Private cars cause traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.

squares.t: Choose: make or do an investment?
squares.a: make an investment

squares.t: Choose: make or do harm?
squares.a: do harm (e.g. do a lot of harm)

squares.t: Name a problem, a solution and a result for Health.
squares.a: e.g. obesity / subsidised sports facilities / lower treatment costs

squares.t: Make it precise: 'Phones are bad for kids.'
squares.a: e.g. Heavy phone use can disturb children's sleep and concentration.

squares.t: What is a 'chunk'? Give an example.
squares.a: A ready word group, e.g. 'to ease the pressure on hospitals'.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: a problem in your city. Use 2 topic chunks.
squares.a: e.g. My city suffers from traffic congestion and poor air quality…

squares.t: Fix the big word: 'The state must obliterate unemployment.'
squares.a: The state must tackle / reduce unemployment.

squares.a: sedentary

squares.t: Give two result chunks for the Environment.
squares.a: e.g. cleaner air, lower fuel costs

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: How can youth unemployment be reduced? Use 3 chunks.

46.title: Dominoes: vague phrase to precise topic chunk

47.title: Collocation Auction: transport and historic centres
47.stage: 'Xato collocationni tuzatish' (2-mashq) dan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
47.goal: Shahar transporti va tarixiy markazlar haqidagi gaplarda begona collocationni (strong problem, take an action, make a role, do decisions, high traffic, make damage) topish va to'g'ri juftlik bilan almashtirish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gapdagi so'z juftligi (collocation) tabiiymi yoki begona?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin to'g'ri juftlikni to'liq aytishi shart (masalan: 'play a role', 'take action', 'heavy traffic').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa). Tuzatilgan juftliklar Collocation daftariga yoziladi.

items.s: Heavy traffic in the city centre costs commuters several hours every week.
items.why: heavy traffic — sifat + ot: tirbandlik 'heavy' bilan yuradi.

items.s: Air pollution has become a strong problem in Tashkent in winter.
items.fix: Air pollution has become a serious problem in Tashkent in winter.
items.why: 'strong' muammoga ishlatilmaydi: a serious / major problem.

items.s: Cheaper tickets would encourage more people to use the metro.
items.why: encourage + kishi + to + V1: encourage people to use.

items.s: The government must take an action to reduce congestion in the centre.
items.fix: The government must take action to reduce congestion in the centre.
items.why: take action — artiklsiz o'zgarmas ibora ('take an action' xato).

items.s: Tourism makes a key role in the economy of Samarkand.
items.fix: Tourism plays a key role in the economy of Samarkand.
items.why: Rol 'play' bilan yuradi: play a key role ('make a role' yo'q).

items.s: Neglect can cause irreversible damage to historic buildings in Bukhara.
items.why: cause damage (fe'l + ot) va irreversible damage (sifat + ot) — tabiiy juftliklar.

items.s: Every year the council has to do difficult decisions about its budget.
items.fix: Every year the council has to make difficult decisions about its budget.
items.why: Qaror 'make' bilan: make a decision ('do a decision' yo'q).

items.s: The city has drawn up a ten-year plan to improve its bus network.
items.why: draw up a plan — reja tuzmoq; to'g'ri fe'l + ot juftligi.

items.s: There is high traffic on the ring road between eight and nine.
items.fix: There is heavy traffic on the ring road between eight and nine.
items.why: traffic 'heavy' bilan yuradi: heavy traffic ('high traffic' begona).

items.s: Restoring the old quarter could generate considerable revenue from tourism.
items.why: generate revenue — daromad keltirmoq; considerable revenue — sezilarli daromad.

items.s: Vibration from lorries can make damage to the old city walls.
items.fix: Vibration from lorries can cause damage to the old city walls.
items.why: Zarar 'cause' yoki 'do' bilan: cause damage to ('make damage' yo'q).

items.s: A social media campaign helped to raise awareness of air pollution.
items.why: raise awareness — to'g'ri ('rise' o'timsiz fe'l, obyekt olmaydi).

47.title: Board Game: find the partner word
47.stage: 5-mashq (zaif gapni kuchaytirish) dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.

FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Heavy traffic brings the ring road to a standstill.

Wrong collocations lower your Lexical Resource score.

47.title: Quiz Board: collocations for Task 2

47.goal: Collocation turlari, sherik so'zni topish, begona juftlikni tuzatish va og'zaki gap tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Find the partner 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What is a collocation?
qs.a: Words that naturally go together, e.g. make a mistake

qs.q: Which type is 'heavy traffic': verb + noun, adjective + noun or noun + noun?
A wrong collocation lowers which criterion: Lexical Resource or Grammatical Range?
Which type is 'government funding'?
Which type is 'public transport', and why?
___ a mistake (do / make)
___ a role (make / play)
___ attention to (pay / make)
___ research (make / carry out)
Give TWO verbs that go with 'revenue'.
qs.a: e.g. generate, raise, earn, bring in
