48.title: Language Auction: two views and your opinion
48.stage: 'Ikki qarash va pozitsiya tili' (4-mashq) dan keyin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
48.goal: Muzeylarga kirish haqi mavzusidagi 'Discuss both views' gaplarida Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: pozitsiyasiz xulosa, 'In my opinion, I think', Although … but, despite of, people believes, mutlaq da'vo, role on.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap Band 7 essayga yarasha to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi; qaysi mezon ball yo'qotishini ham to'g'ri aytsa (TR, CC, LR yoki GRA — kalitda) yana +50.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Supporters of free entry argue that ticket prices decide who visits museums.
items.why: 'Supporters of X argue that…' — birinchi qarashni kiritish uchun tayyor qolip.

items.s: Some people believes that museums should charge an admission fee.
items.fix: Some people believe that museums should charge an admission fee.
items.why: people — ko'plik: believe (-s qo'shilmaydi). GRA.

items.s: In my opinion, I think museums should be free for everyone.
items.fix: In my opinion, museums should be free for everyone.
items.why: 'In my opinion' va 'I think' bir xil ma'no — bittasini olib tashlang. LR (ortiqcha takror).

items.s: Opponents of free entry, however, point to the high cost of maintenance.
items.why: 'however' gap ichida — CC uchun kuchli; point to — ko'rsatib o'tmoq.

items.s: Although free entry attracts more visitors, but it reduces income.
items.fix: Although free entry attracts more visitors, it reduces income.
items.why: Although va but bitta gapda birga ishlatilmaydi. GRA.

items.s: I would argue that school groups should be able to visit museums for free.
items.why: Pozitsiya aniq va rasmiy: I would argue that…

items.s: Free entry always doubles the number of visitors to a museum.
items.fix: Free entry can double the number of visitors to a museum.
items.why: Mutlaq da'vo (always) isbotsiz — yumshating: can / tends to. TR (over-generalise).

items.s: To my mind, both aims can be met if visitors pay only for special exhibitions.
items.why: Shartli murosa: qachon bepul, qachon pullik — bu aniq pozitsiya.

items.s: Despite of the cost, many families visit the history museum every month.
items.fix: Despite the cost, many families visit the history museum every month.
items.why: despite — predlogsiz: despite + ot ('despite of' yo'q). GRA.

items.s: In conclusion, both views have their own advantages and disadvantages.
items.fix: In conclusion, I believe that basic entry to museums should remain free.
items.why: Pozitsiya yo'q — xulosada aniq fikr bo'lmasa TR 5.0 ga tushadi. TR.

items.s: A small fee can help museums repair their buildings and protect their collections.
items.why: can — yumshatilgan da'vo; help + kimdir + V1 to'g'ri.

items.s: Museums play an important role on the education of children.
items.fix: Museums play an important role in the education of children.
items.why: play a role IN something ('on' emas). LR.

48.title: Board Game: Discuss both views — course review
48.stage: 'Ikki halokatli xato' (3-mashq) dan keyin yoki takror darsida — butun kurs takrori (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
48.goal: 'Discuss both views and give your own opinion' talablarini, 4 xatboshili tuzilmani, pozitsiya tilini, paraphrase va 4 mezonni og'zaki takrorlash; muzeylar mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase qiladi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato javob — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Fikr so'ralgan kataklarda (masalan, 'should museums be free?') pozitsiya iborasi (In my view…, I would argue that…) ishlatilmasa, javob qabul qilinmaydi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many commands are in 'Discuss both views and give your own opinion'?
squares.a: Two: discuss both views AND give your own opinion.

squares.t: Name the 4 Writing criteria.
squares.a: Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy

squares.t: How many paragraphs are in the safest structure?
squares.a: Four: introduction, view A, view B, conclusion.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'free to enter'
squares.a: e.g. open without charge / free of charge / free admission

squares.t: Say a phrase to give your opinion (not 'I think').
squares.a: e.g. In my view… / I would argue that… / To my mind…

squares.t: How many words should you aim for?
squares.a: About 260–300 (never fewer than 250).

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about the last museum you visited.
squares.a: e.g. Last year I visited the Amir Timur Museum in Tashkent…

squares.t: Where must your opinion appear?
squares.a: In the introduction AND in the conclusion — the same position.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'pay for admission'
squares.a: e.g. buy a ticket / pay an entrance fee

squares.t: Say a phrase to introduce a view you disagree with.
squares.a: e.g. Supporters of X argue that… / Those in favour of X claim that…

squares.t: Correct: In my opinion, I think tickets are fair.
squares.a: In my opinion, tickets are fair. (or: I think tickets are fair.)

squares.t: The essay gives no clear opinion. What happens to Task Response?
squares.a: It falls to about 5.0.

squares.t: Which view usually goes in paragraph 2?
squares.a: The view you do NOT agree with; your own view comes last.

squares.t: Why is 'Both views are good' not a position?
squares.a: It takes no side and gives no condition, so the examiner sees no opinion.

squares.t: Give a conditional compromise on museum tickets.
squares.a: e.g. Permanent collections free; special exhibitions paid.

squares.t: What must each body paragraph contain?
squares.a: A main idea, a reason and an example or result.

squares.t: Say 2 other words for 'museums' to avoid repetition.
squares.a: e.g. these institutions, galleries, heritage sites

squares.t: Why is starting every paragraph with 'Firstly / Secondly' weak?
squares.a: It is mechanical (CC about 6.0); use linkers inside sentences too.

squares.t: Can you add a new argument in the conclusion?
squares.a: No — the conclusion only restates and briefly justifies your position.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should museums be free? Give a reason.
squares.a: e.g. In my view, yes, because ticket prices keep poorer families away.

squares.t: Give an example to support 'ticket income is useful'.
squares.a: e.g. Ticket money can pay to repair a leaking roof quickly.

squares.t: Intro says 'free entry', conclusion says 'tickets'. What's wrong?
squares.a: Unclear position — TR falls to about 5.0; make both say the same.

squares.t: View A gets 8 sentences, view B gets only 2. What's wrong?
squares.a: The views are not balanced; one view is not fully addressed, so TR falls.

squares.t: Say an introduction sentence with your position on museum fees.
squares.a: e.g. In my view, basic entry should be free, while special exhibitions carry a charge.

48.title: Dominoes: claim and supporting example
48.stage: 'Eng xavfsiz tuzilma' (2-mashq) dan keyin — har qarashga misol topish (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
48.goal: Har qarashni 'fikr + misol' bilan ochishni mashq qilish: da'voga (claim) aynan uni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan misolni topish; kursdagi mavzular (meros, transport, ta'lim, texnologiya, atrof-muhit, ish) takrorlanadi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida da'vo (claim) yozilgan: shu da'voni isbotlaydigan misol yozilgan toshni topib ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi: 'Claim… For example, …' shaklida, 'For example' ni qo'shib.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Free entry widens access to culture.
Families on low incomes can visit every weekend.
A fee can pay for mending a leaking palace roof.
One full bus takes dozens of cars off the road.
Nobody has to cross the city to attend a lecture.
Potters and weavers in Bukhara sell to visitors.
Customers stop visiting shops on jammed streets.
Pupils check messages instead of listening.
Bottles pile up along riverbanks after picnics.
Working from home can cause loneliness.
Some staff go days without talking to a colleague.
Daily PE lessons help children stay fit.
Students learn to share tasks and settle arguments.
Seeing a real ancient coin makes a lesson memorable.
International firms in Tashkent seek English speakers.
Fast food harms young people's health.
Burgers and fizzy drinks are full of sugar and fat.

48.title: Taboo: museums, heritage and essay words
48.stage: 'Kirish va kurs xulosasi' bosqichida — mavzu va essay atamalarini takrorlash (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
48.goal: Muzey va madaniy meros mavzusidagi so'zlarni hamda Task 2 atamalarini (introduction, conclusion, paraphrase, examiner, compromise) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

48.title: Find someone who… has visited a museum this year
48.stage: 'Essayni 4 mezon bo'yicha baholash' dan keyin — uzoq o'tirishdan so'ng harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
48.goal: Muzeylar, tarixiy joylar va essay yozish odatlari haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va javobni asoslash.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you visited a museum this year?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va 'Why?' yoki 'What was it like?' deb bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va bitta natijani 'In my view…' bilan izohlab sinfga aytadi.

items.t: …has visited a museum this year.
items.q: Have you visited a museum this year?

items.t: …has paid for a ticket to an exhibition.
items.q: Have you ever paid for a ticket to an exhibition?

items.t: …has written a full Task 2 essay in 40 minutes.
items.q: Have you ever written a full Task 2 essay in 40 minutes?

items.q: Do you always write a plan before writing an essay?

items.q: Have you ever walked around Itchan Kala in Khiva?

items.t: …has changed their opinion after a debate.
items.q: Have you ever changed your opinion after a debate?

items.q: Can you name the four IELTS Writing criteria?

items.t: …would donate money to repair a historic building.
items.q: Would you donate money to repair a historic building?

items.t: …has taken a guided tour of a museum.
items.q: Have you ever taken a guided tour of a museum?

items.t: …checks their essays for repeated words.
items.q: Do you check your essays for repeated words?

items.t: …prefers museums to shopping centres.
items.q: Do you prefer museums to shopping centres?

48.title: Speaking cards: museums, heritage and both views
48.stage: 'Nega aynan shu ball' (2–3-topshiriq) dan keyin, 5-mashqdan oldin — og'zaki 'ikki qarash + fikr' (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
48.goal: Muzeylar va madaniy meros bo'yicha javob berish; 'Discuss' kartalarida ikki qarashni teng aytib, so'ng aniq pozitsiya bildirish (In my view…, I would argue that…).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi. Savolda ikki tomon bo'lsa: 1-gap — A qarash, 2-gap — B qarash, 3-gap — o'z fikri (In my view… / To my mind…).
Ikki tomonli kartada: ikkala qarash aytildi (+1), pozitsiya aniq (+1), 'Both are good' bilan tugamadi (+1). Oddiy kartada: 3 gap + sabab (+1).
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy visiting museums? Why / why not?
When did you last visit a historic place? What did you see there?
Should museums be free for everyone? Give both sides, then your own view.
Who should pay to protect historic buildings: the state, visitors or private sponsors?
Are museums still important now that we can find everything online?
Would you pay extra for a guided tour? Why / why not?
Some say tourists damage old cities; others say they save them. What is your view?
Should schools take pupils to museums regularly? Why?

How can museums attract more young visitors?
Can virtual tours replace real visits to museums? Why / why not?
Some want free entry; others accept a fee for better services. What is your view?
What is the most useful thing you have learnt in this Writing course? Why?

48.title: Sentence Race: views, positions and rules
48.stage: 'Xulosa va uyga vazifa'dan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
48.goal: Qarashni kiritish, pozitsiya va xulosa gaplarini hamda essay qoidalarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida yig'ish (Supporters of … argue that, In my view, To conclude, I would argue that).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap essayning qaysi xatboshisiga tegishli ekanini aytsa yana +1 ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Supporters of free entry argue that ticket prices exclude poorer families.

Opponents of free entry stress that old buildings are expensive to maintain.
To conclude, both arguments have merit, but free access matters more.
Without a clear position, Task Response cannot go above 5.0.
A view without an example is insufficiently developed.
I would argue that museum tickets should be cheaper for students.
Both views should be discussed in equal detail.
Free entry helps young people build a habit of visiting museums.

48.title: Quiz Board: Discuss both views — final review
48.stage: Kursning yakuniy takrori — dars oxirida yoki alohida takror darsida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
48.goal: Tuzilma, pozitsiya tili, grammatik xatolar va og'zaki 'ikki qarash + fikr' ni o'yin shaklida takrorlash — butun Writing Task 2 kursi bo'yicha.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Structure 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many paragraphs are in the safest structure?
